f8252681.title: Relationship Engagement Manager, Team Lead, Bangalore, India
f8252681.description:
**Location: Bangalore, India**  
**Experience: 8–12 years**  
**Industry: Consulting, Staffing, Professional Services**  
**Mode: Onsite – 5 days working from Bangalore office**

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced Relationship Engagement & Vendor Manager to manage end-to-end consultant lifecycle operations while also acting as a key point of contact for client relationships in India and the UK.

**This hybrid role combines:**

* Consultant lifecycle ownership
* Vendor & client management
* Contract extension & negotiation
* Relationship engagement
* Legal & contract coordination
* Service delivery & account support

You will work closely with client stakeholders, consultants deployed at client sites, internal leadership, and the legal/commercial teams to ensure smooth operations, contract continuity, and a superior consultant experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Consultant Lifecycle Management**

* Manage the full consultant lifecycle: onboarding, deployment, confirmation, extension, and exit
* Coordinate offer letters, contracts, onboarding documents, and induction
* Ensure timely background verification and joining formalities
* Track consultant performance, attendance, timesheets, and project milestones

**2. Client & Vendor Relationship Management (India + UK)**

* Act as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders and vendor partners
* Build strong working relationships with project leads, hiring managers, procurement, and vendor teams
* Conduct regular cadence calls and feedback sessions with both clients and consultants
* Collaborate with clients to identify upcoming needs and opportunities

**3. Contract Extensions & Commercial Coordination**

* Drive contract extensions by proactively engaging clients and consultants
* Manage contract negotiations and commercial terms with clients
* Coordinate with internal legal teams for contract reviews, renewals, and documentation
* Ensure adherence to compliance, legal, and contractual obligations

**4. Operations & Service Delivery**

* Ensure seamless service delivery and consultant performance
* Work across procurement tools and vendor management platforms (Beeline, Fieldglass, PRO)
* Maintain accurate consultant records, trackers, and operational dashboards
* Support account teams in addressing operational issues, escalations, or delays

**5. Compliance & Documentation**

* Ensure compliance with statutory requirements (PF, ESIC, Gratuity, Shops & Establishment, etc.)
* Maintain audit-ready documentation and consultant records
* Coordinate with compliance, finance, and legal teams for updates and filings

**6. Payroll & Timesheet Coordination**

* Liaise with payroll & finance teams to ensure timely salary disbursal
* Track timesheets, client approvals, and billing cycles
* Resolve discrepancies related to pay, attendance, invoicing, or client approvals

**7. Consultant Engagement & HR Support**

* Conduct regular engagement check-ins and welfare calls
* Address consultant grievances, concerns, and escalations promptly
* Drive retention, motivation, and long-term consultant success
* Run engagement initiatives and communication programs

**8. Reporting & Stakeholder Communication**

* Prepare MIS reports, consultant dashboards, extension trackers, and status reports
* Provide timely updates to internal leadership and account managers
* Support client audits and business reviews

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree; MBA/PGDM in HR or related field preferred
* 7–12 years of experience in consulting, staffing, HR operations, account management, or vendor management
* Experience supporting UK or Europe-based clients (preferred)
* Strong understanding of consultant lifecycle, contracts, and compliance
* Familiarity with vendor management platforms (Beeline, Fieldglass, PRO, etc.)
* Strong English communication skills (verbal & written)

**Key Competencies**

* Excellent relationship-building & stakeholder management
* Strong negotiation & commercial awareness
* Solution-oriented mindset with high ownership
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and consultants simultaneously
* Strong organisational skills with attention to detail
* Empathy, professionalism & proactive communication
* Comfort in a fast-paced, dynamic consulting environment

**We empower companies with high-end IT services**

emagine is a high-end business, engineering & IT consulting company. Enabled by an extensive network of experts, emagine powers progress, solves challenges and delivers real results through tailored high-end consulting services. emagine is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with departments in France, Germany, Ireland, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Sweden, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates as well as India. Over the last couple of years, the company has grown extensively, increasing its international footprint to become one of the biggest consultancies in its segment in Europe and beyond. emagine A/S is owned by private equity company Axcel and a group of senior staff and board members.

**Are you our new colleague?**

At emagine, we value diversity immensely. Both when it comes to backgrounds and competences, but also in relation to personality and individual ambition. We are a diverse and well-rounded group made up of experienced specialists, generalists, recent graduates and self-taught people. We are generally curious, helpful and happy to share knowledge with our colleagues.

We are proud of our values that are based on honesty, kindness, helpfulness and solidarity. We nurture a strong community culture, where cooperation is paramount – not just locally but also across borders with our international departments. Only in unison can we provide the best service to our clients and affiliated consultants – and that is our goal. As an employee of emagine, you will experience a close-knit culture in which people stand side by side and where there is an emphasis on building close relationships. Going to work must be a fun and enriching experience yet still provide a challenge. That is why we take several steps to ensure that work is motivating and engaging. Finally, we also strive to create the right conditions for physical and mental wellbeing.

**Want to know more about what it is like to work at emagine?**

Visit our Instagram to get a better idea of who we are or get in contact with our HR department.

ef6ea3e9.title: Management Consulting Engagement Manager, VP
ef6ea3e9.description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**In Scope of Position based Promotions**

  

**Job Title: Management Consulting Engagement Manager, VP**

**Location: Mumbai, India**

**Corporate Title: VP**

**Role Description**

* **You will be joining Deutsche Bank Management Consulting (DBMC), the Bank’s in-house management consulting global team that partners with senior leaders to actively contribute to the bank’s strategic objectives. DBMC connects strategy to execution with measurable outcomes. Our role is to support the bank’s transformation journey, helping to define and operationalize its key priorities. To achieve this, we collaborate with business divisions and infrastructure functions across Deutsche Bank’s global platform.**
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Our Engagements cover a wide range of topics including strategic growth initiatives, product development, process optimization, risk and regulatory transformation, generative AI adoption, as well as organizational / operating model design. This provides our team with broad exposure to the bank’s key priorities, diverse topics, and the opportunity to work with senior clients.
* We are a dynamic and highly motivated team with a global presence, operating from offices in Frankfurt, London, and Mumbai. You will work in a multicultural team, regularly collaborating with international colleagues across different regions.
Our team members are academically and professionally accomplished, with degrees from leading global universities and backgrounds not limited to business/finance. We take pride in being an inclusive and collaborative group of professionals who celebrate and support one another  

  

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy

* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Lead and deliver end-to-end project modules across business and infrastructure functions, applying structured problem-solving methodologies, clearly defining situation, complication, and decision points
* Lead and develop project teams by setting clear expectations, managing team performance, allocating responsibilities effectively, and providing regular coaching and constructive feedback to support individual development and high-quality project delivery
* Take ownership for the conceptual planning and implementation of strategic projects
* Formulate feasible tactical and strategic recommendations, ensuring alignment with Deutsche Bank’s strategic priorities, governance standards, and regulatory context.
* Drive hypothesis led, advanced analytics to generate robust insights and evidence based recommendations and translate findings into clear, decision oriented messages tailored to senior and audiences.
* Together with our AI experts, lead structured problem solving across strategic and transformation topics including opportunity sizing, operating model design and process improvement
* Translate business problems into AI use cases, including problem definition, target outcomes, user needs, business process redesign implications, feasibility considerations and prototyping Agents in our end-user development environment
* Act as a primary day‑to‑day client contact for assigned project modules; independently lead client meetings, workshops, and working sessions.
* Develop the necessary and appropriate structures and frameworks to aid robust analysis and development of solutions, ultimately to ensure positive outcomes and sustainable results
* Prepare high quality, insight driven materials for senior management, translating complex analysis into clear, compelling recommendations.
* Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for the project topic, demonstrating strong understanding of the topic and integrate this knowledge into project delivery and client discussions.
* Own and contribute to project knowledge resources to enable knowledge reuse, consistency, and capability building within DBMC.
* Supervise, coach, and quality‑assure the work of junior and senior consultants and ensure timely delivery of their outputs
* Own and drive strategic internal initiatives alongside client projects, in close collaboration with consulting teams across London, Frankfurt and Mumbai
* Flexibility to work across global time zones (European hours), as required for the project needs and stakeholder interactions.
* Act in line with the bank’s values & aspirational culture, contributing to an inclusive, collaborative, and high‑performance team environment.
Ensure awareness of and adherence to relevant bank policies, practices, governance, and control requirements, proactively flagging delivery, risk, or stakeholder concerns.  

**Your skills and experience**

We are looking for professionals with excellent academic performance across relevant disciplines), in all disciplines (Master's degree mandatory). Professional qualifications are important, but your personality is even more decisive to us.

* Minimum 10 years of relevant Consulting and Financial Services experience (Post MBA) across relevant Consulting, Financial Services, AI transformation or technology-enabled business deliv-ery (ideally in financial services) focusing on strategy, transformation & demonstrating prob-lem‑solving, structured thinking, and delivery ownership
* Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional strategy and transformation engagements end-to-end, from problem definition and workplan development through recommendation, stakeholder alignment and implementation.
* Proven experience leading and managing diverse teams with the ability to motivate team members to deliver complex project outcomes successfully
* Strong senior stakeholder management and executive advisory skills, with the ability to build credibility, challenge constructively and shape decisions with senior leaders across business and infrastructure functions.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity and independently structure complex business problems, develop hypotheses, evaluate strategic options and translate analysis into pragmatic, actionable recommendations.
* Strong commercial and business judgement, with experience developing and challenging business cases, assessing financial and non-financial impact, and evaluating trade-offs to inform management decisions.
* Ability to develop compelling executive-level narratives and decision materials, synthesising complex analysis into clear recommendations and communicating effectively with senior and Board-level audiences.
* Strong understanding of the Financial Services industry, including banking business models, operating models, key value drivers and the broader risk, regulatory and technology environment.
* Track record of translating strategy into execution, including designing target operating models, process improvements, governance structures, implementation roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to identify, anticipate and proactively manage project risks, dependencies and stakeholder challenges, escalating appropriately while maintaining accountability for delivery.
* Experience working effectively across functions, geographies and cultures, with the adaptability to engage different stakeholder groups and operate in complex organisational environments
* Conceptual and practical understanding of Generative AI, workflow automation or agentic workflows is beneficial. Software engineering experience is not required
* Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs
* Clear, confident communicator in English, capable of explaining and interpreting complex information to support stakeholder alignment and decision‑making; German language skills are an advantage.
* Commitment to continuous learning and development, Proven experience in coaching and developing junior professionals
Relevant internships, certifications, and entrepreneurial activities are also a plus  

  

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

**How we’ll support you**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career
* Coaching and support from experts in your team
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs  

**About us and our teams**

Please visit our company website for further information:

**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

cf2d3c7c.title: Senior Silicon Technical Program Manager
cf2d3c7c.description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission.

The Methodology, Infrastructure & Labs Engineering (MILE) team within SCHIE provides the engineering compute infrastructure, computer-aided design (CAD) flows and methods, and labs that Microsoft's silicon teams rely on to design and deliver custom chips. Our team at the India Development Center (IDC) supports two closely linked areas: CAD, which delivers the electronic design automation (EDA) tools, flows and methodologies used by silicon design teams, and Silicon Design Compute Services (SDCS), which runs the high-performance compute, cloud, job scheduling and storage environment those flows depend on, together with managed service partners. As our silicon roadmap grows, we need a Technical Program Manager to drive CAD and SDCS programs to delivery and bring financial rigor to this portfolio.

As a Technical Program Manager in MILE, you will lead technical programs across our CAD and SDCS portfolios and own budget planning and financial operations for them, so that Microsoft's silicon teams get the tools and compute they need, on time and at the right cost.

#SCHIE

 **Responsibilities**

* Lead CAD programs end to end, including EDA tool and flow rollouts, version upgrades, methodology changes and license capacity planning for silicon projects, defining scope, milestones, dependencies and success criteria with CAD engineers and design teams.

* Lead SDCS programs for silicon design-compute infrastructure, such as high-performance compute cluster expansions, cloud migration and burst capacity, job scheduler and storage upgrades, and capacity planning against silicon project demand.

* Run program governance across CAD and SDCS: maintain roadmaps, plans and risk and issue logs, drive quarterly planning and objectives and key results (OKRs), and communicate status, risks and decisions clearly to leadership.

* Own end-to-end budget planning, forecasting and tracking for EDA/CAD software licenses, emulation hardware and software, compute infrastructure and vendor services across OPEX, CAPEX and COGS, partnering with Finance on quarterly and annual planning cycles.

* Partner with silicon engineering teams, EDA vendors, Procurement, Finance and managed service providers to align on demand, contracts, purchase orders and service levels, and run regular business and service reviews.

* Support delivery and financial health across the CAD and SDCS portfolio: identify risks, variances and optimization opportunities, drive trade-off decisions with leadership, and represent the programs in planning and executive reviews.

* Define and report metrics for program delivery, spend versus forecast, license and compute utilization, and vendor SLA performance, using data and dashboards to improve cost efficiency, reliability and on-time execution.

 **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Required Qualifications Instruction: Qualifications must be pulled from the Role Library and cannot deviate from what is listed.

Bachelor's Degree AND 5+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.

* 4+ years experience in cloud Infrastructure, EDA, or CAD, including 2+ years as a project or program manager and a BS(BA) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Information Systems, a related field.

* Strong understanding of Agile concepts and proven experience applying them in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

* Proficiency with project management tools such as Azure DevOps(ADO), Microsoft Project, Jira, etc.

**Other Requirements:**

* Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to, the following specialized security screening:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check. This position is required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.

* This role will require access to information that is controlled for export under export control regulations, potentially under the U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations or Export Administration Regulations, the EU Dual Use Regulation, and/or other export control regulations. As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide either proof of their country of citizenship or proof of their U.S. permanent residency or other protected status (e.g., under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)) for assessment of eligibility to access the export-controlled information. To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate’s citizenship will be verified with a valid passport. Lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees may verify status using other documents, where applicable.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with budgeting, financial forecasting and spend management for engineering or IT infrastructure (OPEX/CAPEX), including working with Finance and Procurement on purchase orders and contracts.

* Experience managing EDA/CAD tool and flow deployments, or high-performance compute, job scheduler, storage or cloud infrastructure programs, ideally in a semiconductor design environment.

* Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly with leaders and influence global, cross-functional teams and external vendors without direct authority.

* Experience managing vendors or managed services (statements of work, service reviews, SLA tracking) and proficiency with Excel or Power BI for financial and program reporting.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

39d33a9c.title: Program Manager I, NOC Relay Ops
39d33a9c.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer-centric company? If so, meet Amazon.  
  
Over the past 20+ years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. Through our entrepreneurial culture, Amazon has developed new technologies and products (like Echo) and, enterprise services (like Amazon Web Services). APEX NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon's transportation network. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.  
Overall, Relay Ops plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.  
  
Responsibilities of Program Manager under Relay Ops/NOC  
We are looking for an experienced Program Manager to coordinate and lead efforts across operations, multiple technology and program teams. We're looking for a hands-on and motivated self-starter who's passionate about using data to help us measure every area of the business, drive efficiencies, optimizations and influence decision-making.  
  
A Program Manager is expected to have deep functional knowledge, ability to design new program frameworks/processes and running defect reduction programs. He should be proficient, in identifying the input and output metric to gauge the success of a program. In this role, he will work with business and operations team to analyze historic results, challenge status quo and make business recommendations to senior management based on those analyses – all in an environment of rapid growth and increasing complexity. The Program Manager will drive improvements to the reporting tools, methods, and processes utilized by the team to increase the availability and granularity of actionable data to internal and external partners.  
  
The successful candidate must have analytical skills and expert in excel. Knowledge of SQL and tools like R/Python would be an added advantage. He/she will be experienced at working with large data sets and the technical tools needed to work with them. He/she will have superb communication and customer-relationship skills, good analytic insight, and be a passionate advocate of operations team to other stakeholders. He/she will drive towards simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, have excellent project-management skills, and be able to communicate complex analytical results, both written and verbally, in a clear and easy-to-understand way.  
  
What are we really looking for?  

* You should be very analytical and be able to justify your decisions and approaches with data
* You should be able to deal with a high degree of ambiguity
* You should be able to take a complex problem and break it down to smaller digestible chunks
* You should be able to define a logical and step by step approach to achieving assigned goals
* You should be comfortable with processes and process design/analysis
* You should have the ability to influence without authority and do so by using data and facts
* You should be able to deal with varied stakeholders and earn their trust
* You are mature and able to function independently with limited guidance
* You should be willing to work in rotational shifts
* Languages proficiency (mandatory) – English.

  
Key job responsibilities  
The incumbent will own the following -  
1) They will be responsible for working with supply chain execution, transportation, FC, carriers and other Amazon teams to identify pain points and scope out large high impact projects  
2) They will be responsible for driving cost benefit analysis and go/no-go decisions on various initiatives  
3) Once a go decision is made, the program manager will work to evolve a plan and timeline for execution.  
4) The program manager will develop a roadmap and metrics to measure progress of the initiative they own. They will also own writing reports that detail the progress to leadership on a frequent basis  
5) They will liaise across functions to drive their project and help clear issues and bottlenecks.  
6) They will work with technology teams to scope out and drive any tech changes that are needed  
  
Other than this, the PM I is required to :  
A. Cost Reduction Strategy:  
(a) Develop and implement strategies to reduce costs in the transportation business  
(b) Analyze and optimize adhoc share, number of trips, and truck utilization  
(c) Participate in and contribute to WBR meetings with the core group  
  
B. Network Optimization:  
(a) Work on improving network design  
(b) Optimize NOC Governance Mechanism  
(c) Improve RLB adoption and truck utilization  
  
C. Forecasting and Scheduling:  
(a) Analyze and act on Frequent Adhoc & Frequent Cancellation (FAFC) trends  
(b) Optimize schedule capacity and reduce adhoc share  
  
D. Cost per Trip Reduction:  
(a) Address issues leading to increased cost per trip collaborate with all the miles to reduce unloading delays  
(b) Improve RLB conversion rates and manage manual adhoc rates  
  
E. Cross-functional Collaboration:  
(a) Work closely with FC, SC, EWH, and other teams to implement improvements  
(b) Coordinate with tech teams for necessary system enhancements  
(c) Manage stakeholder relationships and secure buy-in for new initiatives  
  
F. Data Analysis and Reporting:  
(a) Conduct cost-benefit analyses for proposed initiatives  
(b) Create and maintain performance dashboards  
(c) Provide regular updates on KPIs and project progress  
  
G. Continuous Improvement:  
(a) Identify new opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency improvement  
(b) Plan and execute pilot projects to test new ideas  
(c) Scale successful initiatives across the network  
  
This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, analytical skills, project management expertise, and cross-functional leadership to drive significant improvements in the linehaul network's efficiency and cost-effectiveness.  
  
About the team  
NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem-solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

05ba5a62.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, EU INTech DEX - Delivery Speed Tech
05ba5a62.description:
**Description**
Picture this: You're about to lead the team that decides whether a customer in London gets their package tomorrow or next week, whether a family in Madrid pays €5 or €15 for delivery, and whether someone in Luxembourg receives three boxes or one perfectly consolidated package. We're looking for an L6 Sr. Technical program Manager to join our Delivery Experience (DEX) team – think of it as mission control for Amazon EU's delivery operations, where your decisions ripple across millions of doorsteps every single day. You'll be the strategic mastermind behind our vision of high-speed, low-cost delivery for all EU customers, juggling the exciting challenge of making deliveries faster while simultaneously making them cheaper (yes, we know that sounds like magic, but that's why we need you!). This isn't just any Sr. TPM role – you're getting a front-row seat with the STeam, driving Stores' biggest bets in EU, and basically becoming the person everyone turns to when they ask "how do we crack the customer delivery experience?" Based in Bengaluru, you'll be working on problems so complex and impactful that your morning coffee conversations will involve optimizing networks across entire countries. Ready to turn delivery from a logistics challenge into a customer superpower?
  
  
You understand that a successful program needs to solve meaningful problems for our customers, for our business, and for our technology. You will work with engineers, designers, and our business teams to build a global marketplace product that expedites Amazon’s expansion worldwide.
  
  
**You Are a Good Fit If**

* You can raise the bar on customer-obsessed thinking – at a global scale.
* You are strategic thinker with a strong focus on delivery on strategy and tech
* You communicate your ideas boldly and vision to all levels of the company – both verbally and in writing.
* You align stakeholders on your roadmap
* You thrive on data - a statement that is not supported by data is just another opinion.
* You are brave, have persistence and grit, never hesitate to challenge the status quo.
* You are curious, can dive into technical detail, and ask engineers insightful questions about the services and systems you influence.
* You are a self-starter who is able to work in an environment of high complexity and ambiguity.
* You think long-term, can balance diverse and conflicting customer needs, and converge on outcomes that earn customer loyalty.
* You break down the big picture into actionable goals and deliver them.

Key job responsibilities
  
  
**You Will Be Responsible For**

* You will own delivery and roadmap for 20+ HC team.
* Articulating tech vision and value proposition for Amazon’s worldwide marketplace expansion.
* Working backwards from the customers around the globe to build, manage, and deliver a technical marketplace expansion roadmap.
* Working with Amazon EU businesses around the globe to define solutions for Amazon’s worldwide marketplace expansions in the different regions.
* Influencing technical priorities and business strategy through data-driven contributions, working directly with business stakeholders, engineering managers, engineers, and designers.
* Driving product discussions as well as commissioning market research, usability studies, and focus groups.
* Developing product plans with clear measurable success criteria, using mechanisms and metrics for KPIs, funnels, conversion, and awareness.
* Supporting branding and marketing of your team and programs.

A day in the life
  
  
Successful applicants will have experience solid delivery, leading cross-functional teams, and communicating to a large number of diverse stakeholders.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

c09873a2.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
  
  
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

**An Overview Of This Role**
As a Technical Program Manager on GitLab's all-remote R&D PMO team, you will own complex, end-to-end programs that are central to our AI-powered DevSecOps strategy. You will drive high-priority initiatives across product, engineering, data, and security teams, transforming strategic vision into executable plans that deliver innovative capabilities like the GitLab Duo Agent Platform and next-generation developer tools. You will work closely with executive leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, serving as the bridge between strategy and execution through clear communication, proactive risk management, and structured program delivery. In your first year, you will independently lead strategic programs, driving predictable execution, thoughtful tradeoffs between quality and speed, and transparent stakeholder alignment.
  
  
**Some Examples Of Our Projects**

* Leading the GitLab Duo Agent Platform from GA through enterprise adoption, including customer onboarding, support models, and billing integration for AI-driven capabilities
* Delivering data-intensive platform initiatives that enhance developer productivity and enterprise analytics capabilities
* Driving infrastructure modernization and scalability programs that support our growing customer base
* Orchestrating security and compliance initiatives that maintain our industry-leading DevSecOps standards

**What You Will Do**

* Lead end-to-end technical programs across product, engineering, data, and security, from initial scope through launch and continuous improvement
* Collaborate closely with executive leaders and senior stakeholders to translate strategic vision into actionable roadmaps and align on priorities and tradeoffs
* Coordinate distributed teams across time zones using strong asynchronous communication, providing structure, clarity, and consistent status updates
* Develop and maintain comprehensive program plans, proactively identifying and mitigating risks and dependencies while facilitating decisions that balance speed, quality, and customer impact
* Partner with customer success and cross-functional teams to refine communication plans, and operational workflows
* Champion GitLab's values and culture within programs, fostering collaborative excellence, continuous improvement, and innovation
* Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

**What You Will Bring**

* Proven experience leading technical program initiatives in product, engineering, data, or security environments, with demonstrated success delivering complex programs from inception through scaled adoption
* Demonstrated ability to define strategy and create clarity within extreme ambiguity
* Strong background in SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or DevOps technology companies, with ability to quickly master the GitLab platform and AI/ML initiatives
* Proven experience influencing and driving impact at a division and company-wide scale, affecting market position and revenue
* Excellence in cross-functional leadership, with experience partnering with engineering, product, security teams and engaging effectively with senior and C-level stakeholders
* Outstanding communication skills, including asynchronous collaboration, executive reporting, and the ability to translate technical complexity into clear business impact
* Track record of success in fast-paced, dynamic environments with evolving technical requirements and market opportunities
* Strong facilitation and influence skills, with ability to drive consensus across diverse stakeholder groups while building trust through transparency and delivery excellence
* Expertise in high-level stakeholder management, including masterful communication with Executive Boards and enterprise Customers
* Collaborative leadership style aligned with GitLab's values, including respect, openness to feedback, and commitment to team success
* Proven track record of redefining organizational operations and serving as an escalation point to resolve highly complex, enterprise-level challenges
* Welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds, including those with consulting, enterprise technology, or technical leadership experience who have owned outcomes and delivered transformational initiatives
* Ability to act as a visionary leader, shaping R&D direction and fostering technical excellence across the organization

**About the team:**
The Technical Program Management team sits within GitLab's R&D Program Management Office and drives product, engineering, data, and security initiatives across our AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You will join our growing, distributed team of Technical Program Managers currently spanning North America and Europe. We own the end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-functional programs including AI platform capabilities, enterprise customer initiatives, and strategic technology transformations. As an all-remote team, we excel at asynchronous communication to coordinate across time zones while partnering closely with executive leaders and stakeholders to deliver business-critical outcomes.
  
  
**How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
  
  
**Country Hiring Guidelines:**
GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
  
  
**Privacy Policy:**
Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
  
  
GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

**Job Summary:**
As a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager, you will lead media programs, influencing the teams' roadmap priorities and technical direction. This role combines strong technical understanding, program leadership, and agile delivery excellence. You will own end-to-end execution of critical programs, influence roadmap direction, manage cross-team dependencies and senior stakeholders, and mentor teams to raise execution maturity across the organization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and collaboration
* Lead large, complex technical programs from planning through delivery independently
* Influence roadmap priorities by aligning stakeholders on objectives and outcomes
* Coordinate across engineering, product, and business teams to manage dependencies and ensure timely execution
* Facilitate cross-pod collaboration and alignment to maintain delivery momentum
* Proactively plan for and mitigate risks, evaluating alternatives, quantifying trade-offs, and structuring communication plans
* Apply Agile methodologies for iterative delivery, adaptive planning, and continuous improvement
* Coach teams on Agile best practices and foster high Scrum maturity
* Maintain sprint cadence and rigor through reviews, retrospectives, and OKR alignment

* Strong grasp of risk/reward tradeoffs, and comfort operating in fast-moving, high-stakes environments with shifting priorities and evolving context
* Exceptional communicator, skilled in managing stakeholder expectations and aligning diverse teams on shared timelines, goals, and impact

7d6d8d41.description:
**The Company**
CommerceIQ is building the AI platform that runs commerce for the world's largest brands. We are not selling AI demos. We are shipping
**AI agents**
for content, media, and sales into the workflows of the Fortune 100 every week.

Customers

Customers include Coca-Cola, Nestlé, Colgate-Palmolive, Mondelez, Samsung, and Kellogg's. Backed by SoftBank, Insight Partners, and Madrona. Headquartered in Mountain View with teams across the US, India, Canada, and the UK. Pre-IPO.
  
  
**The role**
As a senior technical program manager (STPM), you'll lead our most complex, cross-team and cross-geography programs, such as cloud cost optimization, platform migrations, and large multi-team launches. You'll turn ambiguity into clear plans, keep every team aligned on what matters, and give senior leadership an honest, current view of progress, risks, and trade-offs.
  
  
You'll also be the bridge between executive leadership and engineering. You'll translate business priorities into engineering plans, and translate technical reality into decisions leaders can act on. You won't manage the engineers, but you'll earn their trust and drive results through influence.
  
  
**What you'll do**

* **Lead complex programs end to end.**
  Own programs that span multiple engineering, product, data, and finance teams across time zones, from scoping and planning through launch and post-launch review.
* **Coordinate product and engineering roadmaps.**
  Align product and engineering roadmaps across teams and regions. Reconcile priorities, capacity, and dependencies, keep one integrated view of what ships when, and flag trade-offs early so leadership can make informed calls.
* **Drive cost and efficiency initiatives.**
  Partner with engineering and finance to analyze cloud and infrastructure spend, identify savings, set targets, and track delivery against them.
* **Keep leadership informed.**
  Run regular program reviews and steering committees. Write concise executive updates covering status, milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions needed, and business impact.
* **Bridge executives and engineering.**
  Translate strategy and customer priorities into technical roadmaps and milestones, and explain technical constraints and trade-offs in plain business terms.
* **Manage dependencies and risk.**
  Surface cross-team dependencies early, own the critical path, escalate with clear options and recommendations, and keep the plan honest.
* **Define and track metrics.**
  Set KPIs, SLAs, and success criteria for each program, and report results with data that leaders can trust.
* **Build repeatable ways of working.**
  Improve planning, intake, prioritization, and delivery processes across engineering. Standardize the practices that work.
* **Raise the bar.**
  Mentor program managers and engineering leads, and share best practices across the organization.

**What you'll bring**

* 5+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering management, or a closely related role, including 5+ years leading cross-functional programs with software engineering teams.
* A track record of delivering large, multi-team programs across geographies, with measurable outcomes in scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
* Strong technical depth. You can discuss architecture, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and CI/CD with engineers and spot risk before it becomes a delay.
* Excellent written and verbal communication. You've presented to VP and C-level audiences and can turn complex detail into a clear story and a clear ask.
* Experience leading cost reduction or efficiency programs, including cloud spend (FinOps), vendor contracts, or resource optimization.
* Proven ability to influence without authority, resolve conflict, and make decisions with incomplete information.
* Comfort with program tooling (Jira, Confluence, or similar) and with building dashboards and reports from engineering and financial data.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to have**

* Background as a software engineer or technical lead.
* Experience at a SaaS, ecommerce, or data and AI company operating at scale.
* Experience with generative AI or agentic AI product development.

**How we'll measure success**

* Programs deliver on agreed scope, timeline, and budget, with risks raised early.
* Cost and efficiency targets are met and tracked transparently.
* Leadership has a current, accurate view of program status and the decisions needed.

**Why CommerceIQ**
You'll work on programs that shape how leading brands win in ecommerce, with direct access to senior leadership and real influence on how engineering operates. We put customers first, communicate clearly, and value people who take ownership.
  
  
*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other category prohibited by applicable law.*

763c8d15.title: Principal Program Manager
763c8d15.description:
**We're looking for a**
****Principal Program Manager****
**This role is**
**Office Based, Hyderabad Office**
Cornerstone OnDemand is looking for a Technical Program Manager who will drive the planning, execution, and delivery of complex, cross-functional technical programs. You will work at the intersection of engineering, product, and business teams to ensure large-scale initiatives are delivered with clarity, predictability, and impact. This role requires a strong technical foundation combined with exceptional program management skills to orchestrate multiple workstreams and stakeholders toward shared outcomes.
  
  
**In this role, you will…**
**Program Planning & Execution**

* Own end-to-end program management for large-scale, cross-functional technical initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams, products, and business units.
* Define program scope, milestones, deliverables, success criteria, and resource requirements in collaboration with engineering and product leadership.
* Build and maintain detailed program plans, roadmaps, and schedules with clear dependencies, critical paths, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Drive program execution through structured governance — standups, status reviews, steering committee meetings, and escalation workflows.
* Track and report program health, progress, risks, and blockers to senior leadership and stakeholders through dashboards and executive summaries.
* Manage program-level trade-offs across scope, timeline, quality, and resources — making recommendations grounded in data and technical context.
* Conduct retrospectives and post-mortems to capture lessons learned and drive continuous improvement in delivery processes.
* Identify process bottlenecks and inefficiencies across teams and implement improvements to accelerate delivery cycles.

**Technical Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Partner with engineering leaders and architects to understand system designs, technical dependencies, and integration points across programs.
* Facilitate architecture and design reviews to ensure alignment across teams and identify cross-cutting concerns early.
* Coordinate platform migrations, infrastructure upgrades, API versioning, and other technical initiatives that span multiple teams.
* Partner with DevOps and SRE teams to ensure release readiness, deployment coordination, and operational handoffs for program deliverables.
* Define and drive Agile-at-scale practices (SAFe, Scrum of Scrums, or similar) across engineering teams to improve delivery predictability and velocity.
* Facilitate alignment between product roadmaps, engineering capacity, and business priorities to ensure realistic commitments.

**Stakeholder Communication & Risk Management**

* Serve as the central point of communication for program status, decisions, and escalations across engineering, product, design, QA, and business teams.
* Translate complex technical concepts and program details into clear, concise updates for executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
* Manage stakeholder expectations proactively — surfacing trade-offs, timeline impacts, and scope changes early with data-backed recommendations.
* Build and maintain a risk management framework — proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks before they become blockers.
* Manage cross-team dependency tracking, capacity planning, and sprint/release coordination.
* Build strong relationships across the organization to enable effective collaboration and influence without authority.

**Requirements**
**You've Got What It Takes If You Have…**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering project management, or a related role within software product organizations.
* 5+ years of hands-on software engineering or technical lead experience (prior to or alongside program management).
* Proven track record of successfully delivering large-scale, cross-functional technical programs on time and within scope.

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, system architecture, distributed systems, and cloud platforms (Azure preferred).
* Familiarity with microservices architecture, API design, CI/CD pipelines, and modern DevOps practices.
* Ability to read and understand code, technical design documents, and architecture diagrams at a level sufficient to assess risks and dependencies.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and scaling frameworks.
* Proficiency with program management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Smartsheet, or MS Project.

**Communication & Leadership**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging for technical and executive audiences.
* Strong facilitation skills — able to lead productive meetings, drive decisions, and resolve conflicts constructively.
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple complex programs simultaneously.
* Proven ability to build trust and influence across engineering, product, and business functions.
* Proactive and self-driven with a strong sense of ownership over program outcomes.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in SaaS/enterprise product development environments.
* Exposure to AI/ML programs and their unique delivery challenges.
* Familiarity with talent management, HR tech, or learning management domains.

**Our Culture**
Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.
  
  
Check us out on LinkedIn , Comparably , Glassdoor , and Facebook !

6f40aea9.title: Senior Silicon Technical Program Manager
6f40aea9.description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission.
  
  
The Methodology, Infrastructure & Labs Engineering (MILE) team within SCHIE provides the engineering compute infrastructure, computer-aided design (CAD) flows and methods, and labs that Microsoft's silicon teams rely on to design and deliver custom chips. Our team at the India Development Center (IDC) supports two closely linked areas: CAD, which delivers the electronic design automation (EDA) tools, flows and methodologies used by silicon design teams, and Silicon Design Compute Services (SDCS), which runs the high-performance compute, cloud, job scheduling and storage environment those flows depend on, together with managed service partners. As our silicon roadmap grows, we need a Technical Program Manager to drive CAD and SDCS programs to delivery and bring financial rigor to this portfolio.
  
  
As a Technical Program Manager in MILE, you will lead technical programs across our CAD and SDCS portfolios and own budget planning and financial operations for them, so that Microsoft's silicon teams get the tools and compute they need, on time and at the right cost.
  
  
#SCHIE
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead CAD programs end to end, including EDA tool and flow rollouts, version upgrades, methodology changes and license capacity planning for silicon projects, defining scope, milestones, dependencies and success criteria with CAD engineers and design teams.
* Lead SDCS programs for silicon design-compute infrastructure, such as high-performance compute cluster expansions, cloud migration and burst capacity, job scheduler and storage upgrades, and capacity planning against silicon project demand.
* Run program governance across CAD and SDCS: maintain roadmaps, plans and risk and issue logs, drive quarterly planning and objectives and key results (OKRs), and communicate status, risks and decisions clearly to leadership.
* Own end-to-end budget planning, forecasting and tracking for EDA/CAD software licenses, emulation hardware and software, compute infrastructure and vendor services across OPEX, CAPEX and COGS, partnering with Finance on quarterly and annual planning cycles.
* Partner with silicon engineering teams, EDA vendors, Procurement, Finance and managed service providers to align on demand, contracts, purchase orders and service levels, and run regular business and service reviews.
* Support delivery and financial health across the CAD and SDCS portfolio: identify risks, variances and optimization opportunities, drive trade-off decisions with leadership, and represent the programs in planning and executive reviews.
* Define and report metrics for program delivery, spend versus forecast, license and compute utilization, and vendor SLA performance, using data and dashboards to improve cost efficiency, reliability and on-time execution.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**

* Required Qualifications Instruction: Qualifications must be pulled from the Role Library and cannot deviate from what is listed.

Bachelor's Degree AND 5+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.
  
  

* 4+ years experience in cloud Infrastructure, EDA, or CAD, including 2+ years as a project or program manager and a BS(BA) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Information Systems, a related field.
* Strong understanding of Agile concepts and proven experience applying them in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
* Proficiency with project management tools such as Azure DevOps(ADO), Microsoft Project, Jira, etc.

**Other Requirements**

* Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to, the following specialized security screening:
* Microsoft Cloud Background Check. This position is required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.
* This role will require access to information that is controlled for export under export control regulations, potentially under the U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations or Export Administration Regulations, the EU Dual Use Regulation, and/or other export control regulations.  As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide either proof of their country of citizenship or proof of their U.S. permanent residency or other protected status (e.g., under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)) for assessment of eligibility to access the export-controlled information. To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate’s citizenship will be verified with a valid passport. Lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees may verify status using other documents, where applicable.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with budgeting, financial forecasting and spend management for engineering or IT infrastructure (OPEX/CAPEX), including working with Finance and Procurement on purchase orders and contracts.
* Experience managing EDA/CAD tool and flow deployments, or high-performance compute, job scheduler, storage or cloud infrastructure programs, ideally in a semiconductor design environment.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly with leaders and influence global, cross-functional teams and external vendors without direct authority.
* Experience managing vendors or managed services (statements of work, service reviews, SLA tracking) and proficiency with Excel or Power BI for financial and program reporting.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
  
  
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
**requesting accommodations.**

At
**PMGlide**
, we aren’t just building another workflow tool—we are redefining how enterprise software is built and delivered. We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the execution of complex, 0-to-1 AI initiatives and scale our core platform. If you thrive in ambiguity, possess deep technical intuition, and want to replace legacy project management with autonomous, AI-native execution, you belong here.

**About PMGlide**

PMGlide is an AI-powered automation platform designed to make project delivery predictable,effortless, and highly visible. By deeply integrating advanced Generative AI and automation into the project lifecycle, we eliminate manual toil, mitigate delivery risks before they surface, and give cross-functional teams unprecedented control.We also partner directly with enterprises, providing expert consultation to help them adopt AI-driven engineering and delivery practices.

**The Role**

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will be the connective tissue between Engineering, Product, and our enterprise customers. You will not just track milestones; you will drive technical architecture discussions, untangle complex system dependencies, and own the delivery of high-impact AI solutions. Operating as a fully remote leader, you will bring engineering rigor to our program execution, ensuring our AI products scale reliably while delivering immediate business value.

**What You Will Do**

* **Drive 0-to-1 Execution:**
   Lead the end-to-end technical delivery of multi-team, cross-functional programs, turning ambiguous product visions into scalable engineering realities.
* **Architect Alignment:**
   Partner deeply with Engineering and Product Management to evaluate technical feasibility,define system architectures, and ensure programs align with core business objectives.
* **Unblock and Accelerate:**
   Identify and mitigate technical bottlenecks, manage complex API and platform dependencies, and ruthlessly prioritize engineering efforts to maintain high-velocity delivery.
* **Optimize the Machine:**
   Implement lightweight, high-impact processes that scale. Guide distributed engineering teams in adopting modern, AI-focused delivery best practices without introducing corporate bloat.
* **Communicate at Scale:**
   Act as the definitive voice of your programs, translating deep technical complexities into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders, executives, and enterprise clients.

**What You Bring (Minimum Qualifications)**

* **Technical Depth:**
   A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience. You can comfortably read architecture diagrams, understand distributed systems, and debate technical trade-offs with senior staff engineers.
* **Elite Execution:**

**single PDF document**

510bc2f3.title: Engineering-Bengaluru-Vice President-Technical Program Manager
510bc2f3.description:
**Job Description**
**What We Do**
At Goldman Sachs, our Engineers don’t just make things – we make things possible. Change the world by connecting people and capital with ideas. Solve the most challenging and pressing engineering problems for our clients. Join our engineering teams that build massively scalable software and systems, architect low latency infrastructure solutions, proactively guard against cyber threats, and leverage machine learning alongside financial engineering to continuously turn data into action. Create new businesses, transform finance, and explore a world of opportunity at the speed of markets.
  
  
Engineering, which is comprised of our Technology Division and global strategists groups, is at the critical center of our business, and our dynamic environment requires innovative strategic thinking and immediate, real solutions. Want to push the limit of digital possibilities? Start here.
  
  
**Who We Look For**
Goldman Sachs Engineers are innovators and problem-solvers, building solutions in risk management, big data, mobile and more. We look for creative collaborators who evolve, adapt to change and thrive in a fast-paced global environment.
  
  
You will act as a force multiplier for Data Platform leadership — translating strategy into a sequenced plan, making the state of the world visible, unblocking engineering teams, and personally executing on the initiatives that matter most. You will break complex, ambiguous problems into steps that teams can act on, adopting the principles of early releases and incremental delivery to generate evidence of value.
  
  
As a Technical Program Manager in Data Engineering, you will:
  
  

* Contribute to one of the most critical Engineering functions at Goldman Sachs.
* Own the roadmap — work with engineering leads to define milestones, sequence dependencies, surface trade-offs, and keep the plan honest as priorities shift.
* Run the commitment book. Maintain a single, trusted view of every major commitment the organization has made — to divisions, to Engineering leadership, to Risk, to Audit, and to regulators — and drive them to closure, escalating early when they are at risk.
* Own the risk book of work. Track and drive remediation of technology risk, control, audit, and regulatory items across the estate; partner with Risk, Compliance, and Engineering leads to ensure obligations are met on time.
* Lead critical cross-cutting programs end to end. Platform migrations, adoption and decommissioning efforts, data model and API rollouts, query engine and performance initiatives, and AI-enablement programs — from framing through delivery and measurable outcome.
* Steward the financials. Support leadership on budget planning and forecasting, headcount and vendor spend, and cloud consumption and cost efficiency for the Lakehouse estate; build the reporting that lets leaders make cost decisions with evidence.
* Support the people agenda. Partner with leadership on organizational planning, hiring pipelines, onboarding, location strategy, engagement, and talent and performance processes.
* Go deep technically. Become a proficient user of the Legend platform; understand our data models, data APIs, connection patterns, and query workloads well enough to challenge assumptions, spot dependencies others miss, and represent the platform credibly to senior stakeholders.
* Use data to run the business. Build and maintain the metrics that describe platform health, adoption, delivery throughput, cost, and user experience.
* Partner with AI initiatives. Help ensure new AI-driven capabilities are delivered in line with the firm's data governance and AI standards.
* Establish robust relationships with our divisional partners and users so that what we build lands with impact, and connect the work of the team to the firm's commercial outcomes.
* Improve how the organization runs — sharpen planning, reporting, and governance rhythms, and shape standards within the firmwide Engineering community.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or a related technical and/or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* 8+ years of technical program or project management experience delivering complex engineering programs, ideally within a data, platform, or infrastructure organization
* Working knowledge of data and cloud fundamentals: strong SQL, relational and analytical databases, data modelling concepts, APIs, and public cloud.
* Demonstrated success partnering with engineering teams to deliver technical outcomes — not just tracking them
* Track record of managing dependencies, risks, and issues across multiple teams, and of driving items to closure without direct authority
* Comfortable with Agile ways of working and with the planning and reporting mechanics that support them
* Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical problems, plans, and trade-offs clearly to both engineers and senior non-technical stakeholders
* Ability to set goals, meet deadlines and effectively communicate progress to stakeholders
* Exceptional organization and attention to detail — you are the person who holds the thread when nobody else does
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Independent thinker, willing to engage, challenge or learn
* Ability to stay commercially focused and to always push for quantifiable commercial impact
* A healthy obsession with the quality of the platform and the experience of the engineers and users who depend on it, and a willingness to be their internal advocate
* Proven ability to lead by example, with a positive, solutions-oriented attitude
* Strong work ethic, a sense of ownership and urgency

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree or MBA in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* Hands-on exposure to modern Lakehouse and data platform technologies — for example object storage, open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake), Spark, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or comparable
* Familiarity with data modelling and semantic modelling approaches, data APIs, data contracts, and data governance, lineage, and access control concepts
* Understanding of AI and machine learning delivery, including the model development lifecycle, retrieval-augmented generation and LLM-based applications, and the data foundations required to support them
* Scripting or data manipulation skills in Python
* Experience supporting a technology risk, controls, audit, or regulatory book of work
* Prior experience in financial services or another highly regulated, data-intensive environment

**About Goldman Sachs**
At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
  
  
We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.
  
  
We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html

Goldman Sachs is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, veterans status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

f18f3e3d.title: Cybersecurity - Pre-sales (Commission Based)
f18f3e3d.description:
**Company Description**
HackHalt Cyber Intelligence Council is a Section 8 nonprofit organization committed to strengthening global defenses against cybercrime. The organization empowers individuals, businesses, and government bodies to operate safely in the digital world through a four-pillar strategy of Prevention, Education, Detection, and Rapid Response. By advancing AI-driven cyber technologies and conducting cutting-edge research, HackHalt focuses on anticipating and mitigating emerging threats. Supported by 40+ global partners and having trained over 10,000 individuals by 2026, the council is actively building a resilient, skilled cyber workforce. The environment offers mission-driven work for professionals who want to contribute to safer, more secure digital ecosystems worldwide.
  
  
**Role Description**
  
This is a full-time, remote Cybersecurity Pre-sales role with a commission-based compensation structure. The role involves engaging prospective clients to understand their cybersecurity challenges and mapping those needs to HackHalt’s solutions and services. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting discovery calls, preparing and delivering technical and business-focused presentations, and supporting solution demonstrations for areas such as application, network, and information security. The position also requires creating proposal documents, collaborating with technical and delivery teams to refine solution designs, and contributing to sales strategies aligned with the organization’s four-pillar security framework. The individual will maintain accurate records of client interactions, provide input on market trends, and help build long-term relationships that support sustainable growth in cybersecurity services.
  
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong foundational knowledge in Cybersecurity and Information Security, with the ability to explain concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Hands-on understanding of Application Security and related secure development or code review practices.
* Knowledge of Network Security principles, architectures, and common protective measures (e.g., firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs).
* Familiarity with broader cyber threat landscapes (“Cyber”), including threat intelligence, incident response, and risk management.
* Experience in pre-sales, solutions consulting, or technical sales, preferably in cybersecurity or IT services.
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and long-term client relationships.
* Comfort working on a commission-based structure, with a results-oriented approach and ability to work independently in a remote setting.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; relevant certifications (e.g., Security+, CEH, CISSP, or similar) are an advantage.
