971d307a.title: Principal Solution Architect
971d307a.description:
**What makes us Qlik?**
A Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader for 16 years in a row, Qlik helps teams get more out of AI with trusted data products, a powerful analytics engine, and AI agents. This helps teams reduce risk and operating costs, while scaling AI responsibly.
  
  
Used by 75% of the Fortune 500, Qlik works with the systems organizations already use, maintaining flexibility without lock-in.
  
  
**The Principal Solution Architect Role**
Are you ready to take the lead in shaping the future of data and analytics? As a Senior Solution Architect, you’ll be the go-to technical expert, guiding some of the largest customers and partners in the India region. You’ll be at the forefront of demonstrating how cutting-edge data integration and analytics solutions can drive real business transformation.
  
  
Collaborating closely with a dynamic Presales team in a flexible, agile environment, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase your expertise while working with Sales, Marketing, R&D, Product, Consulting, and Customer Success teams. If you're looking for a role that is engaging, fast-paced, and full of opportunities to make an impact, this is it.
  
  
**What makes this role interesting?**

* Engage with high-profile customers and partners: Lead technical discussions and showcase innovative solutions to help organizations unlock the true power of their data.
* Drive business success with cutting-edge technology: Leverage Qlik’s next-generation data analytics and data integration platform to solve complex business challenges.
* Be at the forefront of industry trends: Stay ahead of the game by keeping up with the latest advancements in data analytics, as well as the competitive landscape.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams: Work closely with internal teams and experts across Sales, Marketing, R&D, and Customer Success to build compelling solutions that resonate with customers.
* Flexibility and agility: Thrive in an environment that values adaptability, innovation, and dynamic thinking.

**Here’s How You’ll Be Making An Impact**

* Own the technical sales cycle: Become a trusted advisor by guiding customers through technical evaluations, ensuring a seamless journey from exploration to adoption.
* Showcase innovation through tailored solutions: Deliver compelling presentations and custom demonstrations that address real customer needs and business challenges.
* Prove value through successful Proof-of-Concepts: Help customers experience the true power of Qlik’s platform by leading impactful proof-of-concept engagements.
* Support business development efforts: Play a key role in driving regional revenue growth by supporting strategic sales initiatives and expanding Qlik’s presence in the market.
* Position solutions for long-term success: Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, from technical teams to senior leadership, ensuring alignment on the value and impact of Qlik’s solutions.

**We’re Looking For a Teammate With**

* At least 6 years of experience in a presales and/or consulting capacity
* Strong experience in Data Integration (ETL), Data Quality (DQ), Data Governance, iPaaS (APIs, micro services, Application Integration) will be plus
* Good understanding of SQL & data modeling.
* Good understanding of Machine Learning tools and its usage such as Python/R, and other AI/ML and Gen AI technologies
* Familiarity with cloud platforms and services
* Good to have Knowledge of BI & analytics tools like Qlik Sense etc.
* Excellent communication skills to the business as well as technical audience
* Highly driven with strong interpersonal skills
* Track record of developing relationships at technical, commercial, and executive levels throughout large enterprises
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple complex opportunities.

**The location for this role is:**
Delhi, India (travel required across the country as necessary).
  
  
**Apply now to make a significant impact as a Senior Solution Architect and be a vital part of our success story in redefining data integration solutions.**

**Delivery Manager | Engineering, AI & Data – Engineering | AI Data Center Infrastructure**

  

**Location: Delhi**

  

**The team**

Engineering helps empower and drive mission-critical solutions whether we need to modernize existing systems or implement new technology products and platforms. Through innovation, we improve financial performance, accelerate new digital businesses and fuel growth. Learn more about Engineering, AI and Data

  

**Your work profile**

The AI Data Center Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the operational management, monitoring, maintenance, reliability, and optimization of AI-ready data center infrastructure supporting high-density GPU, HPC, and AI workloads. The role ensures continuous availability of power, cooling, networking, rack infrastructure, and facility systems while maintaining operational excellence, compliance, and service-level commitments.

The engineer works closely with facility operations, IT infrastructure, cloud, network, AI platform, and vendor teams to ensure stable and efficient operation of mission-critical AI infrastructure.

Infrastructure Operations

* Monitor and operate critical data center infrastructure including electrical, mechanical, and IT support systems.
* Ensure availability and reliability of power, cooling, network, and server room environments.
* Manage day-to-day operational activities across AI infrastructure facilities.
* Support continuous operations in a 24x7 mission-critical environment.

AI Infrastructure Support

* Support AI clusters, GPU servers, HPC systems, and storage platforms.
* Monitor GPU utilization, thermal performance, power consumption, and environmental conditions.
* Coordinate with AI engineering teams during deployment, upgrade, and operational activities.
* Support infrastructure readiness for AI workload scaling and expansion.

Power Systems Management

* Operate and monitor: Utility power systems, Switchgear, Transformers, UPS systems, Battery systems, PDUs, Standby generators
* Ensure power redundancy and resilience are maintained.
* Participate in maintenance and testing activities.

Cooling Systems Operations

* Monitor and operate cooling infrastructure including: Chillers, CRAH/CRAC units, In-row cooling systems, Rear-door heat exchangers, Liquid cooling systems
* Environmental monitoring platforms, Support high-density AI rack cooling requirements. Optimize thermal management and cooling efficiency.

Monitoring and Incident Management

* Monitor alarms through DCIM, BMS, EMS, and infrastructure monitoring tools.
* Respond to infrastructure incidents and service disruptions.
* Perform troubleshooting and root cause analysis (RCA).
* Coordinate incident response and recovery activities.

Capacity and Performance Management

* Monitor capacity utilization for: Power, Cooling, Rack space, Network connectivity
* Develop forecasts and operational reports.
* Identify infrastructure bottlenecks and growth requirements.

Reliability and Maintenance

* Execute preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs.
* Develop and maintain operational procedures and runbooks.
* Review maintenance activities to minimize operational risks.
* Support reliability improvement initiatives.

Change Management

* Review infrastructure changes and maintenance requests.
* Develop and execute: MOP (Method of Procedure), SOP (Standard Operating Procedure), EOP (Emergency Operating Procedure)
* Conduct risk assessments for planned activities.

Compliance and Governance

* Maintain compliance with industry standards and internal policies.
* Support audits and operational assessments.
* Ensure adherence to: ISO 27001, TIA-942, Uptime Institute standards, Local regulatory requirements, Safety standards

Automation and Continuous Improvement

* Leverage automation tools for operational efficiency.
* Utilize predictive analytics and AI-driven monitoring platforms.
* Implement operational improvements to enhance reliability and efficiency.
* Drive initiatives to optimize PUE and sustainability metrics.
  

**Key skills required:**

* Education : Any Bachelor’s or Master’s degree.
* Equivalent experience in mission-critical data center environments may be considered.
* 5-10+ years of experience in data center operations, mission-critical facilities, or infrastructure operations.
* Experience supporting AI, HPC, hyperscale, or cloud data center environments preferred.
* Experience with high-density rack deployments and GPU infrastructure is highly desirable.
* Technical skills

Data Center Infrastructure

* Critical Facilities Operations, Electrical Power Systems

53bf8952.title: Solution Engineer
53bf8952.description:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.
  
  
As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.
  
  
We operate with an AI-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.
  
  
If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.
  
  
Let’s build what’s next, together.
  
  
As a Solution Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, demonstrating, and implementing enterprise-level SaaS, chatbot, conversational AI, and CPaaS solutions for clients. This is a highly client-facing role that combines strong communication and consultative skills with hands-on technical execution.
  
  
You will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams to understand business requirements, define the scope of work, conduct solution reviews, and deliver customized solutions using APIs, conversational AI, automation platforms, and emerging AI development tools.
  
  
The ideal candidate is confident in customer interactions, able to convince and influence stakeholders, and comfortable using AI tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, and similar platforms to build solutions, prototypes, code, and reusable technical artifacts.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement chatbot, conversational agent, and AI-powered solutions tailored to client requirements.
* Engage directly with customers to understand their business challenges, explain technical concepts, present solutions, and build confidence in the proposed approach.
* Conduct technical discovery sessions, solution reviews, feasibility analyses, product demonstrations, and proof-of-concept discussions.
* Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions, implementation plans, and scopes of work.
* Use AI development tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, and similar AI platforms to accelerate solution design, implementation, coding, prototyping, and documentation.
* Create and maintain AI-generated or AI-assisted technical artifacts, including prototypes, workflows, reusable skills, integrations, code components, documentation, and solution accelerators.
* Integrate and configure CPaaS products, including: Email, Voice, WhatsApp, RCS, Marketing automation solutions, Conversational agent and chatbot platforms
* Utilize REST APIs, Call APIs, webhooks, and other integration capabilities to extend solution functionality.
* Work with JavaScript, C++, .NET, and related technologies to customize and integrate client solutions.
* Collaborate with Sales and Customer Success teams to define client needs, solution scope, effort estimates, dependencies, and delivery expectations.
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to assess feasibility, resolve technical issues, and provide client feedback.
* Support solution implementation, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-implementation troubleshooting.
* Provide ongoing technical consulting and post-implementation support to ensure client satisfaction and optimal solution performance.
* Stay up to date with SaaS, conversational AI, generative AI, automation, and CPaaS trends, and apply relevant best practices.
* Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, best-practice documentation, technical mentorship, and the development of reusable solution assets.

**Required Qualifications And Skills**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in solution engineering, technical consulting, systems development, enterprise software implementation, or a related role.
* Demonstrated experience in a customer-facing role, including the ability to communicate confidently, present solutions, influence stakeholders, and handle client discussions independently.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, or similar platforms to build solutions, prototypes, code, workflows, or other technical artifacts.
* Practical experience with chatbot technologies, conversational AI, generative AI, or conversational agent solutions.
* Proficiency in one or more of JavaScript, C++, and .NET, along with the ability to understand and work across multiple technologies.
* Strong knowledge of API integrations, particularly REST APIs, Call APIs, webhooks, and third-party service integrations.
* Experience with SaaS products and enterprise-level implementations.
* Familiarity with CPaaS products such as Email, Voice, WhatsApp, RCS, and marketing automation platforms.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to convert business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Ability to work collaboratively with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams.
* Experience with Agile methodologies is an advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Why you'll love it here**

* Financial rewards & recognition - A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.
* Flexible work arrangements - We combine in-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere - and not always between 9 and 5.
* ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) - As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.
* Work-life balance and Well-being  - We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
* Career mobility - Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.
* Professional development - Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow - no matter where you start.
* International mobility - Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well-being, and success - wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection

**Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents.**
We’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.
  
  
No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.
  
  
**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other part of one's identity.**
Read more about our hiring process.

b4744fd7.title: Industrial Sales / Project Developer: Heat & Energy Solutions
b4744fd7.description:
**The role:**

You find the factories, earn their trust and close the first sites. You already know utilities and plant heads in pharma, food, chemicals or textiles, and you know how they buy.

  

**What you'll do:**

* Build and work a pipeline of mid-size factories that heat water with LPG, diesel, PNG or boilers.
* Run first meetings, get bills and site access, set up sensor measurements.
* Bring our plant engineer in, shape the proposal and negotiate pay-per-heat contracts with the factory.
* Close the first 2-3 measurement sites in your first quarter, then the first installed plant.
* Tell us what factories actually object to. That shapes the product and the pricing.

  

**Must have:**

* 6+ years selling technical equipment or energy services to factories (boilers, steam, heat pumps, compressors, energy audits, utilities).
* A network of plant, utilities or maintenance heads you can call this week.
* Technical enough to explain a heat pump and a payback to an engineer.

  

**Nice to have:**

* Thermax/TOESL, Forbes Marshall, Promethean, Smart Joules, an ESCO, or a heat pump or chiller maker.
* Has sold anything "as a service" or outcome-based (pay for savings, pay per unit).

Master's Degree

* Exposure to SAP Cloud Integration: Experience with designing, implementing, and configuring SAP Cloud Integration solutions, including analyzing business requirements and ensuring successful project delivery.
* Knowledge of SAP Cloud Integration Modules: Experience with configuring and implementing SAP Cloud Integration modules, such as API Management, Integration Flow, and Cloud Connector.
* Testing and Quality Assurance: Experience with performing unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure solution quality.
* Technical Documentation: Experience with developing and maintaining technical documentation, including configuration documents and testing scripts.
* SAP Cloud Integration Releases and Features: Experience with staying up-to-date with SAP Cloud Integration releases, patches, and new features, and applying this knowledge to client projects.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* SAP Cloud Integration Releases: Exposure to staying current with SAP Cloud Integration releases, patches, and new features, and applying this knowledge to client projects.
* SAP Systems Integration: Experience with integrating SAP Cloud Integration with other SAP systems, such as SAP ERP, SAP CRM, and SAP BW.
* API Management Knowledge: Exposure to configuring and implementing API Management as part of SAP Cloud Integration solutions.

7436687c.title: Senior F5 Consultant – Service Provider & Cloud Native Solutions
7436687c.description:
**Location:**
India

**Experience:**
6+ Years

**F5 Certification:**
F5 CA (101 & 201) Mandatory

**Travel:**
Candidate should be open to customer-site travel as required

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Senior F5 Consultant with strong expertise across F5 BIG-IP, Service Provider networking, Kubernetes/OpenShift, and cloud-native infrastructure.

The consultant will work closely with customers to design, implement, troubleshoot, and optimize F5 solutions across enterprise and Service Provider environments. The role requires a strong combination of traditional F5 expertise and modern containerized / cloud-native networking experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide technical consulting for implementation, configuration, and maintenance of F5 BIG-IP solutions.
* Design and support complex application delivery and networking solutions across enterprise and Service Provider environments.
* Work on F5 BIG-IP CGNAT solutions for IPv4 address preservation and IPv6 transition.
* Design, implement, and troubleshoot BIG-IP DNS / GTM solutions for high availability, performance, and secure DNS services.
* Support containerized and cloud-native environments using Kubernetes and OpenShift.
* Implement and support F5 solutions such as Container Ingress Services (CIS) and Cloud-Native Network Functions (CNF).
* Work with Docker images, YAML configurations, deployment plans, and Kubectl.
* Support provisioning and management of container clusters.
* Perform solution architecture, design, deployment, testing, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.
* Work on routing and networking technologies including BGP, OSPF, IPv4, IPv6, TCP, and UDP.
* Troubleshoot complex application, network, DNS, SSL/TLS, security, and load-balancing issues.
* Work directly with customers and internal technical teams during implementation and migration projects.
* Prepare technical documentation, implementation plans, status updates, and solution recommendations.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Minimum 6+ years of relevant experience in network / systems infrastructure, architecture, design, or application delivery.
* Strong hands-on experience with F5 BIG-IP.
* Strong experience with LTM and GTM / BIG-IP DNS.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes / K8s.
* Experience with OpenShift and containerized environments.
* Experience or strong exposure to CGNAT / Carrier Grade NAT.
* Experience with F5 CIS and/or F5 CNF / cloud-native F5 solutions.
* Strong understanding of Service Provider / Telecom networking environments.
* Hands-on knowledge of:
* Docker
* Kubectl
* YAML
* Container clusters
* Strong networking fundamentals:
* TCP/IP
* IPv4 / IPv6
* BGP
* OSPF
* Static and dynamic routing
* Strong DNS knowledge, including DNSSEC.
* Experience in customer-facing technical consulting / professional services

**Good to Have**

* F5 ASM / Advanced WAF
* BIG-IQ
* Firewalls, WAF, IDS / IPS
* Linux / UNIX
* SSL/TLS, PKI, OpenSSL
* BIND / named
* VPN technologies such as IPsec, SSL VPN, GRE, MPLS
* Active Directory, LDAP, RADIUS, TACACS, SAML
* Python, TCL, Shell or Perl scripting
* AWS / Azure / cloud platform exposure
* Automation using Ansible or similar tools
* Security certifications such as CISSP, Security+, GIAC, OSCP or equivalent

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate will combine strong F5 BIG-IP expertise with Kubernetes/OpenShift and Service Provider networking exposure, and should be comfortable working on both traditional application delivery infrastructure and modern cloud-native / containerized environments.

Candidates with experience across F5 CGNAT, BIG-IP DNS/GTM, CIS/CNF, OpenShift, Kubernetes and telecom/service-provider environments will be highly preferred.

08318264.description:
About TeamGDF sits at the core of Walmart's AI & Data organization, building the foundational data platforms that make it possible for every team at Walmart — technical or non-technical — to build with trustworthy, well-governed, discoverable data. Our platforms serve billions of transactions and interactions across 19 countries, powering everything from supply chain intelligence to customer-facing personalization to enterprise AI agents. This particular team is newly formed to solve one of GDF's next big platform bets — which means you'll be shaping charter, operating model, and delivery cadence essentially from a blank page, not inheriting someone else's playbook.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Serve as the founding TPM for a newly created platform team — standing up program structure, delivery cadence, and governance where none previously existed.
  
  
Manage large, cross-cutting software/platform development programs end-to-end, partnering closely with architects and engineering leaders on architectural decision-making.
  
  
Define goals, stage gates, critical delivery paths, and key deliverables for programs spanning multiple workstreams, dependencies, timelines, and resource constraints.
  
  
Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships across GDF, AI & Data, and downstream consuming teams — driving alignment on roles, responsibilities, and delivery cadences.
  
  
Establish a resource capacity allocation process and tooling to bring planning rigor to a fast-moving, newly formed org.
  
  
Drive efficient engineering resource utilization; simplify and clarify priorities into plans with milestones suitable for advance planning and executive buy-in.
  
  
Identify and champion AI-augmented program management practices — e.g., using AI to auto-summarize status updates, flag at-risk milestones from ticket/PR signal, or generate stakeholder-ready reporting — and work with tooling/eng leads to actually implement them.
  
  
Navigate setbacks and ambiguity with strong problem-solving and decision-making skills — this is a 0→1 team, so comfort operating without a fully paved path is essential.
  
  
Represent the platform team in leadership/executive reviews, translating technical delivery status into business-relevant narrative.
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent; 15+ years of overall technical experience, including 10+ years in a Technical Program Management leadership role delivering software programs with aggressive schedules and significant business impact.
  
  
Proven experience standing up new programs/teams from scratch — comfortable defining process, cadence, and governance rather than just operating within an existing one.
  
  
Strong leadership skills, with the ability to effectively manage and motivate a team of technical program managers and engineers.
  
  
Experience supporting and executing a large software/platform portfolio while collaborating with multiple business stakeholders.
  
  
Solid grounding in system/platform design concepts, architecture, technical design, services, APIs, and data platform technologies (data pipelines, lakehouse architectures, governance frameworks).
  
  
AI-forward program management skillset:Practical experience using GenAI tools (e.g., Copilot-style assistants, internal LLM platforms) to accelerate program artifacts — status reports, risk summaries, requirement drafts, meeting-notes-to-action-items.
  
  
Familiarity with AI-assisted meeting intelligence (e.g., auto-transcription/summarization of Teams/Zoom calls) and using it to close the loop on decisions and action items faster.
  
  
Working understanding of how AI/ML and agentic systems get built and deployed (MLOps basics, model lifecycle, data quality dependencies) — enough to program-manage platform work that directly enables AI use cases.
  
  
Curiosity and judgment to identify where AI genuinely helps a program (signal, not noise) versus where it's a distraction.
  
  
Ability to build positive relationships with product managers, translating target personas and business needs into features/user stories engineers can act on.
  
  
Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a love for data and solving complex, ambiguous problems.
  
  
Expertise in change & risk management methodologies, project tracking tools, dashboards, and executive reporting.
  
  
Excellent verbal and written communicator — equally adept communicating upward, outward, and downward.
  
  
Deep hands-on familiarity with JIRA, JIRA Align, Big Picture, Airtable, or equivalent program tooling.

This one connection to global and regional payment rails reduces the cost and complications of managing individual connections to

NEX is on a transformational modernization journey, building a next-generation platform that is highly scalable, resilient, and configurable to meet the evolving needs of our growing customer base. This modern foundation will enable faster innovation, improved reliability, and greater operational efficiency as we continue to expand our capabilities.
  
  
**About The Role**
Drives execution of an outcome from inception through successful delivery of the services or domains, or an outcome that spans multiple teams and integrations across the enterprise

Looked to as first point of contact for your teams or business line/service and the source of truth for status, providing the correct information and associated data about the state of the project to the right audience at the right time with the right focus
  
  
Understands the business strategy and design approaches within product, program, or domain with depth to be credible and influential with teams they work with
  
  
**All About You**
Experience operating autonomously across multiple teams, demonstrated critical thinking, and thought leadership
  
  
Experience in building large scale enterprise technical or engineering programs and products from inception to delivery and experience articulating the impact using metrics.

At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
  
  
**So, what’s the role all about?**
As a Program Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing multiple projects and initiatives that support the organization's strategic goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project execution, on-time delivery, and adherence to quality standards.
  
  
**How will you make an impact?**

* Define project scope, goals, and deliverables that support business goals in collaboration with senior management and stakeholders.

+ DevOps practices

Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

9f66fe55.title: Partner Delivery Manager, gTech Ads Agency and Partners
9f66fe55.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Mumbai, Maharashtra, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in a technical project management or a customer-facing role.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Business, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering or Applied Science, or a related field.
* Experience in programmatically scaling services and partner capabilities in a global context.
* Understanding of Google’s advertising solutions (e.g., Measurement, Ads), the broader media landscape, and enterprise sales dynamics.
* Ability to drive business outcomes through strategic planning, negotiation of commercial incentives, and executive-level influence.
* Ability to bridge sales, partner needs, and engineering teams by identifying high-value, advanced technology integration use cases, driving co-development opportunities from discovery to activation, and quantifying the downstream business results.

**About The Job**
The gTech Ads organization has established a new Agency and Partners (gAP) Organization with a mission to scale gTech's expert services to thousands of advertisers through a thriving partner ecosystem. By empowering our partners to become a powerful extension of our own gTech service capabilities, we will help more customers succeed with Google.
  
  
As a Partner Delivery Manager (PDM), you are the single-threaded owner and strategic orchestrator for a portfolio of Google's most critical third-party partners. Your will sit at the heart of our new gAP Organization and be responsible for owning the end-to-end delivery lifecycle, from strategic planning and technical readiness assessment to delivery governance and performance management, for partners. You will act as the crucial, senior-level solutions and enablement bridge between Google and the C-suite of our partners. This role is a hybrid of strategy, deep technical expertise, and operational program management, requiring you to define the delivery strategy for your market/product area, carry the activation goals for your partners, and ensure they are motivated, capable, and equipped to scale the delivery of Google's advertising solutions. Your work is critical to expanding our service reach and helping our mutual customers grow.
  
  
Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.
  
  
To learn more about gTech, check out our video .
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage technical delivery of advertising solutions for key agency partners to drive business growth.
* Lead complex, cross-functional projects to optimize operational workflows and improve support efficiency.
* Consult with senior agency stakeholders to identify technical integration needs and provide strategic recommendations.
* Drive adoption of advanced advertising products and features across partner portfolios.
* Resolve critical technical escalations from partner agencies to maintain high levels of client satisfaction.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

b60a2d49.title: Conversational AI Architect - Google Cloud Gemini CX
b60a2d49.description:
We are seeking a **Conversational AI Architect** to design, build and scale enterprise-grade conversational and agentic AI solutions on Google Cloud. This role combines deep technical expertise in Gemini CX, Dialogflow CX and Vertex AI with hands-on engineering leadership to move generative AI agents from pilot to secure, high-volume production environments.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Design and deploy enterprise-grade agentic AI and conversational AI solutions using Gemini CX, Vertex AI Agent Studio, Dialogflow CX and supporting Google Cloud AI services
* Orchestrate hybrid conversational workflows by combining generative playbooks and autonomous agent behaviors with deterministic Dialogflow CX state-machine controls
* Build and optimize RAG pipelines using Vertex AI Search to securely ground agents in enterprise documents, knowledge repositories and business data
* Develop secure backend integrations, connectors and webhooks using Cloud Run, Cloud Functions and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to integrate CRM, ERP and internal enterprise systems
* Implement security and compliance guardrails using Model Armor, VPC Service Controls, IAM least-privilege policies and appropriate data isolation controls
* Build conversation telemetry and analytics pipelines using BigQuery and CCAI Insights for error-taxonomy analysis, intent health, containment reporting and operational improvement
* Provide hands-on engineering leadership, write production-grade code, troubleshoot complex platform issues and guide solutions through production deployment and scale

**Requirements**

* 12-20 years of overall experience in IT
* Expertise in Gemini CX, Google Cloud Contact Center AI (CCAI), Vertex AI Agent Studio and the Advanced Agent Modeling (AAM) framework
* Proven experience designing and deploying agentic and conversational AI systems, including goal-oriented agents, multi-agent workflows and enterprise-scale customer interaction solutions
* Expertise in Dialogflow CX, including pages, parameters, conditional routing, transition routes, Speech-to-Text tuning, Text-to-Speech and telephony/SIP configurations
* Experience building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using Vertex AI Search and grounding AI agents securely with enterprise knowledge sources
* Proficiency in Python or Node.js, with hands-on development of APIs, webhooks, connectors and backend integrations using Cloud Run and Cloud Functions
* Knowledge of GCP infrastructure, BigQuery, Looker Studio, Terraform, IAM, VPC Service Controls, Model Armor, cloud security, data anonymization and enterprise security controls
* Proven experience moving generative AI agents from pilot/MVP stages into secure, scalable and high-volume production environments

**Nice to have**

* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Data Engineer certification
* Completion of Google Cloud Agentic AI or Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience (GECX) learning paths, and experience with automation libraries such as dfcx-scrapi
* Experience delivering high-volume customer service solutions in Financial Services, Telecom, Retail or Healthcare environments

4a8afd59.title: AS400 Architect
4a8afd59.description:
We are looking for a seasoned **AS/400 Architect** to define the technical vision and architectural direction for the AI Tools team, shaping EPAM's in-house solution for IBM iSeries (AS/400) application reverse engineering, analysis, and modernization at an enterprise scale.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Define the architectural vision, standards, and technical roadmap for the IBM iSeries (AS/400) reverse-engineering and modernization solution
* Conduct application portfolio analysis to identify redundant, unreachable, duplicated, obsolete, tightly coupled, and highly complex code, and assess application quality, maintainability, performance, technical debt, modernization readiness, and potential risks
* Analyze legacy IBM AS/400 applications, identify dependencies and business rules, trace data flows, document application behavior, and assess undocumented or complex codebases
* Drive IBM AS/400 modernization approaches, including code refactoring, format conversion, database modernization, API and web-service enablement, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud integration, re-platforming, and application retirement
* Collaborate with the AI Tools team to define requirements, validate analysis logic, improve prompts and rules, and enhance the accuracy of AI-generated application documentation and code insights
* Architect AI capabilities for program understanding, dependency discovery, business-rule extraction, data-flow analysis, impact analysis, code summarization, test-case generation, and modernization recommendations
* Contribute to technical assessments, proofs of concept, solution demonstrations, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, progress reporting, and executive-level presentations
* Partner with customer IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, modernization specialists, AI Tools team members, testing teams, cloud architects, and Technical Leadership across the client and EPAM organizations
* Ensure that the reverse-engineering and modernization solution complies with enterprise architecture standards, customer security policies, source-code handling requirements, data-protection controls, audit requirements, and applicable regulatory obligations

**Requirements**

* 13+ years of experience in enterprise midrange (iSeries or AS/400) technologies, with 5+ years focused on application analysis, reverse engineering, and modernization solutions
* Expertise in RPG III, RPG IV, and RPGLE, including hands-on development, maintenance, and refactoring of large-scale legacy applications
* Proficiency in free-format RPG, CL/CLLE, and COBOL, with the ability to analyze and convert fixed-format code to modern equivalents
* Skills in DDS, DSPFs, and SQL, including designing, interpreting, and optimizing display files, physical/logical files, and complex queries
* Background in Db2 for i, covering database design, performance tuning, journaling, stored procedures, triggers, and DDS-to-DDL conversion
* Understanding of IBM i architecture, including libraries, objects, service programs, printer files, commitment control, and integrated file systems
* Knowledge of reverse engineering techniques for legacy AS/400 applications, including dependency mapping, business-rule extraction, and data-flow tracing
* Familiarity with modernization strategies such as API enablement, web-service integration, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud migration, and re-platforming
* Competency in application portfolio assessment, technical debt evaluation, code quality analysis, and modernization readiness reviews
* Capability to collaborate with AI Tools teams by defining requirements, validating analysis logic, refining prompts, and improving AI-generated documentation and code insights
* Flexibility to support delivery activities, including proofs of concept, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, and executive-level presentations
* Showcase of strong stakeholder management skills to engage IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, cloud architects, and technical leadership across client and internal organizations
* Qualifications in governance and compliance, ensuring adherence to enterprise architecture standards, security policies, data-protection controls, and regulatory obligations
* Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

7b3f34f6.title: Oracle Cloud Architect -HCM Payroll
7b3f34f6.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Oracle Cloud Architect - HCM Payroll based in India.**
In this role, you will lead the architecture, design, and implementation of Oracle HCM Cloud Payroll solutions for large and complex organizations. You will translate business requirements into scalable, efficient payroll systems while ensuring seamless integration with broader HR and financial platforms. Working closely with cross-functional teams and international stakeholders, you will oversee configuration, testing, and deployment activities to deliver reliable payroll operations. You will also play a key role in ensuring payroll accuracy, regulatory compliance, and continuous system improvement. This position offers the opportunity to leverage deep Oracle expertise while advising clients and guiding technical and functional teams. Join a collaborative, remote-first consulting environment focused on delivering innovative enterprise cloud solutions.
  
  
Accountabilities
  
  

* Solution Architecture and Design: Lead the architecture and design of Oracle HCM Cloud Payroll solutions, tailoring system configurations to meet specific client requirements and complex business needs.
* Implementation Leadership: Manage the end-to-end implementation of Oracle HCM Payroll modules, ensuring effective deployment and seamless integration with existing HR and financial systems.
* Payroll Configuration: Oversee the configuration of payroll elements, tax rules, compensation structures, benefits, and other essential payroll components to ensure accurate and efficient processing.
* Cross-Module Integration: Coordinate integrations between Oracle HCM Payroll and other Oracle modules, including Core HR, Absence Management, Time and Labor, Compensation, and Benefits.
* Third-Party Integrations: Collaborate with technical teams to design and implement interfaces connecting Oracle Payroll with external applications and third-party systems.
* Testing and Quality Assurance: Lead end-to-end testing, integration testing, Conference Room Pilots (CRPs), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate system functionality and payroll accuracy.
* Regulatory Compliance: Ensure payroll calculations, taxation, benefits, and related processes comply with applicable legal, regulatory, and business requirements.
* Business Requirements and Client Engagement: Gather and document business requirements, conduct fit-gap analyses, facilitate client workshops, and provide guidance throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Training and Knowledge Transfer: Support client user training and collaborate with onshore and offshore functional and technical teams to ensure successful solution adoption.
* Continuous Improvement: Monitor Oracle HCM Cloud quarterly releases, assess new features and updates, and recommend system enhancements and process optimizations to improve payroll efficiency and performance.
* Payroll Parallel Testing: Provide leadership and guidance during payroll parallel testing activities to validate system readiness and ensure reliable implementation outcomes.

**Requirements**

* More than 10 years of professional experience working with Oracle HCM Cloud applications, particularly Payroll, Compensation, Benefits, and Core HR.
* Extensive hands-on experience in Oracle Payroll configuration, integration, implementation, and solution architecture.
* Proven expertise managing payroll processes and implementations for large, complex organizations.
* Oracle Cloud Payroll certification.
* Strong understanding of payroll structures, payroll elements, taxation, compensation, benefits, and HR processes.
* Demonstrated experience gathering and documenting business requirements, conducting fit-gap analyses, and leading Conference Room Pilots (CRPs).
* Experience with functional configuration, integration design, testing activities, and client user training.
* Strong knowledge of end-to-end testing, integration testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Excellent business communication and client-facing skills, with the ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders and business users.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with geographically distributed onshore and offshore functional and technical teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities, with a focus on delivering scalable and reliable solutions.
* Familiarity with additional Oracle HCM Cloud modules, particularly Time and Labor, Absence Management, and Benefits, is an advantage.
* Previous experience leading payroll parallel testing activities is highly desirable.
* Ability to stay current with Oracle quarterly updates, new functionalities, and industry best practices.

**Benefits**

* Full-time salaried employment opportunity.
* 100% remote working arrangement within India.
* Opportunity to lead complex Oracle HCM Cloud Payroll architecture and implementation projects.
* Exposure to large-scale enterprise environments and international client engagements.
* Collaboration with experienced functional and technical professionals across onshore and offshore teams.
* Opportunities to deepen expertise in Oracle Cloud technologies and enterprise HR transformation.
* Professional development through exposure to Oracle quarterly releases, new functionalities, and evolving implementation practices.
* Opportunity to take a strategic leadership role in delivering innovative payroll solutions.

**Job Description**
At Synoptek, we think globally and act locally. As the world's first Managed Experience Provider (MxP™), Synoptek provides world-class strategic IT leadership and hyper-efficient IT operational support, enabling our global client base to grow and transform their businesses. We are excited to have experienced continuous growth and, in keeping with that momentum, we are seeking to add talent to our team. When you partner with Synoptek, you engage with an ever-growing, ever-evolving IT organization that provides a high-caliber team, drives growth, and delivers clarity. This is an exciting opportunity for you to be a part of this journey!!
  
  
The Cloud Engineer I is responsible for supporting cloud-based infrastructure deployment, configuration, monitoring, documentation, and basic troubleshooting activities within Azure or AWS ecosystems. This role works under the guidance of senior cloud engineers and architects to assist with technical requirement gathering, cloud resource provisioning, scripting, infrastructure documentation, migration support, security reviews, and compliance activities. The position provides hands-on exposure to enterprise cloud environments, cloud security standards, deployment processes, automation tools, and infrastructure-as-code practices while building foundational cloud engineering expertise.
  
  
**Mandatory Skills**
Cloud Infrastructure,Azure,AWS,IaaS,PaaS,Virtual Machines,Storage Accounts,Resource Groups,Azure Portal,Azure CLI,PowerShell,Cloud Provisioning,Infrastructure Deployment,Cloud Configuration,Technical Documentation,Azure Monitor
  
  
**Role**

* Assist with the setup and configuration of cloud resources including virtual machines, storage accounts, and resource groups.
* Support infrastructure provisioning using Azure Portal, Azure CLI, or PowerShell.
* Document technical configurations, deployment steps, and architecture components.
* Assist in creating cloud cost estimates using tools such as Azure Pricing Calculator under supervision.
* Monitor deployed cloud environments using Azure Monitor or equivalent tools.
* Contribute to basic scripting and automation tasks using Bash, PowerShell, or related tools.
* Participate in security and compliance checklist reviews under senior guidance.
* Help research high availability and disaster recovery strategies and document findings.
* Stay updated with cloud best practices, Microsoft Learn modules, and platform learning resources.

b268290a.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**Solution Architect**
----------------------

Are you a designer and problem-solver who can shape the next generation of delivery excellence at Slack? Are you someone who thrives translating ambiguous customer needs into elegant, workable solutions in a fast-paced, AI-forward environment? We want to talk to you!

Slack is looking for an Solution Architect on the Solution Design team to join our global project delivery organization supporting enterprise customer implementations. We need someone who is creative, detail-oriented, and technically fluent — someone who shapes the right solution for each Enterprise customer, working within the Salesforce Delivery Methodology, and who helps unlock the full value of the Slack platform (including Slack AI) through thoughtful design.

  

You'll design, validate, and document solutions for Enterprise customers across use cases, teams, and geographies — balancing customer needs, platform capabilities, and delivery feasibility.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

* Own solution design across the Discover, Define, and Design stages of the Salesforce Delivery Methodology, translating customer requirements into clear, buildable solution designs
* Evaluate and recommend the right mix of out-of-the-box Slack/Slack AI capabilities (search & summaries, huddle notes, Workflow Builder, native Slackbot capabilities, Agentforce integrations) versus custom configuration, always favoring the simplest viable path
* Partner closely with Delivery Managers, Technical Architects, and customer stakeholders to align solution design with scope, timeline, and success measures
* Produce and maintain solution design artifacts — architecture diagrams, functional specs, configuration workbooks — that development and QA teams can build against
* Lead design workshops with customer technical and business stakeholders, facilitating trade-off discussions and driving toward a validated solution
* Proactively surface design risks and work cross-functionally to resolve them before they impact delivery
* Continuously improve design practices and reusable design patterns, incorporating AI-native tooling (e.g., Slackbot skills) to increase design efficiency and consistency across engagements
* Identify integration points with Salesforce products (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Agentforce) and design cross-cloud solutions that keep Slack at the center of the customer's workflow
* Support post-launch adoption by ensuring the solution design accounts for change management and long-term platform maturity

**What you should have**
------------------------

* 8-10+ years of solution design, architecture, or technical consulting experience, preferably in SaaS and/or professional services
* Demonstrated experience designing enterprise-scale solutions involving collaboration, workflow, or integration platforms
* Working knowledge of (or ability to quickly ramp on) the Salesforce Delivery Methodology and Slack/Slack AI product capabilities
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguity and competing requirements to land on the right design
* Excellent communication skills for translating technical design decisions to both customer stakeholders and delivery teams
* Hands-on familiarity with integration patterns and API-based architecture, ideally including Salesforce products

To be successful as a Solution Architect , you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* Experience as a technical Solution Architect, with strong experience creating technical documents such as E2E Design, High Level Design and Architectural Vision, system design
* Strong experience in relevant technologies (Java/.Net/DB)
* Experience in application integration technologies (Streaming services, APIs, Digital).
* Experience in application infrastructure, both on premises, external and Public Cloud (AWS)
* Experience and understanding in AI System design, infrastructure and languages.
* Experience in Project Management, both Agile and Waterfall, and previous evidence of drive, energy, commitment and enthusiasm

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Understanding of the Banking and Financial Services industry and the Trade and Working Capital domain, including experience with financial instruments, deposits, loans and treasury
* Professional certifications, e.g. TOGAF/ Cloud SA
* Strong data and database architecture expertise across enterprise relational and NoSQL platforms, and proven leadership in regulatory-driven design ensuring auditability, traceability, model transparency, and compliance
* Excellent senior stakeholder engagement and technology leadership, including mentoring architects, influencing roadmaps and driving cross-functional alignment

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
The role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To develop, and evolve the banks technology architecture through relevant solutions, strategies and execution plans aligned to and prioritized by business and technology objectives, including the development, evolution and adoption of foundational platforms and products.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development, evolution and implementation of the banks technology architecture and strategies aligned to the business and technology objectives, unlocking execution and run.
* Collaboration with stakeholders, including Enterprise Architecture teams and other developers to provide subject matter expertise and share knowledge to foster continuous improvement, and clients to understand and deliver on their technical needs.
* Motivation and leadership of a diverse collection of technologists, business and operations teams and enterprise leaders, with goal to align business & technology strategy & standards, identifying opportunities and connecting people.
* Assessment of new technologies to address current and future business needs, through a combination of curiosity and problem-solving skills.
* Determination of the optimal solutions while balancing continuous requirements imposed by compliance, governance, security and funding, through deep understanding of the business and customer outcomes and maintaining a strong and steady grasp on the underlying technologies.
* Monitoring and analysis of the performance, resiliency and stability of applications to identify and resolve issues and communicate and document key findings to stakeholders.
* Compliance with applicable regulatory standards and identification of industry developments that may impact the banks operations and controls to enhance the banks application portfolio.
* Support of engineering and architecture community initiatives to mentor team members, streamline operations, share and grow knowledge.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. **Description**
Solution Architect
  
  
Are you a designer and problem-solver who can shape the next generation of delivery excellence at Slack? Are you someone who thrives translating ambiguous customer needs into elegant, workable solutions in a fast-paced, AI-forward environment? We want to talk to you!
  
  
Slack is looking for an Solution Architect on the Solution Design team to join our global project delivery organization supporting enterprise customer implementations. We need someone who is creative, detail-oriented, and technically fluent — someone who shapes the right solution for each Enterprise customer, working within the Salesforce Delivery Methodology, and who helps unlock the full value of the Slack platform (including Slack AI) through thoughtful design.
  
  
You'll design, validate, and document solutions for Enterprise customers across use cases, teams, and geographies — balancing customer needs, platform capabilities, and delivery feasibility.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Own solution design across the Discover, Define, and Design stages of the Salesforce Delivery Methodology, translating customer requirements into clear, buildable solution designs
* Evaluate and recommend the right mix of out-of-the-box Slack/Slack AI capabilities (search & summaries, huddle notes, Workflow Builder, native Slackbot capabilities, Agentforce integrations) versus custom configuration, always favoring the simplest viable path
* Partner closely with Delivery Managers, Technical Architects, and customer stakeholders to align solution design with scope, timeline, and success measures
* Produce and maintain solution design artifacts — architecture diagrams, functional specs, configuration workbooks — that development and QA teams can build against
* Lead design workshops with customer technical and business stakeholders, facilitating trade-off discussions and driving toward a validated solution
* Proactively surface design risks and work cross-functionally to resolve them before they impact delivery
* Continuously improve design practices and reusable design patterns, incorporating AI-native tooling (e.g., Slackbot skills) to increase design efficiency and consistency across engagements
* Identify integration points with Salesforce products (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Agentforce) and design cross-cloud solutions that keep Slack at the center of the customer's workflow
* Support post-launch adoption by ensuring the solution design accounts for change management and long-term platform maturity

What you should have
  
  

* 8-10+ years of solution design, architecture, or technical consulting experience, preferably in SaaS and/or professional services
* Demonstrated experience designing enterprise-scale solutions involving collaboration, workflow, or integration platforms
* Working knowledge of (or ability to quickly ramp on) the Salesforce Delivery Methodology and Slack/Slack AI product capabilities
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguity and competing requirements to land on the right design
* Excellent communication skills for translating technical design decisions to both customer stakeholders and delivery teams
* Hands-on familiarity with integration patterns and API-based architecture, ideally including Salesforce products
* A collaborative mindset — comfortable partnering with Delivery Managers, Technical Architects, and customers to reach a shared design
* Natural curiosity, a love of learning, and a habit of sharing design knowledge and patterns with others
* Familiarity with Salesforce products and how they integrate with Slack (e.g., Agentforce, Sales/Service Cloud notifications) is a plus, though not required

Slack is the collaboration hub of choice for companies of all sizes worldwide — ensuring the right people stay in the loop, key information stays at their fingertips, and teams stay connected, now increasingly powered by Slack AI.

78a28cab.title: Solutions Architect - Insurance
78a28cab.description:
**Role Summary**
The Industry Solution Architect - Insurance is responsible for shaping, designing, and governing end-to-end insurance solutions that align business outcomes with robust, scalable architectures. The role blends deep insurance domain expertise with hands-on solution architecture, ensuring solutions are practical, differentiated, and grounded in real insurer operating models.

The role supports pursuits and programs across major insurance markets including the US, UK, EU, Canada, ANZ, and ASEAN, requiring strong awareness of regional regulatory, operational, and technology considerations.

**Key Responsibilities & Deliverables**

**Solution Architecture & Design**

* Architect end-to-end insurance solutions spanning business processes, core platforms, digital channels, data, integration, and operations.
* Design business solution architectures across P&C, Life & Annuities, Specialty, Reinsurance, Pension, and Supplemental Health.
* Develop functional and technical blueprints that clearly map client requirements to Coforge capabilities, platforms, and delivery models.
* Define business architecture, solution patterns, and reusable assets to support consistency across pursuits and programs.

**Sales & Pursuit Support**

* Partner with Sales, Client Partners, and Industry Leads to support opportunity qualification and solution shaping.
* Contribute proposals, solution sections, executive summaries, and client presentations for strategic deals.
* Participate in client discussions to explain solution approaches, architectural choices, and delivery implications in clear business terms.

**Delivery Alignment & Governance**

* Ensure proposed solutions are realistic, deliverable, and aligned with delivery capabilities and constraints.
* Work closely with delivery architects and engineering teams to govern solution integrity through execution.
* Support transition from pre-sales to delivery, maintaining architectural continuity and intent.

**Technology & Industry Insight**

* Track emerging insurance platforms, core modernization approaches, cloud patterns, data architecture, and AI adoption.
* Apply industry and technology trends to evolve solution approaches and recommend modernization roadmaps.
* Contribute to the definition of new insurance offerings, accelerators, and solution assets.

**Architectural & Domain Expectations**

The Solution Architect is expected to think beyond point solutions, connecting insurer business outcomes to architecture decisions. This includes understanding insurer operating models, regulatory constraints, and modernization paths, and making pragmatic trade-offs that balance innovation with delivery feasibility.

**Required Experience, Skills & Qualifications Experience**

12 to 15 years of experience in insurance solution architecture, consulting, or large-scale transformation roles. Proven experience architecting solutions for insurers across at least two major global markets. Hands-on involvement in presales, solution shaping, and delivery transition for complex insurance engagements.

**Functional & Domain Expertise**

* Strong domain understanding across one or more insurance sub-domains: P&C, Life & Annuities, Specialty, Reinsurance, Pension, and Supplemental Health.
* Solid knowledge of insurance core systems, policy administration, underwriting, claims, billing, and distribution.
* Experience with integration architectures, data platforms, cloud-native solutions, and API-led ecosystems.
* Familiarity with insurance modernization themes such as core replacement, digital experience platforms, data & analytics, and AI-enabled operations.

**Architectural & Collaboration Skills**

* Ability to translate complex architectural concepts into clear, business-friendly explanations.
* Strong collaboration skills across Sales, Industry Leads, Delivery, and Engineering teams.
* Communication & Professional Skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience contributing to executive-level solution narratives.
* Ability to influence solution direction through credibility, clarity, and structured thinking.
* Bachelor's degree required.
* Business architectural qualifications preferred.
* Strong domain knowledge in Insurance

Share resume on vrinda.gupta@coforge.com

6cbb1a32.title: Salesforce Technical Architect - (Life Sciences Industry exp mandate)
6cbb1a32.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Experience**
The Technical Architect will have to be execution-focused, support the full implementation lifecycle, from scoping to deployment in an evolving ecosystem consisting of clients and partners. The Technical Architect will be responsible for successfully solutioning the enterprise application E2E, designing and building the Salesforce Industry-specific Life Sciences, Health industry solutions.
  
  
As a Technical Architect, you will become a deep product expert with Industry Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud (including Health Cloud) applications, and work closely with our sales and delivery teams to ensure customer success.
  
  
The Technical Architect will lead the technical design and implementation of Salesforce solutions, ensuring compliance with industry regulations (HIPAA, GxP, etc.) and alignment with business goals. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce expertise with strong domain understanding of pharmaceuticals, biotech, medtech, or healthcare providers.
  
  
The Technical Architect maintains an ongoing comprehensive understanding of the cloud-computing ecosystem.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Serve as the technical lead for Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud implementations, including Health Cloud and other related Salesforce products.
* Architect and design scalable, secure, and high-performance Salesforce solutions that align with industry best practices and compliance standards (e.g., HIPAA, PHI, GxP).
* Define and oversee data models, security architecture, API integrations (FHIR/HL7), and performance optimization strategies.
* Lead a team of developers driving optimized solutions across multi-cloud implementations, ensuring seamless integration between Health Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud and Omnistudio framework.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Expertise in User Journey preparations, User Story reviews, Data Modeling, Apex Design Patterns, LWC, and other modern UI techniques.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business partners that shape the architectural vision, and establish a program architectural roadmap.
* Lead customer expectations; negotiate solutions to sophisticated problems with both the customer and third-party partners
* Guide our customers, partners, and implementation teams on how best to implement digital transformation with the Salesforce platform using Salesforce Industries.
* Establish trust with the customer's leadership, promoting and/or implementing standard processes with SFI and Salesforce
* Build out sophisticated business processes using native Salesforce Industries technology and the toolkit of the platform and integration tools.
* Research, recommend and implement AppExchange applications and Salesforce upgrades to help meet business needs.
* Successfully create custom enterprise applications using Salesforce and integrate Salesforce with other enterprise systems.
* Work closely with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs.
* Highlight and lead risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion.

**You're Our Person If...**

* 10+ years of experience in developing technology solutions.
* 3+ years of experience in handling client-facing projects in positions of increasing responsibility in the context of systems development and related business consulting.
* Proven experience architecting enterprise-level Salesforce solutions in the life sciences or Veeva product or healthcare industry.
* Strong understanding of compliance and regulatory requirements including HIPAA, GxP, PHI, HL7, and FHIR.
* Expertise in one or multiple domains of Healthcare Providers, Healthcare Payers,Life Science and Pharmaceuticals, Medical Devices, Public health & Government Healthcare programs, Insurance.
* Experience in healthcare domain (Preferred)
* Integration Architecture (Must have)
* Platform Security (Must have)
* Identity and Access Management / Integration Security
* Sharing and Visibility (Must have)
* Data Architecture and Management (Must have)
* Architectural Design Patterns (Must Have)
* Apex Design Patterns (Must Have)
* Salesforce/Apex, Triggers, Lightning Flows, Lightning, LWC, and experience with modern web and mobile technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web Components, others) or Veeva CRm experience
* Salesforce Certification Preferred (Admin, Developer, Sales, and Service Clouds, Application Architect, System Architect)
* OmniStudio Developer/Consultant
* Health Cloud Certification (Good to have).

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.
