4d3453e4.title: Salesforce Functional Consultant - Revenue Cloud (CPQ) / Sales & Service Cloud
4d3453e4.description:
**Job Title:** Salesforce Functional Consultant - Revenue Cloud (CPQ) / Sales & Service Cloud

**Location:** Hyderabad

**Experience Required:** 4–6 years

**Role Summary**
----------------

As a Salesforce Functional Consultant with 4 to 6 years of real-time, end-to-end implementation experience, you will own the functional side of Salesforce projects from discovery to go-live and hypercare. You will independently run discovery workshops, manage client communication, translate business needs into solution designs and user stories, and configure the solution yourself. Experience with Salesforce CPQ / Revenue Cloud is preferred; strong Sales Cloud and Service Cloud implementation experience is also welcome. Exposure to Media Cloud, Agentforce and Data Cloud is a strong added advantage, as our upcoming projects include agentic implementations for media and advertising customers.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **End-to-End Project Ownership:** Drive the functional workstream across the full project lifecycle: discovery, requirements, solution design, build, UAT, go-live, hypercare and handover.
* **Discovery Workshops:** Independently plan and run discovery and requirement workshops with client stakeholders. Map current-state (As-Is) and future-state (To-Be) processes, identify gaps and recommend Salesforce-native solutions.
* **Client Communication:** Act as the day-to-day functional point of contact for clients. Run status updates, solution demos and sprint reviews. Manage scope clarifications, change requests and stakeholder expectations without escalation for routine matters.
* **Requirements & Documentation:** Write clear business requirement documents, functional specifications, user stories with acceptance criteria in JIRA, process flows and fit-gap analyses.
* **Revenue Cloud / CPQ Configuration:** Configure product catalogs, bundles, price rules, product rules, discount schedules, quote templates, approvals, amendments and renewals.
* **Sales & Service Cloud Configuration:** Configure lead-to-cash and case-to-resolution processes, including opportunity stages, forecasting, case management, Omni-Channel, entitlements and Lightning Knowledge.
* **Declarative Automation:** Build Flows (screen, record-triggered, scheduled), validation rules, approval processes, dynamic Lightning pages and custom metadata, keeping custom code to a minimum.
* **Security & Data Management:** Configure OWD, roles, profiles, permission sets and sharing rules. Plan and execute data migration, upserts and deduplication using Data Loader.
* **Reporting & Analytics:** Build custom report types, reports and dashboards for business users and leadership.
* **Developer Collaboration:** Identify where Apex/LWC or integrations are needed, write technical-ready stories for developers, and validate the delivered solution against requirements.
* **UAT & Training:** Prepare UAT scripts, run UAT sessions with clients, track defects to closure, and deliver end-user training and documentation.

**Requirements**
----------------

* **Experience:** 4–6 years of hands-on Salesforce functional consulting experience, with at least 2 full-lifecycle implementations delivered for real clients (not only support or enhancement work).
* **Client-Facing Delivery:** Proven experience independently leading discovery workshops and managing client communication on live projects.
* **Declarative Mastery:** Strong hands-on proficiency in Flows, validation rules, approval processes, assignment rules and permission structures.
* **Domain & Process Expertise:** Solid understanding of quote-to-cash, lead-to-cash and/or service center operations.
* **Documentation Skills:** Ability to produce clear BRDs, functional specs, process flows and user stories.
* **Data & Tools Proficiency:** Hands-on experience with Data Loader, JIRA, Confluence and Agile/Scrum delivery.
* **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal English; comfortable presenting to senior client stakeholders.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or a related field.
* **Certifications Required:**
* Salesforce Certified Administrator
* At least one of: Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, or Revenue Cloud / CPQ certification

**Preferred Skills & Qualifications (Added Advantage)**
-------------------------------------------------------

* **Revenue Cloud / CPQ:** Hands-on implementation of Salesforce CPQ or Revenue Cloud, including pricing, quoting, contracts, amendments, renewals or billing.
* **Media Cloud / OmniStudio:** Exposure to Salesforce Media Cloud/Vlocity, OmniStudio (OmniScripts, DataRaptors, FlexCards), subscriber management or digital ad sales processes.
* **Agentforce:** Understanding of Agentforce agents, topics and actions, and the ability to gather requirements and design conversation flows for AI agents.
* **Data Cloud:** Exposure to Data Cloud data streams, unified profiles and segmentation.
* **Specialized Certifications:** Revenue Cloud / CPQ certification, Agentforce Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant, Media Cloud Accredited Professional.
* **Extended Ecosystem:** Experience Cloud portals, CTI tools (e.g., Amazon Connect, Genesys) or CRM Analytics.

**Information Security & ISO 27001 Compliance**
-----------------------------------------------

Security is at the heart of everything we do. In this role, you will be strictly required to uphold our Information Security Management System (ISMS) policies in alignment with ISO/IEC 27001 standards. Responsibilities include safeguarding sensitive asset data, completing mandatory security awareness training, reporting potential security incidents or vulnerabilities immediately, and ensuring that daily operations comply with our rigorous data protection protocols.

e5dba1bc.title: Oracle SaaS Cloud Security - Senior Consultant
e5dba1bc.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Oracle Cloud Security**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an
**Oracle**
**Cloud Security Consultant / OCI Security Architect**
to help organizations design, secure, and govern
**Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**
environments while protecting critical business applications, data, and cloud-native services. The role focuses on OCI security architecture, identity and access management, data protection, cloud governance, posture management, and secure cloud transformation initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and review secure OCI architectures, landing zones, and infrastructure security controls.
* Implement and govern OCI Identity and Access Management (IAM), policies, compartments, and least-privilege access models.
* Assess and improve OCI security posture using cloud security best practices.
* Design and implement data protection controls, including encryption, key management, vault services, and secrets management.
* Support Zero Trust initiatives, network segmentation, and secure connectivity using OCI networking services.
* Conduct OCI security assessments, threat modeling, architecture reviews, and compliance evaluations.
* Enable secure DevSecOps practices and protect CI/CD pipelines deployed within OCI environments.
* Secure Oracle PaaS and SaaS integrations, including database, analytics, and application workloads.
* Support cloud migration and modernization programs by embedding security controls into OCI landing zones and migrated workloads.
* Develop cloud security dashboards, security monitoring use cases, and compliance reporting capabilities.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, database, and business teams to operationalize security controls and remediate identified risks.
* Support incident response, security investigations, and cloud threat detection activities within OCI environments.

**Required Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) services and security capabilities.
* Strong understanding of OCI security architecture, governance, and operational best practices.
* Experience implementing OCI IAM, compartments, dynamic groups, federation, and privileged access controls.
* Knowledge of OCI Cloud Guard, Security Zones, Vault, and Key Management Services (KMS).
* Experience securing OCI networking components, including VCNs, NSGs, security lists, load balancers, and hybrid connectivity.
* Understanding of encryption, key lifecycle management, and secrets management.
* Familiarity with CSPM, cloud governance, and cloud compliance frameworks.
* Knowledge of DevSecOps practices, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and secure CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with cloud monitoring, logging.

**Preferred Qualifications**

838d8a42.title: Delivery Manager (Technical)
838d8a42.description:
**Role Summary**

The Delivery Manager is responsible for end-to-end client delivery outcomes, operational stability, and account growth within assigned accounts. This is a
**technically hands-on delivery leadership role**
: you will be expected to understand architecture, code quality, environments, and release pipelines well enough to guide engineers, challenge estimates, and lead technical conversations with client stakeholders. The role operationalizes the
**3M Strategy (Manage, Monitor, Mine)**
, ensures adherence to the
**Tiered Operating Model**
, and acts as the primary day-to-day delivery contact for clients. You will work as a
**peer**
with global counterparts, drive client satisfaction, and proactively identify risks and expansion opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **1. Delivery Execution (MANAGE)**
  Own delivery commitments, including SLA tracking and quality assurance, for assigned accounts.
* Lead Agile sprint planning, execution, and demos in coordination with COEs, Solution Architects, and QA teams.
* Ensure hypercare stability (2–4 weeks post go-live) and transition to managed services.
* Manage resource allocation (onshore, nearshore, offshore) based on complexity and cost efficiency.
* Host weekly client delivery status meetings and internal syncs.
* Own major incident resolution, recovery planning, and corrective actions, including leading technical triage and root cause analysis (RCA) with engineering teams.
* Identify and implement process improvements to improve delivery efficiency and predictability.
* **2. Technical Leadership & Quality**
  Review solution designs, technical approaches, and estimates with architects and tech leads; challenge assumptions and flag technical risk early.
* Understand code, branching, CI/CD pipelines, environments, and release processes well enough to unblock teams and validate delivery status.
* Drive engineering quality practices: definition of done, technical debt tracking, and release readiness.
* Translate technical issues into clear business impact for client leadership, and client needs into clear technical direction for teams.
* Evaluate and promote the use of AI-assisted development and testing tools to improve team productivity and quality.
* **3. Risk & Opportunity Monitoring (MONITOR)**
  Continuously monitor client leadership changes, operational shifts, and market dynamics.
* Flag risks early using the
  **Account Health Dashboard (Green/Yellow/Red)**
  .
* Escalate delivery disputes or commercial risks to Delivery Director when thresholds are breached.
* Conduct continuous risk management and quality assurance checks.
* **4. Account Growth Support (MINE)**
  Partner with Account Executive (AE) and Client Success Team to identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities.
* Participate in Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) for key or at-risk accounts.
* Provide delivery health summaries and expansion recommendations to AEs.
* **5. Governance & Reporting**
  Produce
  **weekly status reports**
  rolled up to Delivery Director.
* Use PMO tools, playbooks, and dashboards per organizational standards.
* Co-run internal kickoffs with AE within
  **5 business days**
  of contract signing.
* Lead external client kickoffs within
  **1 business day**
  of tier/PM assignment.
* **6. Peer Collaboration (Global Delivery Model)**
  Operate as a peer with US and India Delivery Managers (no hierarchical silos).
* Participate in
  **weekly delivery health reviews**
  led by Delivery Director.
* Share best practices and resources across the global delivery organization.
* Provide a clean handover and clear escalation path for the hours you are offline, so clients are always covered.
* **7. Availability & Business Needs**
  Provide live support and be reachable for PST clients until approximately 1:00–2:00 AM IST, including client calls, release windows, and urgent escalations.
* Be available to attend the office on short notice when called upon by the business.
* Travel to client sites, delivery centers, or other locations as the need arises.
* **Success Metrics (KPIs)**
  Client satisfaction (CSAT / NPS) for assigned accounts
* Operational stability (missed SLAs < 5%, zero critical incidents without hypercare plan)
* Early risk identification (minimum 2 weeks before client escalation)
* Contribution to account growth (% of identified opportunities converted)
* Adherence to Tiered Model rules (no unauthorized dedicated PM for Tier 2/3)
* Weekly reporting compliance (100% on time)
* Responsiveness during PST coverage hours and quality of handovers
* Release and defect quality (escaped defects, on-time release rate, RCA closure)

**Qualifications**

* **Required**
  8+ years of delivery/project management in IT services or software engineering, with a hands-on technical background (developer, tech lead, architect, or DevOps/QA engineering) of at least 3 years
* Strong technical depth in modern software delivery: system design basics, APIs and integrations, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure), and CI/CD pipelines
* Ability to read and review code or technical designs and hold credible technical discussions with engineers and client architects
* Experience managing multiple clients simultaneously (shared PM model)
* Strong working knowledge of Agile, DevOps, and hybrid delivery models
* Proven ability to work with COEs (e.g., Modern Engineering, Integration, Cloud, ERP)
* Excellent client-facing communication and risk management skills, including experience working with US clients
* Familiarity with tools like Jira, Confluence, DevOps pipelines, and health dashboards
* Willingness and ability to work late-night hours (up to ~1:00–2:00 AM IST) for PST client coverage
* Willingness to come to the office on short notice and to travel as business needs arise
* A dedicated home workspace with reliable internet and power backup for remote work

Must-Have Skills

* Required • 8+ years of delivery/project management in IT services or software engineering, with a hands-on technical background (developer, tech lead, architect, or DevOps/QA engineering) of at least 3 years • Strong technical depth in modern software delivery: system design basics, APIs and integrations, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure), and CI/CD pipelines • Ability to read and review code or technical designs and hold credible technical discussions with engineers and client architects • Experience managing multiple clients simultaneously (shared PM model) • Strong working knowledge of Agile, DevOps, and hybrid delivery models • Proven ability to work with COEs (e.g., Modern Engineering, Integration, Cloud, ERP) • Excellent client-facing communication and risk management skills, including experience working with US clients • Familiarity with tools like Jira, Confluence, DevOps pipelines, and health dashboards

You will lead the end-to-end customer journey—from technical deal structuring and site design customization through core & shell build tracking, liquid cooling layout sign-offs, and final data hall handover. This role requires an individual who can bridge the gap between high-level commercial relationship management and deep technical requirements for 100 kW to 150 kW+ per rack GPU deployments.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Technical Client Onboarding & Design Alignment

Requirement Translation: Act as the direct liaison between customer engineering teams and internal Design/MEP leads to translate high-density AI hardware roadmaps (NVIDIA H100/B200/GB200 clusters) into facility design specifications.

Liquid Cooling & Density Sign-Offs: Guide clients through core & shell layouts, secondary fluid loop handoffs, CDU placement preferences, and in-rack power/cooling boundaries (100 kW–150 kW+ per rack).

Service Level Agreements (SLAs): Co-author and refine technical SLAs, Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) guarantees, and environmental operating parameters within customer leases.

2. Project Buildout & Delivery Governance

Milestone Reporting: Provide enterprise clients with transparent progress updates across Civil/PEB milestones, MEP fit-out, long-lead equipment delivery, and Level 1–5 commissioning sequences.

Customer Change Management: Manage client-requested scope changes, evaluate cost and schedule impacts with the PMO team, and oversee execution of technical variation orders.

Audit & Inspection Facilitation: Organize and lead client technical teams through factory acceptance testing (FAT), field site walk-throughs, and Level 5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST) validations.

3. Relationship Management & Retention

Single Point of Contact (SPOC): Serve as the trusted single point of contact for customer escalations, schedule alignments, and operational readiness reviews.

Post-Handover Transition: Facilitate smooth transitions from construction/commissioning leads to live facility operations teams, ensuring client fit-out and server rack deployment start on time.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

Experience: 8–12+ years in technical customer account management, solutions engineering, or project delivery within hyperscale data centers or cloud infrastructure.

Technical Core: Solid understanding of data center design, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, power distribution (UPS/Busways), and high-density AI rack specifications.

Client Management: Proven track record managing C-suite, engineering, and procurement executives at major hyperscale (cloud) providers or large AI technology enterprises.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or Business/Construction Management.

Key Skills: SLA/MSA contract negotiation, technical client presentation, project progress reporting, change order negotiation, and cross-functional team leadership.

08533e0d.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Infrastructure
08533e0d.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

We are seeking an accomplished, highly self-driven Senior Technical Program Manager to lead programs supporting Rubrik IT's Global Infrastructure and Platform Services (GIPS) organization. Sitting in the central IT PMO, you will own planning and delivery of high-impact, cross-functional programs across Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Platform, Cloud Operations, Network Infrastructure, and Enterprise Identity, etc. You will provide visible leadership, accountability, and governance from intake and prioritization through execution, go-live, and post-implementation optimization.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical program manager with a proven track record delivering complex infrastructure and cloud programs, with deep understanding of Infrastructure, Cloud, SRE and related domains, and also have exceptional communication and collaboration skills to partner effectively with cross functional teams in different geo-locations.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Program Strategy, Delivery & Execution**

* Execute the program roadmap for GIPS domains, aligned with organizational objectives and security requirements.
* Lead multiple concurrent, complex programs across domains such as Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Platform, Cloud Operations, Network Infrastructure, and Enterprise Identity.
* Translate infrastructure and platform goals (reliability, scalability, security posture, cost efficiency, developer and employee experience) into clear program charters, success metrics, and implementation plans.
* Establish program governance, including cadence, forums, decision-making, risk and issue management, and scope control.
* Own the full program lifecycle, from scoping, design, and planning through execution, testing, deployment, and post-go-live optimization.
* Create and own the program plan, including cross-functional deliverables. Negotiate alignment on scope, schedule, and resources with stakeholders, and proactively identify risks and interdependencies to drive mitigations and trade-off decisions.

### **Stakeholders Communication & Engagement**

* Communicate program status, risks, decisions, and outcomes clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
* Drive structured stakeholder engagement through steering committees, executive readouts, business reviews, regular project meetings, and daily stand-ups.
* Track budgets and spend across programs, providing forecasts, variances, and cost-saving opportunities.
* Manage third-party hardware, software, and service vendors to ensure delivery against contracted scope, service levels, and timelines.
* Champion best practices in program management, ITIL processes, and infrastructure lifecycle management, and identify efficiency gains through automation and process improvement.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

Act as a strategic partner to GIPS domain leaders and work closely with cross-functional teams, including:

* **IT Teams:** Partner with the GIPS sub-domain teams and other teams across IT for seamless delivery.
* **Information Security (InfoSec):** Embed security best practices and ensure compliance with security policies.
* **Engineering (R&D):** Collaborate on infrastructure requirements for product development and scalable solutions.

**Experience You'll Need**
--------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* 8+ years of progressive experience in technical program or project management, including at least 5 years delivering infrastructure, cloud, or platform programs.
* Solid background in infrastructure, cloud platforms, or related areas, demonstrated by either hands-on experience in a related technical role or a long track record as a program manager in these domains.
* Proven experience with Agile, Scrum, and hybrid delivery models, and with tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar.
* Proven track record of establishing program governance and driving complex programs to completion in fast-paced environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to define business cases and make data-driven decisions.
* Hands-on proficiency with generative AI tools (e.g. Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) to automate program documentation, risk analysis, and executive reporting, and a track record of integrating AI tools into daily program management.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive).

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Formal program management certifications (e.g., PMP, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Certified Scrum Master).
* Master's degree.
* Experience in high-growth technology or SaaS companies.
* Experience with security and compliance practices in infrastructure programs.

**Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation**
----------------------------------------------------------------------

Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

  

**Inclusion @ Rubrik**
----------------------

At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.

Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.

### **Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:**

* Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.
* Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.
* Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.

**Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled**
------------------------------------------------

Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants in all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, promotion, compensation, training, leave, and termination.

Rubrik provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application process or to perform your job, please contact hr@rubrik.com. Accommodations may include changes to the application process, documents in an alternate format, a sign language interpreter, or specialized equipment.

bba08e45.description:
**About Team**
US Omni Tech at Walmart Global Tech, Bengaluru, is focused on improving Walmart customer experience across both physical & digital and make Walmart the most exciting place to shop. As a leader in the supply chain group, you are accountable and responsible for number of critical products/platforms that helps serve our customers in the most cost-effective manner in multiple geographies and businesses.

Your main responsibilities will revolve around managing large software development projects.

You will also need to build strong relationships with stakeholders across Walmart, ensuring alignment on roles, responsibilities, and project cadences.
  
  
Your role will involve defining goals, stage gates, critical delivery paths, and key deliverables for large-scale programs that incorporate multiple programs with dependencies across multiple areas of work, timelines, and resource constraints.
  
  
Efficient engineering resource utilization and delivery will be a priority, and you will need to simplify and clarify priorities and create plans with appropriate milestones for advance planning and executive buy-in.
  
  
You will also establish a resource capacity allocation process and tool to transform the planning process.
  
  
Your problem-solving and decision-making skills will be crucial in navigating any setbacks or obstacles that may arise.
  
  
Overall, as a seasoned professional, your expertise and passion for driving technical projects to success will be invaluable in this role at Walmart Global Tech.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**
A bachelor’s degree in computer science/engineering or equivalent.
  
  
Overall around 18+years of technical experience with 10+ years of leadership experience as a Technical Program Manager in software delivery within a related industry managing aggressive schedules and significant business impact.
  
  
Strong leadership skills, with the ability to effectively manage and motivate a team of technical program managers and engineers.
  
  
Experience supporting and executing a large software portfolio, collaborating with multiple business stakeholders.
  
  
Experienced in system/platform design concepts, architecture, technical design, services, APIs, and technologies.
  
  
Build positive relationships and collaborate with product managers to understand target personas and business process needs, which you will then translate into features and user stories that engineers will leverage to iterate products quickly.
  
  
Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a love for data and solving complex problems.
  
  
Expertise in change & risk management methodologies, project management tools, techniques, project tracking tools, dashboards, and reports
  
  
Strong communicator in both verbal and written forms and are equally adept in communicating upwards, outwards, and downward.
  
  
Deep understanding of JIRA, JIRA Align, Big Picture, Airtable etc.
  
  
**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging
  
  
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
  
  
At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
  
  
Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
Walmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunities Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.

****AI Engineering Layer for mission-critical AI****

. We help enterprises turn open and closed models into
****governed, auditable, production-grade systems****

without vendor or infrastructure lock-in.

****AI safety, interpretability, alignment, and systems engineering****

****DL-Backtrace****

, enable explainability and auditability at a scale that enterprise AI demands.

Our customers deploy AI in environments where failures are expensive, regulation is real, and evidence matters: banking, financial services, insurance, and other high-risk domains.

****Senior AI Solutions Architect****

to lead strategic, high-value customer engagements and support large enterprise transactions. This is a senior, customer-facing pre-sales role for someone who combines
****deep AI understanding, system-level thinking, and executive communication skills****

.

****sovereign, governed, and defensible AI systems****

using Lexsi’s platform and research-led primitives.

****owning technical credibility in complex sales cycles****

.

You will lead technical discovery, solution design, and executive-level presentations for large, multi-stakeholder customers across Europe, the Middle East, and South Asia. You will support advanced demos and proofs-of-concept, and help customers understand how Lexsi enables governed LLM gateways, explainability at scale, alignment and fine-tuning pipelines, and runtime observability.

Internally, you will act as the voice of the customer, feeding structured insights back into product, platform, and go-to-market strategy.

Who You Are

You have significant experience working with AI systems and have spent time in
****pre-sales, solution architecture, or technical consulting roles****

tied to complex enterprise deals. You have built or shipped AI products and understand modern ML systems beyond surface-level tooling.

You are comfortable discussing topics such as explainability, alignment, evaluation, and deployment trade-offs with both researchers and senior enterprise stakeholders. You can walk into a high-stakes meeting and clearly explain why governance, auditability, and model optionality matter, without losing the room in technical detail.

You write clearly, present confidently, and operate well in ambiguity. You enjoy shaping solutions rather than following scripts.

Why This Role at Lexsi

You will work at the frontier of
****trustworthy and mission-critical AI****

, influencing how advanced research is adopted in real enterprises. You will play a visible role in large strategic deals and help define how Lexsi is positioned with regulators, banks, and global institutions.

This is a role for someone who wants to sit where

62dbbd4e.title: Security Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
62dbbd4e.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in cybersecurity, with a focus on application security, secure Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices, and vulnerability management, particularly within cloud-native or hybrid environments.
* Experience with cloud and software development.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related technical field.
* Experience with AI-powered security tools for automated vulnerability detection, exploit generation, and code fix remediation.
* Experience in a customer-facing technical role, delivering product and solution briefings, partnering with security leaders and technical teams, and optimizing for production results.
* Understanding of the impact of AI on both offensive and defensive security strategies, including how AI can be leveraged to exploit binaries and firmware as source code.
* Familiarity with platforms for deploying and managing security agents or AI models for security applications, particularly in code analysis and remediation workflows.

**About the job**
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
  
  
As a Customer Engineer, you will help grow our cyber security business by building and expanding relationships with new and existing customers. You will be a trusted advisor to customers and an advocate for our security solutions. You will provide support to C-level, security leaders, cloud security architects and security analysts, using both technical and business skill sets to lead projects forward. You will accompany customers in discovering the technology/solution and consult around the best way to secure and ensure compliance. You will optimize for results when in production, leading with empathy, while identifying innovative ways to multiply the impact of the team.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Work with the team to identify and qualify business opportunities, understand customer technical objections, and develop the strategy to resolve technical blockers.
* Work directly with customers to demonstrate and prototype Google Cloud product integrations in customer/partner environments.
* Recommend integration strategies, enterprise architectures, platforms, and application infrastructure required to complete solutions using best practices on Google Cloud.
* Share security experience to support the technical relationship with customers, including product and solution briefings and proof-of-concept work, partnering with product management to prioritize solutions impacting customer engagement with Google Cloud.
* Support customer-facing presentations and conduct workshops to share the experience and be a subject matter expert on cyber security.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

974229dc.title: Sr. Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India - HCLS
974229dc.description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect in AWS Industries HCLS segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud and AI architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
  
  
You will partner some of the worlds largest companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a small set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind-share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.
  
  
**Here Are Some Other Qualities We Are Looking For**
Enjoy working with large, global customers as an active contributor to a diverse team. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
  
  
Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
* Architect AI-ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS
* In partnership with the account management team, formulate and execute a strategy
* Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
* Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
* Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community
* Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers
* Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
* Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

A day in the life
  
  

* Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
* Develop proof-of-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
* Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
* Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
* Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures

**About The Team**
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
  
  
The HCLS Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic Healthcare and Life Sciences accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in a professional field

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

c79b41c0.description:
Are you interested in working with a leading education technology player, the global leader in the assessment and certification of professional skills industry with presence in more than 200 countries worldwide? If so, this is the chance to apply now! 📥

**PeopleCert**
 is looking for a 
**Director-ITIL (Presales)**
to provide ITIL subject matter expertise to the global ITIL ecosystem (including Business Development, ITIL Ambassadors, training organizations, universities, Governments, and corporations). This role sits in the intersection between Business Development, Product, and Marketing. This is a global role with travel expected, and the successful candidate can be located anywhere.

**As a Director-ITIL (Presales), your responsibilities will include:**

* Connecting with corporates, government entities and other professional organizations to help grow the awareness and the market size of the ITIL products.
* Working closely with global ITIL Business Development to sell more ITIL products.
* Working closely with Product Management, and Product Development to provide input to content development
* Working closely with global Marketing to promote the ITIL brand
* Supporting the ITIL partner organizations with client calls, sales enablement activities, marketing support and other resources to sell more ITIL products.
* Undertaking webinars, speaking events, panel discussions and other activities to promote the ITIL brand.
* Inspiring and motivating the ITIL ecosystem, including ITIL Ambassadors, and the official ITIL Community Group.
* Forging and nurturing high-impact relationships with senior decision-makers in the ecosystem to promote ITIL products.
* Participating in conferences, ITIL education events, and strategic forums promoting ITIL.
* Collaborating group-wide (inc. LanguageCert, ITIL, City & Guilds, DevOps) to drive group-wide performance.
* Providing input (as required) to PeopleCert reports and business updates
* Ensure alignment with company values — Quality, Innovation, Passion, Integrity, Clarity, and Velocity.

**What we are looking for:**

* Recognised global expert in ITIL and Digital Product and Service Management
* 10+ years' experience working with ITIL products. This includes real-world consulting and/or practitioner experience beyond just providing training courses
* Understanding of other digital product and service management products, such as COBIT, IT4IT, ISO20001.  Established record of working with the bodies that own or promote these products is an advantage
* Extensive understanding of ITIL training partner organizations.
* Accredited trainer/consultant in some/all of the ITIL products would be advantageous
* Extensive experience of undertaking webinars, speaking at conferences, and other marketing activities
* Extensive experience of working with Sales teams to provide subject matter expertise in ITIL. For example: sales enablement activities.
* Extensive experience of undertaking client business development activities. For example, creating proposals/formal bids, providing ITIL expertise on client calls.
* Advanced written and spoken English (C2 level certification desired, LANGUAGECERT C2 LTE or C2 IESOL certificate would be a plus).

**What we offer:**

* Competitive remuneration package
* Work in an international, dynamic and fun atmosphere
* Two free vouchers for all certifications from PeopleCert's Portfolio per year for all employees
* Huge learning experience in using best practices and global environment
* Constant personal and professional development
* 100% Virtual Hiring Process

**About PeopleCert**

PeopleCert is a global leader in assessment and certification of professional skills, partnering with multi-national organizations and government bodies for the development & delivery of standardized exams. Delivering exams across 200 countries and in 25 languages over its state-of-the-art assessment technology, PeopleCert enables professionals to boost their careers and realize their life ambitions.

**Quality, Innovation, Passion, Integrity, Clarity, and Velocity are the core values which guide everything we do.**

Our offices in UK, Greece, and Cyprus boast a culture of diversity, where everyone is different, yet everyone fits in. All of us at PeopleCert are committed to the reflection of the diversity and inclusion of our customers and the communities in which we do business.

**Secure English Language Tests (SELTs)**

Any person who is engaged by PeopleCert to work on the SELT service must undergo a Background Check prior to commencing their SELT duties. All SELT personnel will be required to complete a declaration (provided by PeopleCert) where the existence of any criminal record and/or bankruptcy must be declared.

If working on the SELT service anywhere in the world, personnel will undergo equivalent background checks.

All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.

a3d3bb4a.title: Senior Prisma Cloud Consultant
a3d3bb4a.description:
**Prisma Cloud - Senior Professional Services Consultant**

**Job Description**

***Your Career***

As a Professional Services Engineer, you’ll get into the details of our platform. You will push the buttons, flip the levers, turn the knobs. You do not shy away from difficult challenges as it relates to cybersecurity, implementations, and integrations. You are the technical authority and will interact directly with our customers to help them secure their digital environments. The customers are counting on you to perform this work and train their staff. And while experience on the company’s platform is desired, even more important is having a solid foundation in networking and security technologies. In fact, extensive experience with a competitor’s technology can play to your advantage. Many of the opportunities involve a client migrating to our platform for the first time, so understanding the nuances of that technology will enable you to be a better Palo Alto Networks consultant. And don't worry, we will send you to our Professional Services Academy to prepare you for the role, so you are experienced with our suite of services and products before you first meet the customer.

***Your Impact***

* Design and Integrate/deploy Palo Alto Networks Cloud Security (Prisma) solutions into the customer’s environment in either public cloud (AWS/AZURE/GPC) or private cloud (Kubernetes, Openstack) environments
* Be at the forefront of all Palo Alto Networks Cloud security technologies
* Build custom security policies and application signatures, configured for our client’s needs
* Migrate customers from legacy firewall technologies to Palo Alto Networks platforms
* Progress and uphold expertise in deploying advanced Palo Alto Networks features and functionality
* Provide after hours and weekend on-call support as needed to support maintenance activities Analyze logs and events from the solution to perform initial troubleshooting and issue identification
* Work with our Technical Assistance Center to troubleshoot and diagnose support cases
* Maintain the Company's solution and provide mentorship on code upgrades and best practices
* Ensure client needs are met and deliverables produced on time according to specified project deliverables and scope

***Qualifications***

* Your Experience
* Experience with network, security solutions, and technologies leading security solutions in large environments
* Extensive hands-on experience with delivering infrastructure solutions and related security aspects in Public / Private / Hybrid cloud solutions
* Experience with troubleshooting skills related to cloud technology such as orchestration, provisioning, work load balancing and auto scaling scenarios
* Experience with troubleshooting skills related to networking, routing, IP, NAT, IPSEC VPNs and knowledge of how these interact with applications and users
* Experience with installation, configuration and operation of high-end firewall appliances, ideally with Palo Alto Networks products
* Possess one of more of the following industry certifications - CISSP, CNSE, JNCIE-SEC, CCSE, CCSM, PCNSE, RHCSA, CKA, GCP PCSE, AWS CS
* Effectively handle multiple projects and work calmly under pressure
* An excellent writer, with strong verbal social skills, with demonstrated ability to communicate to senior leaders, technical peers, and non-technical partners
* Ability to work with the customers security & network teams to build confidence across the business units impacted by the change with the addition Palo Alto Networks

***About Us:***  
Saddleback Solutions offer Consultancy and Professional Services to our Partners and Clients. We partner Palo Alto Networks, Juniper Networks and Arista worldwide, and we indirectly Partner AWS, so there are always lots of varying opportunities that come up.

We have long standing and close relationships with our consultants and our partners so we can represent you fully. We offer free training for all our consultants should they wish to expand their knowledge and profiles while with us.

We have an education services arm also, so our consultants once qualified can also offer their services running workshops or bootcamps between projects or even full time.

We will support you the best way we know how

*Salary shall be agreed upon.*

Job Type: Contractual / Temporary

Application Question(s):

* Do you have previous experience with Prisma Cloud/ Prisma Cortex?

Work Location: In person

7d2e8135.title: Customer Solutions Engineer - Forward Deployment Engineering
7d2e8135.description:
Customer Solutions Engineer - Forward Deployment Engineering

Company: KAVIA AI

Location: India — Remote

Type: Full-time

Reports to: Chief Operating Officer and Head of Customer Solutions Engineering

Experience: 4–8 years

Compensation: INR 20,00,000 to INR 28,00,000 annual CTC, based on background, experience, and demonstrated customer-facing technical ownership

About KAVIA AI

KAVIA AI is an enterprise software company building the enterprise software engineering platform for complex codebases.

We help engineering teams understand, plan, change, and validate large software systems. KAVIA connects code understanding, workflow automation, artifact generation, reviewable code, and validation across repositories and environments.

Our platform is used by enterprise teams working on consequential software systems. As KAVIA’s product and customer footprint grow, we are expanding the customer engineering capability that turns difficult technical use cases into successful pilots and production adoption.

The Role

This is a hands-on, customer-facing engineering role at a growing enterprise software company. At KAVIA, the Customer Solutions Engineer serves as a Forward Deployed Engineer: part software engineer, part technical problem solver, and part pilot owner.

Reporting to KAVIA’s Chief Operating Officer and Head of Customer Solutions Engineering, you will work closely with enterprise engineering customers, KAVIA’s product and engineering teams, and company leadership. You will understand a customer’s codebase and operating constraints, demonstrate KAVIA against the right problem, translate that problem into a tightly scoped pilot, and stay accountable through technical validation.

Success in this role is not measured by the number of demos delivered. It is measured by whether KAVIA earns technical confidence: the right problem is selected, the evaluation is credible, blockers are resolved, results are documented, and the customer can make an informed production decision.

This is not a conventional sales-engineering role built around standard demonstrations, and it is not a support role limited to routing issues. You must be comfortable reading unfamiliar code, working directly in technical environments, and communicating clearly with both engineers and senior stakeholders. The role requires regular overlap with US and European business hours and may include occasional customer travel.

What You’ll Do

Lead Technical Discovery

* Run structured discovery with engineering leaders, architects, developers, and other technical stakeholders.
* Understand the customer’s codebase, architecture, repositories, build and test systems, development workflow, constraints, and desired outcome.
* Separate the stated request from the underlying engineering problem, and identify where KAVIA can create measurable value.
* Surface dependencies, security or deployment requirements, data-access constraints, technical risks, and decision criteria early.
* Determine whether an opportunity is technically ready for a demonstration or pilot, and say so clearly when it is not.

Prepare and Deliver Tailored Demonstrations

* Design demonstrations around the customer’s actual use case rather than rely on a generic product walkthrough.
* Select representative code, workflows, and evidence that make KAVIA’s value understandable and technically credible.
* Configure and test the demonstration environment, anticipate likely questions, and prepare recovery paths when live systems behave unexpectedly.
* Explain KAVIA’s reasoning, outputs, limitations, and deployment options with precision and without overclaiming.
* Capture questions and objections, follow up with clear technical answers, and identify what must be proven next.

Convert Use Cases into Well-Scoped Pilots

* Translate discovery into a concise pilot definition with a clear problem statement, scope, inputs, deliverables, responsibilities, dependencies, schedule, and acceptance criteria.
* Define success measures that compare KAVIA-assisted work with the customer’s current process, including time, effort, quality, completeness, or validation outcomes where appropriate.
* Keep pilots narrow enough to execute quickly while meaningful enough to support a purchase or deployment decision.
* Align customer and internal stakeholders on what is in scope, what is not, and what evidence will constitute success before work begins.

Own Pilot Execution and Resolve Technical Blockers

* Serve as the technical owner for assigned pilots from kickoff through final validation.
* Work directly with repositories, manifests, branches, build systems, APIs, development environments, and deployment configurations as required by the engagement.
* Use KAVIA hands-on to investigate the customer’s problem, generate or review outputs, and validate results against agreed criteria.
* Diagnose blockers, distinguish product issues from environment or integration issues, and coordinate the right engineering response without losing momentum.
* Maintain a clear execution plan, technical decision log, risk list, and next action for every active pilot.
* Escalate product gaps and delivery risks early, with enough evidence for engineering and leadership to act.

Move Customers to Technical Validation

* Design and run the final validation against the agreed acceptance criteria, including build, test, review, or workflow evidence where applicable.
* Present results honestly, including what worked, what remains unresolved, and what would be required for production use.
* Quantify before-and-after outcomes when the evidence supports them and avoid unsupported or inflated claims.
* Produce the technical readout, recommendations, open issues, and proposed next step needed for the customer and KAVIA to make a decision.
* Support the transition from successful pilot to deployment, expansion, or a clearly defined follow-on phase.

Turn Customer Learning into Reusable Assets

* Write concise technical follow-ups, solution notes, pilot plans, validation summaries, runbooks, and implementation guidance.
* Contribute credible technical evidence and approved results to case studies, sales collateral, product documentation, and enablement material.
* Convert repeated customer patterns into reusable demo assets, pilot templates, checklists, and internal playbooks.
* Bring structured customer feedback to product and engineering, distinguishing one-off requests from broadly valuable product improvements.
* Help improve KAVIA’s customer-engineering methods as the company builds a repeatable enterprise adoption motion.

What We’re Looking For

Required

* 4–8 years of professional software engineering, solutions engineering, implementation engineering, or forward deployment engineering experience, with substantial hands-on technical ownership.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals and production experience in at least one widely used programming language such as Python, Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, C, or C++.
* Ability to enter an unfamiliar codebase, form a useful system model, trace dependencies, diagnose failures, and make progress without a fully specified playbook.
* Working knowledge of Git-based development, APIs, build and test workflows, CI/CD, containers, cloud or on-premises environments, and modern software delivery practices.
* Experience leading technical discovery, demonstrations, proofs of concept, pilots, implementations, or similarly bounded customer engagements.
* Ability to translate an ambiguous customer problem into a clear technical plan, measurable success criteria, and disciplined execution.
* Strong written and spoken English, including the ability to explain complex technical matters to engineers, executives, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Sound judgment under pressure, intellectual honesty about product limitations, and the confidence to challenge an unworkable scope or unsupported claim.
* Strong project ownership, including action tracking, risk management, documentation, follow-through, and timely escalation.
* Ability to maintain dependable overlap with US or European business hours when customer meetings and pilot execution require it.
* Comfort working in a startup environment where priorities change, processes are still being built, and customer outcomes matter more than role boundaries.

Strong Plus

* Experience with enterprise developer tools, AI-assisted software engineering, code intelligence, software modernization, testing, or engineering productivity platforms.
* Experience with complex brownfield systems, multi-repository codebases, embedded Linux, Android, Yocto, RDK, OpenWrt, automotive software, telecom software, or similar platform environments.
* Experience designing secure enterprise deployments, including customer-controlled cloud, self-hosted, restricted-network, or air-gapped environments.
* Experience working with large language models, agentic workflows, retrieval systems, knowledge graphs, or evaluation frameworks.
* Experience gathering defensible before-and-after metrics and presenting technical validation results to enterprise decision-makers.
* Experience working across product, engineering, sales, and customer teams without losing clarity about technical ownership.
* Startup experience or a record of building repeatable methods from early customer engagements.

A Note from KAVIA

We are not looking for someone who has used every technology or worked in every domain listed above.

We are looking for a strong, hands-on engineer who can earn trust with enterprise customers, bring structure to ambiguous technical work, and stay accountable until the customer has credible evidence. Applicants with demonstrated engineering depth and customer-facing ownership are encouraged to apply, even if their current title is not Customer Solutions Engineer or Forward Deployment Engineer.

How to Apply

* Please apply with your resume and a short note addressing the following: Your current location in India and your ability to maintain regular overlap with US business hours.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeKv92ccKCbznHuF8fh5V\_6M1FuhEoMuyBPZJU2Wn5TzpRv5Q/viewform?usp=header

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

* Experience deploying structured practitioner enablement frameworks, certification programs, or readiness portals at scale.
* Track record of using AI and agentic capabilities to increase personal productivity and impact in daily workflows.
* Ability to influence senior partner practice directors, delivery executives, and cross-functional leadership across Sales, PSO, and Engineering.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Equipped with your business acumen and extensive product knowledge, you are right on the front line of interacting with our partners, and helping them find ways to grow using Google's newest product offerings. Your knowledge of relevant verticals and relationships with key industry players will help shape our great applications and content for products such as YouTube, Google TV and Commerce.

As the Partner Delivery Excellence Lead, you will serve as the principal embedded delivery authority based out of one of our primary tech hubs (Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai or Gurgaon). You will sit directly within strategic Global System Integrators' (GSIs) delivery environments, partnering shoulder-to-shoulder with GSI Google Cloud Platform(GCP) Practice Leaders, Delivery Executives, and Lead Architects. Your core objective is to ensure active GSI-led customer deployments are executing flawlessly without risk of failure, milestone slip, or architectural drift.  
  
Bringing deep technical depth in Google Cloud, Data & Analytics and Artificial Intelligence (GenAI/Agentic Workflows), you will monitor project health telemetry, identify early delivery friction, and serve as the critical bridge to internal Google stakeholders, mobilizing Professional Services (PSO), Customer Engineering (CE) and Partner Leadership to deploy rapid remediation before issues escalate to the customer. Additionally, you will advocate delivery upskilling across thousands of GSI practitioners, driving adoption of Google Cloud’s Delivery Readiness Portal (DRP), Delivery Navigator (DelNav), reference architectures, and safeguarding programs.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Serve as the embedded Google Cloud delivery authority within partner Global Delivery Centers (GDCs), establishing operational oversight across enterprise cloud transformation engagements to safeguard architectural integrity and milestone adherence.
* Identify technical roadblocks and delivery risks early, mobilizing cross-functional Google Cloud teams (PSO, Support, Partner Development Managers, Customer Engineering) to execute closed-loop remediation before issues impact customers.
* Provide authoritative architectural guidance across Data & Analytics and AI/ML (Vertex AI, agentic workflows), validating partner delivery approaches on complex, mission-critical workloads.
* Drive programmatic enablement across partner delivery benches utilizing Google Cloud readiness assets, Delivery Navigator runbooks, and safeguarding programs.
* Synthesize delivery patterns and partner capabilities back to Center of Excellence (CoE) and PSO teams, informing joint service offerings and governance policies.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. **Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Are you an experienced Cloud architect/developer who can assist our customers in Application modernization, Design and development of cloud native applications and/or re-engineering applications that can fully leverage the AWS Cloud? As an architect you would champion applications to be cloud optimized by making them well-architected ,enabling them to reap the benefits of elasticity, horizontal scalability, automation and high availability. You should have a knack of GenAI tooling to driving application modernization at scale with GenAI tools.
  
  
On the AWS platform services such as Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling, Elastic Load Balancing, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Amazon Elastic Container Services to name just a few, provide opportunities to design and build cloud ready applications.
  
  
AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands on technical architects to help accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. This is an opportunity to join Amazon’s world class technical teams, working with some of the brightest engineers while also developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies.
  
  
Professional Services engage in a wide variety of projects for internal customers and partners, providing collective experience from across the AWS customer base and are obsessed about success for the internal customers. Our team collaborates across the entire AWS organization to bring access to product and service teams, to get the right solution delivered and drive feature innovation based upon customer needs.
  
  
Amazon aims to be the most customer centric company on earth. Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers critical applications for hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands on Mig and Mod (MM) Architects with:
  
  

* Strong Consulting, client-facing (CXO) level communication driving cloud solutioning and leading technical workshops
* Ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders into implementable solution adhering to well architected framework.
* Problem-solving and analytical thinking driving envisioning , presales and be a thought leader in the domain driving Application discovery , Risk mitigation strategies, Performance testing and validation, Migration and Post-migration optimization
* Deep expertise in large scale cloud migrations, and AWS infrastructure to drive complex cloud transformation journey from Onprem successfully modernizing them to help realize true value from cloud

* Ability to drive Migration discovery to Mobilize to lead and drive Migration and Modernization end to end.

* hand-on experience in designing and developing web applications, APIs, microservices, and data integrations for cloud native applications

* Experience working in Agile development environments, with a strong focus on iterative delivery and continuous improvement.

**Additional Desired Skills**

* Scripting (Python, PowerShell)
* CI/CD pipelines
* Programming Skill with Java, .Net
* Container technologies
* Database migrations
* Knowledge of compliance frameworks

Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**Overview**

iCSU is Microsoft's Customer Success organisation for our largest multinational customers. It works across three time zones (Americas, EMEA and Asia) as one global team, so a customer gets the same quality of engagement wherever they operate. Customer Success Account Managers own the executive relationship, coordinate stakeholders and plan the customer's journey. Cloud Solution Architects (CSAs) turn business needs into working solutions in AI, Copilot and agents, Azure, data and security. We work closely with the account teams, local Customer Success Units (CSUs), delivery and engineering. Our goal is to move customers from buying Microsoft technology to getting real business value from it. iCSU Vision is to be the trusted transformation partner for the world's most global enterprises, so every customer gets measurable business value from Microsoft AI and Cloud in every country where they operate.

As an iCSU CSA manager, you lead CSAs who handle some of Microsoft's most complex and visible customer relationships. You work across countries and functions, and your team's results are measured by customer outcomes. It's a role for leaders who want global scope, close contact with senior executives, and the chance to shape how Microsoft delivers AI transformation at scale.

By leveraging your business and technical expertise, you will coach and empower your team to drive outcomes through AI Business Solutions and Unified Support. This is a people management role, with accountability for a portfolio of customers and aligned Microsoft business metrics.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Deliver cloud-based endpoint management and virtualization solutions. Ensure the health and growth of the D365 & Power Platform customer base.
* Team Development: Drive skill development and training through programs like Tech Boost, Tech Excel, and Tech Connect for technical skills. Drive business value and BDM engagement skilling, coaching your team on how articulate the business value impact of transforming with AI. * Resolve blockers with urgency: Drive team to anticipate, identify, escalate and mitigate blockers to accelerate solution deployment and usage.

Coach the team to use all available engagement opportunities to create VAS or Unified opportunities that the STU will drive, leading to Unified VAS growth.

  + AND 8+ years' experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture and/or consulting or equivalent experience
  + OR equivalent experience

  + OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field AND 8+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting

  + Functional or technical certification in one or more of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 apps and fluency in SaaS solutions from Microsoft or its key competitors
