A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As an Application Consultant for AWS Cloud, you will lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement and utilize your strong understanding of software architecture fundamentals to drive project success. You will collaborate with clients to deliver successful projects, leveraging your proficiency in cloud implementation methodologies like the garage method.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Implement Cloud Architecture: Lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement, utilizing your knowledge of software architecture fundamentals and cloud native development principles to ensure successful project delivery.
* Collaborate with Clients: Work closely with clients to understand their needs and deliver tailored solutions, leveraging your strong communication and leadership skills to ensure effective collaboration and project success.
* Map Components to AWS Services: Utilize your experience with AWS to map existing components and functionalities to AWS-specific services, ensuring seamless integration and optimal system performance.
* Develop Cloud Solutions: Apply your proficiency in technologies like Node.js, Spring Boot, or Netflix OSS to develop cloud solutions that meet client needs and adhere to cloud native development principles.
* Provide Technical Guidance: Offer technical guidance and support to clients, leveraging your knowledge of cloud computing fundamentals, containers, and serverless computing to help them make informed decisions about their cloud architecture.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Software Architecture Fundamentals: Exposure to software architecture fundamentals, including design patterns and principles, to lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement.
* Cloud Implementation Methodologies: Proficiency in using the garage method for cloud implementation, with experience working with cloud native development principles, containers, and serverless computing fundamentals.
* API and Microservices Architecture: Experience working with API and Microservices-based architecture implementation, with proficiency in at least one of the following technologies: Node.js, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, or Netflix OSS.
* AWS Services Mapping: Experience with AWS, including the ability to map existing components/functionalities to AWS-specific services, with a solid understanding of the advantages and disadvantages of related AWS Services.
* Cloud Development Technologies: Exposure to scripting technologies like JavaScript, CSS, and familiarity with Angular.js, with the ability to apply this knowledge to develop cloud solutions.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Familiarity with Scripting Technologies: Exposure to scripting technologies like JavaScript and CSS is beneficial for developing cloud solutions. Knowledge of these technologies can be applied to create tailored solutions for clients.
* Knowledge of Angular.js: Familiarity with Angular.js is advantageous for developing cloud solutions, allowing for more versatile and effective solutions to be delivered to clients.

312b2e2c.title: Digital Solution Engineering (Database Architect )
312b2e2c.description:
****Overview****
Are you insatiably curious, deeply passionate about the realm of databases and analytics, and ready to tackle complex challenges in a dynamic environment in the era of Agentic AI? If so, we invite you to join our team as Digital Cloud & AI Data Solution Engineer for mid-market customers at Microsoft. Here, you'll be at the forefront of cutting-edge projects that leverage the latest technologies to drive meaningful impact. Join us and be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning.
  
  
In this technical sales role, you'll be at the forefront of cutting-edge projects that leverage the latest technologies to drive meaningful impact. Join us and be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning.
  
  
Databases & Analytics is a growth opportunity for Microsoft Azure, as well as its partners and customers. These technologies empower customers to build, deploy, and manage database and analytics solutions in the age of Frontier AI.
  
  
At Small Medium Enterprises and Channel (SME&C), we are leading a high-growth, AI-powered global sales team—one that is deeply connected to our partners and driven by customer success. By uniting our Small Medium Business, Corporate, Strategy, and Partner teams, we are unlocking the largest customer opportunity, backed by the industry’s most significant investments. Leveraging the power of AI and our extensive partner ecosystem, we are redefining how businesses of all sizes adopt technology to drive growth.
  
  
SME&C is more than a sales organization—it’s a culture of opportunity, and inclusivity. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, high-performing, and customer-obsessed team where collaboration, connection, and continuous learning fuel everything we do.
  
  
If you thrive in a fast-paced, digital-first environment and are eager to make a meaningful impact, explore how SME&C can be the next step in your career. Together, we are shaping the future of business.
  
  
As a Data Platform Digital Solution Engineer (DSE), you will play a pivotal role in helping enterprises unlock the full potential of Microsoft’s cloud database and analytics stack across every stage of deployment. You will work directly with technical and business stakeholders to design secure, scalable, and resilient database and analytics architectures that support business-critical applications and Frontier AI transformation. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll guide customers and win their technical decisions on Azure for their database and analytics deployment.
  
  
You bring deep expertise in database and analytics workloads—including Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, and Azure Databases SQL DB, Cosmos DB, DocumentDB, PostgreSQL while exploring how Agentic AI can accelerate Frontier transformation.
  
  
As you join the team, you will have the opportunity to accelerate your career growth, develop deep business acumen, hone your technical skills, and become adept at solution design and deployment. In summary, you’ll help customers modernize their database and analytics platforms to realize the full value of Microsoft’s platform, all while enjoying flexible work opportunities.
  
  
****Responsibilities****
As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll guide customers through secure, scalable solution design, influence technical decisions, and accelerate database and analytics migration into their deployment workflows. In summary, you’ll help customers modernize their data platform and realize the full value of Microsoft’s platform.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
****Responsibilities****

* Lead Databases & Analytics customer engagements.
* Drive technical sales with decision makers using demos and PoCs to influence solution design and enable production deployments.
* Drive technical workshop using live demos, co-create with customers whiteboarding & architecture, rapid prototyping, hands-on proofs of concept & pilots to resolve technical blockers.
* Prove technical solutions, co-create or re-use existing architecture to influence solution design and enable customer commitment for deployments.
* Maintain deep expertise in Analytics Portfolio: Microsoft Fabric including OneLake, Azure Databricks, and Azure Databases: SQL DB, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL.
* Deepen knowledge of on-prem EDW (Teradata, Netezza, Exadata), Hadoop & BI solutions. and Migrations to DWH

****Qualifications****
**Qualifications**

* 10+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience
* OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience
* OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 3+ year(s) technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience
* OR equivalent experience
* Expert on Azure Databases (SQL DB, Cosmos DB, DocumentDB, PostgreSQL) for migration & modernization.
* Expert on Microsoft Fabric including OneLake, Azure Databricks and competitors (BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake) in data warehouse, data lake, big data, analytics, real-time intelligent, and reporting using integrated Data Security & Governance.
* Proven ability to lead technical engagements (e.g., prototyping, pilot, PoCs) that drive production-scale outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 6+ years technical pre-sales, technical consulting, or technology delivery, or related experience
* OR equivalent experience
* 4+ years experience with cloud and hybrid, or on premises infrastructure, architecture designs, migrations, industry standards, and/or technology management
* Familiarity with database technologies (ETL, DW, Reporting)
* Proficient on data warehouse & big data migration including on-prem appliance (Teradata, Netezza, Oracle), Hadoop (Cloudera, Hortonworks) and Cloud & AI Synapse Gen2.
* Azure Fabric would be good to have

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
  
  
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. 1f4e2778.title: Senior ServiceNow Solution Architect - ITOM & CSDM
1f4e2778.description:
Pragma Technologies is an innovative IT company specializing in consulting and technology services across the German-speaking region (DACH). With a team of around 50 dedicated professionals, we deliver modern digital solutions and help organizations transform their processes, platforms, and technology landscapes. We are headquartered in Hamburg, Germany and Lucerne, Switzerland.

  

We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow Solution Architect with a strong development background and deep expertise in ITOM, CMDB, CSDM, and NowAssist to join our growing offshore delivery team based in India.

  

**Tasks**

  

As a ServiceNow Solution Architect, you will be a key technical driver in our offshore team. You will design, develop, and deliver robust ServiceNow solutions for enterprise clients across the DACH region — working independently and collaboratively with our onshore consultants in Germany and Switzerland. You will be responsible for both architectural decisions and hands-on development. Design and develop complex ServiceNow solutions with a focus on ITOM, CMDB, and CSDM 5.0 alignment.

  

**Project Leadership & Autonomy**

  

  
* Take full ownership of ServiceNow workstreams - plan, prioritize, and drive delivery independently with minimal supervision
  
* Lead projects end-to-end: from initial scoping and solution design through to go-live and handover
  
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for assigned clients, managing expectations and communicating progress proactively
  
* Coordinate with developers, consultants, and client teams to ensure on-time, on-quality delivery
  
* Identify risks early, propose mitigation strategies, and escalate when necessary
  

  

**Presentations & Client Communication**

  

  
* Prepare and deliver structured presentations to senior client stakeholders — including architecture overviews, sprint reviews, and solution demonstrations
  
* Present complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  
* Create high-quality documentation and deliverables: solution designs, architecture diagrams, and implementation reports
  
* Represent Pragma Technologies professionally in client-facing situations — written and spoken English required at all times
  

  

**Presales Activities**

  

  
* Support presales processes by contributing technical input to proposals, RFP responses, and solution concepts
  
* Conduct discovery calls and technical assessment sessions with prospective clients
  
* Estimate effort, define scope, and propose solution approaches for new opportunities
  
* Develop reusable presales assets such as solution templates, demo environments, and capability decks
  

  

**Process Workshops**

  

  
* Plan and facilitate process workshops with client stakeholders to capture requirements and define target architectures
  
* Lead CMDB scoping workshops: define CI classes, discovery scope, data ownership, and governance rules
  
* Run CSDM alignment workshops to map business services, technical services, and application portfolios
  
* Document workshop outcomes as structured decision logs, process flows, and solution blueprints
  
* Drive stakeholder alignment across IT, business, and management levels during workshops
  

  

**Technical Delivery**

  

  
* Design and develop complex ServiceNow solutions with a focus on ITOM, CMDB, and CSDM 5.0 alignment
  
* Lead and execute Discovery configurations and troubleshooting (patterns, MID Server, credentials, probes/sensors)
  
* Architect and maintain a healthy, well-structured CMDB including IRE, normalization, deduplication, and CMDB Health dashboards
  
* Implement and govern CSDM 5.0 data models — mapping Business Services, Technical Services, Application Services, and supporting CIs
  
* Configure and extend NowAssist (AI features) including Now Intelligence, Predictive Intelligence, and Virtual Agent flows
  
* Develop advanced platform customizations: Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Flow Designer, and REST/SOAP integrations
  
* Perform code reviews and enforce ServiceNow development best practices — minimizing unnecessary customizations
  
* Document solution designs, architecture decisions, and implementation guides
  

  

**Requirements**

  

**Certifications**

  

  
* Certified System Administrator (CSA) – mandatory
  
* Certified Application Developer (CAD) – mandatory
  
* CIS-ITSM – mandatory
  
* CIS-Discovery – mandatory
  
* CIS-DF (CMDB & CSDM) – scheduled/mandatory or demonstrable equivalent expertise
  
* Additional certifications (CIS-Service Mapping, ITIL) are a strong plus
  

  

**Technical Expertise**

  

  
* Expert-level scripting (JavaScript/GlideScript), Flow Designer, REST APIs, Integration Hub, App Engine ServiceNow Development
  
* Hands-on experience with Discovery (patterns, schedules, MID Server, credentials), Service Mapping, Event Management, and Operational Intelligence ITOM
  
* Deep knowledge of CMDB architecture, IRE (Identification & Reconciliation Engine), CMDB Data Manager, Service Graph Connectors, deduplication strategies, and CMDB 360
  
* Strong familiarity with CSDM 5.0 framework — Business Applications, Technical Services, Application Services, Hosted On relationships, and lifecycle management
  
* Practical experience configuring NowAssist, Predictive Intelligence, or Virtual Agent — AI-powered workflows and case deflection use cases NowAssist / AI
  
* Experience with REST/SOAP integrations, Integration Hub spokes, and third-party connectors Integration
  
* CMDB Health configuration, ATF (Automated Testing Framework), and instance performance best practices Performance & Health
  

  

**Language Requirements**

  

  
* English: Fluent (written and spoken) - required for daily client and team communication
  
* Hindi: Fluent - required for internal team collaboration
  

  

**Nice to Have**

  

  
* Exposure to Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) modules
  
* Experience with DACH-region enterprise clients or German-speaking stakeholders
  
* Experience in a subcontracting or offshore delivery model
  

  

**Soft Skills We Value**

  

  
* Highly self-driven and autonomous - you take ownership of your work and deliver without being micromanaged
  
* Natural leader - comfortable running workshops, steering project meetings, and keeping teams aligned
  
* Confident presenter - you can hold a room and explain technical solutions to executives and IT teams alike
  
* Strong analytical thinker - you systematically diagnose complex issues and communicate findings clearly
  
* Reliable communicator across time zones - proactive status updates, clean documentation, no surprises
  
* Culturally adaptable - experienced in working with European enterprise clients and DACH business culture
  
* Continuous learner - you stay current with ServiceNow releases and proactively develop new competencies
  

  

**Benefits**

  

  
* Fully remote position based in India with flexible working hours
  
* Sponsored trip to Switzerland for an in-person workation with the core team - fully covered
  
* Long-term engagement with a stable, growing company in the DACH region
  
* Exposure to high-quality enterprise projects across Switzerland and Germany
  
* Access to ServiceNow learning resources and certification support
  
* Collaborative team culture
  
* Fair compensation aligned with your expertise and contribution
  

  

**How to Apply**

  

If you are passionate about ServiceNow, have a strong development background, and thrive in a technically challenging environment - we would love to hear from you.

  

Please send your CV, ServiceNow certifications, and a brief summary of your most relevant ITOM/CMDB/CSDM experience.

  

Applications in English only, please.

dbce7bcb.title: Service Delivery Manager
dbce7bcb.description:
**Hello,**
**FCM part of FCTG**
is one of the world’s largest travel management companies and a trusted partner for nationals and multinational companies. With a 24/7 reach in 97 countries, FCM’s flexible technology anticipates and solves client needs, supported by experts who provide in-depth local knowledge and duty of care as part of the ultimate personalised business travel experience.
  
  
As part of the ASX-listed Flight Centre Travel Group, FCM delivers the best market-wide rates, unique added-value benefits, and exclusive solutions.
  
  
**Winner of the World's Leading Travel Management Company Award at the WTM for nine consecutive years (2019-2011),**
FCM is constantly transforming the business of travel through its empowered and accountable people who deliver 24/7 service and are available online and offline. FCM has won the coveted
**Great Place to Work certification for the fifth time**
! FCM Travel India is one of India’s Top 100 Great Mid-size Workplaces 2024 and the Best in Professional Services.
  
  
A leader in the travel tech space, FCM has proprietary client solutions. FCM provides specialist services via FCM Consulting and FCM Meetings & Events.
  
  
**Summary**
The Service Delivery Manager is the local manager for Techlab team members and is responsible for service delivery governance across assigned technology business units, local people processes, recruitment, and the transition of services or modules to the local team. Global stakeholders (Product Managers, Product Owners, Technical Leads and Engineering Managers) own delivery priorities, work assignment and day-to-day direction, and treat global and local members as one team. The role ensures services are delivered with high quality, strong stakeholder engagement, effective resource utilisation and consistent operational governance, risks and issues are proactively managed, team members are well supported, and agreed service and delivery outcomes are achieved.
  
  
**Day In The Life**
**Service Delivery Leadership**

* Own service delivery governance across assigned business units, ensuring delivery commitments, priorities and outcomes are clearly understood and achieved. Priorities and work assignment for work directed by global stakeholders remain with those stakeholders; the SDM is accountable for operational delivery of services fully transitioned to the local team.
* Establish effective delivery governance, operating rhythms and performance reporting across multiple teams and workstreams.
* Ensure delivery is aligned with business objectives, customer expectations and agreed service commitments.
* Support accountability across delivery teams by proactively raising blockers, dependencies, risks and issues with the responsible stakeholders and escalating where needed.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong, trusted relationships with business stakeholders, technology leaders, product owners, project managers and delivery teams.
* Act as a key point of contact for service and delivery-related matters, providing clear and transparent communication on progress, capacity, risks and priorities.
* Facilitate regular stakeholder reviews, QBRs and delivery forums, ensuring actions and decisions are documented and followed through.
* Understand stakeholder needs and translate them into clear local actions, resourcing requirements and actionable outcomes, without altering task priorities set by global stakeholders.
* Run a fortnightly or monthly cadence with global stakeholders (Product Managers, Product Owners, Technical Leads and Engineering Managers); collect, consolidate and track feedback on local team members.
* Attend sprint demos and reviews to understand what and how the team is delivering, so that feedback and coaching are well informed.
* Align with stakeholders on workforce and capacity risks (attrition, planned absences, hiring needs) and remain reliably available for cross-time-zone calls and escalations.
* Partner with vendors and outgoing teams during transitions, managing expectations on timelines, scope and handover quality.

**Project & Delivery Management**

* Support delivery of projects and initiatives across multiple technology teams through demos, reviews and Jira dashboards (read-only), ensuring scope, timelines, dependencies, risks and outcomes are visible and actively managed with the responsible stakeholders.
* Coordinate local capacity, availability and resourcing across multiple concurrent initiatives, working with global stakeholders who own prioritisation and work assignment.
* Apply Agile, Lean and appropriate project management practices to improve predictability, flow and delivery outcomes.
* Monitor delivery milestones, capacity and key performance indicators and drive corrective action through the responsible stakeholders where required.

**Resource & Capacity Management**

* Plan and optimise local team capacity, availability and rosters across competing priorities and workstreams, in partnership with global stakeholders who direct work allocation.
* Identify resource constraints, capability gaps and emerging capacity requirements and work with leadership to address them.
* Support workforce planning, recruitment requirements and effective utilisation of delivery resources.
* Work with team leaders and managers to ensure appropriate skills, coverage and succession plans are in place.

**Service Quality, Governance & Risk**

* Establish and maintain delivery governance, standards and controls to ensure consistent and high-quality outcomes.
* Track KPIs, service performance, delivery health, risks, issues and dependencies, providing timely escalation and resolution.
* Drive effective risk and issue management, ensuring mitigation and recovery plans are established for material delivery risks.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, SOPs, knowledge transfer and operational readiness are maintained.

**Continuous Improvement & Transformation**

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve delivery efficiency, quality, customer experience and team effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve automation, reduce operational friction and strengthen delivery maturity.
* Promote adoption of Agile, Lean, DevOps and other relevant delivery practices where appropriate.
* Use delivery data, stakeholder feedback and operational insights to identify and implement measurable improvements.
* Use Jira workflows and dashboards (as a read-only observer) to understand team flow, workload and delivery health.
* Model responsible use of AI tools and apply them to feedback summarisation, reporting, documentation and pipeline tracking.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach and mentor delivery professionals and team leaders, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous learning.
* Develop high-performing teams through regular feedback, capability development and clear performance expectations.
* Create an environment that encourages ownership, innovation, knowledge sharing and customer-centric behaviour.
* Support effective change management and help teams adapt to evolving business and technology priorities.
* Coach team members on productivity and effectiveness, particularly when the need arises from stakeholder feedback, in partnership with the stakeholders concerned.

**Transition to Operations and Service / Module Transition**

* Ensure projects and technology initiatives have appropriate transition plans before moving into production or ongoing service operations.
* Coordinate with service operations and support teams to ensure effective handover, documentation, training and knowledge transfer.
* Ensure operational readiness, support ownership and post-implementation activities are clearly defined.

*Where a service or module moves from a vendor or global team to the local team for full ownership, the SDM owns the transition end to end.*

* Plan: Define scope with the outgoing party, build the transition plan (knowledge transfer, shadowing, reverse shadowing, handover) and align contractual aspects with vendor management, procurement and legal where relevant.
* Resourcing: Assess skills and capacity, identify owners, plan hiring ahead of need, arrange training, and manage key-person dependencies and workload impact on individuals.
* Governance: Run regular checkpoints, track milestones and risks, hold the outgoing party to its obligations, and ensure access, environments, tooling and compliance are in place.
* Readiness: Agree objective readiness criteria and sign-off gates, plan hypercare, and set up Jira workflows, queues and escalation paths for the service.
* Steady state: Remain accountable for SLA performance, incident trends, capacity and key-person risk; hold 30/60/90-day reviews and capture lessons learned. Daily work direction sits with a designated local service owner or tech lead.

**People Process Governance & Performance Support**
*Global stakeholders own the evaluation of work, performance judgements and day-to-day development conversations. The SDM drives the process, ensures it runs on time and with quality, and supports both sides.*

* Appraisals: Drive the calendar, briefings, templates and follow-up for goal setting, mid-year check-ins, stakeholder input, ratings and calibration; quality-check inputs for gaps, bias and missing evidence; facilitate delivery of final feedback.
* PIPs: Ensure stakeholder-defined expectations are specific, measurable and time-bound; set review cadence, track progress, keep records and coordinate outcomes with HR.
* Probation: Track timelines, trigger checkpoints, consolidate evidence-based assessments and coordinate confirmation or extension.
* 1:1s: Ensure stakeholders hold regular 1:1s. Hold local check-ins focused on wellbeing, workload, aspirations and concerns, not task direction.
* Growth: Run promotion and role-change processes; shape development plans and coordinate stretch opportunities with stakeholders.

**Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**
*Global stakeholders define requirements and decide technical and team fit. The SDM runs the end-to-end process and keeps everyone informed.*

* Intake: Initiate new and replacement requisitions; run calibration calls with stakeholders on scope, must-have skills, seniority, fit and working hours; convert them into a hiring brief.
* Sourcing and screening: Work with talent acquisition, screen profiles against calibrated requirements (including a first-level technical fit check), and share shortlists with a fit-and-gap summary.
* Interviews: Coordinate panels across time zones, brief interviewers, chase timely evidence-based feedback, and monitor pipeline health.
* Reporting and closure: Share regular progress updates (pipeline, time-to-hire, risks), facilitate the selection discussion, and coordinate offer, negotiation, notice-period tracking and joining.

**Local Operations & Onboarding**

* Manage WFH/WFO rosters and ensure availability during business hours and overlap windows with global teams.
* Approve and track leave in the local system, and communicate planned absences to stakeholders to avoid delivery impact.
* Own the pre-joining and first-30-days experience for new hires, and coordinate access, equipment, offboarding and vendor-related administration with HR, IT and admin.
* Ensure compliance with local policy and code of conduct.

**Wellbeing, Engagement & Conflict Resolution**

* Be the first point of contact for team members' concerns; monitor workload, morale and burnout risk and raise issues with stakeholders.
* Represent team aspirations (career, projects, learning) to global stakeholders.
* Mediate conflicts or misalignment between global stakeholders and local members, including cross-location cultural friction.

Escalate risks, attrition signals and systemic issues to senior leadership with recommendations
  
  
**You'll Be Perfect For The Role If You Have**

* Proven experience managing multiple concurrent initiatives and leading multi-disciplinary technology teams. Proven experience running appraisal cycles, PIPs, probation reviews and leave management; driving end-to-end recruitment or hiring coordination for technology roles; and leading a service, module or knowledge transition, including vendor or cross-team handovers.
* 15+ years of total professional experience, including 5+ years of delivery management and/or project management experience and 4+ years managing people in technology or engineering teams.
* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience). Relevant certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum/Agile, SAFe, ICAgile, ITIL, CIPD or equivalent are advantageous.
* Normal business hours, with flexibility required to support global stakeholders and delivery requirements, including cross-time-zone calls, overlap windows and escalations.

#FCMIN

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.
  
  
You will be rewarded with competitive market salary. You will also be equipped with relevant training courses and tools to set you up for success with endless career advancement and job opportunities all over the world.

**Love for travel**

**We value you...**
Flight Centre Travel Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace that supports your unique identity to create better, safer experiences for everyone. We encourage you to come as you are; to foster inclusivity and collaboration. We celebrate you.

3760fd00.title: Technical Delivery Manager
3760fd00.description:
**"ABOUT US:**
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a commitment to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, handle risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years.
  
  
Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.
  
  
LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia PaDecific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.
  
  
**OUR PEOPLE:**
People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential.
  
  
We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and exciting experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.
  
  
We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and exciting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise.
  
  
**PROGRAMME SUMMARY:**
LSEG are embarking on a large transformation programme to streamline and optimise our current capabilities, and to deliver next-generation, industry-standard Financial Crime (FC) processes, technologies and tools to support our Customer and Third-Party onboarding. While continuing to meet internal stringent policies and our external obligations, this programme shall introduce new ways of working and standards, drive efficiencies and transforme the way we deliver value towards customer journey lifecycle at LSEG.
  
  
**ROLE PROFILE:**
A fantastic opportunity for a proven and experienced Technical Delivery Manager with a background in Know Your Customer (KYC), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Financial Crime (FC), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Sanctions, Transaction Monitoring and Regulatory Transformation, to lead and support the delivery of key technology initiatives underpinning the FC Transformation programme.
  
  
The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of business, technology and programme delivery, driving requirements definition, collaborator alignment, execution governance and change implementation. This individual will act as a trusted partner to business leaders, technology teams, architects, vendors and programme leadership, ensuring the successful delivery of strategic and regulatory initiatives through the full delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Lead Business and Technology Transformation**

* Partner with business, operations, risk and technology stakeholders to define strategic objectives, business requirements and delivery outcomes.
* Analyse business processes, operating models, systems and data flows to find opportunities for optimisation and transformation.
* Lead requirements definition activities including workshops, process mapping, user story development and acceptance criteria definition.
* Ensure business requirements are traceable through design, testing and implementation.

**Drive Delivery Excellence**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex technology initiatives from discovery through implementation.
* Develop delivery plans, manage dependencies and ensure alignment across multiple teams and workstreams.
* Identify and proactively manage risks, issues and delivery challenges.
* Monitor progress against achievements and ensure successful execution of programme commitments.
* Champion Agile delivery approaches, selecting the most appropriate methodology for each initiative.

**Build Strong Partnerships**

* Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders.
* Facilitate alignment across teams with differing priorities and objectives.
* Provide clear communication and regular reporting to programme leadership and senior stakeholders.
* Influence decision-making through data-driven insights and thoughtful recommendations.

**Lead High-Performing Teams**

* Manage, coach and develop a team of Business Analysts and delivery professionals.
* Create an inclusive environment where individuals can grow, develop and perform at their best.
* Support career development, succession planning and capability building across the team.
* Ensure resources are effectively allocated to meet programme and organisational priorities.

**Deliver Sustainable Technology Solutions**

* Collaborate with architecture, engineering and product teams to design and implement scalable solutions.
* Support delivery of Financial Crime technology capabilities including onboarding, KYC, CDD, screening, monitoring and reporting solutions.
* Ensure solutions align with governance, security, data and regulatory requirements.
* Promote continuous improvement and adoption of standard methodologies across delivery teams.

**Enable Data-Driven Decisions**

* Partner with data, reporting and engineering teams to define information requirements and reporting solutions.
* Support delivery of management information, operational insights and performance reporting.
* Ensure data quality, integrity and consistency across delivered solutions.

**Experience**
**What You'll Bring**

* Significant experience leading business analysis and technology delivery within Financial Services, Risk, Compliance or Financial Crime domains.
* Demonstrated success delivering large-scale business and technology transformation initiatives.
* Experience leading and developing teams in a people management capacity.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders across business, operations and technology organisations.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex, fast-paced environment.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong understanding of Financial Crime processes including KYC, Customer Due Diligence, Sanctions Screening and Transaction Monitoring.
* Excellent business analysis, process improvement and requirements management capabilities.
* Strong project and delivery management experience, including planning, dependency management and governance.
* Ability to simplify complex problems and translate business needs into practical technology solutions.
* Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working within Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery environments.
* Knowledge of enterprise technologies, data platforms, workflow solutions and system integrations.

**Preferred**

* Experience delivering Financial Crime technology platforms, in-house built solutions around customer
* Professional certifications in Business Analysis, Agile, Project Management or Product Management.
* Experience working across global teams and multiple time zones.

84a47036.title: Infrastructure Architect
84a47036.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

Company is hiring a Senior GCP Infrastructure Architect covering cloud operations, platform governance, and infrastructure advisory for a client's Google Cloud Platform environment. The architect owns the technical backbone of the engagement: landing zone design, security posture, and the architectural decisions that keep the platform reliable and cost-efficient across the full

contract term.

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

  

Key Responsibilities

* Own overall GCP architecture governance across the client's environment, ensuring designs align with security, compliance, and cost-efficiency standards.
* Design and maintain the GCP landing zone: networking, IAM structure, org policies, and resource hierarchy.
* Provide security oversight for cloud infrastructure, including access controls, encryption, and policy enforcement.
* Act as the architecture advisory point of contact for client stakeholders, translating business needs into technical designs.
* Lead stakeholder management across the client and the Companys delivery team, including the onsite Delivery/Project Manager.
* Guide and mentor the offshore delivery pod (DevOps, Data Engineering, Network Engineering, Infra/OS) on architectural standards and best practices.
* Support incident escalations and major changes with architectural review.
* Identify and drive infrastructure efficiencies and cost optimisation across the platform.

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 9+ years in cloud infrastructure/architecture roles, with at least 45 years focused on Google Cloud Platform.
* Proven experience designing and governing GCP landing zones at enterprise scale (networking, IAM, org policy, resource hierarchy).
* Strong background in cloud security architecture (IAM, VPC Service Controls, encryption, policy enforcement).
* Experience architecting for managed services / long-term support engagements, not just one- time builds.
* Comfortable in a client-facing advisory role with Middle East / industrial-sector clients (utilities sector experience is a plus).
* Working knowledge of Terraform or equivalent IaC, GCP monitoring/observability tooling, and hybrid/on-prem integration patterns.
* Experience leading or mentoring a small offshore delivery pod (DevOps, data engineering, network engineering).

  

**Preferred Certifications**

* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect (required or strongly preferred)
* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer (nice to have)
* Google Cloud Professional Network Engineer (nice to have)
* ITIL Foundation (useful for the managed services context) Engagement Details
* Delivery location: Primarily offshore (India-based delivery pod); periodic coordination with the onsite Delivery/Project Manager.
* Team context: Works alongside a GCP DevOps Engineer, GCP Data Engineer, GCP Network Engineer, GCP Infra/OS Engineer, and L1 support staff.
* Allocation: Full-time, dedicated to the client account for the duration of the engagement.

  

**Success Metrics**

* Architecture governance maintained with zero major security or compliance findings.
* Platform uptime/reliability targets met per the managed services SLA.
* Infrastructure costs held within plan through continuous optimisation.
* Positive stakeholder feedback from the client on technical advisory and responsiveness.
* Successful transition from onsite-supported delivery to fully offshore-run operations with no service degradation.

87ffc366.title: Sr. Engagement Manager, AWS Professional Services India
87ffc366.description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Engagement Manager to lead and deliver complex, multi-workstream cloud transformation programs for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India. In this role, you will own the end-to-end delivery lifecycle of large and complex customer engagements, shaping cloud strategies, driving business outcomes, and acting as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders.
  
  
The ideal candidate is an experienced program leader with deep IT consulting expertise, a proven track record in delivering complex technical programs across enterprise customers, and the ability to navigate ambiguity with limited guidance. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on incredibly high standards, and are passionate about mentoring others and scaling delivery best practices across teams.
  
  
You will lead matrixed teams of AWS consultants, partners, and customer resources across multiple workstreams simultaneously. You are expected to drive delivery excellence, maximize engagement value, manage risks proactively, and serve as a force multiplier for your peers and the broader organization. You will actively contribute to pre-sales, build deep customer trust, and leverage AI/GenAI to drive delivery innovation.
  
  
In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Engagement Management Delivery Practice Manager.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own and lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-workstream cloud transformation programs, ensuring business outcomes are achieved within schedule, scope, and financial constraints.
* Shape and validate cloud delivery strategies for complex engagements, applying frameworks such as the Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF), Well-Architected Framework (WAF), and Engagement Delivery Framework (EDF).
* Serve as a strategic advisor to senior customer stakeholders, leading steering committees, driving alignment, and building deep trusted relationships.
* Proactively identify, manage, and escalate risks and issues; develop and execute mitigation plans; redirect distressed programs to delight customers.
* Maximize engagement value by negotiating conditions of acceptance, managing scope changes, and amending contractual terms within project constraints.
* Drive delivery excellence across engagements by defining and sharing EM best practices, creating reusable mechanisms, and establishing operational excellence.
* Actively mentor and develop team members; perform Technical Promotion Assessments (TPAs) and coach Engagement Managers to raise the bar.
* Participate in pre-sales activities, contributing to proposals, scoping, and business development for complex services engagements.
* Leverage Agentic AI and GenAI to optimize delivery processes, improve team productivity, and drive innovative customer outcomes.
* Collaborate with cross-functional AWS teams including Delivery Consultants, Account Executives, Cloud Architects, and Partner teams to solution and deliver cloud programs.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 7+ years of project/program management experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent
* PMP, Prince2, PgMP, SAFe or SCRUM/Agile certification
* 9+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Partner delivery experience — enabling and managing delivery through third-party partners

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

8994bea7.title: Engagement Manager, Customer Success
8994bea7.description:
If you've spent the last few years in consulting, you know the work: get inside a client's operation, find where value is leaking, and go after it. This is that job, except here you keep the clients. You keep an ongoing relationship with the clients where your engagement would normally end.
  
  
You'll run a book of Nash's strategic and enterprise customers, four or five strategic accounts or about ten enterprise ones. When a deal is sold, a Solutions Consultant scopes and builds each deployment. Your role during onboarding is to learn the operation alongside them and take the lead once the customer is live.From there, your job is to make sure every account gets the most out of Nash, and to keep finding what would make it better.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  

* Learn each operation from the inside. Join during onboarding with the Solutions Consultant and Engineers, so by go-live you know how the customer runs as well as the people who built it.
* Find the opportunities and go after them. Every account has four kinds:

+ Adoption: customers are engaged with the services they purchased, as well as all future releases of Nash that are applicable to their operations, including our AI Agents.
+ Operations: better on-time performance, lower cost per delivery, fewer exceptions.
+ Efficiency: accounts that run cleanly, with day-to-day work handled by Support instead of you.
+ Growth: a well-run account surfaces new opportunities. You bring them to the Account Executive and Solutions Consultant to pursue.

* Run each account on a cadence. Quarterly adoption goals, a regular operating review with the customer's team, and business reviews with their leadership.
* Spot risk early. Know the health of every account in your book, and act before a problem becomes an escalation.
* Work across Nash. Support handles day-to-day requests, Solutions Consultants and Engineering handle builds, and Account Executives handle the commercial side. You're the one who knows what each account needs from all of them.
* Keep up with the product. Nash ships product quickly, including AI capabilities. Know what's new before your customers ask, and bring it to them when it fits.

Who you are
  
  

* From consulting or strategic customer work. Two or more years in strategy or operations consulting, or in strategic customer success or account management at an enterprise software company.
* A problem finder. You look at an operation and see where it could be better, and you structure the case for fixing it.
* An operator. You get things done by working with other people and following through until the job is complete.
* Data fluent. You're at home in dashboards and spreadsheets, and you can pull the numbers that make your case.
* Fluent with AI. You already use AI tools in your daily work, and you pick up new ones quickly.
* Credible at every level. With executives and with the people running the operation every day.
* Logistics experience helps, but isn't required. How you think matters more.

How you're measured
  
  

* Adoption goals for each account, set quarterly.
* The health of every account in your book.
* How efficiently each account runs.
* The opportunities you surface for the Account Executive and Solutions Consultant.

How we hire
  
  

* Apply, then send a short Loom (2 to 3 minutes) on why Nash and why this role.
* A conversation with the hiring manager.
* A conversation with a Nash colleague.
* A case study on a real customer situation.
* Offer.

**More about**
**Nash**
**Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics.**
Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.
  
  
Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.
  
  
We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.
  
  
Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco.
  
  
**What You’ll Love About Us**
✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career!
  
  
✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates
  
  
✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
  
  
✅ Flexible paid time off
  
  
✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

**Job Highlight:**

WRI India is seeking a Manager – GeoAnalytics to strengthen the GeoAnalytics team's capabilities in geospatial analytics, software engineering and digital product development. This role will have a dual focus: leading the development and operationalization of Climate Lens, WRI India's integrated climate intelligence and decision-support platform, while managing and contributing to the development of geospatial software applications and analytical solutions across WRI India's programmes.

The position will combine product management, technical leadership, software development and project coordination. The successful candidate will work closely with research and programme teams to translate complex environmental, climate and urban challenges into robust, scalable and user-oriented digital solutions.

The role will be responsible for ensuring that analytical methodologies and research outputs are translated into reusable digital products, supported by sound software architecture, reliable data infrastructure and effective user experiences. The candidate will also contribute to building shared technical capabilities, reusable software components and engineering standards within the GeoAnalytics team.

**What you will do:**

The role will be structured around two complementary areas of responsibility.

1. Climate Lens – Digital Product Development and Management (50%)

Lead the end-to-end development, implementation and continuous improvement of Climate Lens, ensuring that it evolves into a scalable and operational climate intelligence platform supporting evidence-based planning, adaptation and investment decisions.

Product Strategy and Management

* Lead the product development roadmap for Climate Lens, translating the platform vision, strategic objectives and programme requirements into defined product features, development priorities and implementation plans.
* Work closely with GeoAnalytics, Cities and other programme teams to identify user needs, define product requirements and translate climate research methodologies into digital workflows.
* Define product specifications, functional requirements, user journeys, workflows, wireframes and feature-level development plans.
* Coordinate product development activities across research, design, data science and software engineering teams, ensuring alignment between analytical requirements and technical implementation.
* Manage product priorities, timelines, resources, dependencies and delivery milestones.

Technical Development and Integration

* Lead the development and operationalization of Climate Lens
* Oversee the development of shared platform capabilities, including climate data integration, climate hazard and vulnerability assessment, risk prioritization, adaptation planning, scenario modelling and decision-support functionalities.
* Drive the digital productization of WRI India's Climate Hazard Vulnerability Assessment (CHVA) methodology into standardized, configurable and reusable analytical workflows.
* Coordinate the integration of the Urban NbS FinLink finance-search functionality into Climate Lens, ensuring that users can access project assessment and climate finance discovery capabilities across the three geographic applications.
* Work with software developers and technical partners to define system architecture, APIs, databases, data pipelines and integration requirements.
* Ensure that the platform is modular, interoperable, scalable and designed for future expansion across cities, states and thematic applications.

Product Quality, Validation and Adoption

* Establish product development processes, including prototyping, technical validation, user acceptance testing (UAT), release management and continuous improvement.
* Coordinate pilot testing and stakeholder consultations with government agencies, urban local bodies and other intended users.
* Define product performance indicators and monitor platform adoption, user engagement, analytical utilization and institutional uptake.
* Translate user feedback and implementation experience into product enhancements and development priorities.
* Develop product documentation, user guides, technical specifications and onboarding materials.
* Support institutional partnerships, technical presentations and resource mobilization related to Climate Lens.

2. GeoAnalytics and Software Development (50%)

Lead and contribute to the development of geospatial software applications, data-driven solutions and reusable technology components across WRI India's programmes and projects.

Application Development

* Design, develop and maintain full-stack web applications, geospatial platforms, dashboards and digital tools to address programme and research requirements.
* Develop backend services, APIs and frontend applications using appropriate modern software development frameworks and technologies.
* Develop and maintain geospatial data services and workflows using technologies such as PostGIS, GeoServer, GDAL, GeoPandas and Google Earth Engine.
* Build reusable software components, libraries and modules that can be applied across multiple WRI India products and projects.
* Contribute to the development of open-source, interoperable and publicly accessible digital products, including platforms aligned with Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) principles.
* Integrate geospatial analytics, data visualization and AI/ML capabilities into digital applications where relevant.

Engineering Standards

* Establish and promote good software engineering practices, including coding standards, version control, documentation, code reviews and testing.
* Support the implementation of pipelines, deployment processes, cloud infrastructure and application monitoring.
* Evaluate emerging geospatial technologies, open-source frameworks and AI-enabled development approaches for their potential application within WRI India.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to developers, research associates and other members of the GeoAnalytics team.
* Maintain technical documentation, reusable code repositories and institutional knowledge resources.

Project Coordination and Collaboration

* Coordinate with programme teams to understand project requirements, define technical scope and ensure timely delivery of analytical and software development outputs.
* Manage technical work plans, development milestones, resource requirements and project dependencies.
* Provide technical guidance to project teams and support the integration of geospatial and software solutions into programme activities.
* Contribute to research publications, technical reports, proposals, presentations and other institutional knowledge products.

**What you will need:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Geoinformatics, Geography, Geospatial Science, Remote Sensing or a related technical discipline.
* 6–8 years of relevant professional experience in software development, geospatial technology, digital product development or a related field.

**Potential Salary and Benefits:** *INR 18,00,000 to 24,00,000 Annum*

Only select applicants will be contacted for interview. There will be a writing test conducted with final candidates. Please do not contact program staff directly for this position.

70733455.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Strategic programs, PRISM, Last Mile Delivery Tech
70733455.description:
**Description**
How does Amazon deliver millions of packages faster than customers expect, across the globe, every single day?
  
  
If that question excites you, keep reading. We're looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead the strategy and execution of programs across Last Mile Delivery. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where your work will shape the delivery experience for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide.
  
  
At Amazon, we're working to be the most Customer-centric company on earth. One customer experience that we’re constantly looking to take to a new level is how we fulfill and deliver their orders. Our Last Mile organization is at the forefront of this mission: pioneering new products and services, partnering with Delivery Service Partners and Amazon Flex, and building a world-class operation that spans North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific. Last Mile is one of the most customer-visible and strategically important pillars of this work, and you'll be at the center of it.
  
  
As part of Amazon Delivery's PRISM (Central TPM) organization, you will own the end-to-end program strategy for last mile initiatives, driving cross-functional alignment across business, product, and engineering teams to launch and scale programs that move the needle on delivery speed. You will partner with senior leaders across multiple organizations to define priorities, remove blockers, and deliver results.
  
  
The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, brings strong business and technical judgment, and has a track record of delivering complex programs. You are a crisp communicator who can influence at the VP level and translate business goals into actionable roadmaps. If you want to solve one of the most challenging problems in logistics, making delivery faster for every customer, everywhere, this is your role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Serve as the single-threaded leader owning complex programs across multiple VP organizations
* Identify business and technical requirements with science, operations, product, and engineering stakeholders, translating them into specifications, scoped deliverables, and program roadmap from design through launch
* Lead design and implementation efforts across cross-functional teams, making trade-offs to optimize time-to-market
* Own stakeholder communication through all stages of the product lifecycle, clearly articulating goals, roles, and desired outcomes
* Drive high-level strategic initiatives while being willing to roll up your sleeves and get the job done

The right candidate will have a strong program management background, demonstrated experience leading large to extra-large projects, and a well-rounded technical foundation. You must thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Your day starts by connecting the dots across teams, aligning product, engineering, and operations leaders on what matters most for our customer and business. You will run strategic reviews, unblock cross-functional dependencies, and make trade-off decisions that keep programs on track. Some days you are deep in data, shaping the roadmap; other days you are in a room full of senior leaders driving alignment on the next big bet. No two days look the same, but every day you are directly influencing how fast customers get their packages.
  
  
**About The Team**
PRISM is Amazon Delivery's central Technical Program Management organization. We drive programs that span Last Mile and partner organizations including Robotics, Pharmacy, Prime Air, and more. The problems we solve sit at the intersection of customer experience, technology, and operations at massive scale. If you want to work on programs that shape how Amazon delivers to customers globally, this is the team to be on.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of software development experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**

3e2c0cf4.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, UnifiedAuth
3e2c0cf4.description:
**Description**
Unified Authorization is responsible for securing customer and corporate communication across all of Amazon. Whether it's the retail website, Alexa, or Kindle, we ensure actors are authenticated and authorized to take the requested action. Every aspect of Amazon's business interacts with our systems, including enabling the next generation of retail services on AWS infrastructure. As a global security provider, we're at the intersection of resiliency, availability, and the need to move at agile internet speed.
  
  
You are an experienced technical program manager who can work closely with product management and other business partners to define strategy and requirements, and help lead teams from concept through delivery and subsequent operation. You have regular communication with senior management on status, risks and product strategy. You have excellent listening, writing skills and very strong technical competency. You're a thought leader, but you don't just know how to solve the problem, you prove it by leading team to build the solution. Last but not the least; you have a high bar for quality and passion for design and architecture.
  
  
As the ideal candidate you will be experienced in working closely with a team of software development engineers and have a proven track record of working on complex software solutions using an agile methodology. You will have the ability to dive deep into the understanding of problems in order to help your team make the right decisions for the product and the business. You will have a proven track record of working across organizational lines. You will also be a strong communicator and will have proven abilities in managing through ambiguous situations.
  
  
**About The Team**
Unified Auth is responsible for securing every service transaction within Amazon SDO’s service-oriented architecture (SOA) by authenticating the services involved in the transaction, authorizing APIs access, and enforcing least-privilege access to Amazon’s business data such as Cart, Order, Customer Identity, Item, Employee Information and more. Unified Auth’s systems are classified as Maximally Secure Applications (MSA) by Amazon Security as they control access to all Amazon services. Amazon’s SOA is large, complex, and ever-growing. A single Amazon customer interaction such as adding an item into cart, proceeding to checkout, adding/changing payment methods, confirming purchase, etc. spans tens to hundreds of inter-service interactions that must be secured and observed using Unified Auth’s systems. Stores, Alexa, Ring, IMDB, Prime Video, Advertisement, Selling Partners, Pharmacy, Ordering and Payments, Fulfillment Centers, and Amazon’s internal systems such as PXT rely on Unified Auth solutions to meet rising access control security and privacy standards, such as Digital Markets Act (DMA) compliance, GDPR, and SOC 2 Type II certification.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**

BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high-quality software at speed.
