2156fd4b.title: Technical Program Manager III, AI & Data
2156fd4b.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
**Technical Program Manager III, AI & Data**
Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools that deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. This role sits in the AI and Data Organisation, supporting the AI and Analytics Platform team which makes AI, ML, analytics, metrics, behavioural data and experimentation fast, governed, reliable, self-service and cost effective for every Expedia team.
  
  
As a Technical Program Manager III, you will lead complex, cross-functional programs, connecting strategic goals to clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and predictable delivery. You will own integrated program plans from concept through completion and make scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and critical paths visible so teams can make timely, informed trade-offs. You will raise risks and blockers early, apply sound judgment to options and trade-offs, and create clarity on ownership, decisions, and next steps. This role also strengthens portfolio visibility and operating rhythms across teams and divisions by creating practical planning and reporting mechanisms, and applying AI, automation, and reusable delivery frameworks to improve how work gets done.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead strategic program delivery. Translate business objectives and product or technical requirements into integrated plans, milestones, workstreams, and execution priorities. Drive delivery end to end, adapting plans as scope, sequencing, capacity, or context changes.
* Connect work to business outcomes: Partner with Functional Area and team leaders to assess whether proposed work supports AI and Data and Expedia Group priorities. Define success criteria and measurable outcomes before execution, and use results to guide decisions and continuous improvement.
* Make the portfolio visible: Maintain an accurate view of programs including commitments, status, dependencies, risks, and changes. Develop roadmaps and concise leadership updates that provide the right visibility with minimal overhead and be candid when commitments are at risk or information is unresolved.
* Enable planning and prioritization: Support quarterly planning cycles that connect team commitments to Expedia Group goals. Facilitate prioritization and trade-off discussions so leaders and teams can focus capacity on the most important outcomes.
* Drive cross-functional alignment: Coordinate engineering, product, design, data, business, and partner teams. Build trusted working relationships and help surface and resolve program-level questions about system design, APIs, data, operating models, and delivery approaches; document decisions, owners, and their implications so teams can move forward with shared understanding.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and change: Identify issues and bottlenecks early, maintain clear ownership and mitigation plans, and escalate when needed. Track cross-team dependencies and critical paths, frame trade-offs, and communicate impacts to scope, schedule, and outcomes.
* Establish effective operating mechanisms: Create or improve governance, status reporting, decision forums, team communications, and delivery practices that support transparent decisions and reliable execution without unnecessary process. Use expertise to recommend practical approaches when teams face ambiguity.
* Advance AI & Data delivery frameworks: Use appropriate AI-enabled tools and automation to streamline program planning, synthesis, reporting, risk identification, and repeatable workflows. Develop reusable program frameworks and self-service paths that help teams spend more time on high-value work. Help teams safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled capabilities, applying foundational AI/ML concepts in real product and engineering contexts and using judgment about human review, data handling, and appropriate tool use.
* Measure and improve: Define and report program and team outcomes, delivery health, and relevant performance metrics. Monitor product or capability performance after launch, identify opportunities to simplify processes, and turn insights into actionable improvements. Use data and operational insights to improve predictability, workflow, and delivery quality.
* Build trusted partnerships: Develop strong working relationships with stakeholders who have varied perspectives. Communicate technical and business concepts clearly to delivery teams, partners, senior leaders, and executives.
* Stay curious: Keep learning about the AI and Data domain, the business, emerging AI tools, and better ways of working; apply relevant learning to continually improve program delivery.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* You have 5+ years of experience leading technical programs with cross-functional dependencies in platform, infrastructure, data, analytics, or similarly complex engineering environments.
* Prior technical background and core understand of SDLC is a foundational requirement for success in this role
* You have experience planning and delivering moderately complex programs across multiple teams, including managing timelines, dependencies, risks, milestones, and execution reporting.
* You are skilled at building clarity and accountability through dashboards, status communication, governance mechanisms, and structured operating rhythms.
* You are comfortable influencing without authority and aligning engineering, product, and business stakeholders around trade-offs, priorities, and next steps.
* You have strong technical fluency and can understand distributed systems, APIs, services, data flows, architecture discussions, and operational risks well enough to ask the right questions and surface gaps early.

20dacf9e.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Network Design & Planning
20dacf9e.description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
  
  
Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
  
  
At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
  
  
When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
  
  
**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
*This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office.*
**Summary Of How You Will Impact Skylo**
Skylo is hiring a
**Senior**
**Technical Program Manager for Network Design & Planning**
to help fulfill Skylo’s mission of making satellite connectivity available to all. Based in Bangalore, this individual will drive the planning and execution of the team’s most important cross-functional programs, including new market and ground station launches, core and RAN capacity expansions, vendor deliveries, regulatory capabilities, and service maturity initiatives. You will bring structure, visibility, and pace to complex technical work spanning engineering teams, vendors, satellite operators, and MNO partners across multiple time zones.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**

* Own end-to-end delivery of Network Design & Planning programs, such as network expansions, new ground station and market launches, core and RAN capacity upgrades, and regulatory capabilities (e.g. Lawful Intercept, emergency alerts).
* Build and maintain integrated program plans, milestones, dependencies, and resource plans across engineering, operations, product, and partner teams.
* Manage technical deliveries from network vendors (including our 5G core vendor), tracking scope, releases, acceptance testing, and contractual milestones.
* Coordinate with satellite operators, MNO partners, and ground station providers on joint technical plans and launch readiness.
* Identify and manage program risks, issues, and decisions, and drive timely escalation and resolution.
* Establish program operating rhythms, including status reporting, steering reviews, and dashboards for engineering leadership.
* Drive service maturity initiatives with Operations, including launch readiness checklists, runbooks, and handover from design to operations.
* Track network capacity and budget plans alongside engineering leads, and support vendor and procurement processes.
* Continuously improve the team’s planning, intake, and delivery processes and tooling (e.g. Jira, Confluence).
* Communicate clearly across time zones (India, Europe, and the US) to keep stakeholders aligned.

**What We Look For**

* 8+ years of experience in telecom, with at least 4 years in technical program or project management of network deployments, expansions, or vendor deliveries.
* Solid technical understanding of mobile networks (RAN, 4G/5G core, IMS, IP transport) sufficient to engage credibly with engineers and vendors.
* Proven track record delivering complex, multi-team technical programs on time, including with external vendors and partners.
* Strong skills in program planning, dependency and risk management, and executive-level status reporting.
* Experience managing network equipment or software vendors, including release tracking and acceptance testing.
* Experience working across distributed, multi-time-zone teams.
* Proficiency with program management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or MS Project.
* Experience with satellite communications or Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) is a plus.
* PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification is a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong stakeholder management and facilitation abilities.

**What We Offer**
With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range benefits such as:
  
  

* Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
* Comprehensive occupational health coverage
* Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
* A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
* Once in a lifetime opportunity to be a part of developing and running world’s first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network and service
* Access to world-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
* Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends multi-national characteristics

**EEO Statement**
Skylo is an equal-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

0dfe4342.title: Support Engineer III, AMC, Ad-Tech Solutions
0dfe4342.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) is a new secure, privacy-safe, and dedicated cloud-based environment in which advertisers can easily perform analytics across multiple, pseudonymized data sets to generate insights. Inputs can include an advertiser’s own data sets, as well as their Amazon Advertising campaign events, such as impressions, clicks, and conversions. AMC enables advertisers to perform campaign measurement, audience refinement, supply optimization, and more, enabling advertisers to make more informed decisions about their cross-channel marketing investments. Our services ingest billions of behavioral signals every day. Speed, scale, and accuracy are critical to our success.  
  
This is a customer-facing role that demands strong technical depth across AWS services, excellent communication skills, and a project management mindset. You will be the bridge between customers and internal teams, ensuring a seamless onboarding experience while advocating for customer needs.  
  
Are you passionate about driving customer success? Interested in learning new technologies? Do you thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment? AMC is seeking a Sr Support Engineer to provide support to partners and external customers as they build business-critical applications on our platform. You'll also work directly with Amazon Advertising product and engineering teams to ensure that customer issues are resolved as expediently as possible.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
In this role, you will independently resolve customer issues and blockers by providing knowledgeable and responsive technical support on AMC. Our customers are large enterprises, direct and agencies.You would often interact with customers’ Data Analysts and other Data focused stakeholders. You would use advanced SQL skills to build confidence and solutions. You will have ownership for issue investigation, identifying root cause and software defects, conceive and provide workarounds if acceptable to customers for continuity. You will gather sufficient information that helps reproduce issues and contribute to building software fixes. This is a complex, and fast-paced environment as you will own the most critical part of the customer experience and delivering on our customers’ most basic need. While we obsess over issue resolution, in this role you will also develop tools to scale our support & service quality, and provide critical input for product prioritization to address root causes of why the customer experienced an issue in the first place. Our advertising customers are likely Amazon customers, and we take seriously maintaining the high customer service bar set by Amazon to be the level at which we need to operate.  
A day in the life
  
  

* Track, investigate, and resolve customer questions and issues using appropriate communication channel including phone, email, and live as well as asynchronous at various levels of complexity and customer impact.
* Act as an escalation point for the most complex and in-depth issues that potentially span multiple external and internal organizations.
* Communicate directly with internal organizations to complete root cause analyses, issue investigation, workarounds and defect resolution.
* Develop and implement complex repro cases to identify potential software defects, mis-configurations, or issues in customer environments.
* Use case management tools to manage and prioritize issues based on multiple factors including customer impact.
* Build & Contribute to training material and documentation for both internal and customer-facing users.
* Actively seeking solutions to customer needs, communicating trends to leadership, and suggesting innovative solutions on behalf of the customer experience.
* Providing support directly to data analysts who are using Amazon Marketing Cloud.
* Writing queries, code samples, tutorials, and technical articles for the customer community
* Working with customers to understand how they are using our services, and providing feedback to development teams
* Collaborating with internal stakeholders to drive timely customer communication
* Driving internal projects that improve support-related processes and our customer's user experience
* Customer Onboarding: Own end-to-end technical onboarding of customers onto Amazon Ads solutions, ensuring smooth and timely implementation.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve technical issues across the AWS stack, working closely with customers and internal engineering teams to drive resolution.
* Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer — collect and synthesize VOC (Voice of the Customer) feedback, and translate customer questions, pain points, and feature requests into engineering and program-level requirements.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, product, and program teams to drive resolution of customer issues and influence the product roadmap based on customer insights.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
* 3+ years of technical support experience
* 2+ years of scripting language experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of cloud platforms and cloud computing such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, etc.

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Job Description Summary**
This role for strategic AI Solution Architect bridging between control systems and artificial intelligence to lead the digital transformation in control system platforms. You will be responsible for designing and implementing the end-to-end architecture that allows AI and Machine Learning models to run securely and efficiently within Gas Power Controls environments to bridge the gap between traditional Operational Technology (OT) such as Mark VIe controllers and HMI platforms with modern AI frameworks. Ensure that our AI solutions are not only innovative but also hardened, compliant with global energy standards (NERC/CIP, IEC 62443), and seamlessly integrated into the lifecycle management.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Architectural Leadership: Lead the design, implementation, and validation of AI-ready platform lifecycle tools, scalability and deployment of predictive and generative AI models.
* Infrastructure Design: Define complex network architectures and hardware/software configurations that support both on-prem edge computing and cloud-based AI workloads.
* System Hardening: Make the system ready for Installation, configuration, patching, and hardening to ensure the highest levels of cybersecurity of assets.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Interface with cross functional team including Principal Engineers, Product Line Managers to translate business needs into technical AI requirements, maintaining delivery plans using Agile methodologies.
* Global Project Coordination: Drive and coordinate multiple AI-driven programs simultaneously across a global, cross-functional environment, ensuring alignment between manufacturing, sourcing, and suppliers.
* Continuous Improvement: Implement Lean process methodologies to optimize the AI development lifecycle, from data ingestion at the controller level to model inference at the HMI.
* Support & Deployment: Provide high-level technical support to field personnel during the deployment of AI-enhanced control systems and HMI platforms.

**Required Skills**

* 12-15 years of relevant experience on the industrial control systems, platform architecture and Gen AI
* Industrial Control Systems: Deep knowledge of MarkVIe controller platforms, ToolboxST, and HMI platform architecture.
* AI/ML Architecture: Proven experience in designing scalable AI solutions, including knowledge of model deployment, data orchestration, and MLOps.
* Network & Security Engineering: Expertise in routers, firewalls, switches, compute, and storage, specifically within Software-Defined Networks (SDN) and Active Directory environments.
* Compliance & Cybersecurity: Hands-on application of cybersecurity technologies and standards, with a firm awareness of NERC/CIP and IEC 62443 requirements for power generation.
* Virtualization & Cloud: Advanced proficiency in virtualization platforms, and integration of on-prem infrastructure.
* Agile Leadership: Experience leading technical teams and managing complex delivery roadmaps in an Agile framework.

**Desired Skills**

* Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in scripting tools (Python, PowerShell, or Bash) to automate the deployment and monitoring of AI models.
* GenAI & Data Strategy: Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), Vector Databases, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) within an industrial context.
* Strategic Thinking: Ability to influence stakeholders by connecting AI technical capabilities for operational efficiency.
* Domain Expertise: Understanding of GT, ST, HRSG operations, and power plant operation and maintenance.

* Proven ability to evaluate cloud security technologies, policies and processes.
* Experience conducting cloud risk assessments against global/MENA specific standards/regulations
* Experience managing cloud security metrics, reporting, and audit readiness.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience in incident management and response in cloud environments.
* Familiarity with DevSecOps and secure CI/CD practices in Cloud

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 5–8 years of experience in cloud security, with hands-on expertise in hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Knowledge of CIS Benchmarks, NIST, ISO 27001, CSA CCM, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience leading client workshops, assessments, cloud security strategy engagements, and preparing executive-level reports and recommendations.
* Open to travel to MENA (up to 50% of the time)
* Excellent communication skills with consulting experience preferred

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* A bachelor's or master's degree in B. TECH/B. E, MS in computer science, MBA (IT or Systems) or a related discipline.

2cacb25f.title: Solution Architect
2cacb25f.description:
*There is an immediate need for an experienced*
***Solution Architect***
*at SupraITS Canada through its subsidiary Atomic North India. If you’re someone who can see both the big picture and the technical details, enjoys designing scalable systems, and thrives on solving complex engineering and infrastructure challenges then this position is for you.*
**LOCATIONS:**
This role is remote/hybrid and is available for candidates located in: Delhi, Chennai or Jammu
  
  
**About Supra Its**
Founded in 1999, Supra ITS has grown into a globally trusted IT partner, delivering world-class Managed IT, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Application Services, and Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) Services. Headquartered in Mississauga, Supra ITS operates with 650+ employees worldwide, including Network Operations Centers (NOCs) in Canada and India, ensuring 24/7 IT support and seamless service delivery.
  
  
Supra ITS provides a full spectrum of IT solutions, including server and network management, private cloud, disaster recovery, service desk support, and advanced security services. With a security-first approach and SLA-driven commitments, Supra ITS takes complete ownership of IT services, allowing clients to focus on growth while ensuring uninterrupted operations.
  
  
**Canon Partnership**
In 2021, Canon Canada made an equity investment in Supra ITS, recognizing a shared vision to deliver world-class technology and managed services across North America.
  
  
What began as a strategic investment has since evolved into an integrated partnership, combining Canon’s innovation and enterprise solutions with Supra ITS’s agility, customer focus, and managed services expertise.
  
  
Today, we operate as a unified force, driving rapid growth across North America through automation, cloud, cybersecurity, and business process solutions. Together, Canon and Supra ITS are accelerating digital transformation for customers, delivering secure, scalable, and performance-driven IT solutions that redefine what it means to be truly customer-centric.
  
  
Canon Canada’s strategic investment in Supra ITS strengthens this commitment by integrating Canon’s cutting-edge technologies with Supra’s agile IT services. This partnership fosters innovation, enhances efficiency, and accelerates digital transformation, providing customers with superior IT solutions that are scalable, secure, and customer centric.
  
  
For more information, visit www.supraits.com.
  
  
**About Atomic North**
Atomic North is the India-based subsidiary of Supra ITS, serving as the global delivery and operations centre behind Supra’s Managed IT, Application Services, and BPO businesses. As an integral part of Supra ITS’ international ecosystem, Atomic North ensures operational transparency, and seamless collaboration with our North American leadership teams. As Supra ITS scales rapidly across North America in partnership with Canon, Atomic North is expanding its leadership team in India to support the company’s next phase of growth, maturity, and operational excellence.
  
  
**Team Overview**
This is your opportunity to join a dynamic company with a team that works very well together and has solid organized structures in place. Supra’s head office is based in Brampton, Ontario with offices across North America and growing, you will be part of a growing team and evolving company.
  
  
Our global delivery operations are in India through our subsidiary, Atomic North. With Canon’s strategic equity partnership and a strong North American customer base, Supra ITS is scaling its India operations to deliver world-class infrastructure services, automation, and cybersecurity solutions.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a strategic technical leader who can balance architecture, reliability, security, cost, and team growth while guiding engineers and driving long-term technical vision.
  
  
As Solution Architect, you'll define the technical strategy for the AI ITSM Agent Platform. You'll make cloud infrastructure decisions, design systems for scale, build and mentor the engineering team, and ensure we execute with excellence. You'll report to the CTO and own the platform's technical roadmap for 18–24 months.
  
  
**YOU ARE!**
An experienced Solution Architect with 8+ years’ experience in production software engineering
  
  
2+ years’ experience in architecture or technical leadership.
  
  
Can articulate technical vision to C-level and engineers
  
  
Writes clear RFCs and design docs that guide implementation
  
  
Runs effective technical discussions; makes decisive trade-off decisions
  
  
Builds and mentors engineers; creates psychological safety and growth
  
  
Transparent: admits when you don't know; seeks expertise
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**What you’ll own**

* Technical architecture: design system for 10x growth (compute, data, async processing, observability)
* Cloud infrastructure on AWS/GCP/Azure: serverless vs. containerized, multi-region strategy, cost optimization
* Security & compliance: authentication, authorization, encryption, audit logging, data privacy
* Observability: monitoring, logging, alerting, SLOs/SLIs, incident response
* Team building: hire engineers (junior through architect), establish best practices, mentorship
* Technology choices: databases, message queues, vector DBs, agent frameworks, deployment platforms
* Reliability: design for 99.9% uptime, disaster recovery, data integrity
* Cost optimization: right-sizing resources, pricing models, vendor management

**Tech Stack**

* Clouds - AWS (EC2, ECS, RDS, Lambda, S3) or GCP (Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, Cloud Run) or Azure
* Full Stack - React, TypeScript, FastAPI, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker
* Distributed - Message queues, load balancing, replication, sharding
* Agents/AI - LLM integration patterns, agent orchestration, MCP, vector scaling, Claude Agents
* Observability - Structured logging, metrics, traces, alerting (Datadog, ELK, etc.)

**Technical Experience**
**Deep Technical Knowledge:**

* Mastery across full stack: React, TypeScript, FastAPI, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker
* Can jump into any layer and make informed decisions or code changes
* Deep understanding of trade-offs between technologies

**Cloud Architecture (AWS, GCP, Or Azure—Deep In One)**

* Compute options: EC2/VMs vs. Lambda/serverless vs. Kubernetes; when each is appropriate
* Database scaling: read replicas, Multi-AZ, replication, sharding strategies
* Networking: VPC design, security groups, load balancing, multi-region failover
* Security: encryption, secrets management, IAM, audit logging, compliance
* Cost optimization: right-sizing, reserved instances, spot instances, pricing models

**System Architecture At Scale**

* Microservices vs. monolith: when each is appropriate
* Asynchronous processing: message queues, job processors, event-driven architecture
* Caching strategies: cache invalidation, CDN, in-memory, database-level
* API design patterns: rate limiting, circuit breakers, bulkheads

**Operational Excellence**

* Observability: structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, alerting
* SLOs/SLIs: defining reliability targets, measuring against them
* Incident response: post-mortems, root cause analysis, blameless culture
* Deployment strategies: blue-green, canary, feature flags, rollback

**AI & Agent Systems**

* LLM integration patterns: streaming, token management, rate limiting
* Agent workflow architecture: planning, memory, reflection, tool use
* Vector embedding pipelines: batch processing, caching, similarity search at scale
* Cost optimization for LLM usage: token counting, batching, caching

**Preferred Qualifications**
While not required, preference may be given to candidates with experience in the following areas:
  
  

* Redis caching and optimization
* Message queues (Celery, Bull)
* GraphQL experience
* Advanced prompt engineering and fine-tuning experience

Skills: python,ai agents,cloud architecture,typescript

2cb3662b.title: Expert Service Delivery Manager
2cb3662b.description:
**Overview:**
The Service Delivery Manager is a senior operations position providing leadership for rotational team and collaborate with duty managers supporting 100+ clients on a rotating shift pattern, responsible for the efficient and professional execution of activities associated with providing an exceptional level of hospitality for clients' mission-critical systems. The Service Delivery Manager also serves as the accountable owner of Change Management governance for the entire business unit under the Altera Cloud Operations Change Management Process (v2.1) — chairing the Technical Review Board (TRB), overseeing implementation and validation, and holding final closure authority across all towers and shifts.
  
  
Change Implementation, Validation & Closure
  
  

* Facilitate TRB meeting for change reviews across cloud BU.
* Staff and lead the Hosting Response Bridge (HRB), providing 24x7 monitoring across the post-change stability window; trigger swarms the moment an anomaly is detected.
* Enforce alert-suppression discipline and confirm pre-change baseline capture and post-change comparison before closure.
* Oversee validation against Validation Test Library pass/fail criteria and evidence — including mandatory application and technical validation for production changes.
* Hold final closure authority: confirm the 24-hour or TRB approved closure window with HRB observation if the change was clean and evidence is complete before authorizing closure; refuse closure otherwise.
* Invoke rollback directly against a pre-agreed trigger without further approval; escalate exceptions to the Tower Leader.
* Carry open items into shift handover with clear owners so closure is never missed across a shift boundary.

Operational Leadership & Incident Management
  
  

* Major incident / critical issue early detection and fast remediation for all matters during their shift.
* Ensure all client requests, incidents, and problems are addressed in a timely and professional manner.
* Run stand-up calls with their team, managing proper hand-over of activities and client status between shifts and teams.
* Allocate resources as necessary across teams to provide efficient, effective resolution of issues.
* Identify and implement operational process improvements across teams.
* Assist Shift Site Reliability Engineers with client communication and escalations.
* Drive results through agreed KPIs for alerts, monitoring tools, and case/ServiceNow (SNOW) metrics.

TRB Ownership & Change Process Governance
  
  

* Chair the Technical Review Board: the final gate reviewing risk classification, architectural impact, rollback adequacy, and monitoring plan for every change; approve, send back for rework, or escalate.
* Pre-agree and record rollback triggers at TRB, each with a maximum time-to-decide.
* Own and continuously improve the end-to-end process, intake template, and Validation Test Library across all towers.
* Track and report TRB gate-hold and rework rates monthly; a near-zero rework rate signals the board is a formality, not a control.

People Management
  
  

* Provide detailed and accurate job performance feedback for each resource working under their guidance.
* Supervise employee attendance and participation.
* Inspire and motivate employees on their rotating shift.

Reporting Relationships
  
  
The Service Delivery Manager has primary responsibility for the rating and review of each employee dedicated to rotating with them, with input from the Tower Manager. The Tower Manager is accountable for best practices, effective training/testing, and the overall architecture and direction of their service delivery tower, and provides functional direction and input into employee ratings. Employees have a hard-line reporting relationship into their Tower Manager, with a dotted line to the Service Delivery Manager.
  
  
Metrics Ownership
  
  

* Report monthly: peer-review SLA breaches, TRB gate-hold/rework rates, closure refusals, change success and change-caused incident rates (24-hr/7-day), rollback invocation/success rate, and process exceptions by tower, alongside case/SNOW and alerting KPIs.
* Success rate for changes driven thought TRB , all changes should be successful.
* Bi-weekly reporting of change management team control deck.

1b3ddb5b.title: AMS Cloud EPM ARCS Consultant
1b3ddb5b.description:
Overview:
  
At Peloton, we don't just implement technology. We transform the way organizations work, compete, and grow. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in the US, Peloton is one of the most respected and fastest-growing global Oracle consulting firms, delivering Advisory, Consulting, and Managed Services to leading organizations across many industries, including Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Consumer Packaged Goods, and more.
  
Peloton Consulting Group has the vision and connected global capabilities to help organizations envision, implement, and realize the benefits of digital transformation. Our team has the best practices, knowledge, industry expertise, and know-how. We make digital transformation a reality by leveraging AI, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Supply Chain Management (SCM), Human Capital Management (HCM), Customer Experience (CX), Analytics, and Data Management for the cloud. Through connected capabilities, we bring people, processes, and technology together. We help organizations go further faster. That is the Peloton way!
  
What truly sets us apart is our people. We are team players. We are energetic and entrepreneurial. We are problem solvers and innovative thinkers who believe the best outcomes are built together. We believe in quality, appreciate creativity, recognize individual contributions, and place trust in every member of our team. If you bring strong business or technical expertise and want to do meaningful work alongside people who are equally passionate about getting it right, we think you'll feel right at home here.
  
This role requires a balance of client relationship management, operational oversight, and strategic thinking to ensure services are delivered efficiently and aligned with evolving client business needs.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
This role requires candidates to work in IST hours from 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM and have a minimum of 6+ years of relevant professional experience.
  
While this is a remote opportunity open to candidates across India, applicants based in Hyderabad or Bangalore will be preferred, as these are our primary hiring locations.

ab42216b.title: Expert Service Delivery Manager
ab42216b.description:
**Overview:**
The Service Delivery Manager is a senior operations position providing leadership for rotational team and collaborate with duty managers supporting 100+ clients on a rotating shift pattern, responsible for the efficient and professional execution of activities associated with providing an exceptional level of hospitality for clients' mission-critical systems. The Service Delivery Manager also serves as the accountable owner of Change Management governance for the entire business unit under the Altera Cloud Operations Change Management Process (v2.1) — chairing the Technical Review Board (TRB), overseeing implementation and validation, and holding final closure authority across all towers and shifts.
  
  
Change Implementation, Validation & Closure
  
  

* Facilitate TRB meeting for change reviews across cloud BU.
* Staff and lead the Hosting Response Bridge (HRB), providing 24x7 monitoring across the post-change stability window; trigger swarms the moment an anomaly is detected.
* Enforce alert-suppression discipline and confirm pre-change baseline capture and post-change comparison before closure.
* Oversee validation against Validation Test Library pass/fail criteria and evidence — including mandatory application and technical validation for production changes.
* Hold final closure authority: confirm the 24-hour or TRB approved closure window with HRB observation if the change was clean and evidence is complete before authorizing closure; refuse closure otherwise.
* Invoke rollback directly against a pre-agreed trigger without further approval; escalate exceptions to the Tower Leader.
* Carry open items into shift handover with clear owners so closure is never missed across a shift boundary.

Operational Leadership & Incident Management
  
  

* Major incident / critical issue early detection and fast remediation for all matters during their shift.
* Ensure all client requests, incidents, and problems are addressed in a timely and professional manner.
* Run stand-up calls with their team, managing proper hand-over of activities and client status between shifts and teams.
* Allocate resources as necessary across teams to provide efficient, effective resolution of issues.
* Identify and implement operational process improvements across teams.
* Assist Shift Site Reliability Engineers with client communication and escalations.
* Drive results through agreed KPIs for alerts, monitoring tools, and case/ServiceNow (SNOW) metrics.

TRB Ownership & Change Process Governance
  
  

* Chair the Technical Review Board: the final gate reviewing risk classification, architectural impact, rollback adequacy, and monitoring plan for every change; approve, send back for rework, or escalate.
* Pre-agree and record rollback triggers at TRB, each with a maximum time-to-decide.
* Own and continuously improve the end-to-end process, intake template, and Validation Test Library across all towers.
* Track and report TRB gate-hold and rework rates monthly; a near-zero rework rate signals the board is a formality, not a control.

People Management
  
  

* Provide detailed and accurate job performance feedback for each resource working under their guidance.
* Supervise employee attendance and participation.
* Inspire and motivate employees on their rotating shift.

Reporting Relationships
  
  
The Service Delivery Manager has primary responsibility for the rating and review of each employee dedicated to rotating with them, with input from the Tower Manager. The Tower Manager is accountable for best practices, effective training/testing, and the overall architecture and direction of their service delivery tower, and provides functional direction and input into employee ratings. Employees have a hard-line reporting relationship into their Tower Manager, with a dotted line to the Service Delivery Manager.
  
  
Metrics Ownership
  
  

* Report monthly: peer-review SLA breaches, TRB gate-hold/rework rates, closure refusals, change success and change-caused incident rates (24-hr/7-day), rollback invocation/success rate, and process exceptions by tower, alongside case/SNOW and alerting KPIs.
* Success rate for changes driven thought TRB , all changes should be successful.
* Bi-weekly reporting of change management team control deck.

e37b59a6.title: Assistant Service Delivery Manager (US Client Experience)
e37b59a6.description:
**About us**  
XO Team India is the Hyderabad team of the Base8 group, which provides technology and business services to companies across the US and Canada, including Cure8, a managed IT provider for the cannabis industry. Our team works directly with US colleagues and clients every day over Teams, phone and our ticketing and CRM tools, so strong written and spoken English matters in every role.

**About the role**  
This role exists to keep service delivery steady and accountable across more than 80 client accounts, working alongside the Service Delivery Manager. Success in a year looks like SLAs met without last-minute scrambles, clients who trust the team, and reporting that senior management can act on.

**What you'll do**

* Monitor daily performance against contracted SLAs and KPIs, acting before breaches occur.
* Oversee incident, problem, change and request processes, and lead major incidents and post-incident reviews.
* Prepare monthly client service reports with trends, risks and recommendations, and internal performance reports for senior management.
* Act as the day-to-day contact for client stakeholders, lead service review meetings and manage escalations.
* Coordinate internal teams, manage rotas, resource planning, engineer allocation and absence cover.
* Coach teams on service management and customer handling, and maintain service catalogues, runbooks and client documentation.
* Identify recurring issues and improve processes, tools and automation, and support new client onboarding.
* Deputise for the Service Delivery Manager when unavailable, including out-of-hours major incident cover.

**What you'll bring**

* 15+ years in IT service delivery, service management or senior service desk roles, ideally within an MSP.
* Proven experience managing SLAs, KPIs and multiple client accounts.
* Strong ITIL knowledge, especially incident, problem, change and service level management.
* Experience leading major incidents and post-incident reviews.
* Experience with PSA/ITSM tools such as HaloPSA or ConnectWise.
* Advanced Excel and Power BI reporting skills.

**Nice to have**

* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher.
* Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, CompTIA, Cisco or Security+ certification.
* Previous experience deputising for a senior manager.

**Working hours**  
US Pacific shift: 9:30 PM – 6:30 AM IST, Monday to Friday.

**Benefits**  
PF, medical insurance, paid US holidays, 12 earned leaves, 12 paid sick leaves, 12 casual leaves per calendar year, and compensatory off as applicable.

**Hiring process**  
We never charge any fee at any stage of hiring and never ask for payment for interviews, training or equipment. Offers come only from an @base8.io email address.

**Equal opportunity**  
XO Team India Pvt Ltd is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of gender (including transgender persons), sexual orientation, caste, religion, region, disability, age, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply; email hr@base8.io if you need any accommodation during the hiring process.

**Your data**  
By applying, you share your resume and contact details with XO Team India Pvt Ltd so we can assess you for this and similar roles. Resume files are deleted 90 days after you apply. To withdraw your consent, correct your data or ask us to erase it, email hr@base8.io.

0085f7c7.title: Project Delivery Manager – SAP
0085f7c7.description:
##### **Job Description**

Professional Experience and Expertise SAP Project Delivery Manager with 10 years of experience in managing and delivering SAP projects. Experienced in managing cross-functional and cross-geography SAP RICEFW projects involving ABAP, PI/PO, MDG, SD/MM, FI/CO, PP and QM teams. Experienced in end-to-end project delivery across all phases, including requirements gathering, solution design, estimation, development, testing, cutover and deployment. Skilled in managing project plans, resource plans, risks, dependencies, issues, escalations and stakeholder expectations. Experienced in conducting project meetings and workshops, preparing weekly status reports, maintaining dashboards and managing stakeholder communications and presentations. Proficient in Jira, Agile methodologies, user stories and project management tools. Key Strengths and Competencies Independent contributor with the ability to manage responsibilities and deliver tasks independently without continuous support or follow-ups. Strong decision-making skills with the ability to assess situations, establish clarity and make timely decisions to keep delivery activities moving forward. Effective collaborator with experience working across multiple geographies, cross-functional teams and diverse stakeholders. Strong facilitation skills with experience conducting meetings and workshops across requirements, design, development, testing, deployment and knowledge transfer phases. Role Purpose The Project Delivery Manager is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of SAP BTP projects across the complete BTP Operating Model. The role ensures predictable, governed and high-quality delivery of BTP demands by acting as the single point of accountability between Business, Sector IT, BTP CoE teams, including Design, Development and Platform teams, Architecture, Governance, Validation and AMS teams. The role also includes Scrum Master or Agile Master responsibilities and is designed for Waterfall or Hybrid BTP initiatives that require strong project management, governance coordination and cross-team orchestration. Role Objectives Ensuring consistent execution of the BTP Operating Model. Managing end-to-end delivery from Demand Intake to Project Closure. Reducing delivery challenges, escalations and stakeholder dissatisfaction. Providing clear accountability and transparency to Business and IT leadership. Enabling development and platform teams to focus on execution by managing coordination activities and removing delivery obstacles. Scope of Accountability The Project Delivery Manager is responsible for managing and coordinating delivery across the entire SAP BTP project lifecycle, including requirements gathering, feasibility assessment, solution design, estimation, approvals, preparation, development, testing, knowledge transfer, deployment, hypercare and project closure. Communication and Reporting Providing regular and consistent project status updates to Business and IT leadership. Maintaining project dashboards, risk registers, issue logs, dependency trackers and action trackers. Proactively identifying and escalating risks, issues, dependencies and critical decision points. Ensuring transparency and leadership visibility across the BTP project portfolio. Meeting and Coordination Ownership The Project Delivery Manager is responsible for planning, organizing and coordinating all project lifecycle meetings and engagements. Coordinating demand intake and prioritization meetings. Facilitating requirements gathering and solution design workshops. Managing feasibility assessments and estimation discussions. Coordinating governance and approval meetings. Conducting weekly project delivery reviews and status reporting meetings. Coordinating hypercare and AMS knowledge transfer sessions. The Project Delivery Manager ensures a structured and coordinated engagement model across all participating teams, reducing fragmented communication and improving overall delivery efficiency. Key Stakeholder Interfaces Working closely with Business Requestors and Business Project Leads. Coordinating

b628dbb6.title: Implementation & Support Technical Specialist – ShopperTrak Solutions
b628dbb6.description:
**Who we are?**

***About Johnson Controls***

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services, and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results, and help move society forward.

Visit johnsoncontrols.com for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms.

**What you will do**

We are looking for a technically skilled and customer-focused **Implementation & Support Technical Specialist** to deploy, configure, maintain, and support **ShopperTrak retail analytics solutions** across retail customer environments. The role is responsible for Pre Sales discussion with end-to-end implementation of traffic counting systems, occupancy solutions, retail analytics platforms, data integrations, and ongoing technical support.

The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in retail technology, networking, field deployments, troubleshooting, and customer engagement. The specialist will work closely with sales, project management, customer success, product engineering, and retail customers to ensure successful implementation and operational excellence.

**How you will do it**  
**Solution Design, Implementation & Deployment:**

* Pre Sales engagement with client along with Sales team for Designing the solution to provide all required KPI’s by client.
* Coordinating with Subcon for best quote and installation planning and supporting Subcon team to find suitable Subcon in unrepresented areas.
* Install, configure, and commission ShopperTrak traffic counting and retail analytics solutions.
* Conduct site surveys and assess infrastructure readiness including network, power, mounting locations, and connectivity requirements.
* Deploy and configure:

* + ShopperTrak Vision sensors
  + Traffic counting devices
  + Occupancy monitoring solutions
* Validate sensor performance, counting accuracy, and data quality.
* Execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and customer sign-off procedures.
* Coordinate implementation activities with retailers, contractors, IT teams, and project managers.
* Ensure deployments meet project timelines, quality standards, and customer expectations.

**Technical Support & Operations :**

* Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for ShopperTrak hardware and software solutions.
* Troubleshoot:
  + Sensor communication issues
  + Network connectivity failures
  + Analytics data synchronization problems
* Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
* Monitor system health and proactively address performance issues.
* Manage incidents, service requests, and escalations according to SLA commitments.
* Coordinate with global engineering and product support teams for complex issues.
* Ensuring PO to Subcon is issued on time to meet SLA committed to clients.

**Documentation & Compliance :**

* Create and maintain:
  + Solution Design including markup plans wherever required.
  + Installation guides
  + Technical runbooks
  + Site documentation
  + Network diagrams
  + Support procedures
  + Knowledge base articles
* Maintain deployment records and configuration management documentation.
* Ensure all Implementation and Services reports are available for submitting to client for timely recognizing the revenue.
* Ensure compliance with customer security and data privacy requirements.

**What we look for**

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics Engineering, Telecommunications, or related discipline.

**Experience**

* 3-7 years of experience in:
  + Retail technology deployments
  + Field implementation
  + Technical support
  + Systems integration
  + IoT or analytics solutions

**Technical Skills**

**Networking**

* TCP/IP
* DNS
* DHCP
* VPN
* Firewall fundamentals
* LAN/WAN troubleshooting

**Operating Systems**

* Windows
* Linux fundamentals – will be added advantage

**Tools**

* ServiceNow/Remedy
* Jira
* Power BI
* Excel (Advanced)
* Remote support tools

**Preferred Experience**

* Solution deployment and support.
* Retail implementation projects.
* Traffic counting and occupancy monitoring technologies.
* Sensormatic Solutions ecosystem knowledge.
* Multi-site retail rollout experience.
* Supporting large retail brands.
* Experience working with supermarkets, fashion retailers, department stores, specialty retail, and shopping malls.

**Key Competencies**

* Advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis
* Customer-facing communication skills
* Project coordination
* Technical documentation
* Stakeholder management
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to work independently in field environments

**Success Metrics**

* On-time implementation delivery (>95%)
* Customer acceptance and sign-off success rate
* SLA compliance for incident resolution
* System uptime and device availability
* Traffic count accuracy targets
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) scores
* Reduction in recurring incidents
* Successful customer training and onboarding completion

**What we offer:**

We offer a challenging and exciting position as part of a global, multi-industrial corporation. Joining us provides a stimulating work environment, career development opportunities, and the chance to make a significant impact on society.

**Diversity & Inclusion:**

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion stems from our core values. We lead with integrity and aim for a future aligned with our customers' vision for success. Our culture fosters engagement, innovation, and collaboration, ensuring every employee contributes to our collective mission.

cb71a3df.title: Global Outreach Program Manager
cb71a3df.description:
**Company Description**
Edumilestones.com is a leading provider of psychometric assessments for the education and corporate sectors, with a strong focus on comprehensive career planning. Its flagship Comprehensive Career Planning Assessment (CCPA) is widely used for career counseling across India, helping counselors save significant time through an online, research-backed platform. The assessment was developed over four years by experts in Psychology, Education, and IT, ensuring robust, reliable results for diverse user groups. Educational institutions and counseling centers across major cities and regions in India, as well as international locations, actively use Edumilestones.com solutions, often with customized and co-branded assessment interfaces and reports. The company now also offers advanced assessment tools tailored to corporates, trainers, and working professionals.

**Role Description**
The Global Outreach Program Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru. This role is responsible for developing and executing outreach strategies to expand Edumilestones.com’s presence among schools, colleges, universities, corporates, trainers, and counselors in India and international markets. Daily responsibilities include identifying and nurturing partnerships, coordinating with internal teams to customize assessment offerings, and managing communication campaigns and events that promote Edumilestones.com solutions. The role also involves tracking program performance, preparing reports, and recommending improvements to engagement and adoption strategies. The Global Outreach Program Manager is expected to represent the organization in meetings, conferences, and training sessions, ensuring consistent messaging and a strong partner experience.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in program management, stakeholder engagement, and partnership development, ideally in education, counseling, or corporate training domains.
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills to effectively interact with schools, universities, corporates, and counseling centers.
* Proficiency in planning and executing outreach campaigns, events, and workshops, including basic knowledge of digital communication tools.
* Ability to analyze program data, prepare concise reports, and use insights to refine outreach strategies and improve partner outcomes.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Education, Psychology, or a related field; advanced degrees or certifications in program management or education services are an advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfort with technology platforms and online assessment tools; prior experience with psychometric or career assessment solutions is beneficial.
* Willingness to travel for partner meetings, events, and conferences as required.

1249429e.description:
Cloud Developer IIIThis role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

***Job Family Definition:***

The Cloud Developer builds from the ground up to meet the needs of mission-critical applications, and is always looking for innovative approaches to deliver end-to-end technical solutions to solve customer problems.  
Brings technical thinking to break down complex data and to engineer new ideas and methods for solving, prototyping, designing, and implementing cloud-based solutions.  
Collaborates with project managers and development partners to ensure effective and efficient delivery, deployment, operation, monitoring, and support of Cloud engagements.  
The Cloud Developer provides business value expertise to drive the development of innovative service offerings that enrich HPE's Cloud Services portfolio across multiple systems, platforms, and applications.

***Management Level Definition:***

Contributions include applying developed subject matter expertise to solve common and sometimes complex technical problems and recommending alternatives where necessary. Might act as project lead and provide assistance to lower level professionals. Exercises independent judgment and consults with others to determine best method for accomplishing work and achieving objectives.

***Responsibilities:***

* Analyses the feature specifications and determines the required coding, testing, and integration activities.
* Designs and develops moderate to complex cloud application modules per feature specifications adhering to security policies.
* Identifies debugs and creates solutions for issues with code and integration into application architecture.
* Develops and executes comprehensive test plans for features adhering to performance, scale, usability, and security requirements.
* Deploy cloud-based systems and applications code using continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to automate cloud applications' management, scaling, and deployment.
* Contributes towards innovation and integration of new technologies into projects.
* Analyzes science, engineering, business, and other data processing problems to develop and implement solutions to complex application problems, system administration issues, or network concerns.

***Education and Experience Required:***

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or closely related quantitative discipline. Master’s desirable.
* Typically, 4-7 years’ experience.

***Knowledge and Skills:***

* Strong programming skills in Python, Java, Golang, or JavaScript.
* Good understanding of distributed systems, event-driven programming paradigms, and designing for scale and performance.
* Experience with cloud-native applications, developer tools, managed services, and next-generation databases.
* Knowledge of DevOps practices like CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containerization, and orchestration using Kubernetes.
* Good written and verbal communication skills and agile in a changing environment.

If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

**Personal & Professional Development**

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

**Unconditional Inclusion**

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

3904d550.description:
NVIDIA's Connectivity Software team seeks a skilled and experienced technical program manager to help deliver on NVIDIA's inspiring product roadmap! The software produced by this team include foundational kernel components, drivers, and firmware that support the entire family of NVIDIA chipsets. Join an excellent team and help guide NVIDIA's future!
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
You will collaborate with the team and peers across the company to build, represent and carry out detailed plans for delivering the team's work. In particular, you will have the opportunity to:
  
  

* Work on aligning NVIDIA's SoC and product roadmap with the software team capacity roadmap and help balance global priorities
* Keep the team on track by coordinating dependencies across functional areas and identifying planning gaps
* Be empowered to make prioritization decisions and represent the team to other groups
* Collaborate closely with hardware, release planning, customers, and industry partners giving you a complete picture of software at NVIDIA

**Job Description Summary**
The Senior Staff AI Architect will lead the integrated execution of complex, cross-functional AI programs within GE Vernova Power. The role combines strong AI technical judgment with senior program leadership to translate strategic and architectural direction into executable plans and to drive decisions, dependencies, risks, and partner commitments to closure.
  
  
The individual will work across AI Delivery, AI Foundry, Product Management, Infrastructure, AI Program Management, business and engineering teams, and strategic technology partners. This is not limited to the technical accountability of an architect — the role will work alongside data scientists and portfolio leaders, integrate their contributions into one coherent program plan, and establish the operating mechanisms needed to deliver predictable outcomes.
  
  
The initial primary assignment will be a strategic Foundation Model development effort, with the opportunity to establish reusable execution practices for other strategic AI programs, AI observability and operational readiness, and partner-supported initiatives.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Lead the integrated execution of complex, cross-functional AI programs from definition through technical validation, deployment readiness, operationalization, and adoption.
* Translate strategic and architectural direction into an executable program plan with measurable outcomes, milestones, dependencies, decision points, technical gates, and accountable owners.
* Integrate work across AI Architecture, AI Foundry, Product Management, Infrastructure, AI Program Management, business teams, engineering teams, and strategic partners into one coherent plan.
* Own the integrated program plan, execution rhythm, dependency closure, risk management, decision governance, partner coordination, and recovery planning.
* Apply strong AI technical judgment to challenge assumptions, sequencing, estimates, validation approaches, infrastructure requirements, integration dependencies, and operational-readiness evidence.
* Facilitate complex technical decisions while preserving the accountability of designated architecture, data-science, platform, security, and engineering authorities.
* Drive decisions, dependencies, risks, commitments, and outcomes through teams and partners without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Identify execution gaps early and require recovery plans, scope decisions, resource actions, or leadership escalations.
* Serve as a senior execution counterpart for strategic technology partners, integrating their work into the program while retaining internal ownership of technical direction and acceptance.
* Maintain a clear, evidence-based leadership view of program outcomes, milestones, decisions, risks, dependencies, and required actions.
* Establish repeatable mechanisms for integrated planning, technical-gate readiness, decision closure, partner delivery, observability, operational readiness, and leadership reporting — and extend these as reusable practices across strategic AI initiatives.
* Drive reuse and adoption of approved AI platforms, reusable services, architectural patterns, and validation approaches across strategic AI programs.
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity, incomplete information, distributed accountability, and changing program conditions; outcome-oriented and pragmatic, balancing technical rigor, delivery urgency, enterprise standards, and long-term reusability.
* Able to move fluidly between technical depth, integrated program leadership, partner management, and executive communication.

**Required Qualifications**




+ A Minimum of Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent professional experience), with significant experience leading complex, cross-functional technology programs involving AI, machine learning, data platforms, cloud platforms, or enterprise applications.
+ Strong working knowledge of AI and machine-learning delivery lifecycles — data readiness, experimentation, model development, evaluation, integration, deployment, monitoring, and operationalization — combined with experience spanning both AI/software architecture and coordinated delivery working along with data science, software engineering, infrastructure, product management, program management, business teams, and external partners.
+ Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical and execution issues into clear options, recommendations, decisions, and business implications, and to influence senior technical contributors, leaders, and strategic partners in a complex matrixed organization.
+ Experience establishing program operating rhythms, integrated plans, decision mechanisms, technical-readiness reviews, risk-management practices, and executive reporting that deliver predictable outcomes.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Experience leading enterprise or industrial AI programs — time-series analytics, predictive analytics, generative AI, agentic AI, or data-platform initiatives — ideally in energy, industrial, manufacturing, asset-intensive, or regulated environments.
* Hands-on familiarity with cloud and hybrid platforms, including AWS and Azure as well as on-premises AI and data environments, with practical knowledge of AWS-based AI/ML and data services relevant to this program.
* Understanding of modern AI engineering practices, including MLOps, LLMOps, model evaluation, observability, responsible AI, data governance, platform engineering, and production operations.
* Experience working with strategic technology partners, system integrators, consulting organizations, or externally supported engineering teams.
* Strong systems-thinking skills, with the ability to connect business outcomes, architecture, data, infrastructure, models, applications, operations, and organizational dependencies.

ba8fa3a7.title: Data Solution Architect
ba8fa3a7.description:
The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.
  
  
Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Solution Architect owns the end to end technical and architectural design of complex enterprise solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives, enterprise architecture standards, and platform capabilities. This role bridges business strategy and technology execution by defining scalable, secure, and cost-effective solution architectures, providing architectural governance, and guiding delivery teams through design and implementation.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 12-18 years of experience in solution architecture, system design, and enterprise scale delivery.
* Strong expertise in Azure Databricks, Apache Spark (PySpark), Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and scaled distributed data processing.
* Proficiency with Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, and modern data orchestration tools. Hands-on experience building end-to-end data pipelines using Python and PySpark.

* Solid experience with DevOps and CI/CD tooling (Azure Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Terraform or similar)
* Work closely with multiple architects to align on the right architecture design.
* Drive adoption of enterprise architecture design standards.
* Propose alternative solutions when standard approaches don’t fit, while staying aligned to enterprise principles

* Strong understanding of data governance, security, compliance, and cloud cost optimization.

* Experience driving DevOps, CI/CD, and automated deployment practices at the architectural level.
* Strong focus on performance, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization.

**Leadership & Communication**

* Proven ability to influence architectural decisions across teams and stakeholders.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate complex designs clearly.
* Excellent analytical, communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, supporting business requirements across the world. Accordingly, the work hours for employees will be aligned to support business requirements. The standard work week will be Monday to Friday. Working hours are 8:00am to 5:00pm or 1:30pm to 10:30pm.

Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.

value than third-party engagement.

and risk.

vendor technical briefings, certification programs, and continuous hands-on evaluation of new platforms

and tools.

solution designs without intermediary analysis.

Preferred

The position provides hands-on exposure to enterprise cloud environments, cloud security standards, deployment processes, automation tools, and infrastructure-as-code practices while building foundational cloud engineering expertise.

Cloud Infrastructure,Azure,AWS,IaaS,PaaS,Virtual Machines,Storage Accounts,Resource Groups,Azure Portal,Azure CLI,PowerShell,Cloud Provisioning,Infrastructure Deployment,Cloud Configuration,Technical Documentation,Azure Monitor
  
  
**Role**

* Assist with the setup and configuration of cloud resources including virtual machines, storage accounts, and resource groups.
* Support infrastructure provisioning using Azure Portal, Azure CLI, or PowerShell.
* Document technical configurations, deployment steps, and architecture components.
* Assist in creating cloud cost estimates using tools such as Azure Pricing Calculator under supervision.
* Monitor deployed cloud environments using Azure Monitor or equivalent tools.
* Contribute to basic scripting and automation tasks using Bash, PowerShell, or related tools.
* Participate in security and compliance checklist reviews under senior guidance.
* Help research high availability and disaster recovery strategies and document findings.
* Stay updated with cloud best practices, Microsoft Learn modules, and platform learning resources.
* Collaborate with senior team members to support cloud migration and modernization efforts.
* Assist in gathering technical requirements for cloud infrastructure projects.
* Support basic troubleshooting of cloud infrastructure, networking, storage, and deployment-related issues.

ebe20d61.description:

Engineer must have strong technical background in MS Azure and Office 365 Cloud products

Excellent communication, customer escalation handling, Team management skills, proactiveness & punctuality are essential part of this position. 47883809.description:

**Cloud Operations Consultant**
and play a key role in keeping our enterprise cloud environments secure, reliable, and future-ready.
  
  
With AWS at the core, you’ll work across cloud operations, automation, security, monitoring, and SAP infrastructure while collaborating with experienced global teams.
  
  
This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, taking ownership, and continuously improving the way cloud environments are managed.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Manage and support AWS cloud infrastructure, ensuring high availability, performance, security, and operational stability.
* Troubleshoot incidents, perform root cause analysis, and support SAP workloads hosted on AWS, including upgrades, patching, backups, migrations, and performance optimization.
* Strengthen cloud security by managing AWS IAM, enforcing least-privilege access, and addressing stale credentials, policy drift, and over-permissioned roles.
* Automate EC2 patching, hardening, and compliance reporting, helping improve the reliability and security of the cloud environment.
* Enhance observability using CloudWatch, Prometheus, and Grafana, while collaborating with SAP Basis, engineering teams, and external vendors.

**Your Expertise**

* 3–5 years of relevant experience in cloud operations, infrastructure support, or cloud engineering, with strong hands-on AWS expertise.
* Solid knowledge of EC2, networking, storage, IAM, Linux/Windows administration, DNS, VPN, firewalls, backup, and security best practices.
* Experience supporting SAP infrastructure on AWS, including patching, hardening, backup, monitoring, and operational support.
* Practical experience with AWS IAM and monitoring tools such as CloudWatch, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Exposure to Azure Entra ID, Terraform, Docker, and Kubernetes is an advantage.
* Certifications such as AWS Certified SysOps Administrator or AWS Certified Solutions Architect are an added advantage.

**Why Join Westernacher?**

* Inspiring, exciting, and innovative working environment.
* Competitive remuneration package (salary, bonus, benefits).
* International company culture and a minimal hierarchical structure.
* Chance to work on complex projects from different industries.
* Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model.

Founded in 1969, Westernacher Consulting is a global business and SAP consulting company represented in 28 countries, with 1,400 consultants across Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Americas. As an SAP Gold Partner with over 30 years of SAP partnership experience, we combine deep industry knowledge, business process expertise, and technology innovation to create sustainable value for our clients.
  
  
We are 100% employee-owned, which shapes our entrepreneurial culture and our commitment to shared responsibility, long-term thinking and sustainable success. We work in partnership, challenge conventional thinking and give our people the opportunity to create meaningful impact for our clients, our company and one another.
