8beafc32.title: Senior Program Manager
8beafc32.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Program Manager based in India.**
The Senior Program Manager will lead complex, large-scale data and AI transformation programs for strategic enterprise customers, ensuring successful delivery and measurable business outcomes. You will oversee multiple workstreams, coordinate multidisciplinary teams, and manage critical delivery dimensions, including budgets, resources, timelines, and client expectations. Acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, you will translate business objectives into actionable roadmaps while proactively managing risks and opportunities. You will collaborate with sales, engineering, architecture, and delivery leadership to strengthen customer relationships and drive long-term account growth. Beyond client engagements, you will contribute to improving organizational delivery standards, governance frameworks, and operational best practices. This is an opportunity to influence strategic initiatives within a remote-first, globally distributed data and AI consulting environment.
  
  
**Accountabilities**
As Senior Program Manager, you will take end-to-end ownership of strategic customer programs, ensuring consistent execution, financial performance, and alignment with business objectives. You will combine strong client leadership with operational discipline, team development, and continuous improvement to deliver high-impact data and AI initiatives.
  
  

* Program and Client Delivery: Lead complex, multi-workstream data and AI programs for strategic enterprise customers, from initial discovery through execution and scaling, ensuring alignment with client objectives and measurable outcomes.
* Strategic Roadmap Development: Translate business priorities into actionable data and AI roadmaps, connecting architecture, engineering, and delivery activities to clear business value and milestones.
* Resource and Financial Management: Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, revenue targets, margins, forecasts, and resource allocation across multiple concurrent customer engagements while maintaining high utilization and delivery quality.
* Program Governance: Establish and maintain robust governance frameworks, including operating cadences, RACI structures, risk and issue logs, decision tracking, change control processes, and stakeholder communication plans.
* Risk and Issue Management: Proactively identify delivery, scope, and resource-related risks, develop recovery strategies, and drive issues through to resolution.
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders, including C-level executives, facilitating strategic alignment, informed decision-making, and effective management of competing priorities.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, account management, engineering, architecture, and delivery leadership to strengthen customer success and overall account health.
* Team Leadership and Mentorship: Lead and mentor multidisciplinary teams across geographies and time zones, supporting professional development, improving delivery standards, and coaching other Program Managers and Technical Program Managers.
* Client Engagement and Innovation: Facilitate workshops, innovation forums, and onsite sessions to accelerate stakeholder alignment, solution adoption, and value realization.
* Delivery Excellence: Develop and refine program management methodologies, playbooks, templates, documentation standards, and key performance indicators across the delivery organization.
* Business Development Support: Contribute to proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs), executive presentations, account plans, and strategic roadmaps in collaboration with sales and delivery teams.
* Account Growth: Identify and support upselling and cross-selling opportunities for data and AI solutions, helping expand strategic customer relationships.
* Operational Transformation: Champion process improvements, automation, and the adoption of AI-powered tools to increase delivery efficiency, predictability, and scalability.
* Organizational Development: Help develop future leaders and promote a culture of accountability, psychological safety, transparency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Requirements**
The ideal candidate is a highly experienced technical program management professional with a strong consulting background and a proven ability to deliver complex data and AI initiatives for enterprise customers. You should combine commercial awareness, technical understanding, executive communication skills, and exceptional leadership capabilities. The role requires someone who can navigate complex stakeholder environments, manage multiple strategic engagements simultaneously, and consistently translate business objectives into successful delivery outcomes.
  
  

* 15+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, leading complex, multi-workstream initiatives.
* Extensive experience managing customer relationships, project scope, timelines, budgets, and technical resources, including architects and engineers.
* Strong background in program and portfolio management for data platforms, analytics, and AI initiatives.
* Hands-on experience managing projects involving modern data and analytics technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, Fivetran, Power BI, Tableau, or Sigma.
* Proven experience delivering projects for external customers within consulting, professional services, or technology-driven organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple customer engagements concurrently while maintaining high billable utilization and achieving on-time, on-budget delivery.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and practical knowledge of Waterfall approaches, with the ability to adapt delivery frameworks to different client requirements.
* Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, MS Project, and Microsoft 365, particularly Excel.
* Excellent technical documentation, process management, analytical, critical-thinking, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to interpret complex information, exercise sound judgment, and communicate risks and escalations effectively.
* Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to prepare executive-ready updates and communicate confidently with C-level stakeholders and technical teams.
* Strong commercial and strategic thinking, with the ability to connect program outcomes to business objectives, return on investment (ROI), and measurable value realization.
* Demonstrated experience building and maintaining strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders across distributed teams.
* Proven people management experience, including leading high-performing teams, mentoring professionals, and supporting career development.
* Excellent organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage competing initiatives independently while maintaining accountability for results.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or a related technical discipline is preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP and Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) certifications are strongly preferred; additional relevant professional certifications are an advantage.
* Experience managing large strategic customer portfolios, particularly engagements exceeding $10 million.
* Demonstrated success driving account growth through upselling and cross-selling data and AI solutions.
* Experience developing executive-level enablement materials, including ROI summaries, case studies, and internal success stories.
* Previous experience working with global, remote, and geographically distributed teams, particularly across the United States, Latin America, and India.
* Experience developing and institutionalizing delivery best practices, program management playbooks, governance frameworks, and portfolio-level performance indicators.

**Benefits**

* Fully remote-first working environment.
* Medical insurance coverage for employees and their families.
* Additional medical insurance coverage for parents.
* Term life insurance and personal accident coverage.
* Wellness allowance to support employee well-being.
* Broadband reimbursement.
* Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
* Paid professional certifications to support career growth.
* Professional development allowance.
* Bonuses for creating company-approved content.
* Opportunities to work on impactful data and AI initiatives for leading enterprise organizations.
* Collaborative, high-performing international team that values transparency, autonomy, and continuous improvement.
* Access to challenging projects, mentorship, and structured career development opportunities.
* Flexible working arrangements within a globally distributed team, with some availability required across international time zones and key client milestones.

**How Jobgether Works**

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
  
  
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
  
  
Why Apply Through Jobgether?

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

1f6b4bb1.title: Senior Program Manager
1f6b4bb1.description:
**About the Role**

You will own end-to-end delivery of private label programs for our key US big-box retail partners. You'll be the single point of contact for the retailer's cross-functional teams: Sourcing, Product Development, Quality, Packaging and Logistics. Internally, you'll drive PlayShifu's design, packaging, quality and operations teams so that every deliverable lands on time and to spec. You will run each program from product shortlisting to PO release, production and shipment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and run the Time & Action (TnA) plan for every program, working backwards from retailer calendars. It covers design freeze, tooling, T0/T1/T2, packaging, testing, production, inspections and ship dates.
* Lead weekly calls with retailer Sourcing, Quality and Logistics teams. Publish status updates and escalate risks early.
* Hold internal teams accountable to TnA milestones, and flag dependencies and delays before they become misses.
* Manage the retailer's PD portal: create product IDs, track design feedback and revisions, and coordinate sample requests and timelines with internal teams against retailer ETDs.
* Work with our Toy Design team so that every feedback loop closes within the agreed timelines.
* Consolidate documentation from internal teams, including BOM, measurements, claims and Manufacturing Variability. Get it submitted and approved on time.
* Translate the retailer's structural packaging guidelines and feedback into clear briefs and deadlines for our internal packaging team.
* Consolidate all packaging content (copy, claims, warnings, specs, imagery) from internal teams and submit it to the retailer.
* Lead the retailer-side proofing process with the retailer's artwork agency. Review soft and hard proofs for UPC/EAN, regulatory copy, battery instructions and font requirements, and route corrections through the internal packaging team.
* Track testing, inspection and audit milestones (DUPRO, FRI, TOP, quality and responsible sourcing audits) against the TnA. Work through the internal quality and operations teams, who manage labs, inspection agencies and factories.
* Act as the retailer's point of contact on quality and compliance. Make sure that issues, corrective actions and approvals are closed on time.
* Represent PlayShifu in placement and production-readiness reviews alongside the operations and quality team.
* Work with the operations team's systems & item setup function to keep vendor portal data (costing, item setup, case pack, vendor order points, factory mapping) accurate and consistent with what's been agreed with the retailer.
* Track item-wise progress from costing to PO release, and flag gaps or delays that could hold up a business award or PO.
* Support cost submissions and cost-change management, working with the Head of Sales.

**Requirements**

* 8–12 years in program management, merchandising or sourcing for consumer products. Toys, juvenile, hardlines or seasonal/outdoor preferred.
* Hands-on experience delivering private label programs for US big-box retailers. Buying house, sourcing agency, export house or vendor-side experience is ideal.
* Working knowledge of retailer vendor portals, product development workflows, packaging development and product compliance and testing. You need enough depth to review the work and challenge it. Hands-on vendor management is not required.
* Proven ability to drive cross-functional teams without direct authority. You set the timelines, hold teams accountable and escalate early.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication. You'll be the face of PlayShifu to senior retailer stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail, comfort with structured trackers, and the ability to run several programs in parallel.
* Willingness to work with a US time-zone overlap, and to travel occasionally to retailer offices and production-readiness reviews.

**What We Offer**

* Visibility and ownership from day one, working directly with leadership.
* A fast-growing business with some of the world's largest retailers as partners.
* Freedom to build processes for a program that is set to scale significantly.

5c1c891f.title: Domain Pre Sales AP
5c1c891f.description:

is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Business Partner in our Domain Risk Pre-Sales unit, you'll identify and cultivate new opportunities related to credit and fraud risk, combining deep business knowledge across both domains with a consultative, solutions-based approach to selling. This role focuses on building new revenue streams through the expansion of FICO Platform capabilities, working closely with the Asia Pacific sales team to translate client business challenges into compelling and credible solutions.
  
  
**What You’ll Contribute**

* Partner with clients on discovery and scoping sessions to uncover business challenges and growth opportunities, then develop proposals and business cases that demonstrate value.
* Contribute to client account plans and lead deal structuring and negotiations, working with internal teams to shape and position solutions that protect existing business and win new deals.
* Contribute to go-to-market strategy and market sizing, tracking industry trends and maintaining a strong grasp of our products and the competitive landscape.
* Support innovation workshops, quarterly business reviews, and PoC/PoV engagements, acting as a credit and fraud risk subject matter expert for financial services, insurance, retail, and telecommunications clients.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced **AI Solutions Architect** with strong expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), model fine-tuning, and advanced AI architectures. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying customized AI solutions using fine-tuning techniques, Knowledge Graphs, and GraphRAG.

The candidate will be responsible for architecting scalable AI solutions, optimizing LLM performance, and implementing advanced training methodologies such as Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO).

Key Responsibilities

**1. AI Architecture & Solution Design**

* Design and architect scalable AI and Generative AI solutions based on business requirements.
* Develop enterprise-grade LLM-based applications and intelligent AI systems.
* Define model selection, fine-tuning strategies, and deployment architectures.
* Drive AI solution development from proof of concept to production.

**2. LLM Fine-Tuning & Optimization**

* Implement and optimize LLM fine-tuning methodologies.
* Work on Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to customize foundation models for specific use cases.
* Apply Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to improve model alignment and response quality.
* Leverage Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) for reinforcement learning-based model optimization.
* Implement parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques, including LoRA and QLoRA.
* Evaluate model performance and optimize accuracy, efficiency, and inference costs.

**3. Knowledge Graphs & GraphRAG**

* Design and implement Knowledge Graph-based AI solutions.
* Develop GraphRAG architectures to enhance retrieval, contextual understanding, and reasoning.
* Integrate structured and unstructured data sources into knowledge-driven AI applications.
* Build intelligent retrieval pipelines combining graph-based retrieval and LLM capabilities.
* Optimize knowledge representation and retrieval strategies.

**4. AI Engineering & Implementation**

* Develop end-to-end AI workflows for model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment.
* Integrate fine-tuned LLMs into enterprise applications and business workflows.
* Establish model evaluation and performance monitoring frameworks.
* Collaborate with engineering and product teams to deliver scalable AI solutions.

Required Technical Skills

* Large Language Models (LLMs)
* Model Fine-Tuning
* Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT)
* Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)
* Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)
* Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA)
* Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA)
* Knowledge Graphs
* GraphRAG
* Generative AI
* LLM Architecture & Optimization
* AI Model Evaluation & Deployment

Desired Candidate Profile

* Strong experience in AI/ML engineering, Generative AI, and LLM-based solution development.
* Hands-on experience with fine-tuning open-source or foundation language models.
* Practical knowledge of SFT, DPO, PPO, LoRA, and QLoRA techniques.
* Experience designing Knowledge Graphs and implementing GraphRAG solutions.
* Strong understanding of LLM training, optimization, retrieval, and inference workflows.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI architectures.
* Strong problem-solving, technical leadership, and stakeholder communication skills.

Key Deliverables

* Design and implementation of scalable LLM-based AI architectures.
* Successful fine-tuning and optimization of foundation models.
* Implementation of SFT, DPO, PPO, LoRA, and QLoRA approaches.
* Development of Knowledge Graph and GraphRAG-based retrieval solutions.
* Production-ready AI solutions with measurable improvements in model performance and efficiency.

**Ideal Candidate:** An AI Solutions Architect with hands-on expertise in LLM fine-tuning, preference optimization, Knowledge Graphs, and GraphRAG, capable of taking advanced AI solutions from architecture to production.

Pay: ₹2,000,000.00 - ₹4,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

### **About Us**

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in.

### **Location:** **Singapore**

### **About Developer GTM**

The Developer GTM organization is a highly collaborative startup within Cloudflare, dedicated to attracting, inspiring, and growing the next generation of builders. We are redefining developer acquisition in a world where AI and distributed agents are reshaping the stack. Our mission is to create accessible and exciting pathways for developers to discover Cloudflare—whether through ecosystem partnerships, high-impact content, or creative field engagement.

We are a diverse team of builders, storytellers, and connectors united by one goal: to make Cloudflare the most empowering and exciting place for developers to build.

### **About the Role**

As a Senior Solutions Architect for the Developer Platform, you will shape and lead the regional technical strategy for our customer and partner engagements across APJC.

In this role, you will partner closely with engineering leaders, architects, developers, security teams, and executives to define architectures, validate technical approaches, and confidently transition production workloads onto Cloudflare. Rather than focusing on a single account, you will operate across a dynamic portfolio of engagements, ensuring broad impact.

A central part of your role involves translating your field experience into reusable organizational knowledge. You will create architectural frameworks, provide technical guidance, and champion the needs of regional customers directly to our product teams. This is a senior, individual-contributor role that beautifully balances hands-on architecture, executive collaboration, and regional technical leadership. You will report directly to the Director of Developer GTM, APJC.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Shape Strategy:** Guide the technical strategy for Developer Platform customers and partners across the region.
* **Design & Translate:** Transform business, application, security, and operational requirements into secure, scalable, and highly maintainable architectures on Cloudflare.
* **Collaborate & Advise:** Partner with engineering executives and senior stakeholders to advise on application modernization, distributed systems, AI architecture, and platform strategy.
* **Facilitate Discovery:** Lead architecture discovery sessions, technical workshops, proofs of concept, design reviews, and production-readiness discussions in a supportive, consultative manner.
* **Create Frameworks:** Establish reference architectures, architectural standards, and governance patterns that empower our customers and the broader APJC field organization.
* **Stay Hands-On:** Build, review, and troubleshoot representative applications and integrations.
* **Champion the Region:** Serve as a Developer Platform technical leader through presentations, written guidance, and internal enablement.
* **Mentor & Grow:** Support and mentor fellow solutions architects and technical colleagues navigating complex customer engagements.
* **Bridge Teams:** Build effective, continuous feedback loops between customers, field teams, and product leaders, translating regional needs into actionable product and go-to-market recommendations.

### **What Success Looks Like**

By the end of your first year, you will have:

* Become a trusted technical advisor and collaborative partner to customers, partners, and internal leaders.
* Established clear, actionable technical strategies and adoption plans for priority engagements.
* Helped customers successfully validate and launch their production workloads on Cloudflare.
* Published reusable reference architectures and field guidance that elevate the entire team.
* Improved the field organization's ability to position, architect, and deliver Cloudflare's developer and AI solutions.
* Cultivated the technical leadership of your colleagues through active mentorship and enablement.
* Provided product teams with consistent, evidence-based insights into regional customer requirements and adoption barriers.
* Become recognized as a supportive, authoritative Developer Platform leader across APJC.

### **What We're Looking For**

* **Meaningful Experience:** A strong background in solutions architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or a related customer-facing technical role. While candidates often bring 10+ years of experience, we care most about your demonstrated scope, impact, and ability to deliver results.
* **Language Skills:** Professional fluency in English and a major language spoken in India, with the ability to comfortably lead technical and executive discussions in both languages, to support clients in that region. A significant portion of your portfolio will consist of clients based in India.
* **Strategic Collaboration:** A track record of owning complex technical strategies involving developers, infrastructure teams, security stakeholders, and senior executives.
* **Technical Depth:** Deep working knowledge of distributed application architecture (compute, storage, networking, security, reliability, and observability).
* **Hands-On Capability:** Software-development experience, including the ability to build or review production-quality applications and proofs of concept (preferably in JavaScript or TypeScript).
* **Ecosystem Knowledge:** A strong understanding of modern web technologies, serverless/cloud-native architectures, modern software-delivery practices, and at least one major public cloud platform.
* **Influential Leadership:** A proven ability to influence without direct authority, thoughtfully mentor colleagues, and turn individual solutions into shared organizational capabilities.
* **Communication:** Excellent written, presentation, and facilitation skills tailored for developer, architectural, and executive audiences.
* **Travel:** Ability to travel up to 30%, primarily within APJC, including India (supported by flexible planning).

### **Nice-to-Have (Bonus Skills)**

* Experience building and operating production applications on Cloudflare's Developer Platform.
* Experience designing AI inference, agentic, retrieval-augmented generation, or data-intensive applications.
* Familiarity with customers, technology partners, or developer communities in India.
* A background in public speaking, technical writing, open-source contribution, or community building.
* Relevant cloud or architecture certifications.
* A degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, OR equivalent practical experience.

**Important Note:** *At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. You don't need to tick every single box to be right for this role. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.*

### **What Makes Cloudflare Special?**

We're not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We're a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

**Project Galileo**: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare's enterprise customers-at no cost.

**Athenian Project**: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

**1.1.1.1**: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here's the deal - we don't store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you'd like to be a part of? We'd love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. **Description**
AWS Global Sales (AGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Are you excited to work with the team that enables India’s conglomerates to build innovative services with AWS, scaling to serve billion+ Indians? The Conglomerates team in AWS India is looking for a Solutions Architect who can work with our customers who are augmenting their existing business empires with new business models on the foundations of payment infrastructure like UPI, quick commerce, widespread 5G internet access, affordable smartphones, exploding digital content, identity infrastructure like Aadhaar and world class AI & cloud infrastructure. These new businesses are rapidly and profoundly changing everyday life of billion+ Indians through their platforms & services for E-commerce, Smart Factories, Connected Vehicles, Travel & Hospitality, FinTech and many more.
  
  
#aws-ags-India
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Your broad responsibilities will include, owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects, and developing deep expertise in the AWS technologies as well as broad know-how around how applications and services are constructed using the AWS platform. An ideal candidate should have worked on solution design & architecture of as part of a CoE, Cloud Practice team etc. Candidate must have have in-depth experience one or more of following technologies - Full stack application development/ DevOps / Databases / Networking / Security / Observability / Data Analytics & AIML. Good understanding of patterns and frameworks and ability to identify trade-offs is required. Candidate should have a flair for hands-on coding to do Proof of Concepts and demonstrate technologies. Candidate should be good at identifying repeatable pattern and best practices, and able to learn new technologies and customer business domain.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess customer facing skills that will allow them to represent AWS India well within a customer’s or partner's environment and drive discussions with mid to senior personnel within the company, as well as a technical background that enables them to easily interact and give guidance to software developers and architects.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (DEI) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
The selected candidate will work with subsidiairies / JV of large Indian conglomerates to map business requirements to technology. This will include but not limited to, understanding various design patterns & discern between various data & compute technologies. The candidate will also ensure right TCO while meeting the functional & non-functional requirements. The candidate will also guide on building DevSecOps, Observability & Monitoring of Infrastructure & Applications; conduct Well Architected Reviews; partner with AWS Domain & Technology Specialists to implement innovative solutions; collaborate with the Service Teams to identify feature gaps & engage with Technical communities and Customer C-Suite on Technology strategy & Best practices.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Conglomerates team is one of the most diverse teams you would ever get in your career. Our team members have deep technology experience spanning areas of Analytics, IoT, AI/ML, GenAI, Observability, Resiliency & Security. Top it up with years of domain expertise across Automotive, Manufacturing, e-Commerce, Telco, Travel & Hospitality - this is the team where Tech meets Business for the largest movers & shakers of India's push to $5T economy.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
* Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
* Knowledge of SAP systems (like SAP Business Suite, S/4HANA, SAP Business Warehouse, SAP HANA, SAP Business Objects, etc.) and their architecture and infrastructure needs
* Experience leading or developing high quality, enterprise scale software products using a structured system development lifecycle
* 5+ years of solving problems with technology in the Automotive & Manufacturing industries experience

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience designing property/knowledge graphs (GQL, Cypher, RDF/OWL), enterprise semantic catalogs, or multimodal data pipelines that process and index unstructured data alongside tabular data.

When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
  
  
The Google Forge Team partners with our most strategic customers to bring their transformative goals to life. In the agentic era, enterprise data architectures must evolve from passive Systems of Intelligence built for human-scale reporting into active, governed "Systems of Action" engineered for agent-scale autonomy.
  
  
In this role, you will lead the end-to-end architectural design and engineering of next-generation agentic data platforms—unifying operational and analytical data estates, open multimodal lakehouses, semantic knowledge catalogs, and graph reasoning to ground and scale autonomous AI agents. You will play a key leadership role in driving solutions from initial architecture through enterprise security, governance, and production readiness, while mentoring team members and shaping the strategic direction of our reusable engineering assets.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

* Mentor and guide team members, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning.
* Establish and promote innovative best practices and methodologies for data-motivated solutions, actively contributing to industry thought leadership through publications, presentations, and community engagement.

**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. d85b5a33.title: AWS Cloud & DevSecOps Consultant
d85b5a33.description:
We are building a secure, enterprise-grade AWS platform for our PERN-stack (PostgreSQL, Express, React, Node.js) ERP applications. A detailed blueprint (about 170 documented steps) already exists from our first setup. We need a hands-on cloud engineer to build the same setup for two more group companies, from the first AWS account to a live production application, and to hand everything over with full documentation.

Responsibilities (for each company)

1. Account & billing - AWS account creation, root MFA, company billing and GST invoicing, budgets and cost-anomaly alerts .

2.AWS Organization -Organization with Dev / Prod / Security OUs; Dev, Prod and Audit accounts; centralized root access

3. Guardrails (SCPs)-Region lock (Mumbai), CloudTrail protection, data-protection and security-lock policies, all tested.

4.Identity & access -IAM Identity Center, enforced MFA, groups and permission sets, least privilege, emergency admin, no IAM users or long-term keys.

5. Security & monitoring- Organization CloudTrail with protected log bucket, GuardDuty (incl. RDS protection), IAM Access Analyzer, Security Hub, EventBridge + SNS alerting, encryption by default, default-VPC removal.

6.Network -VPC and CIDR planning, 3-tier subnets, route tables, NAT, VPC endpoints, security groups, VPC flow logs.

7. Data layer- RDS PostgreSQL (private, encrypted, Multi-AZ for production), database roles (app / migrator / read-only), Secrets Manager, ElastiCache (Valkey/Redis) with RBAC, AWS Backup with vault lock.

8. Compute & delivery- EC2 launch templates (Graviton), user-data bootstrap, Session Manager (no SSH), ALB + Auto Scaling for production, CloudFront + S3 for the React frontend, WAF, ACM certificates, Route 53.

9.CI/CD & GitHub -GitHub organization setup, fork → pull request → owner-approval flow, GitHub Actions (secret scanning, dependency audit), OIDC deployment to AWS without stored keys, owner-only production release, rollback

10.Cost control -Right-sizing, start/stop schedules for Dev, Savings Plans guidance, staying within approved budgets.

11. Handover -Setup checklist, handover document, runbooks, incident plan, knowledge-transfer sessions for the internal IT team.

Must Have - 2–4 years in cloud / DevOps, with at least 1–2 years of hands-on AWS (real projects, not only training)

* Has worked with AWS Organizations, SCPs and IAM Identity Center (or is able to follow our documented blueprint step by step)

* Strong in VPC networking, security groups, RDS PostgreSQL, EC2, ALB, Auto Scaling, CloudFront, S3 and WAF

* Security-first mindset: least privilege, encryption, secrets management, audit logging
* CI/CD with GitHub Actions and OIDC to AWS; deploying Node.js and React applications.

.Linux (Amazon Linux) and Bash; basic PostgreSQL administration

* Clear written documentation and the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders.

Good to have • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or AWS CDK / CloudFormation), so later companies are built from code

* AWS Control Tower / landing-zone experience
* ElastiCache (Valkey/Redis), AWS Backup, Security Hub
* Experience with Indian billing (AISPL, GST) and SME-sized budgets.

Working rules

* The company keeps ownership of root logins, payment methods, GitHub organization ownership and production releases.
* The consultant receives time-bound administrator access through IAM Identity Center only; access is removed at contract end.
* No access to real business data beyond what is strictly needed to set up production.
* NDA and confidentiality agreement required. No company code or data in personal accounts or AI tools without approval.
* Every completed step is recorded in the setup checklist with date and time.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at a scale across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (18500+ experts across 39 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in!

  

**Requirements**

* Experience : 9+ years
* Strong experience in Data Architecture, Enterprise Data Architecture or related data engineering roles.
* Relevant hands-on experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and designing large-scale enterprise data platforms.
* Strong expertise in GCP services, including BigQuery, Google Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Eventarc, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud Workflows and IAM.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise data modelling, including conceptual, logical and physical data models.
* Expertise in dimensional modelling, relational modelling, Data Vault and domain-oriented data modelling approaches.
* Strong experience in designing and implementing scalable Data Lake, Lakehouse and Data Warehouse architectures.
* Hands-on experience with data ingestion, ETL/ELT, data integration and processing frameworks.
* Strong understanding of batch, streaming and real-time/near-real-time data processing architectures.
* Experience with Pub/Sub, Eventarc, Kafka or other event-driven and event-streaming technologies.
* Strong SQL skills and expertise in BigQuery data modelling, partitioning, clustering and query performance optimization.
* Experience in designing enterprise data architectures, data products, semantic layers and reusable data models.
* Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, data lineage, data quality and data cataloguing.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM, encryption, data privacy, access controls and least-privilege principles.
* Experience in designing API-based, event-driven and file-based integration architectures.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable conceptual, logical and physical data architectures.
* Experience collaborating with global stakeholders across Enterprise Architecture, Data Engineering, AI/ML, Cloud Engineering and Cybersecurity teams.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, architecture governance and technical leadership skills.
* Good to have experience with Dataplex, Data Catalog, Looker/LookML, Vertex AI and Google Cloud AI services.
* Good to have exposure to Generative AI, RAG, vector search, embeddings, Machine Learning and AI-ready data architectures.
* Exposure to Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, GKE, CI/CD and GitOps practices is desirable.
* Experience integrating enterprise applications such as SAP, Salesforce, CRM, e-commerce, marketing and supply-chain platforms is preferred.
* Exposure to KVYOS and enterprise knowledge architecture is an added advantage.
* Experience in Retail, CPG, FMCG, Beauty or Consumer Products domains and global multi-country data platforms is desirable.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Define, drive and evolve enterprise data architecture, target-state architecture and technology roadmaps across global business and technology domains.
* Design scalable, secure, governed and AI-ready enterprise data platforms using Google Cloud Platform.
* Establish enterprise architecture standards, principles, reference architectures, reusable design patterns and technology guidelines.
* Architect modern GCP data platforms leveraging BigQuery, Google Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Eventarc, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions and Cloud Workflows.
* Design cloud-native, serverless, event-driven, multi-cloud and hybrid data architectures.
* Define scalable data ingestion, integration, processing, storage, analytics and consumption architectures.
* Architect batch, streaming and near-real-time data pipelines for enterprise data sources.
* Design and implement event-driven integration patterns using Pub/Sub, Eventarc and Kafka.
* Define integration strategies for SAP, Salesforce, e-commerce, CRM, marketing, retail, supply-chain and external data platforms.
* Establish enterprise conceptual, logical and physical data models using dimensional, relational, Data Vault and domain-oriented modelling approaches.
* Define canonical data models, enterprise data standards, semantic layers and common business metrics and KPIs.
* Drive the creation, implementation and lifecycle management of reusable domain-oriented data products.
* Design and optimize BigQuery data architectures, including data models, partitioning, clustering, workload management and query performance.
* Leverage Dataplex and Data Catalog for enterprise data discovery, metadata management, governance and lineage.
* Define data quality, observability, monitoring and operational standards across the data lifecycle.
* Design secure GCP architectures using IAM, Workload Identity, encryption, VPC Service Controls and least-privilege access.
* Establish data classification, masking, privacy, access-control and row/column-level security mechanisms.
* Ensure compliance with global data privacy, security and regulatory requirements.
* Architect AI/ML-ready data platforms supporting Generative AI, Machine Learning and Agentic AI use cases.
* Design data pipelines for AI/ML training, inference, feature engineering, RAG, vector search and enterprise knowledge management.
* Integrate enterprise data platforms with Vertex AI and other Google Cloud AI services.
* Enable trusted and governed enterprise data for personalization, consumer analytics, marketing intelligence and business insights.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Data Engineering, AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Cloud Engineering and business teams to deliver enterprise-wide data solutions.
* Lead architecture workshops, technical discussions and design reviews with global stakeholders.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, recommend suitable platforms and drive build-versus-buy decisions.
* Review solution architectures, provide technical governance and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards.
* Mentor data architects, data engineers and technical leads while promoting architecture best practices.
* Communicate complex architectural concepts, technical strategies and recommendations effectively to senior leadership.

Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.
  
  
Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
Lead managed services delivery for enterprise SaaS customers by owning platform strategy, governance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives. Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, driving adoption, business value realization, platform optimization, and long-term success. Experience with customer community platforms such as Sprinklr Community or similar solutions is highly desirable and will be considered an advantage.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead end-to-end managed services delivery, ensuring platform stability, governance, adoption, and alignment with customer business objectives.
* Drive strategic consulting engagements, helping customers optimise digital experiences, engagement models, operational processes, and platform utilisation.
* Act as the primary advisor to customer stakeholders, providing guidance on best practices, platform capabilities, governance frameworks, and roadmap planning.
* Lead requirements discovery, solution design, enhancement planning, and execution of continuous improvement programmes.
* Establish governance frameworks covering user administration, access management, workflows, content lifecycle management, and operational controls.
* Oversee platform health checks, audits, release management activities, and optimisation reviews.
* Lead investigation and resolution of complex platform, workflow, configuration, and user experience challenges.
* Own reporting, analytics, adoption measurement, and recommendations to improve customer outcomes.
* Provide leadership and mentorship to consultants and delivery teams supporting managed services engagements.
* Partner with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and customer leadership teams to deliver successful business outcomes.
* Provide architectural guidance on integrations, APIs, authentication, SSO, enterprise connectivity, and ecosystem solutions.
* Establish reusable delivery standards, governance playbooks, operational frameworks, and best practice models.
* Contribute to customer digital transformation initiatives, ensuring scalable and sustainable platform adoption.

**What Makes You Qualified?**
**Must Have Qualifications**

* 8-12 years of experience in Managed Services, SaaS Consulting, Digital Experience Platforms, Customer Engagement Solutions, or Enterprise Software implementations.
* Proven experience managing enterprise SaaS platforms and customer-facing managed services engagements.
* Strong consulting experience involving solution design, customer advisory services, governance reviews, and stakeholder management.
* Expertise in platform governance, operational excellence, adoption strategies, user management, workflows, and business process optimisation.
* Strong understanding of user experience principles, digital engagement strategies, information architecture, and customer journey optimisation.
* Working knowledge of web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, responsive design principles, and modern digital experiences.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, integrations, authentication models, SSO, webhooks, and enterprise system connectivity.
* Experience facilitating workshops, executive reviews, solution discussions, and strategic planning sessions.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and customer management skills.
* Experience leading distributed delivery teams and managing multiple customer engagements simultaneously.

**Good To Have Skills**

* Experience with customer support communities, brand advocacy programs, knowledge communities, or peer-to-peer support ecosystems.
* Exposure to SEO, search optimization, content strategy, and digital engagement best practices.
* Understanding of CRM platforms, customer support ecosystems, and customer experience technologies.
* Experience managing globally distributed communities and enterprise-scale engagement programs.
* Program management and service delivery leadership experience within managed services organizations.

**Who You Are**

* A strategic consultant with strong expertise in enterprise SaaS platforms, managed services, and customer success.
* Skilled at balancing business objectives, operational requirements, and technical considerations.
* Comfortable engaging with executive stakeholders while collaborating effectively with technical teams.
* A proactive leader who drives continuous improvement, innovation, and customer value realisation.
* Experience with customer communities and digital engagement platforms is considered a strong advantage.

**What Success Looks Like**

* High customer satisfaction, adoption, and business value realisation.
* Well-governed, scalable, and optimised platform operations.
* Successful execution of transformation, optimisation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Improved user adoption, engagement, and operational efficiency metrics.
* Trusted advisor status with customer leadership and key stakeholders.
* Consistent delivery of managed services KPIs, governance objectives, and customer success outcome

**We focus on our mission**
: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
  
  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**
: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
  
  
**We invest in our people**
: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
  
  
To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
  
  
To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
  
  
**EEO - Our philosophy**
: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
  
  
Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
  
  
**Warning about Recruiting Scams:**
Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
  
  
If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

a1a1dca6.title: Jr Broadcasting & Delivery Manager
a1a1dca6.description:
We are looking for an experienced Broadcast Technology & Operations Manager with 5+ years of experience in broadcast operations, playout, live transmission, and technical coordination. The candidate should have hands-on experience in managing Live Sports/Events and GEC (General Entertainment Channel) playout operations, including broadcast automation, master control room (MCR) operations, channel monitoring, content management, live feed handling, troubleshooting, and coordination with technical and operations teams. The role requires a strong understanding of the complete broadcast chain and the ability to manage incidents in a 24x7 broadcast environment while ensuring channel availability, quality, and operational continuity. Key Responsibilities 1. Live & GEC Playout Operations • Manage day-to-day Live and GEC channel playout operations. • Oversee live event workflows including: o Live feed acquisition o Feed switching o Primary/backup feed management o Live event insertion o SCTE/event trigger management o Slates and channel branding o Commercial/ad-break management o Return to scheduled programming • Manage GEC playout workflows including: o Daily playlists o Content ingestion o Scheduling o Primary and backup playlists o Channel branding o Logo and graphics insertion o Ad and break management o Emergency/manual intervention • Ensure uninterrupted channel transmission and timely resolution of operational issues. 2. Broadcast Technology Management • Manage and monitor broadcast systems including: o Playout automation systems o MCR systems o Video servers o Encoders/decoders o Transcoders o Satellite/IP contribution feeds o Monitoring and QC systems o Storage and content management systems • Understand and troubleshoot IP, OTT and hybrid broadcast workflows. • Work with technologies such as SRT, RTMP, RTP, UDP, HLS, MPEG-TS, SCTE35/104 and other broadcast protocols. • SRT Gateway Management: Configure, manage, and troubleshoot SRT Gateway input and output feeds, including SRT caller/listener/rendezvous modes, stream routing, IP/port configuration, latency, encryption/passphrase, bitrate, and primary/backup feed switching. Ensure reliable contribution and distribution of live feeds across broadcast and OTT workflows. 3. Live Event Operations • Manage technical and operational requirements for live sports and entertainment events. • Coordinate pre-event technical checks, and signal testing. • Ensure availability of: o Primary and backup feeds o Encoding/transcoding resources o Contribution links o Playout resources o Monitoring o Storage and recording • Monitor live events and coordinate rapid resolution of issues. • Maintain incident timelines and post-event reports. 4. GEC Channel Operations • Manage daily GEC channel operations and playlist execution. • Ensure correct content, metadata, duration and scheduling. • Monitor playlist integrity and identify: o Missing content o Corrupt files o Incorrect duration/timecodes o Playlist discrepancies o Audio/video issues o Logo/branding issues o SCTE/ad-break issues • Coordinate with Content, Programming, Traffic, QC and Technology teams for issue resolution. • Ensure changes received from the content/programming team are correctly implemented and acknowledged. 5. Monitoring & Incident Management • Monitor channels, feeds and systems on a continuous basis. • Establish and maintain incident management and escalation procedures. • Ensure all incidents are properly documented with: o Incident start time o Detection time o Action taken o Feed/channel impact o Root cause o Recovery time o Total outage/downtime • Maintain incident logs and daily operational reports. • Ensure screenshots/logs/evidence are captured for critical incidents. • Conduct RCA for recurring technical and operational issues. 6. Team Management • Lead and manage Broadcast Operations/Playout teams. • Plan shift schedules and ensure adequate 24x7 coverage. • Train operators and supervisors on: o Playout systems o Live event workflows o Channel monitoring o Troubleshooting o Incident management o Emergency procedures • Define SOPs, checklists and escalation matrices. • Conduct performance reviews and identify training requirements. • Ensure operational teams follow documented processes consistently. 7. Technical Troubleshooting • Act as the first-level technical escalation point for complex broadcast issues. • Troubleshoot issues related to: o Video/audio o Playout servers o Automation o Encoders/decoders o Transcoding o IP connectivity o Satellite feeds o Storage o Network o Streaming o SCTE/ad insertion • Coordinate with NOC, Network, Cloud, Engineering and vendor teams for advanced troubleshooting. 8. Cloud & IP Broadcast Workflows • Good understanding of cloud-based broadcast workflows. • Experience working with platforms such as: o AWS o Google Cloud o Azure o Cloud-based playout/transcoding platforms • Understand cloud storage, compute, networking and media processing workflows. • Experience with hybrid on-premise + cloud broadcast environments will be an advantage. 9. Documentation & Process Improvement • Develop and maintain: o SOPs o Technical documentation o Operational checklists o Escalation matrices o Incident reports o RCA reports o Shift handover documents • Identify operational bottlenecks and recommend automation/process improvements. • Work with technology teams to improve reliability and reduce manual intervention. Required Technical Skills Broadcast & Playout • Strong understanding of Live and GEC playout workflows • MCR/NOC operations • Broadcast automation • Playlist management • Channel branding • Ad-break management • SCTE-35 / SCTE-104 • Live feed switching • Primary/backup workflows • Channel monitoring • Audio/Video QC • SRT Gateways Video & Audio • MPEG-2 / H.264 / H.265 • MPEG-TS • HD/SD workflows • Frame rates and resolutions • Audio formats and channel mapping • Timecode concepts • Video/audio troubleshooting IP & Streaming • TCP/IP and UDP • RTP/RTMP/SRT • HLS • Multicast • Network troubleshooting • Contribution and distribution workflows Broadcast Infrastructure • Playout servers • Video servers • Encoders/decoders • Transcoders • Storage systems • SDI/IP gateways • Satellite contribution/downlink • Monitoring systems • Redundancy and failover systems Preferred Experience Experience with one or more of the following will be an advantage: • GV / Grass Valley • GV AMPP • Harmonic • Ateme • Imagine Communications • Cinegy • PlayBox • Broadpeak • AWS MediaLive / MediaConnect • Google Cloud Media workflows • FFmpeg • SRT • SCTE • OTT streaming platforms Key Competencies • Strong broadcast technology knowledge • Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills • Ability to work under pressure during live events • Strong incident and escalation management • Good communication and coordination skills • Ability to manage multiple channels/events simultaneously • Strong understanding of broadcast operational risks • Good leadership and team-management skills • Ability to make quick decisions during live incidents • Strong documentation and reporting skills Qualification • Bachelor's/Diploma in B.E. or B.Eng., Broadcast Engineering, Electronics, Telecommunications, IT, or a related field. • 5+ years of relevant experience in broadcast technology, playout, MCR/NOC or live broadcast operations. • Candidates with significant hands-on experience in Live Sports + GEC Playout will be preferred. Working Environment • Willingness to work in a 24x7 broadcast operations environment. • Comfortable working in rotational shifts and during weekends/holidays when required. • Must be capable of handling high-pressure situations during live broadcasts. • Strong focus on uptime, reliability, broadcast quality and operational continuity. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) • Channel uptime and availability • Live event uptime • Incident response and resolution time • Number of recurring incidents • Playout accuracy • Playlist/content accuracy • Successful execution of live events • SLA compliance • RCA closure • Operational efficiency • Team performance and SOP compliance • Reduction in manual interventions and operational errors

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Life insurance

Work Location: In person

We value curiosity, independent thinking, continuous learning, and the courage to challenge the expected. Where Your Ideas Find Purpose, and Your Potential Finds Opportunity. Website URL: www.ganitinc.com

**About the Role**

Job Description – Delivery Manager Experience: 8+ Years Location: Bangalore Employment Type: Full-time Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Delivery Manager with 8+ years of experience in managing end-to-end project delivery, client relationships, and cross-functional teams. The ideal candidate should have strong experience working with US-based clients, managing delivery expectations, ensuring project execution, and driving operational excellence. The candidate should be capable of handling multiple projects, managing stakeholders across geographies and time zones, and ensuring timely, high-quality delivery aligned with business objectives.

* Manage relationships with US-based clients and act as the primary point of contact for delivery-related matters.
* Understand client requirements, business objectives, and expectations, and translate them into actionable delivery plans.
* Lead and manage cross-functional teams, ensuring effective resource allocation and optimal team utilization.
* Monitor project progress, delivery milestones, risks, dependencies, and overall performance.
* Conduct regular client meetings, status reviews, and governance calls to provide updates and address concerns.
* Proactively identify delivery risks and implement mitigation strategies.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance delivery efficiency, quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including technical teams, project managers, and leadership, to ensure smooth execution.
* Manage escalations, resolve delivery challenges, and maintain strong client relationships.
* Track delivery metrics, KPIs, project profitability, and resource utilization.
* Key Success Factors Strong client relationship management, particularly with US clients.
* Consistent and predictable project delivery.
* Effective team leadership and resource management.
* High client satisfaction and successful escalation management.
* Ability to drive operational efficiency and business outcomes.

* Proven experience managing US-based clients and international stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end project delivery and client management.
* Experience managing multiple projects and cross-functional teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage client expectations, escalations, and delivery commitments.

* Ability to work in US time-zone overlap as required.

* PMP, Scrum Master, or other project management certifications.
* Experience managing distributed teams across geographies.
* Exposure to project budgeting, forecasting, resource planning, and delivery governance.

* 8+ years of overall experience in IT services, project management, or delivery management.
* Proven experience managing US-based clients and international stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end project delivery and client management.
* Experience managing multiple projects and cross-functional teams.

* Ability to manage client expectations, escalations, and delivery commitments.

4902a857.title: Technical Delivery Manager
4902a857.description:
**About Us**
Kumaran Systems: Engineering Future-Ready Transformations Since 1992, Kumaran Systems has been helping enterprises bridge the past and the future, reimagining legacy systems and embracing AI-led possibilities. With over 34 years of delivery excellence, we specialise in re-engineering core applications, driving cloud transformation, and building automation-first, GenAI-enabled ecosystems across the Banking and Financial Services, Insurance, Telecom, and Automotive sectors. We help organisations not just upgrade their systems but reimagine what’s possible.
  
  
Why Kumaran?
  
  
We blend engineering discipline with AI innovation, helping clients modernise with confidence, automate with clarity, and scale with purpose. Our global delivery model ensures agility, responsiveness, and seamless collaboration, with clients always at the heart of every engagement. At Kumaran, we don’t just solve problems, we engineer future-ready transformations.
  
  
This role is critical for driving the successful delivery of Cloud, Data Engineering, and AI/ML initiatives. The individual will serve as a technical and project leader, ensuring end-to-end execution from planning to deployment while maintaining alignment with business objectives, stakeholder expectations, and technical excellence. The position demands a strategic mindset with the ability to manage cross-functional teams, govern project delivery, and implement scalable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud solutions across AWS, Azure, or GCP platforms.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of Cloud, Data Engineering, and AI/ML projects from inception to production.
* Design and oversee cloud architectures on AWS, Azure, or GCP, ensuring security, scalability, and cost optimization.
* Develop and manage data pipelines and AI/ML workflows, including model training, validation, deployment, and MLOps integration.
* Coordinate and mentor cross-functional teams including Data Engineers, ML Engineers, and Cloud Developers.
* Manage stakeholder relationships through effective requirement gathering, progress reporting, and escalation resolution.

4802329f.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
4802329f.description:
**Opportunity Overview**
We’re seeking a strategic and execution-focused Technical Program Manager to drive large, cross-functional initiatives from concept through launch. In this role, you will lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-team programs—such as platform migrations, architectural modernization, reliability improvements, and major product launches—while defining clear milestones, success metrics, and sequencing plans. You’ll partner deeply with Engineering to proactively manage dependencies, mitigate risk, and ensure technical and business alignment. This role also strengthens our execution systems by improving program transparency, standardizing launch rigor, and translating technical complexity into clear executive-level insights.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of multi-team initiatives (e.g., platform migrations, architectural modernization, reliability improvements, major product launches)
* Define milestones, critical paths, and measurable success criteria
* Break ambiguous initiatives into executable phases with clear sequencing
* Identify and manage cross-team technical dependencies
* Proactively surface risks and tradeoffs with mitigation plans
* Run structured risk reviews and escalation processes when needed
* Participate in technical design discussions to understand architecture and constraints
* Ensure design reviews, capacity planning, and rollout strategies happen early
* Collaborate with EMs and engineers leaders to align on realistic timelines
* Establish program tracking mechanisms that create transparency without bureaucracy
* Standardize launch readiness, milestone reviews, and postmortem follow-ups
* Identify systemic delivery bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement
* Provide concise executive updates with clear status, risks, and asks
* Maintain decision logs and documentation for key initiatives
* Translate technical complexity into business impact

**What You’ll Need**
**Must-haves**

* 6+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or related roles in high-growth technology companies
* 6+ years of experience hands on experience as a software engineer
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum/SAFe or other delivery frameworks (with pragmatic application)
* Demonstrated experience leading multi-team, multi-quarter technical initiatives
* Strong technical fluency (experience working closely with backend, infrastructure, data, or platform engineering teams)
* Ability to understand system architecture, dependencies, and engineering tradeoffs
* Proven track record of driving programs to completion in ambiguous environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including influencing senior engineering leaders
* Excellent english written and verbal communication skills
* Experience implementing program management frameworks, milestone tracking, and risk management systems

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience in platform engineering, infrastructure modernization, large-scale migrations, GenAI Integrations, inference infrastructure, data pipelines, model deployment platforms
* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Experience in scaling startups
* Experience improving delivery predictability metrics (e.g., on-time delivery, scope control, forecast accuracy)
* Experience supporting compliance, security, or reliability initiatives
* MBA or advanced technical degree

**ISMS Roles And Responsibilities**

* Good knowledge of Information practices.
* Assist the manager in all the information security activities implementation and maintenance process.
* Ensuring the team and imparted with Competence related to Information security
* Responsible for implementation of security policies and procedures and report any issues to the Information Security Manager.

**Ability To Commute/relocate**

* Hyderabad, Telangana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

**Interview Process\*:**

* Connect with Talent Acquisition
* Meet with the Hiring Manager
* Behavioral Interview(s)
* Case Study
* Interview with Senior Leadership
* Subject to change

**About Cohere Health**
Cohere Health’s clinical intelligence platform and agentic AI-powered solutions connect health plans’ strategic goals and providers’ needs, optimizing the speed, cost, and quality of care. With an enterprise approach that streamlines payer-provider decision-making across the care continuum–including policy, prior authorization, payment accuracy, and more–the company improves collaboration and reduces burden, resulting in up to 8x ROI and 94% provider satisfaction.
  
  
With the acquisition of ZignaAI, we expanded our AI-native platform with a comprehensive Payment Integrity Suite that spans data mining, clinical and coding validation, authorization and claims reconciliation, and end-to-end payment integrity services across pre- and post-pay workflows. By connecting clinical and payment insights, our transparent, AI-powered solutions help health plans proactively improve payment accuracy, reduce waste and vendor dependency, strengthen provider relationships, and build smarter, more efficient payment integrity programs.
  
  
Cohere Health’s innovations continue to receive industry-wide recognition.
