add45747.title: Solutions Architect, ISV
add45747.description:
**Description**
AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
  
  
Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
  
  
AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud-based solutions.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
  
  
Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
  
  
You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
  
  
As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
  
  
To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
  
  
Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9).
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
  
  
**About The Team**
ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. 3b46b20a.title: Oracle Cloud HCM Consultant
3b46b20a.description:
Overview:
  
At Peloton, we don't just implement technology. We transform the way organizations work, compete, and grow. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in the US, Peloton is one of the most respected and fastest-growing global Oracle consulting firms, delivering Advisory, Consulting, and Managed Services to leading organizations across many industries, including Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Consumer Packaged Goods, and more.
  
Peloton Consulting Group has the vision and connected global capabilities to help organizations envision, implement, and realize the benefits of digital transformation. Our team has the best practices, knowledge, industry expertise, and know-how. We make digital transformation a reality by leveraging AI, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Supply Chain Management (SCM), Human Capital Management (HCM), Customer Experience (CX), Analytics, and Data Management for the cloud. Through connected capabilities, we bring people, processes, and technology together. We help organizations go further faster. That is the Peloton way!
  
What truly sets us apart is our people. We are team players. We are energetic and entrepreneurial. We are problem solvers and innovative thinkers who believe the best outcomes are built together. We believe in quality, appreciate creativity, recognize individual contributions, and place trust in every member of our team. If you bring strong business or technical expertise and want to do meaningful work alongside people who are equally passionate about getting it right, we think you'll feel right at home here.
  
Peloton is seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud HCM Solution Architect to play a key role in a high-growth practice area. This is a strategic, hands-on role responsible for leading end-to-end solution design and guiding clients through complex HCM transformations using Oracle Cloud.
  
As a Solution Architect, you will partner with business and IT stakeholders to define future-state architectures, align business processes with Oracle leading practices, and ensure scalable, high-quality solution delivery across the HCM suite.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
Responsibilities will vary depending on the level and experience of the individual. The consultant will work as part of a project team delivering analytical, solution-oriented services to Fortune 1000 clients. Based upon experience, specific responsibilities may include:
  
• Developing an understanding of a client’s current state process and developing future state recommendations based on Oracle’s best business practices
  
• Recommending roadmaps to close performance gaps and developing high level implementation plans
  
• Gathering and analyzing benefits and open enrollment requirements
  
• Aligning business requirements and best practices to implement a technical solution • Defining new and refining existing business processes
  
• Contributing to continuous improvement and development of Peloton processes and intellectual property
  
  
Required Experience & Skills:
  
• Qualified candidates must have a BS or BA degree in Business, Technology, or equivalent degree or experience in HCM.
  
• Overall 6+ years of Experience with minimum of 2 to 3 years of experience in Oracle HCM Cloud.
  
• Minimum 2 years of experience in implementing Core HR, Benefits, Compensation, Absence, Talent, Payroll, ORC and OTL.
  
• Minimum of 2-3 modules and cross module knowledge.
  
• Experience in writing configuration workbooks and Understanding in Application Implementation Methodology.
  
• Experience with either development or reviewing fast formulas a plus.
  
• Ability to quickly understand HR concepts and apply to technology.
  
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  
• Proven ability to work remotely and independently in support of clients
  
• Fit with Peloton culture and company values: teamwork, innovation, integrity, service, “can-do” attitude, and communicating your ideas.
  
  
Compensation:
  
Peloton provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, business needs, and geographic location. Peloton also offer bonus opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package including
  
- Competitive base salary with performance-based bonus
  
  
- Vacation, Leave, and Holiday pay
  
  
- Annual Health Wallet
  
  
- Group Medical Insurance
  
  
- Group Term Accident & Life Insurance
  
  
- Paid holidays and PTO
  
  
  
Peloton Group is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

2bfb811d.title: Solution Engineer
2bfb811d.description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.
  
  
We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.
  
  
Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.
  
  
Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The System Solution Engineer is accountable for the strategic oversight, successful implementation and reliable maintenance of the core Customer Services technology stack, including systems like Genesys, Zendesk, Teramind, and associated Data & Quality Management (QM) tools. This role acts as the primary subject matter expert, ensuring system stability, optimal performance, and continuous feature adoption. The purpose is to maximize agent efficiency, ensure compliance and align the capabilities of these platforms directly with operational objectives to deliver a seamless, high-quality agent & customer experience.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities**

* System Ownership & Strategy: Take full ownership of the technical health, lifecycle management, and multi-year roadmap for the entire Customer Services IT systems portfolio (including Genesys Cloud, Zendesk, Teramind, and integrated 3rd party tools).
* Cross-System Integration: Define and govern the strategic approach for integrating different platforms (telephony, CRM, WFM, QA) to ensure data flow, system compatibility, and a unified agent experience.
* Vendor & Budget Management: Manage key technology vendor relationships and oversee system-related budgets and capacity planning.Provide L3 subject matter expertise and guidance on how agents and supervisors can best utilize the appointed systems.
* Maintain an expert-level understanding of new features and market trends across the CS technology landscape to drive continuous feature adoption.
* Assesses situations to make appropriate recommendations based on operational needs.
* Adheres to support processes and best practices.
* Prepares and/or reviews functional requirements documentation.
* System Configuration, Development & Change Management: Design, develop, test, and deploy complex system configurations, integrations, and changes based on business requirements.
* Hands-on Coding: Write and maintain ad-hoc scripts, APIs, and microservices (e.g., using Python, Go, or JavaScript) to facilitate system integrations and custom functionality.
* Adapts to prestigeless work within a small team environment.
* Participate in operational meetings for technical guidance and solution proposals.

**Qualification /Personal Characteristics**
**:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 5 or more years of IT experience supporting applications and infrastructure in a contact center or large-scale enterprise environment.
* Proven experience as a solutions architect or lead engineer, with a strong portfolio of successfully delivered projects.
* Strong, demonstrable experience with Customer Service platforms (e.g., Genesys Cloud, Zendesk, Teramind, WFM systems).
* Expertise in designing systems on cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.
* Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, APIs and RESTful services.
* Programming knowledge (Python, Go, or JavaScript preferred) for ad-hoc scripts and integrations.
* Ability to troubleshoot and diagnose issues related to hardware, software, VoIP or network connectivity.
* Strategic Communication & Stakeholder Alignment: Excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical issues and translate system capabilities into business value for both technical and non-technical stakeholders (e.g., leadership, operations teams).
* Analytical & Problem Solving Mindset: Ability to think strategically, solve complex, cross-functional technical problems, and demonstrate strong analytical skills with a hands-on approach.
* Organizational & Team Skills: Prestigeless team player with strong organizational, detailed orientation, and planning skills to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Must be passionate about contributing to an organization focused on continuously improving consumer experiences.

**Benefits**
What’s in it for You?
  
  

* Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Confidential, free support for personal or work-related challenges—covering counseling, or financial guidance, and more—to help maintain well-being and performance.
* Term Life Insurance: Provides financial peace of mind for your loved ones with a fixed-coverage death benefit over a defined term. Affordable protection offered by your employer.
* Mediclaim (Health Insurance): Extensive coverage for medical expenses to ensure you and your family get the care you need when it matters.
* Meal Coupons: A tasty perk to fuel your workday—delicious meals or snacks on us!
* Performance-Based Incentives: Earn more when you deliver more. Your hard work pays off—literally.
* Learning & Development (L&D) Sessions: Continued growth through curated upskilling sessions—boosting your skills and career progression.

Diversity disclaimer
  
  
*At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds.*
*During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.*

73f699ef.description:
**About Us:**
Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.
  
  
Seismic is the global leader in AI-powered enablement, empowering go-to-market leaders to drive strategic growth and deliver exceptional customer experiences at scale. The Seismic Enablement Cloud™ is the only unified AI-powered platform that prepares customer-facing teams with the skills, content, tools, and insights needed to maximize every buyer interaction and strengthen client relationships. Trusted by more than 2,000 organizations worldwide, Seismic helps businesses achieve measurable outcomes and accelerate revenue growth. Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia. Learn more at seismic.com.
  
  
**Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.**
**Overview:**
We are looking for a talented and driven Solution Architect to join our Professional Services team. In this role, you will design and implement integration solutions, collaborating closely with product and engineering teams to scope and deliver tailored solutions for our enterprise clients. You will serve as the subject matter expert on Seismic’s platform components, working alongside customers, project managers, solution consultants, and teams across different geographies to deliver seamless automations, custom solutions, and integrations.
  
  
**Who you are:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Four or more years of experience in Enterprise Content Professional Services.
* Three or more years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and testing API integrations and solutions, with above average knowledge of RESTful APIs.
* Strong knowledge of SQL, Web Service Consumption, SOQL, and Salesforce Reporting.
* Expert knowledge of Excel Model, SSO, SMTP, and Salesforce Setup.
* Expert knowledge of LiveDoc & LiveForm is preferred.
* Ability to lead projects with teams located in different geographies.
* Demonstrated experience leading requirements gathering efforts on large-scale projects.
* Strong written and oral communication skills with a proven ability to initiate and manage relationships with customers at all levels.
* Self-starter with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Demonstrates strong self-learning capabilities with the aptitude to quickly grasp new product features, technologies, and concepts.
* Critical thinking, analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capability.
* Advanced proficiency with the Microsoft Office Suite including PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.
* Understanding of New Product Development Methodologies and Emerging Technologies (Mobile, Security, Internet, etc.).
* Strong facilitation, project management, and organisational skills.
* Strong relationship development and people management skills.
* Experience collaborating with and providing business recommendations to management.
* Comfortable writing and troubleshooting Python code snippets.
* Experience utilising AI tools and building agents to drive efficiency and quality improvement.
* Experience in the Business Requirements Creation Process for a technical product or similar experience.
* Experience with Seismic or another Sales Enablement platform is a plus.
* Experience in Product Management on a Technical Product is a plus.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Collaborate with business development, product management, and engineering teams to define, design, and create integration solutions for complex client needs.
* Lead requirement gathering sessions with enterprise customers to understand business goals, technical requirements, and integration objectives; craft Statements of Work (SOWs) for large-scale projects.
* Translate business and technical requirements into detailed solution designs, architecture diagrams, and data flow documentation.
* Serve as subject matter expert on Seismic’s platform capabilities, APIs, out-of-the-box offerings, and custom integrations.
* Provide strategic and hands-on technical guidance to clients throughout the evaluation, implementation, and post-deployment phases.
* Communicate and present solutions effectively to client executives and technical teams, including participation in sales calls to address customer integration questions.
* Serve as technical lead across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring timely delivery and high-quality outcomes in collaboration with cross-functional teams across different geographies.
* Identify and mitigate risks in technical workstreams, escalating critical issues as needed.
* Develop creative, robust, scalable, and reusable strategies to support evolving business needs.
* Deliver ongoing support and services for existing customers in alignment with SLAs; manage customer escalations while seeking technical resolution.
* Conduct virtual and on-site training sessions to enable customer success.
* Mentor and support junior team members, fostering knowledge sharing and skill development.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to advocate for customer-driven enhancements and feature requests; promote and implement a minimum of one product enhancement per year.
* Seek out new industry and technology trends and apply this knowledge to solve business problems.

**What we have for you:**
At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.

**enablement**

66749e5b.title: Migration Modernization Architect, Professional Services
66749e5b.description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Are you an experienced Cloud architect/developer who can assist our customers in Application modernization, Design and development of cloud native applications and/or re-engineering applications that can fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like to work on a variety of game changing projects, at the forefront of application development and cloud technology adoption? This role is open for Delhi/NCR.
  
  
As an architect you would champion applications to be cloud optimized by making them well-architected ,enabling them to reap the benefits of elasticity, horizontal scalability, automation and high availability. You should have a knack of GenAI tooling to driving application modernization at scale with GenAI tools.

Our team collaborates across the entire AWS organization to bring access to product and service teams, to get the right solution delivered and drive feature innovation based upon customer needs.
  
  
Amazon aims to be the most customer centric company on earth. Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers critical applications for hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands on Mig and Mod (MM) Architects with:
  
  

* Strong Consulting, client-facing (CXO) level communication driving cloud solutioning and leading technical workshops
* Ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders into implementable solution adhering to well architected framework.
* Problem-solving and analytical thinking driving envisioning , presales and be a thought leader in the domain driving Application discovery , Risk mitigation strategies, Performance testing and validation, Migration and Post-migration optimization
* Deep expertise in large scale cloud migrations, and AWS infrastructure to drive complex cloud transformation journey from Onprem successfully modernizing them to help realize true value from cloud
* Deep expertise in VMware technologies having worked on vSphere administration, vCenter management, NSX networking, vSAN storage, HCX for migrations, VMware Cloud on AWS
* Ability to drive Migration discovery to Mobilize to lead and drive Migration and Modernization end to end.
* Strong experience on Cloud Infra, network, Security and cloud resiliency (DR)
* Ability to modernize application in .Net, Java, Python and get them out of legacy framework to realize true potential of cloud
* hand-on experience in designing and developing web applications, APIs, microservices, and data integrations for cloud native applications
* Knowledge of cloud-native design patterns, including microservices architecture and event-driven systems.

a8c0731a.title: Architect, IT Solutions, Copilot & Agentic AI Platforms
a8c0731a.description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care.
  
  
As Edwards accelerates its AI-driven transformation, we are seeking an Architect, IT Solutions to serve as the enterprise technical authority for our two most strategic agentic AI platforms — Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks. This is a multi-faceted architecture role that spans platform leadership, integration design, and end-to-end solution architecture. You will define how these platforms are built, extended, integrated, and governed across the enterprise.
  
  
This role works alongside our existing Azure infrastructure architect and complements cloud expertise with deep, platform-specific technical authority. If you thrive at the intersection of enterprise architecture, applied AI, and business-facing delivery — and want to shape how a global lifescience company adopts agentic AI at scale — this is the role for you.
  
  
**How you’ll make an impact:**
**Platform Architecture Leadership — Copilot & Moveworks**

* Own the enterprise platform architecture for Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks — serving as the definitive technical authority on capabilities, extensibility, and best practices.
* Define the ecosystem blueprint, platform standards, extensibility patterns, and long-term technical roadmap for both platforms.
* Evaluate and recommend new platform features, plugins, connectors, and agentic AI capabilities as they emerge from Microsoft and Moveworks.

**Integration Architecture**

* Design and govern the integration layer connecting Copilot and Moveworks to enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, JDE, Active Directory, HRIS, LMS, and CMDB.
* Define API strategies, event-driven patterns, connector frameworks, and messaging standards that enable secure, reliable, and scalable data flows across platforms.
* Partner with the Azure architecture team to ensure integration patterns align with cloud infrastructure, identity (Entra ID), and security standards.

**Lead Solution Architecture**

* Provide end-to-end solution design and technical authority for all AI agent, copilot, and automation solutions built on these platforms.
* Lead architecture reviews, approve design decisions, and ensure solutions are production-ready, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable, repeatable architectural patterns and executable design strategies.

**Governance, Mentorship & Innovation**

* Develop, institute, and maintain platform-specific design methodologies, development standards, security patterns, and operational best practices.
* Provide training, coaching, and technical mentorship to Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs), solution developers, and IT team members on Copilot and Moveworks architecture.
* Survey emerging developments in agentic AI — including multi-agent orchestration, RAG patterns, and tool-using agents — and recommend approaches that extend platform value.
* Develop and maintain architecture models, reference designs, integration maps, and documentation for current and proposed implementations.

**What you’ll need (Required):**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Progressive IT experience, including significant depth in platform architecture, integration architecture, or solution architecture.
* Experience in an architect role working with cross-functional teams (within IT and/or business) on enterprise-level or complex system implementations.
* Deep expertise in at least one of the following: Microsoft Copilot ecosystem (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Graph API, Graph Connectors, Copilot extensibility) or Moveworks platform (conversational AI, enterprise integrations, workflow automation).
* Strong integration architecture skills: REST/GraphQL APIs, event-driven architectures, enterprise connectors, middleware, and messaging patterns (e.g., Azure Service Bus, Logic Apps, Power Automate).
* Proven ability to design end-to-end solution architectures for enterprise AI, automation, or digital workplace platforms.
* Experience defining platform standards, governance frameworks, and reusable architectural patterns at enterprise scale.
* Strong understanding of identity, security, and compliance requirements in enterprise AI deployments (e.g., Entra ID, conditional access, DLP, data classification).
* Expert-level documentation and communication skills — ability to create architecture blueprints, integration maps, and present complex technical concepts to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, including cross-functional negotiation, vendor management, and the ability to drive alignment across distributed teams.

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio — building custom copilots, plugins, connectors, topics, and generative AI orchestration.
* Hands-on experience with Moveworks platform — configuring enterprise virtual agents, workflow automation, knowledge integration, and analytics.
* Experience with agentic AI patterns including multi-agent orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool-using agents, and planner-executor models.
* Experience integrating AI platforms with enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, Active Directory, LMS, and CMDB.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) as an automation and extensibility layer.
* Experience deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., medical device, pharmaceuticals, financial services) with attention to governance and responsible AI practices.
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* Professional certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, TOGAF, or equivalent architecture frameworks.
* Track record of mentoring engineers and building technical communities of practice.

**Why is this role different?**
This is not a generic enterprise architect role. You will be the single technical authority for two of the most strategic AI platforms at Edwards Lifesciences — platforms that are actively transforming how our work, decide, and collaborate. You will shape the architecture, set the standards, and mentor the next generation of Forward-Deployed AI Engineers who build on these platforms every day.
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of platform strategy, hands-on architecture, and business impact — with direct visibility to senior IT leadership and the opportunity to influence how a global healthcare company scales agentic AI responsibly.

51eddf9c.description:
We are looking for a customer-facing delivery lead who combines the rigor of a Digital Project Manager, the curiosity and analytical depth of a Business Analyst, and the habits of someone who already runs much of their own work with AI.

Our projects run on an AI-first delivery harness: a shared set of AI agents, templates, workflows and quality checks that takes work from requirement through design, build, test and release. You will lead delivery on it. That means learning it quickly, using it every day, making sure your team uses it properly, and owning the quality of what it produces.

You will be the primary bridge between the customer’s business stakeholders, technical delivery, and QA teams. You will understand why a customer needs change, shape what should be delivered, and ensure it is delivered successfully.

This is not a meeting-coordination or documentation-only role. You should be equally comfortable challenging the customer business and technical stakeholder, shaping a base solution design, refining an insurance journey, tracing a data integration, reviewing release readiness, and automating the routine work that would otherwise distract you from high-value customer conversations.

This role suits someone who:

* Communicates clearly and confidently. Is comfortable having tough conversations about scope, cost, timelines and quality, and stays calm when a customer pushes back
* Is technically sound, and can hold an end-to-end conversation on requirements, journy flow, architecture, integrations, data and release management
* Has a keen eye for detail and is not shy of reading. AI drafts a lot of our material, and nothing goes to a customer until a person has read it, checked it against the source and cut anything vague, padded or generic. On your projects, that person is you
* Brings structure without being chased: keeps the backlog, plan, status reports and RAID log current, so the team and the customer always have an accurate picture of where things stand
* Picks up new tools and ways of working quickly, automates their own work first, and keeps looking for new ways AI can make them and their team faster and better
* Gets excited about doing many times more with the same team
* Is happy to work from our Noida office and to travel to customer sites in India and overseas as and when required

**Responsibilities**

**Requirements, Customer Engagement & Business Outcomes**

* Elicit, analyze and validate business, functional, non-functional, regulatory and integration requirements; translate them into concise BRDs/FSDs where, appropriate, epics, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Produce the base solution design for new requirements and change requests using our AI-first approach: generate the first draft with the delivery harness, test it against the requirement, the existing implementation and known constraints, then refine and agree it with architects and tech leads.
* Own and maintain the product backlog: clarity, traceability, dependencies, prioritization and change control; keep it refined ahead of each sprint and ensure customer sign-off on scope and acceptance criteria.
* Own day-to-day customer communication and build credible, trusted relationships across business, technology and leadership stakeholders.
* Lead discovery workshops, challenge incomplete requirements, surface business problems, establish measurable outcomes and propose practical solutions.
* Conduct difficult conversations professionally: negotiate scope, explain trade-offs, manage escalations, communicate delays and secure clear decisions without avoiding accountability.
* Understand customer goals, operational pain points, growth priorities and changing market conditions; identify incremental value opportunities and share them with account and solution leaders.

**Delivery, governance and release ownership**

* Convert agreed scope into delivery plans, sprint/release goals, estimates, milestones, ownership, dependencies, RAID logs and realistic stakeholder commitments.
* Run Agile ceremonies and customer governance with purpose; maintain JIRA/Confluence and publish regular, decision-ready status reports, RAID logs and delivery metrics that show what has changed, what is at risk and what decision is needed, rather than status theatre.
* Work hands-on with engineering, QA, UX, DevOps and vendors to resolve blockers, assess change impact and prevent requirement-to-build gaps.
* Drive UAT planning, scenarios, defect triage, customer acceptance, go/no-go readiness, deployment coordination, release notes, hypercare and handover to support.
* Communicate risks early and transparently, and own corrective action through resolution; track delivery against scope, quality, schedule and customer outcomes.

**AI-first delivery and framework adoption**

* Run day-to-day delivery on our AI-first delivery harness and approved AI tools, using them for meeting preparation and summaries, action tracking, requirement drafts, solution design drafts, story/criteria generation, gap analysis, test scenarios, reporting and release documentation.
* Drive adoption of the delivery framework within the team: onboard new members onto it, make sure work follows the agreed workflow, templates and quality checks, notice where people work around it, and feed improvements back to the framework owners.
* Connect workflows where practical (for example, JIRA, Confluence, collaboration tools and approved AI assistants) to reduce manual updates, duplicate entry and administrative effort.
* Regularly identify, prototype, measure and scale repeatable automations.
* Own the quality of everything AI produces on your project. Read and review AI-generated requirements, designs, test scenarios, reports and customer communication before they are published; check facts against the source, remove generic or padded content, and make sure every document is accurate, specific and something you would put your name to.

**Qualifications**

* Should be a B.Tech/BE/MCA
* At least 3 years of demonstrated delivery ownership across discovery, requirements, implementation, UAT and production release in software product or IT solutions environments.
* Excellent written and spoken communication: able to write a clear status report, decision note or escalation email, and to hold their own with clients, developers and senior stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and comfortable reading long documents closely; able to spot errors, gaps, contradictions and generic filler in requirements, designs and AI-generated content.
* Evidence of personally using AI and automation to improve the way work is executed; ability to demonstrate real workflows, limitations, safeguards, how AI output is reviewed before use, and measurable results.
* Familiarity with digital buying journeys in the BFSI sector, including customer onboarding, fulfilment, and servicing.
* Working knowledge of tools such as JIRA, Lucid Charts, Confluence or similar tools.
* Experience maintaining a backlog, delivery plan and RAID log, and producing regular status reporting for customer governance.
* Ability to create detailed UML diagrams (Use Case, Sequence, Activity) for complex processes.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
* Ability to pick up a new delivery framework or toolset quickly and bring a team along with it.
* Hands-on experience running agile delivery (Scrum or Kanban) and working in agile teams.

**﻿Apply:**

To apply for the job, email our Talent Acquisition Team at
careers@infoaxon.com,
mentioning the Job Title in the subject line, along with your latest CV.

* Capable of deep user empathy and adept at balancing product goals and engineering constraints to deliver impactful experiences

* Inspired to innovate in areas where automation can replace manual work. The team works primarily with JIRA, Smartsheet, and GSuite so programming proficiency with all tools is a plus
* Skilled at communicating across a diverse set of engineers and stakeholders

0703566e.title: Technical Program Manager II - AI Platforms
0703566e.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
  
  
As the Technical Program Manager for AI Platform, you’ll turn our internal AI components and platform foundations into golden paths for the Product & Tech teams shipping AI experiences to customers. You’ll align roadmaps on shared components, establish clear owners, and make platform leverage visible through metrics and reporting.
  
  
**You Will**

* Own the shared-foundations program. Maintain the view of components that multiple feature teams need (agent handoff, identity, context, memory, governance, and more). Drive a single accountable owner, clear roles, and decision dates for each, overlaying team roadmaps without replacing them.
* Drive cross-team decisions to closure. Frame the decisions that unblock architecture, sequence product, UX, and engineering inputs, and run working sessions with named owners and dated action items.
* Scale an innersource model. Partner with engineering to establish a contribution-based approach for shared AI components: versioned templates, reference implementations, and docs that anyone can improve through review, with clear guidelines, release processes, and safe staged rollout.
* Report on platform scorecard. Define metrics that capture ecosystem leverage, adoption, quality, and team velocity. Set baselines and targets, secure instrumentation, and bring the results into leadership and stakeholder reporting.
* Reduce duplication. Identify capabilities built in multiple places and drive consolidation/unification, tracking those migration plans across teams.
* Partner on governance. Work with security, identity, audit, and legal teams to continually iterate and track responsible AI requirements within the platform.
* Communicate clearly. Write decision-first updates tailored to leaders and project stakeholders.

**You Have**

* 2-4 years of technical program management on platform, infrastructure, or developer-experience programs spanning many teams and timezones.
* Fluency in LLM & agent systems: orchestration, tool use, MCP, memory, context, evals.
* Experience defining platform or developer metrics: baselines, targets, instrumentation, and adoption measures. You’ve made invisible infrastructure work visible to leadership.
* Experience enabling shared components through SDK-style or innersource models, including versioning and release management.
* Proven ability to lead without authority across engineering, product, UX, and security.
* Strong planning discipline: dependency mapping, risk tracking, capacity awareness.
* Excellent written communication, especially decision memos and executive reporting.
* Legally eligible and available to work a hybrid schedule in BLR office.
* Fluency in English is required.

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with agent interoperability protocols and data platform governance tooling.
* Experience consolidating internal systems and managing build/buy/adopt decisions.
* Familiarity with AI governance, agent identity, auditing, and compliance.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, GitLab, and work-management tools at scale.

**Get To Know Us**
At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. c4dc6336.title: Sr Tech Infra Program Manager, DCPD
c4dc6336.description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost cloud infrastructure platform that empowers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries to innovate and invent.
  
  
Do you have the business background, complex cross functional program management experience, financial expertise, legal/regulatory comprehension and technical understanding? Can you communicate effectively, find clarity in ambiguity, and simplicity in complexity ? Have you managed complex infrastructure projects ?
  
  
If yes, then come and explore this exciting role. This role in Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) Hyderabad, Telengana builds infrastructure that hosts AWS cloud services. It delivers AWS cloud infrastructure in a challenging, high growth, fast paced and customer focused work environment. In this role, you will lead cross functional teams to deliver usable data center capacity. You will partner with senior stakeholders to develop, document, manage and deliver infrastructure designs, implementation schedules and budgets. You will earn trust of your partners in your ability to solve complex issues and steer teams in right direction to deliver results, on-time and at-cost.
  
  
You must be an exceptionally strong communicator (both written and verbal), and possess relevant experience in managing technical and strategic programs. If you bring past experience in data center deployment programs, great. If not, then having a background in program and project management, architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering managing a team with strong urge to learn will be essential.
  
  
Come Join us, have fun, and create history!!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Senior Infrastructure TPM owns delivery of new DC across one or more availability zones in Hyderabad, Telangana India. The Sr TIPM manages delivery of ~5 projects at any time. They bridge internal customers, business functions, (Planning, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Policy, Operations), and functional delivery teams (Construction, Commissioning, Controls, Fiber and Network) to enable on-time and right sized delivery of new DC capacity. The Sr TIPM is able to guide and develop partner teams to accomplish the regions goal.
  
  
The scope begins with early expansion planning, which includes a feasibility analysis to approve expansion plans and associated build timelines. They evaluate multiple factors prior to approving a new plan of record, including owned/leased/collocated DC supply, utility delivery (power, water, and fiber), and long lead equipment (LLE) availability. It requires region-wide knowledge and monitoring of in-flight projects, major risks, and remediation efforts to ensure DC delivery is not only on track to meet supply commitments but also to meet customer demand, which is constantly changing.
  
  
A successful TPM Manager must be capable of managing a combination of metrics, tools, and mechanisms to remain aware of ongoing risks or issues that require their action, decision, mitigations, or effort to identify alternative solutions communicating up, down, and across the organization to align direction, gain support and drive remediation efforts
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
* Master's degree in a related technical field

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management
* Experience in construction of data center delivery (design, commissioning and construction), mission critical facilities, or equivalent industrial/manufacturing facility builds

984c2b7c.description:
**E T Consultant - Nature Based Solutions Specialist**

**Job #:**

**Required Language(s):**

English, Hindi

  

**Preferred Language(s):**

  

**Closing Date:**

11/26/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC

**Description**

At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd  
  
India's 11,099-kilometer coastline is home to 250 million people and supports key blue economy sectors including fisheries, tourism, agriculture, and transport. Despite its ecological richness, India's coastal ecosystems face mounting pressure from climate-induced hazards, coastal erosion, pollution, and land-use change. One-third of India's coastline is reported as vulnerable to erosion, threatening livelihoods, settlements, and biodiversity of global significance.  
  
The SHORE MPA has begun implementation in the states of Tamil Nadu and Karnataka under Phase 1 and will be expanded to other coastal states such as Goa, Maharashtra, Puducherry and West Bengal under subsequent phases. It aims to increase the resilience of targeted coastal communities and ecosystems, focusing on four components: (i) strengthening institutions for Integrated Coastal Zone Management (ICZM); (ii) shoreline management, coastal protection and conservation; (iii) improving livelihoods for natural resource-dependent communities; and (iv) enhancing marine pollution management and plastic circularity.  
  
Nature-based solutions (NBS) are central to Component 2, which supports mangrove, seagrass and coral reef conservation management and restoration, along with shelter belts, bio-shields, and hybrid coastal erosion management measures such as beach nourishment, sand dune stabilization, artificial reefs, and others. Where relevant, NBS investments should be coordinated with livelihood activities such as eco-tourism and mangrove-friendly value chains to ensure that conservation-livelihood tradeoffs are managed. The project also involves establishment of Centers of Excellence for coastal ecosystem management, long-term biodiversity monitoring, and eco-tourism.  
  
The Environment (ENV) Department in South Asia seeks to recruit a highly skilled and motivated ET Consultant (Nature-based Solutions Specialist) to provide technical, operational, and analytical support to the World Bank task team and the state-level implementing agencies in planning, implementing, and monitoring nature-based solutions for coastal resilience under the SHORE MPA. The ET Consultant will report to the ENV Practice Manager for the South Asia Region (SAR) and work under the supervision of the SHORE Task Team Leaders.  
  
The South Asia Region comprises six countries (Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, and Sri Lanka) that range in size from India (with a population of over 1 billion) to Maldives (with 0.3 million people). The region has experienced a long period of robust economic growth, averaging 6% a year over the past 20 years. It was the second-fastest growing region in the world in the aftermath of the global crisis. This strong growth has translated into declining poverty and impressive improvements in human development. The percentage of people living below the poverty line fell in South Asia from 56% to 16% between 1981 and 2013. Still, the region remains home to a third of the world’s poorest, with 216 million people living below $1.9/day.  
  
The South Asia Region: https://www.worldbank.org/en/region/sar

The Environment Department (ENV), located within the World Bank’s Planet Practice Group has been established to deliver on the opportunities, benefits and outcomes offered by enhanced management of the environment and natural resources. ENV provides expertise, technical assistance and financing to help countries manage land, sea and freshwater natural resources in a sustainable way to help create jobs, improve livelihoods, enhance ecosystem services, decrease pollution and increase resilience to climate change. Over 360 ENV staff working across the globe help set developing countries on a clean, green growth trajectory for resilient economies and healthy communities.  
  
The SSAE1 unit comprises around 30 staff, with 95 percent based in Country Offices. The rest of the team is based in Washington DC. Our Sri Lanka country office is a joint World Bank/International Finance Cooperation office, comprising approximately 100 staff, including an ETC working on environment, providing a vibrant, collegial working environment.  
  
**Duties and accountabilities:**  
  
The ET Consultant will have the following tasks:  
  
**1)Technical Advisory and Operational Support**  
  

* Provide technical guidance to the task team and clients on the design, siting, and implementation of NBS interventions including mangrove, coastal sandy-soil & cliff forests, seagrass and coral reef conservation and restoration, bio-shields and shelter belts, and hybrid erosion management.
* Support preparation and quality review of sub-project-level technical designs for NBS activities, including for e.g. Environmental and Social Impact Assessments (ESIAs), Environmental and Social Management Plans (ESMPs), and Biodiversity Management Plans (BMPs).
* Advise on screening of NBS sub-project sites to avoid ecologically sensitive areas, no-go zones, and areas with high biodiversity value in line with State Coastal Zone Management Plans (CZMP) and Shoreline Management Plans (SMP).
* Contribute to Implementation Support Missions and progress report reviews from implementing agencies related to NBS design and implementation.

  
**2)Global Knowledge and Technical Expertise**  
  

* Support the implementation of nature-based solutions-related advisory services and knowledge products, including through technical inputs, guidance materials, and planning for the timely delivery of analytical products.
* Generate and curate knowledge, such as by identifying best practices and lessons learned on NBS for coastal protection, and promote dissemination at the national and global levels.
* Support the team in technical assessments/analyses related to NBS e.g. cost-benefit analysis frameworks for NBS interventions, assessment of ecosystem services and livelihoods benefits.
* Support the design and operationalization of long-term NBS/ecosystem monitoring programs in line with project results frameworks.

  
**3)Stakeholder Engagement and Capacity Building**  
  

* Contribute to the engagement and policy dialogue with government counterparts and other collaborators in the NBS space.
* Support capacity building and knowledge sharing activities for state officials, community groups, and technical staff on NBS principles, implementation, and adaptive management. This may include knowledge exchange between SHORE state teams, with national institutions (e.g., NCSCM, NIOT, NCCR, IIT-Madras, SDMRI), and with other countries that are implementing coastal NBS projects.
* Engage with local natural-resource dependent communities and Self-Help Groups (SHGs) in the design of community-driven NBS interventions.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master's (or higher) degree in marine ecology, coastal engineering, forestry, environmental science, natural resource management, geography, or a closely related field.

  

* Minimum of 8 years of relevant professional experience in nature-based solutions, forestry/mangroves, coastal ecosystem management, coastal resilience, natural resource management, and/or sustainable development fields with demonstrated experience in World Bank operations and analytics.

  

* Demonstrated knowledge and expertise on nature-based solutions, which may include mangrove restoration, coral reef rehabilitation, seagrass conservation, shelter belts, bio-shields, or green-grey hybrid coastal protection.

  

* Strong technical skills with remote sensing, coastal modeling tools, or GIS as applied to coastal ecosystem management.

  

* Strong analytical skills, ability to think strategically, analyze and synthesize diverse qualitative and quantitative data and information. Ability to develop, conduct, or review assessments of NBS design and implementation is an advantage.

  

* Excellent writing skills and ability to produce high-quality analytical and advisory outputs for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  

* Experience working on South Asia and familiarity with the Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) Notification framework and ICZM principles in the Indian context is an advantage.

  

* Good team player who can work as a member of a multi-disciplinary and multi-cultural team, motivate and lead group efforts and network effectively across boundaries.

  

* A drive for results while working with limited supervision and under tight timelines.

  
**Additional Considerations:**  
  
**As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:**  

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.
* Bring experience working on fragile, conflict-affected, and violent (FCV)-related contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.

**WBG Culture Attributes:**

1. Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.  
2. Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.  
3. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

7d9e5bfc.title: Veeva CRM Solution Architect
7d9e5bfc.description:
**Introduction**
================

At Slipstream Life Sciences, we help pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations transform and manage their technology ecosystems through strategic consulting, implementation, and managed services.

Our Veeva Commercial practice supports clients across CRM implementations, migrations, integrations, and ongoing platform support. As the life sciences industry transitions from Salesforce-based Veeva CRM to Veeva Vault CRM, we are expanding our offshore delivery capabilities and investing in developing the next generation of Veeva CRM architects.

We are seeking experienced Veeva CRM professionals who can lead solution design and technical delivery while building their expertise in Vault CRM.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

Slipstream is seeking an experienced **Veeva CRM Solution Architect** to join our offshore Veeva Commercial practice.

This is a hands-on solution architecture and technical leadership role responsible for designing, configuring, and delivering Veeva CRM solutions for pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience with Salesforce-based Veeva CRM, strong knowledge of life sciences commercial processes, and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable technical solutions.

The role requires someone who can independently own solution design, guide configuration teams, resolve complex technical challenges, and ensure that implementations follow established architectural standards and best practices.

**Prior Vault CRM experience is not required.** Slipstream will provide training and practical exposure to support the transition from Salesforce-based Veeva CRM to Vault CRM. Candidates must demonstrate strong architectural fundamentals, technical depth, and the ability to learn and adapt to a new platform.

**Location:** Offshore – India  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Working Hours:** Standard offshore hours with flexibility for overlap with US teams  
**Practice:** Veeva Commercial

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Solution Architecture and Design**

* Lead the technical and solution architecture for Veeva CRM implementations, enhancements, and migration programs.
* Translate business and functional requirements into scalable solution designs aligned with Veeva CRM capabilities and life sciences commercial processes.
* Design CRM data models, object relationships, security frameworks, user access, automation, and configuration approaches.
* Define technical solutions for core Veeva CRM capabilities, including HCP/HCO management, call reporting, territory management, product management, sample management, and consent management.
* Provide solution guidance for Veeva commercial modules, including CLM, Approved Email, Engage, MyInsights, Events Management, and multichannel capabilities.
* Evaluate business requirements and recommend standard platform functionality wherever possible, minimizing unnecessary customization.
* Develop and review solution design documents, configuration specifications, technical design decisions, and architectural documentation.
* Identify technical dependencies, design constraints, integration considerations, and potential implementation risks.

### **Technical Leadership and Delivery**

* Provide technical leadership to Veeva CRM configurators, developers, and other delivery team members.
* Review configuration designs and technical solutions to ensure consistency with approved architecture and platform best practices.
* Remain hands-on with complex configurations, troubleshooting, technical assessments, and proof-of-concept activities.
* Guide teams on Salesforce and Veeva CRM configuration, including objects, fields, layouts, security, automation, validation rules, and administrative settings.
* Support technical estimation, work breakdown, and implementation planning.
* Establish configuration standards, reusable components, design patterns, and quality controls across delivery teams.
* Review technical deliverables and ensure that configuration activities meet project requirements and quality expectations.
* Support SIT, UAT, deployment planning, defect resolution, and post-go-live stabilization.
* Troubleshoot complex platform issues and provide guidance on root cause analysis and resolution.

### **Integration and Data Architecture**

* Define CRM integration requirements and collaborate with integration architects and developers on interface design.
* Understand data flows between Veeva CRM and related enterprise systems, including MDM, data warehouses, consent platforms, and other commercial applications.
* Provide architectural guidance on data migration, mapping, transformation, reconciliation, and validation.
* Support Veeva CRM integrations with products such as Veeva Network, Veeva Align, Vault PromoMats, and external enterprise systems.
* Review integration designs to ensure alignment with CRM data models, business processes, and technical constraints.
* Participate in migration assessments and identify configuration, data, and integration dependencies.

### **CRM Migration and Vault CRM Transition**

* Support assessments and migration planning for clients transitioning from Salesforce-based Veeva CRM to Veeva Vault CRM.
* Evaluate existing Veeva CRM configurations, customizations, integrations, and business processes to identify migration considerations.
* Participate in configuration rationalization, gap analysis, and future-state solution design.
* Develop an understanding of Vault CRM architecture, configuration capabilities, security, data models, and deployment approaches through structured training.
* Apply existing Veeva CRM commercial process knowledge and solution architecture experience to Vault CRM implementation programs.
* Collaborate with experienced Vault CRM architects and Veeva teams to understand platform differences and appropriate solution design approaches.
* Progressively assume architecture responsibilities on Vault CRM implementations as platform proficiency develops.

### **Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work closely with Business Analysts, Solution Architects, Project Managers, client stakeholders, and offshore delivery teams.
* Participate in technical design workshops and provide recommendations on solution options and trade-offs.
* Communicate technical decisions, risks, dependencies, and design considerations clearly to both technical and functional audiences.
* Collaborate with onshore architects and delivery leadership to maintain consistency across implementation workstreams.
* Support technical reviews, solution walkthroughs, and knowledge transfer activities.

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

* Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce-based Veeva CRM architecture, configuration, and administration.
* Deep understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities, including data models, object relationships, security, profiles, permission sets, automation, and configuration.
* Strong understanding of Veeva CRM commercial functionality, including call reporting, account management, territory management, product setup, samples, and consent.
* Experience designing solutions involving Veeva CRM modules such as CLM, Approved Email, Engage, MyInsights, and Events Management.
* Ability to develop solution architecture documents, technical designs, configuration specifications, and data flow diagrams.
* Strong understanding of CRM data architecture, integrations, APIs, and enterprise application dependencies.
* Experience evaluating technical requirements and recommending configuration versus customization approaches.
* Knowledge of Salesforce deployment practices, environment management, and release management.
* Ability to review complex configurations and troubleshoot technical issues.
* Understanding of life sciences commercial business processes, data governance, and regulatory considerations.
* Familiarity with data migration, data quality, reconciliation, and integration testing.

**Required Experience**
-----------------------

* **7+ years of CRM implementation, configuration, or technical consulting experience**, including at least **4+ years of hands-on Salesforce-based Veeva CRM experience**.
* Experience serving as a Technical Lead, Solution Architect, or Senior Veeva CRM Consultant on implementation or major enhancement programs.
* Hands-on involvement in at least two Veeva CRM implementation or significant transformation projects.
* Demonstrated experience designing CRM solutions and translating business requirements into technical architecture.
* Experience leading or mentoring configurators and developers, including reviewing technical designs and configuration deliverables.
* Experience working across the full implementation lifecycle, including discovery, design, build, testing, deployment, and hypercare.
* Experience collaborating with integration, data migration, and enterprise architecture teams.
* Strong problem-solving, technical leadership, and communication skills.
* Ability to independently own assigned solution architecture workstreams and escalate risks or design decisions appropriately.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Experience supporting global or multi-country Veeva CRM implementations.
* Experience with Veeva Network, Veeva Align, Vault PromoMats, or other Veeva Commercial products.
* Exposure to Veeva Vault, Vault CRM, or Vault platform administration.
* Experience participating in Veeva CRM migration assessments or transformation programs.
* Salesforce certifications, including Administrator, Platform App Builder, or relevant architecture certifications.
* Veeva CRM or Vault platform certifications.
* Experience with CRM integrations, middleware platforms, and enterprise data architecture.
* Experience leading offshore technical delivery teams supporting US or global clients.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Confluence.

**Vault CRM Training and Career Development**
---------------------------------------------

Slipstream recognizes that experienced Salesforce-based Veeva CRM architects bring valuable commercial domain knowledge, solution design experience, and technical leadership skills that can be applied to Vault CRM.

We will provide training and practical exposure to support the transition to Vault CRM, including:

* Vault platform architecture and core configuration concepts.
* Vault CRM data models, objects, relationships, and security architecture.
* Vault CRM commercial functionality and solution design.
* Vault workflows, lifecycles, business rules, and platform automation.
* Vault CRM integrations, APIs, and data management.
* Vault CRM deployment and environment management.
* Veeva CRM to Vault CRM migration approaches, configuration mapping, and design considerations.
* Hands-on participation in Vault CRM implementation and migration programs.

Candidates are not expected to have prior Vault CRM implementation experience or certification. However, they must be willing to invest in developing their Vault CRM architecture skills and progressively take ownership of Vault CRM solution design responsibilities.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Opportunities to lead Veeva CRM implementation, migration, and transformation programs for pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients.
* Structured training and hands-on experience with Veeva Vault CRM.
* Technical leadership opportunities within a growing Veeva Commercial practice.
* Exposure to global life sciences clients and complex enterprise CRM ecosystems.
* Opportunities to mentor technical teams and contribute to reusable architecture standards and delivery accelerators.
* Career progression toward Senior Solution Architect, Enterprise Architect, and Practice Technical Leadership roles.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.

**How to Apply**
----------------

Interested candidates should submit their resume highlighting their Veeva CRM architecture, configuration, technical leadership, and implementation experience.

Candidates should describe the Veeva CRM solutions they have designed, the modules and integrations they have supported, and their involvement in leading technical delivery teams.

**Prior Vault CRM experience is not required.**

*Slipstream is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation or identity, national origin, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Slipstream IT makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.*

*This job description may not be inclusive of all assigned duties, responsibilities, or aspects of the job described, and may be amended at any time at the sole discretion of the Employer.*

**Job description**
-------------------

**About this role**

**Your Team**

The Data Science & Artificial Intelligence (AI) team helps transform how technology, data, and AI drive better outcomes for clients and the business. The team partners closely with client-facing teams, product strategists, engineers, and business leaders to develop and scale AI-powered solutions that enhance productivity, improve decision-making, strengthen client engagement, and unlock commercial value. You will partner with stakeholders across Sales, Product Strategy, Chief Operating Officer (COO) functions, and Technology to identify opportunities, develop AI-driven products, and deploy solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. Success in this role requires intellectual curiosity, analytical thinking, hands-on technical skills, and the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and embrace the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies while challenging outcomes. Your Experience
