* Demonstrated ability to build and deploy AI and machine learning solutions in production environments.

* Strong technical proficiency in Python, Structured Query Language (SQL), data engineering, and analytical platforms.

* Demonstrated expertise in machine learning, statistics, experimentation, and predictive modeling.

* Experience developing generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, natural language processing (NLP), and related techniques.

* Experience in asset management, financial services, fintech, or modern cloud-based AI ecosystems is preferred.

* Strong communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and responsible AI practices.

**Our benefits**
  
  
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

**Our hybrid work model**

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

  

**About BlackRock**

  
  

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

  
  

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

  
  

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window).

2ca31f33.title: Architect, IT Solutions, Copilot & Agentic AI Platforms
2ca31f33.description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care.
  
  
As Edwards accelerates its AI-driven transformation, we are seeking an Architect, IT Solutions to serve as the enterprise technical authority for our two most strategic agentic AI platforms — Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks. This is a multi-faceted architecture role that spans platform leadership, integration design, and end-to-end solution architecture. You will define how these platforms are built, extended, integrated, and governed across the enterprise.
  
  
This role works alongside our existing Azure infrastructure architect and complements cloud expertise with deep, platform-specific technical authority. If you thrive at the intersection of enterprise architecture, applied AI, and business-facing delivery — and want to shape how a global lifescience company adopts agentic AI at scale — this is the role for you.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**
**Platform Architecture Leadership — Copilot & Moveworks**

* Own the enterprise platform architecture for Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks — serving as the definitive technical authority on capabilities, extensibility, and best practices.
* Define the ecosystem blueprint, platform standards, extensibility patterns, and long-term technical roadmap for both platforms.
* Evaluate and recommend new platform features, plugins, connectors, and agentic AI capabilities as they emerge from Microsoft and Moveworks.

**Integration Architecture**

* Design and govern the integration layer connecting Copilot and Moveworks to enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, JDE, Active Directory, HRIS, LMS, and CMDB.
* Define API strategies, event-driven patterns, connector frameworks, and messaging standards that enable secure, reliable, and scalable data flows across platforms.
* Partner with the Azure architecture team to ensure integration patterns align with cloud infrastructure, identity (Entra ID), and security standards.

**Lead Solution Architecture**

* Provide end-to-end solution design and technical authority for all AI agent, copilot, and automation solutions built on these platforms.
* Lead architecture reviews, approve design decisions, and ensure solutions are production-ready, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable, repeatable architectural patterns and executable design strategies.

**Governance, Mentorship & Innovation**

* Develop, institute, and maintain platform-specific design methodologies, development standards, security patterns, and operational best practices.
* Provide training, coaching, and technical mentorship to Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs), solution developers, and IT team members on Copilot and Moveworks architecture.
* Survey emerging developments in agentic AI — including multi-agent orchestration, RAG patterns, and tool-using agents — and recommend approaches that extend platform value.
* Develop and maintain architecture models, reference designs, integration maps, and documentation for current and proposed implementations.

**What you’ll need (Required):**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Progressive IT experience, including significant depth in platform architecture, integration architecture, or solution architecture.
* Experience in an architect role working with cross-functional teams (within IT and/or business) on enterprise-level or complex system implementations.
* Deep expertise in at least one of the following: Microsoft Copilot ecosystem (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Graph API, Graph Connectors, Copilot extensibility) or Moveworks platform (conversational AI, enterprise integrations, workflow automation).
* Strong integration architecture skills: REST/GraphQL APIs, event-driven architectures, enterprise connectors, middleware, and messaging patterns (e.g., Azure Service Bus, Logic Apps, Power Automate).
* Proven ability to design end-to-end solution architectures for enterprise AI, automation, or digital workplace platforms.
* Experience defining platform standards, governance frameworks, and reusable architectural patterns at enterprise scale.
* Strong understanding of identity, security, and compliance requirements in enterprise AI deployments (e.g., Entra ID, conditional access, DLP, data classification).
* Expert-level documentation and communication skills — ability to create architecture blueprints, integration maps, and present complex technical concepts to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, including cross-functional negotiation, vendor management, and the ability to drive alignment across distributed teams.

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio — building custom copilots, plugins, connectors, topics, and generative AI orchestration.
* Hands-on experience with Moveworks platform — configuring enterprise virtual agents, workflow automation, knowledge integration, and analytics.
* Experience with agentic AI patterns including multi-agent orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool-using agents, and planner-executor models.
* Experience integrating AI platforms with enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, Active Directory, LMS, and CMDB.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) as an automation and extensibility layer.
* Experience deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., medical device, pharmaceuticals, financial services) with attention to governance and responsible AI practices.
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* Professional certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, TOGAF, or equivalent architecture frameworks.
* Track record of mentoring engineers and building technical communities of practice.

**Why is this role different?**
This is not a generic enterprise architect role. You will be the single technical authority for two of the most strategic AI platforms at Edwards Lifesciences — platforms that are actively transforming how our work, decide, and collaborate. You will shape the architecture, set the standards, and mentor the next generation of Forward-Deployed AI Engineers who build on these platforms every day.
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of platform strategy, hands-on architecture, and business impact — with direct visibility to senior IT leadership and the opportunity to influence how a global healthcare company scales agentic AI responsibly.

Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. The hands-on Solution Architect is responsible for the architecture, design, and delivery of cohesive technical solutions across BCG business, primarily focusing on implementation of new solutions, solution enhancements, and system/data integration. The Solution Architect likely will be aligned with one or more business area, such that they can develop a thorough understanding of the business and drive consistency and integration across solutions for that business area. They will also maintain awareness of emerging technologies relevant to their areas of expertise and responsibility.
  
  
The successful candidate will be a highly motivated strategic thinker, engaging collaborator, and effective influencer. Key objectives of the role are to drive digital transformation and the strategic and tactical use of technology to deliver business capabilities, while the organization with cutting edge technologies in a high paced environment. Critical to the Solution Architect’s success is their ability to drive projects and teams to deliver results for the business, balanced with adherence to standards and processes. They will coordinate and provide oversight to the solution/technical leads of multiple development squads.
  
  
The Solution Architect will also facilitate cross-enterprise coordination, ensuring that we accommodate requirements across the business and address system integration needs for solutions. They will collaborate with multi-disciplinary architects and engineers across the Technology organization and within the business to develop strategy, technology roadmaps, and technical standards. They will also work as an interface point with strategic partners, determining where they may offer value to business partners and facilitating coordination on joint initiatives.

* Design and scale agentic systems; define standards for agent development, orchestration, deployment, and monitoring.

* Work across multiple systems/solutions to ensure their consistency and alignment, as well as to determine how multiple systems/solutions can work together to serve a particular line of business and/or to ensure that a solution works across lines of business.
* Leverage experience and expertise across a wide variety of technology domains, including infrastructure, data management, systems integration, and application development, with a recent emphasis on technologies leveraged by BCG, such as FiveTrans, MuleSoft APIs, Infomatica, AWS, Azure, and SnowFlake.
* Employ and enforce system/solution develop processes, agile methodologies, DevOps principles and practices, and quality engineering best practices.
* Exercise concepts and best practices for designing system reliability/resilience, performance/scalability and maintainability/operability.
* Provide technical oversight to multiple project teams to ensure compliance with processes and standards. Ensure that solutions/systems developed in support of the business are aligned with BCG Enterprise Architecture, technical standards, and technology roadmaps.
* Organize Architecture and Design Reviews to ensure wider architecture peer group input is sought for robust design
* Conduct proof of concept exercises for emerging solutions and prove out potential enhancements to the design
* Ensure designs are implemented with target architecture and key design decisions are clearly communicated to leadership and all key stakeholders
* Review and consider prospective changes to the baseline solution that have been raised by process owners, projects, production support, continuous improvement initiatives and the business for architectural impact

What You'll Bring
  
  
**Essential Education**

* Master’s Degree in Computer Science
* 14 years of work experience + 10 years of experience designing and implementing business critical applications in multi-region environments +1 year of deep exposure to LLM based business applications

**Essential Experience & Job Requirements**

* Minimum of 7 years of experience as a software developer, preferably in multitenant/SaaS projects

* Familiarity with GenAI dev platforms (e.g., AI Studio, Replit, Devin, equivalents) for rapid prototyping.
* Deep expertise in agent patterns (RAG, tool use, planning, memory, guardrails, HITL) and production operations.
* Experience with agent orchestration/deployment (CI/CD, runtime, monitoring, incident response).
* Experience building/managing MCP ecosystems (registry, access, versioning, performance/cost controls).
* Critical thinking and analytical skills to address complex technical challenges
* Experience in conducting technical assessments and feasibility studies
* Advanced Expertise in major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
* Knowledge of cloud-native technologies and practices

* Experience with one or more application development languages and/or system integration platforms
* Knowledge of and exposure to Azure and AWS application services, including serverless solutions.
* Excellent collaboration skills, evidence of building highly effective partnerships with projects, vendors, peer architects, security teams and operational Service lines and engagement with senior stakeholders
* Provide technical coaching and mentoring, actively keeps current with developments
* Ability to work simultaneously on multiple projects, at times with conflicting priorities with a strong track record of delivery
* Ability to estimate tasks and workload to achieve deliverables and goals, delivering on time and on estimation
* Ability to work with multiple external teams and accomplish shared goals
* Demonstrated ability to constantly learn outside of a classroom environment, and successfully apply learnings

Who You'll Work With

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
Position summary
  
  
Reporting to Director India Sourcing, this person will be a critical leader responsible for execution of sourcing Cost saving, VAVE, resourcing projects across all Regal Rexnord segments with a focus on
**RRX India region**
.
  
  
The Supply Chain Program Manager is responsible for leading cross-functional supply chain initiatives that improve supplier performance, cost, quality, delivery, inventory, and operational efficiency. This role partners with sourcing, procurement, operations, engineering, quality, logistics, finance, and IT teams to execute strategic programs and drive supply chain transformation initiatives.
  
  
SC Program Manager will lead projects spanning direct procurement, supply chain and operations optimization, and procurement synergy. In this role, the individual will lead multiple projects that can vary in complexity across the Regal Rexnord Enterprise. The program manager will oversee the work related to all functions over the duration of the projects. The ideal candidate will be self-driven, straightforward, able to handle multi projects at same time, and a good problem solver with common sense and a practical approach to problems.
  
  
You will bring your demonstrated history of getting quickly adapted to an unfamiliar working environment, building and leveraging relationships in a matrixed environment, working collaboratively to ensure team performance, and successfully influencing a variety of business stakeholders at all levels.
  
  
Monitor and mitigate risks with leveraging the key tasks on the critical path spanning overall project lifecycle. With priorities and sense of urgency, properly communicate and manage stakeholder’s expectations and team players’ concerns. A good problem solver to facilitate alignment when various issues that arise from stakeholders. Develop trust within the business so that where there are conflicting priorities or other issues you can ensure that all involved understand the issues and agree with the solutions put forward.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Leverages a high level of project management skills on supply chain related outsourcing, insourcing, VA/VE, supplier resourcing, large cost out initiatives and integration projects.
* Identify the project scope, objectives, schedule planning and new part qualification progress with category managers to build a healthy project pipeline for annual cost save goals by category and business unit.
* Responsible for assembling project team globally with category managers. Work with category managers to identify individual responsibilities, appropriate resources needed and develop schedules to ensure timely completion of projects.
* Acts as liaison between RRX India plants and enterprise sourcing team. Review the sourcing cost-out target attainability and new project pipeline with plants on a regular basis. Be a major window to identify any potential gaps to meet AOP cost save target and initiate new potential projects working with category managers and plant procurement managers.
* Implement robust communication strategies to report on program status, communicates critical issues to external and internal customers. Maintain a consistent way on project reporting-out, documentation, execution processes in line with regional supply chain management requirement.
* Identify the risks in terms of project execution from the pipeline management perspective and escalate the potential impact with mitigation plans. Demonstrate managerial courage and leadership to challenge project priorities, resource allocation and escalate project obstacles promptly based on 80/20 principles.

* Monitor and drive Open Purchase Order (PO) execution with India-based BVC suppliers supporting manufacturing plants across the USA, Mexico, Europe, and APAC regions. Proactively identify and resolve supply risks, material shortages, and delivery issues to ensure uninterrupted production and prevent line stoppages at global Regal Rexnord (RRX) facilities.
* Collaborate closely with Global Category Managers, RRX manufacturing plants, India Category Managers, and Supplier Quality & Development Engineers (SQDEs) to drive the successful execution of cost-out projects. Ensure on-time delivery, right-first-time implementation, and realization of targeted savings while maintaining quality, service, and supply continuity.
* Program & Project Management

+ Lead supply chain programs from planning through implementation.
+ Develop project plans, timelines, milestones, and risk mitigation strategies.



* Track prog
* ram performance and communicate progress to leadership.
* Coordinate cross-functional activities to ensure successful execution.
* Data Analytics & Reporting
* Develop and maintain performance dashboards and reports.
* Utilize ERP, BI, and analytics tools to generate actionable insights.
* Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and governance.
* Present findings and recommendations to management.
* Supplier & Stakeholder Management
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and suppliers to resolve issues.
* Support supplier performance reviews and improvement programs.
* Lead communication across global supply chain teams.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.
* Process Improvement & Transformation
* Identify and implement productivity and cost-saving opportunities.
* Support sourcing, logistics, and supply chain transformation initiatives.
* Standardize processes, reporting methods, and performance metrics.
* Leverage best practices and digital tools to improve efficiency.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Cost savings and productivity improvements
* Supplier on-time delivery (OTD)
* Inventory turns and working capital improvements
* Supplier quality performance
* Program milestone achievement
* Process compliance and adoption rates
* undefined

**Professional Experience/Qualifications**
**‘Must’ Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, Electrical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 20 ~ 25 years of experience in direct material sourcing or procurement, project management or relevant experience in a manufacturing company, (project schedule, planning & execution);
* Strong negotiation skills and experience managing supplier contracts.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
* Proficiency in sourcing and procurement software, ERP systems, Oracle, Excel and PPT.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships at all levels of the organization.
* Knowledge of industry regulations and compliance standards.
* Knowledge of various Quality system methodologies 8D, Lean, 5 Why’s, Pareto Analysis, Six Sigma, PPAP, APQP, Poka-Yoke (Error Proofing), Measurement System Analysis is essential.
* Project Management Certification, Supply Chain Certifications will be a plus.
* Good presentation, verbal and written communication skills. Fluent in English.
* Demonstrated ability to drive productivity and compliance throughout a complex organization.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to communicate, interact, and influence at all levels of the organization to drive results.
* Excellence in generating accurate and understandable data and reports to analyze performance to make data-driven decisions.

**‘Nice To Have’ Requirements**

* Ability to think strategically, conceptually, and analytically to assess problems, identify and consider potential solutions, and make timely recommendations with data-driven analysis.
* Proven ability to develop trusted, respectful relationships internally and externally.
* Experience with development of sourcing processes or procurement is a plus. PMP certificate is a plus;
* High level of personal initiative, energy and ownership of business results.

**Travel:**
Up to 50%
  
  
**Language:**
English
  
  
**About Regal Rexnord**
Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.
  
  
The Company’s end markets benefit from meaningful secular demand tailwinds, and include factory automation, food & beverage, aerospace, medical, data center, warehouse, alternative energy, residential and commercial buildings, general industrial, construction, metals and mining, and agriculture.
  
  
Regal Rexnord is comprised of three operating segments: Industrial Powertrain Solutions, Power Efficiency Solutions, and Automation & Motion Control. Regal Rexnord has offices and manufacturing, sales and service facilities worldwide. For more information, including a copy of our Sustainability Report, visit RegalRexnord.com.

* Collaborate closely with Enterprise Architects to guide development teams migrating legacy monolithic codebases into modern cloud-native (AWS, Azure, or GCP) microservices
* Provide high-level technical oversight for teams delivering on the Java Ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate) or .NET Ecosystem (.NET Core, .NET 8+, C#, ASP.NET Web API)
* Drive continuous improvement across delivery pipelines, championing automated testing, robust CI/CD maturity, DevSecOps adoption, and cloud infrastructure optimization
* Partner with VP/C-level executives, Product Owners, and Business Units to translate long-term business strategy into actionable technical delivery roadmaps; oversee strategic offshore/nearshore development partners, manage SOWs, negotiate vendor contracts, and ensure third-party deliverables meet quality and security standards
* Mentor and inspire a high-performing organization of Project Managers, Scrum Masters, Tech Leads, and Software Engineers (onshore, offshore, and hybrid), cultivating a culture of psychological safety, accountability, continuous upskilling (including AI-assisted engineering tools like Copilot), and innovation

* Proven record of successfully managing enterprise portfolios with budgets exceeding $5M+ and teams of 50+ engineers
* Background in software engineering, with hands-on experience across Java (Spring frameworks, Spring Boot, J2EE legacy) and/or .NET (C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core)

* Capability to spearhead legacy monolithic-to-microservices modernization programs at enterprise scale
* Background in collaborating with Enterprise Architects on cloud-native migration strategies

6f2f25da.title: Value Architect, Consultant(2-4Yrs)
6f2f25da.description:
### **Description**

As a key part of the Infor cloud sales initiative, the mission of the CloudHub team is to support Infor sales teams in CloudSuite pursuits globally. Collaborating with the direct sales teams to shape deliverable CloudSuite infrastructure and solutions is a key driver of increased win rates, bigger deal sizes and lower discount rates. CloudHub validates every CloudSuite deal through a team-built, rule-driven validation and architecture pipeline that does the first pass and keeps evolving. Value Architects own the judgment layer: they interpret the results, shape the deal position, and lead the conversation with sales and product teams. The goal is to ensure a seamless customer experience during onboarding and implementation.

### **A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**

Quickly build a point of view on each deal from system-generated validation and architecture context, and take it into sales and customer conversations  

* Review generated outputs critically, question the gaps, and add the context automation cannot
* Lead due-diligence discussions with Sales, Solution Consulting, Product, Services and Customer Success on product readiness, deployment availability, integrations, localizations and cloud operability
* Bring clear, well-reasoned positions to difficult deal discussions, and handle them with composure and good judgment
* Keep validation rules and mappings current as products evolve release to release, and suggest improvements to the pipeline
* Communicate clearly and confidently with internal stakeholders and customers

Experience in a SaaS or software product company, ideally in product management (APM/associate PM) or presales, with exposure to continuous release cycles  

* Comfortable working with AI assistants and rule-driven workflows: able to read, question and adjust structured data and simple scripts
* Understanding of cloud-based enterprise applications (ERP and related) and how they are sold and deployed
* Working knowledge of cloud operability: security, high availability/DR, integration and data
* Exposure to AWS or other cloud platforms
* Excellent spoken and written English, with structured thinking under ambiguity

9198f033.title: Bid & Pre-Sales Executive (IT Tenders & RFPs)
9198f033.description:
**Bid & Pre-Sales Executive (IT Tenders & RFPs)**

Sajal Tech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. | Bhopal (On-site) | Full-time | 1 to 4 years experience

**About Us**

Sajal Tech Solutions is an AI-first software development company based in Bhopal. We build SaaS products, AI/ML solutions, mobile apps and automation for clients in India, the US, the UK and the UAE. We hold ISO 9001:2015, ISO 27001 and CMMI Level 3 certifications, and we are a DPIIT-recognised startup and MSME.

**Role Summary**

You will run our government and enterprise IT bidding from start to finish. That means finding opportunities, understanding the technical scope, writing the proposal and submitting a compliant bid on time. You will work closely with our Head of Business Development and the technical team, and you need to know software well enough to write about it convincingly.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Tenders & Bids*

* Track and shortlist IT and software tenders and RFPs every day on GeM, CPPP (eprocure.gov.in), MP e-Tender, other state and PSU portals, and private or international RFP platforms
* Analyse each RFP and prepare a bid/no-bid summary covering scope, eligibility, PQ/TQ criteria, EMD, evaluation method and key dates
* Prepare complete bid packs, including technical and commercial proposals, compliance matrices, forms, annexures, affidavits and undertakings
* Submit bids online using a DSC and handle EMD/bid security, tender fees, BOQs and PBGs
* Attend pre-bid meetings, raise pre-bid queries, and track corrigenda, clarifications, technical evaluation and results
* Manage our GeM seller account, including catalogue, bids, reverse auctions and order acceptance
* Maintain a current bid library: registrations, certificates, financials, work orders, completion certificates, CVs and case studies
* Keep a tender tracker/MIS covering pipeline, submissions, win/loss and the reasons behind each result

*Technical Proposals & Pre-Sales*

* Write the technical sections of proposals: understanding of requirements, solution approach, architecture overview, technology stack, implementation plan, timelines, team deployment, SLA and support model
* Map RFP functional and technical requirements (FRS/SRS) into point-by-point compliance sheets
* Work with developers and architects on solution design, effort estimates, manpower plans and cost components (resources, cloud, licences, AMC)
* Prepare technical presentations and coordinate demos for evaluation committees and enterprise clients
* Create capability statements and case studies from our project portfolio

*Business Development Support*

* Help the Head of BD with proposals, decks and pricing inputs
* Handle vendor registrations and empanelments with government departments, PSUs and enterprises
* Find new opportunities, including upcoming tenders, consortium or partner bids, startup-friendly procurement and relevant schemes
* Manage follow-ups, CRM updates and documentation for active opportunities

**Requirements**

* B.Tech, BCA, MCA or B.Sc (IT/CS) strongly preferred
* 1 to 4 years in bid management or pre-sales for IT or software services
* Has submitted bids on GeM and CPPP or a state e-procurement portal, and can use a DSC independently
* Working knowledge of MSE and Startup relaxations (EMD exemption, prior turnover and experience waivers), Make in India (Class I/II supplier) and GFR basics
* Strong written English, with the ability to write clear, structured technical content

**Technical Knowledge (Must Have)**

* Understands the SDLC and Agile, and how web, mobile, ERP and SaaS projects are scoped, built and maintained
* Can read and break down technical scope covering portals, ERP, mobile apps, APIs and integrations, cloud hosting, AI/ML and AMC/O&M
* Familiar with cloud basics (AWS, Azure, GCP), MeitY-empanelled cloud, hosting, backup and DR
* Knows common government IT requirements: GIGW and accessibility, CERT-In security audits, STQC, data localisation, SLA/uptime and penalty clauses, ISO 27001
* Can prepare effort and manpower estimates with the tech team and sanity-check a BOQ

**Good to Have**

* Background as a developer, business analyst or pre-sales engineer
* Experience with international RFPs (Middle East, UK, US)
* Can create basic architecture diagrams (draw.io, Lucidchart or similar)
* Uses AI tools to draft and review documents faster

**What We Offer**

* Salary:
  **₹2.5 to ₹6**
  **LPA**
  , plus an incentive on won bids
* Work directly with the founders, the BD head and the engineering team
* Clear path to a Bid Manager / Pre-Sales Lead role
* A fast-growing AI-first company with international clients

0626083a.title: Walk-in || Solution Architect
0626083a.description:
**Tech Lead / Solution Architect (Stream Lead)**

  

**Role:**

As a **Tech Lead / Solution Architect (Stream Lead)**, you will lead an engineering pod (stream) building features for an enterprise-grade SaaS platform in the data privacy, data governance and AI governance space. You will own the technical design of your stream within the clients architecture governance, break the backlog into deliverable work, and make sure every sprint ships production-ready, well-tested code. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines solution design, code and design reviews, and day-to-day guidance of a team of backend, data/AI, frontend and quality engineers.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the technical design and solution architecture for your stream, aligned with the clients architecture governance, standards and review processes.
* Break down epics and features into well-defined user stories and technical tasks, and provide reliable effort estimates.
* Lead sprint planning and execution for the pod, making sure committed scope is delivered on time and meets the definition of done.
* Conduct code and design reviews across backend (Java/Spring Boot, Python), frontend (Angular) and integration components, enforcing quality, security and performance standards.
* Design scalable microservices, REST APIs and integration patterns, including connectors to SaaS, cloud, data and AI platforms.
* Drive release readiness: test coverage, CI/CD quality gates, documentation & deployment sign-off.
* Identify and manage technical risks, dependencies and blockers, and escalate early to the Engineering Manager.
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, UX designers and QA to translate requirements into technical solutions.

**What Youll Bring:**

* Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2–3 years as a Tech Lead or Solution Architect.
* Proven track record of leading agile teams that deliver enterprise SaaS products or platforms.
* Strong hands-on background in Java/Spring Boot and/or Python, with the ability to review full-stack code.

**Mandatory Skills:**

* Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot and microservices architecture, with working knowledge of Python.
* Experience designing RESTful APIs, event-driven integrations and data models for distributed systems.
* Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, Docker and Kubernetes.
* Working knowledge of Angular and TypeScript, enough to review frontend designs and code.
* Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and release management.
* Exp. with Agile/Scrum, backlog refinement and estimation, using tools such as Jira & Confluence.
* Good understanding of secure coding, OAuth2/SSO and role-based access control (RBAC).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience building connectors or integrations with SaaS, cloud or data platforms (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, Snowflake, Databricks).
* Exposure to GenAI/LLM-based applications and agentic AI frameworks.
* Domain knowledge of data privacy, data governance, security or AI governance products.
* Cloud architecture certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

  

**Why join us?**

* Build enterprise-grade products in data privacy, AI governance that are used worldwide.
* Work hands-on technologies across GenAI, agentic AI, cloud (AWS and Azure), full-stack engineering.
* Learn from experienced architects, engineering leaders through mentorship, design reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Grow your career with twice-yearly appraisals, certification support and a promote-from-within culture.
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits as a full-time employee.
* Be part of an award-winning, CMMI Level 3 appraised data and AI company.

**Company Description**
A Business Studio, founded in 2021, helps organizations scale through an integrated ecosystem of services that streamline workflows and support sustainable growth. The company provides vetted staffing, financial strategy, and operational consulting to address key business challenges in a cohesive way. By combining strategic advisory with hands-on implementation, A Business Studio enables clients to optimize processes and improve performance. The Salesforce Architect is a full-time, on-site role based in New Delhi, responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing Salesforce solutions across the organization and for client projects. This role involves translating business requirements into scalable Salesforce architectures, configuring and developing custom functionality, and ensuring effective integration with other systems. Day-to-day responsibilities include collaborating with stakeholders to refine requirements, leading technical design sessions, overseeing development activities, and maintaining best practices for Salesforce governance, security, and performance. The Salesforce Architect will also mentor team members, contribute to solution roadmaps, and support ongoing enhancements to maximize value from the Salesforce platform.

cc447711.title: Senior Architect - GCI
cc447711.description:
Senior Solutions Architect — Governance, Compliance, & Insights
  
  
Why Join Us?
  
  
The interesting work in enterprise security has moved inside the organization. AI agents are creating new insider risk and compliance obligations every day. Data is sprawling faster than the controls around it. At Mimecast, our product lines sit where all of that converges.
  
  
This is an architecture role reporting directly to an Enterprise Architect (EA). You’ll work alongside other Solutions Architects on the team to shape how the product evolves, how it integrates with the rest of Mimecast, and how it stays ahead of where the market is going.
  
  
The Solutions Architect role at Mimecast sits closer to the product problem. Discovery, shaping, and contract design now drive more of the value than detailed component design. If you primarily want to be a heads-down individual contributor, this isn’t the right seat. If you want to shape what gets built and own the structural decisions that make a product line move fast with quality, it is.
  
  
AI-First Architecture at Mimecast
  
  
Mimecast is an AI-First engineering organization. We expect this role to use AI development tools daily — for design exploration, prototyping, documentation, code review, and analysis. This is not optional and it is not bolt-on; it is how we work.
  
  
You will also be designing systems that incorporate AI directly. This product line is actively building agent-aware detections and AI-driven enrichment, and contributing to Mimecast’s broader AI-powered risk products. Comfort designing with — and for — LLMs, agents, and modern AI architectures is core to this job, not a side interest.
  
  
We treat architecture artifacts — ADRs, AGENTS.md files (agent-readable repo context), and data contracts — as machine-readable context, not documentation. They’re the substrate that humans and agents both operate inside, and they capture the reasoning behind design decisions — the why, not just the what.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
This is a leadership role shaping the future of Mimecast's Governance, Compliance & Insight (GCI) suite. GCI helps organizations manage data governance, retention, and compliance at scale. Our products include email & collaboration archiving, eDiscovery, compliance management, data retention, audit capabilities, and analytics, alongside our new AI-powered governance and compliance tools.
  
  
You will be the connective tissue across product management, user experience, and engineering to translate real customer problems into effective, efficient solutions. You will help the team unlock value across Mimecast’s entire portfolio to help customers navigate the human and agentic risks they face every day.
  
  
We operate with a sense of urgency. Cyber threats don't wait, and neither do we. You'll lead teams that move fast, make decisions with conviction, and deliver results. We expect leaders who thrive in this environment and inspire the same urgency in the teams around you.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Shape problems with product partners: Contribute at the problem-framing stage, not just after requirements land. Run and facilitate workshops with product managers, engineers, UX designers, and subject matter experts to surface user needs, constraints, and opportunities. Define what “good” looks like in customer and business terms before settling on a technical shape.
* Own integration contracts as product artifacts: Help define how the product line touches the rest of the Mimecast platform. You’ll own the durable interfaces — APIs, events, and data contracts. You’ll also do the coordination work that makes integrations actually land.
* Build the architectural context engineering teams operate inside: ADRs, data contracts, and service interaction patterns. These are how architecture decisions get propagated and enforced at scale across humans and agents — they’re part of the build system, not the wiki.
* Set NFR and evaluability targets: Performance, availability, security, cost — help define the targets with real numbers. For AI features, extend that to eval coverage, agent boundary safety, and prompt/data-contract stability.
* Coordinate across teams and organizations: A lot of the impact in this role comes from getting the right people in the room, gathering stakeholder buy-in, and shepherding decisions to closure.
* Engage Enterprise Architecture bidirectionally: Bring cross-product and platform-level decisions to the EA for alignment. Pull EA-level constraints into product shaping early. Push back when standards don’t fit your situation, with a clear case.
* Estimate and monitor cost and unit economics: Provide cost projections for new architecture work; flag unexpected spend and propose remediation. Reason about cost per outcome — per protected user, per investigated incident, per inference — not just AWS spend.
* Wear a technical-architect hat when it adds value: Default mode is solution and product shaping. Drop into detailed technical design when the problem warrants it or when you’re unblocking a team — and know when to step back out. With agentic engineering practices in place, more of the detailed implementation work is carried by engineers with AI assistance.
* Propose technical debt work: Identify and prioritize debt reduction with Product Management partners.

What You’ll Bring
  
  

* Architecture experience at scale: 8+ years building and operating production systems, and engaging with product early in the cycle. Time as a Solutions Architect, Principal Engineer, Tech Lead, Product Architect, Staff Engineer, or equivalent. Comfortable owning architecture across multiple teams.
* Cloud-native depth: Strong working knowledge of AWS (ECS/EKS, S3, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, IAM, VPC), Kafka, and the ability to reason about distributed systems at high volume. You don’t need deeper AWS internals knowledge than the senior engineers — you need to reason about system shape and trade-offs.
* Contract-first integration thinking: A track record of designing clean contracts between systems and teams — async messaging, event streaming, REST/gRPC APIs, data contracts — and a clear point of view on when to reach for which.
* Product partnership: Comfortable working with PMs on problem definition, customer research synthesis, jobs-to-be-done framing, and outcome hypotheses. You have a point of view on what makes a good product bet, not just a good technical bet.
* AI-First working style: You actively use AI development tools day-to-day and have a real opinion on where they help and where they don’t. You’re comfortable designing systems that include LLMs, agents, retrieval, or related components — or you’re hungry to get there fast.
* Strong written and verbal communication: Can write a one-page ADR that lands, draft a solution brief that holds up under EA review, and lead a whiteboard session that produces a decision. Equally comfortable with engineers, PMs, and designers.
* Stakeholder navigation: Good at building consensus across teams and organizations. Comfortable with ambiguity.
* Self-direction: Driven, accountable, and able to identify the right problems to work on without being told. The team is small and senior — you’ll be expected to lead, not wait for direction.
* Bonus points: Background in security, compliance, eDiscovery, identity, observability, or data platforms. Familiarity with agentic AI, MCP (Model Context Protocol), or LLM application architecture. Experience with eval design for AI systems, product discovery practices, or data contract / data mesh approaches (e.g., ODCS).

What We Offer
  
  

* Impact: Your architecture decisions will shape one of Mimecast’s fastest-evolving product lines and protect data inside thousands of enterprises.
* Voice: Direct working relationship with senior architecture leadership and a real say in technology direction across the product line — and beyond, as opportunities present themselves.
* Modern stack and modern ways of working: AWS managed services, Kafka, modern Java and Kotlin services, a growing AI tooling footprint, and a team that defaults to ship-and-iterate over review-and-gate.
* Senior peers: A small architecture team where everyone is operating at a high level and trust runs deep.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of professional software engineering and architecture experience, with at least 2 years in a Solutions Architect, Principal Engineer, Tech Lead, Product Architect, Staff Engineer, or similar role with significant product-shaping responsibility.
* Willingness and drive to use AI development tools in a professional setting.

**Belonging at Mimecast**
Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course.
  
  
We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we’d encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups.
  
  
We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won’t affect your application.
  
  
*Due to certain obligations to our customers, an offer of employment will be subject to your successful completion of applicable background checks, conducted in accordance with local law.*
*It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment.*

e2e5eef6.title: Director, Solution Engineer, Data Storage and Registration
e2e5eef6.description: Role Summary Discovery, Preclinical, and Translational Solutions (DP&TS) sits at the center of Pfizer’s scientific software work, building the digital tools that help researchers move from target identification through clinical translation. We’re looking for a Solution Engineer to own data storage and registration for integrative biology research. This is a hands-on role: you’ll design, build, and maintain the capabilities that determine how biological research data gets stored, registered, and accessed. You’ll partner with the aligned capability lead to scope and prioritize what gets built, and work across scientific, product, and engineering stakeholders to deliver solutions that are secure, scalable, and useful for researchers. You’ll work hands-on in AWS and GCP, building storage and data services that span both clouds and hold large omics datasets (genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, imaging). You’ll need depth in large-scale data management and cross-cloud integration, plus enough scientific fluency to earn credibility with computational biologists and engineers alike. Reporting to the Principal Engineer, Integrative Biology Solutions, you’ll define the technical direction for data storage and registration within the Integrative Biology space, aligning with scientific strategy, regulatory requirements, and enterprise architecture. You’re expected to be hands-on writing and reviewing real code, not just directing while also setting the standards and patterns that guide contractors and cross-functional teams. You’ll lead contractor teams as needed to extend capacity. You’re the primary technical owner: individual engineering depth combined with cross-functional leadership. The problems are real, large-scale, heterogeneous scientific data with strict regulatory requirements, and the solutions need to hold up at research scale. Key Responsibilities Own and Lead Data Storage and Registration Solutions: own data storage and registration end-to-end: design, implementation, and maintenance. Work with the Capability Lead to prioritize and scope features. Lead contractors as needed to extend capacity. Oversee Data Storage, Registration, and Scientific Data Stewardship: design and implement scalable data storage, experiment registration, metadata, provenance, lineage, access control, and findability capabilities. Set the storage, metadata, and stewardship standards that make Integrative Biology omics data trustworthy, reusable, and AI-ready across AWS and GCP. Define Standards and Best Practices: establish and maintain standards, architectural patterns, and governance frameworks for the capability area. Get them documented and adopted by delivery teams and contractors. Collaborate with Capability Lead and Business Stakeholders: work closely with the R&D capability lead to understand business needs, translate scientific requirements into technical solutions, and keep the backlog prioritized. Be the technical partner scientists and product stakeholders can rely on. Lead Contractor Teams and Drive Delivery: direct contractors as needed: provide technical guidance, review their work, and hold the line on quality, scope, and timelines. Provide Technical Guidance and Architecture Leadership: make and document key technical decisions, review designs and implementations, and guide technical direction for contractors and cross-functional partners in the capability area. Drive Innovation, Continuous Improvement, and Operational Excellence: identify and address technical debt, performance issues, and security gaps. Keep the platform moving forward in line with changing research and business needs. Solve Highly Complex and Cross-Disciplinary Problems: solve complex data engineering and storage challenges: large-scale heterogeneous scientific data, demanding research workflows, and the compliance requirements that come with a regulated environment. Build and Operate Cross-Cloud Storage and Data Services: design and implement storage, registration, and data access capabilities across AWS and GCP. Own identity federation, network connectivity, data movement, and replication between clouds so researchers can work with data where it lives without duplicating it. Manage Data Lifecycle, Performance, and Cost at Scale: define storage tiering, retention, archival, and egress policies for very large omics datasets. Monitor storage and transfer costs and tune for throughput on high-volume analytical and pipeline workloads. Basic Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Bioinformatics, Engineering, or related discipline) Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, data engineering, or solution engineering roles, with demonstrated hands-on delivery of complex data storage, registration, or related platform capabilities. Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining data storage and registration solutions in a scientific or regulated enterprise environment, including hands-on implementation accountability. Experience defining standards, best practices, and technical patterns within a capability or domain area, and driving their adoption across delivery teams. Strong technical background in data engineering, cloud-native platforms, and software development, with the ability to contribute individually and lead contractor teams toward delivery outcomes. Hands-on experience designing and operating storage and data services in both AWS and GCP, including at least one production system that integrates data or services across the two clouds. Experience managing very large scientific or research datasets (hundreds of terabytes to petabytes), including tiering, lifecycle management, performance tuning, and cost control. Technical Skills Proficiency in Python, Typescript, Java, or other modern high-level language Expertise in infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, Helm) and CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions) AWS: S3 (including storage classes and Glacier), IAM, Lake Formation, Glue, Athena, and high-throughput file storage such as FSx for Lustre. GCP: Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Dataproc or Dataflow, IAM and Workload Identity Federation, and VPC Service Controls. Cross-cloud integration: identity federation between AWS and GCP, private connectivity (Direct Connect, Cloud Interconnect, Cross-Cloud Interconnect), data transfer and replication tooling (e.g., Storage Transfer Service, DataSync), and egress cost management. Modern data architectures: lakehouse patterns and open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) that work across cloud engines. Omics data: working knowledge of common formats (FASTQ, BAM/CRAM, VCF, Parquet, HDF5/AnnData, Zarr) and how their size and access patterns affect storage design. Other Requirements Demonstrated experience in working with regulated data, compliance frameworks, and secure development practices Ability to lead complex engineering efforts across global, cross-functional teams Fluent in English; capable of clear technical communication across scientific and engineering disciplines Preferred Qualifications Education: Master’s or PhD in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Bioinformatics, Engineering, or related discipline) Domain Expertise Experience supporting pharmaceutical R&D, life sciences, or computational biology Familiarity with GA4GH standards for omics data (DRS, htsget, refget, Passports) and FAIR data principles Experience with scientific workflow platforms such as Nextflow, Snakemake, AWS HealthOmics, or Google Cloud Batch. AWS or GCP professional-level certifications, such as Solutions Architect Professional or Professional Cloud Architect. Technical Leadership Recognized internal or external technical thought leadership in integrative biology, omics data ecosystems, computational research environments, AI-ready data products, or scientific analytics capabilities Experience directing contractor teams or vendor resources on technical delivery, including providing technical guidance, reviewing work, and maintaining quality standards Strategic Capabilities Familiarity with research environments and how data scientists and computational biologists work, including their tooling preferences and data workflows Experience working with large volumes of scientific or research data, including understanding the technical challenges of data at scale (performance, storage costs, data quality, heterogeneous formats, findability) Travel Requirements Travel up to 10% may be required for business activities. Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact. dd1d979a.title: Principal Program Manager, Enterprise AI Strategy & Governance
dd1d979a.description:
We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
You Are
  
  
You are a highly skilled program manager with strong understanding of Artificial intelligence technology and its transformative potential. With deep expertise in leading complex, cross-functional programs, you thrive in fast-paced environments where strategic thinking and execution go hand in hand. You are comfortable collaborating with diverse stakeholders, from engineers to executive leadership, and excel at aligning program objectives with organizational strategy.
  
  
You bring a proven track record of managing enterprise-scale AI initiatives, including the evaluation and integration of new models, tools, and third-party solutions. Your leadership style fosters a culture of continuous improvement, and you are adept at change management, ensuring smooth adoption of Gen/Agentic AI technologies across corporate functions. If you are energized by the challenge of shaping the future of AI at scale, Synopsys offers you the platform to make a lasting impact.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Lead and scale Synopsys' enterprise AI Governance operating model across GenAI, LLMs, Agentic AI, third-party AI solutions, and internal AI applications, establishing processes for intake, evaluation, approval, monitoring, risk management, and lifecycle oversight
* Partner with Legal, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Compliance, Procurement, Engineering, Product, IT, and business stakeholders to evaluate AI technologies and use cases, ensuring alignment across risk, regulatory compliance, IP protection, privacy, and security requirements
* Operationalize governance frameworks including NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF), ISO/IEC 42001, and Responsible AI principles, translating them into practical workflows that balance innovation velocity with enterprise risk
* Define governance patterns for Agentic AI systems, including access controls, monitoring, auditability, and lifecycle management, partnering with R&D teams to ensure safe and responsible deployment
* Drive AI Academy initiatives in partnership with People and business leaders to build AI literacy, responsible AI awareness, and role-specific AI skills across the organization, developing adoption playbooks and enablement programs
* Develop governance metrics, executive dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to drive transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement across AI adoption and risk management
* Support strategic AI ecosystem partnerships, platform evaluations, and technology provider assessments, contributing to enterprise AI strategy, adoption roadmaps, and executive communications

The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Shape how Synopsys governs, deploys, and scales AI technologies across 30,000 employees, establishing the foundation for responsible and secure AI adoption company-wide
* Enable business units and corporate functions to adopt GenAI and Agentic AI safely and effectively, reducing risk exposure while accelerating innovation velocity
* Build governance processes that protect Synopsys' intellectual property, customer data, and regulatory compliance posture as AI becomes embedded across products and operations
* Drive workforce readiness and AI literacy across the organization, ensuring employees have the skills and awareness to integrate AI into their daily work responsibly
* Establish Synopsys as a leader in enterprise AI governance, operationalizing best practices that set the standard for responsible AI adoption in the semiconductor and high-tech industry
* Provide executive leadership with visibility into AI adoption, risk posture, and business impact through metrics, dashboards, and reporting that inform strategic decision-making
* Create governance mechanisms that adapt to evolving AI technologies, regulatory requirements, and business needs, ensuring Synopsys stays ahead of the curve as AI capabilities advance

What You'll Need
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline
* 12+ years of experience leading complex enterprise-scale technical programs within software, semiconductor, cloud, AI, or high-tech environments
* Experience building or operating AI Governance, Responsible AI, technology risk, compliance, cybersecurity, or enterprise transformation programs
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI, AI platforms, and AI adoption challenges within large organizations
* Experience coordinating cross-functional reviews involving Legal, Privacy, Cybersecurity, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders
* Familiarity with governance and risk frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and emerging AI regulatory requirements is a plus,
* Experience with portfolio management and workflow tools such as Jira, SharePoint, Confluence etc.
* Experience driving enterprise adoption, change management, workforce enablement, or AI upskilling initiatives is a plus

Who You Are
  
  

* You can translate complex AI governance and risk topics into clear, actionable guidance for executives, engineers, and business leaders without losing the technical nuance
* You influence across organizations and executive levels without direct authority, building trust and alignment through credibility, clarity, and follow-through
* You operate comfortably in ambiguity, building governance structures and processes in environments where technology, policy, and business objectives are evolving in real time
* You connect the dots between AI technology capabilities, governance requirements, risk management, and business value, ensuring that governance enables rather than blocks progress
* You manage multiple high-stakes initiatives simultaneously, keeping stakeholders aligned, timelines on track, and deliverables moving without dropping details
* You have a point of view on what good AI governance looks like and you are not afraid to push back when a policy is too vague, a process is too slow, or a risk assessment misses the actual exposure

The Team You'll Be Part Of
  
  
You will be part of the Strategic Missions & Technologies (SMT) organization, helping drive Synopsys' enterprise AI journey. The team partners closely with Engineering, Product, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, IT, People, IP group along with executive leadership to enable the responsible, secure, and scalable adoption of AI across the company. This role reports to the Head of AI Governance, Program Management and Chief of Staff for Strategic Missions & Technologies (SMT). This onsite role is based in Bangalore and requires regular collaboration with US-based teams, including overlap with Pacific Time hours.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

1e207941.title: Solution Advisor Senior Specialist (AI Expertise)
1e207941.description:
**Job Description**
**What you'll bring**
If you understand AI well enough to explain it in a customer meeting, and you get just as excited about solving a business problem as a technical one, these roles were written for you. Customers come to SAP with specific problems, a timeline, and a board asking questions. Your job is to understand what they're actually facing, work out what AI can genuinely do for them, and help them get there. With 400,000 customers across every industry, the scale and variety of what you'll be working on is unlike most roles in tech right now.
  
  
You independently engage customers throughout the sales cycle, delivering compelling demonstrations and solution stories that differentiate SAP. You combine strong commercial awareness with an
**AI-native advisory approach**
— bringing creativity and the genuine ability to make technology tangible
**for any customer, across any industry and any solution domain**
.

05d2ad7d.title: Solution Engineer : Mumbai
05d2ad7d.description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for
**domain-first, systems-oriented engineers**
who understand how real-world systems (in renewable energy
**,**
automotive, manufacturing, IoT, etc.) generate and use data — and can translate that into meaningful AI-driven workflows using DevRev.
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer, you will act as a
**trusted advisor**
, combining
**domain expertise, engineering depth, and problem-solving**
to help customers unlock value from their data through DevRev’s AI platform.
  
  
You will work closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to design solutions that go beyond demos — enabling
**real-world automation, intelligence, and agentic workflows**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with customers to deeply understand domain workflows, systems, and data flows (e.g., connected vehicles, factory systems, IoT environments)
* Translate real-world signals (sensor data, logs, events) into insights, workflows, and automated actions
* Build and showcase AI-driven workflows, automations, and agentic use cases
* Design and articulate end-to-end solutions (data ingestion → processing → decision → action)
* Act as a technical advisor, guiding customers on how DevRev can integrate into and enhance their existing systems
* Deliver tailored demos, PoCs, and solution walkthroughs grounded in real-world use cases (not generic SaaS demos)
* Support integrations with external systems via APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines
* Contribute to technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and solution architectures
* Stay current on industry trends (renewable energy, automotive, manufacturing, IoT, AI) and bring insights into customer conversations

**Qualifications & Skills**
**Domain Expertise**

* Experience in renewable energy, automotive, manufacturing, industrial systems, or IoT environments
* Strong understanding of:
* Connected systems (vehicles, machines, robotics, embedded systems)
* Sensor ecosystems (CAN, telemetry, vision systems, IoT devices)
* Real-world data (signals, logs, time-series)
* Familiarity with manufacturing workflows (inspection, defect detection, production cycles).
* Ability to explain data flow from system → processing → business outcomes

**Engineering Depth**

* Strong system-level thinking
* Experience with:
* Data pipelines, APIs, integrations, distributed systems
* Experience in Python / TypeScript / JavaScript (or similar)
* Understanding of system design, reliability, and failure handling
* Exposure to AI/ML in industrial use cases (vision systems, predictive maintenance, log-stream analysis, etc.)

**Problem Solving & Use Case Thinking**

* Ability to translate data → insights → workflows → actions
* Experience designing end-to-end systems
* Strong analytical mindset to identify automation opportunities from real-world signals

**AI & Tools**

* Exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI agents
* Familiarity with prompt design and AI workflows
* Tools: Postman, GitHub, Jira, Cursor, Claude Code

**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!
  
  
*DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.*

c577b1ae.title: Solution Architect – Data & AI Solutions
c577b1ae.description:
**Key Responsibilities**
Presales & Client Engagement
  
  

* Partner with sales and industry teams to design client-ready demos, proof-of-concepts, and technical solution blueprints.
* Present complex architectures in a clear, business-outcome-driven manner to both executive and technical stakeholders.
* Contribute to RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, and deal shaping.
* Act as a trusted advisor in client conversations, highlighting differentiators of Data & AI Solutions.

Solution Architecture & Demo Environments
  
  

* Architect distributed, scalable, and resilient data and AI platforms for presales demonstrations.
* Design abstraction layers for multi-model AI orchestration, including fallback logic, dynamic model switching, and cost control.
* Lead implementation of event-driven architectures using messaging frameworks (Kafka, Pulsar, SQS, etc.) and state machines.
* Build reusable, industry-specific demo environments leveraging hyperscaler services and data platforms.

Observability, Security & Compliance
  
  

* Define and enforce observability standards for demo and enterprise environments (logging, tracing, telemetry, real-time alerting).
* Implement zero-trust security models (RBAC/ABAC, IAM, OAuth2, encryption, API gateways).
* Ensure all demo and client environments meet compliance standards such as HIPAA, GDPR, SOC2.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Work with Product, Data Science, Engineering, and Governance teams to align demos with business/regulatory needs.
* Collaborate with IMUs (verticals) to build domain-specific demo templates (e.g., Insurance claims, Healthcare payment integrity, Banking KYC/fraud, Retail personalization).
* Provide hands-on support to engineering teams during delivery, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.

Innovation & Technical Leadership
  
  

* Stay ahead of hyperscaler advancements, AI/ML frameworks, and orchestration patterns.
* Drive technical due diligence, PoCs, and vendor/platform evaluations.
* Create technical artifacts (architecture diagrams, design patterns, runbooks).
* Mentor presales engineers and junior architects in solution design and client presentation skills.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Certifications preferred: - Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Kubernetes / CNCF ecosystem.
* Architecture frameworks (TOGAF, SAFe).

**Skills & Experience**
Must-Have Skills & Experience
  
  

* 15+ years in software architecture, presales engineering, or enterprise data/AI platform design.
* Hands-on expertise in at least two hyperscaler platforms: - Azure (Fabric, Synapse, Data Factory, Azure ML, Power BI).
* AWS (Redshift, Glue, S3, SageMaker, Lake Formation).
* GCP (BigQuery, Dataplex, Vertex AI, Pub/Sub).
* Proven experience architecting distributed systems, microservices, and scalable AI/ML platforms.
* Strong knowledge of Data Governance, Data Quality, Metadata, Lineage, and DataOps.
* Expertise in event-driven systems and asynchronous workflows.
* Hands-on with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK).
* Advanced programming with Python (async), TypeScript/JavaScript, or Go.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, service mesh (Istio), serverless design patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD automation, GitOps, Terraform, Helm.
* Strong presentation, storytelling, and client engagement skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms and usage-based billing.
* Familiarity with data mesh, knowledge graphs, and semantic interoperability.
* Knowledge of frontend architecture patterns (micro-frontends, data visualizations).
* Experience building presales demo or sandbox environments.

Exposure to agentic AI concepts and LLM-based orchestration.
