bd090ab6.title: Solution Architect
bd090ab6.description:
**Role overview**

EDMO is looking for a Solutions Architect to own how this will work for this customer across complex university implementations. This role sits at the intersection of sales, product, engineering, and implementation, ensuring that what is promised to clients is technically feasible, scalable, secure, and aligned with EDMOs core platform.

You will lead technical discovery, design endtoend solutions(especially integrations and configuration), and guide implementations so that each deployment is repeatable rather than a oneoff custom project.

  

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead technical discovery with universities
* Run deepdive sessions with client IT and admissions teams to understand systems (CRM/SIS/LMS), telephony/chat stack (e.g., Genesys), SSO, security/compliance, and dataflow requirements.
* Translate business and admissionsprocess needs into clear technical requirements,
* constraints, and nonfunctional expectations (performance, privacy, retention, observability).
* Design endtoend solutions and integrations
* Own the solution blueprint for each customer: integration patterns (APIs, webhooks, MCPs / connectors), data contracts, mapping to CRM/SIS, and event flows into EDMO.
* Decide what is configuration vs. product gap vs. true custom work, clearly articulating tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure solutions adhere to EDMOs architectural guardrails on security, multitenancy, scalability, and maintainability.
* Presales and scoping support
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success in latestage opportunities as the senior technical voice, especially where integrations and complex workflows are involved.
* Validate feasibility, effort, and risks before contracts/SOWs are signed, helping ensure EDMO does not commit to nonviable or nonscalable customizations.
* Contribute to RFP responses, solution summaries, and executivelevel technical presentations for key accounts.
* Implementation oversight and handoff
* Work closely with Implementation / Professional Services to turn the solution blueprint into a concrete plan: milestones, cutover strategy, environments, data migration, and UAT.Stay engaged through golive as an escalation point for scope changes, new technical risks, and critical design decisions that affect stability or timeline.
* Ensure a clean transition from project mode to steadystate Customer Success, with clear documentation and knowledge transfer.
* Architecture, standards, and product feedback
* Champion repeatability: push toward configuration, patterns, and reusable assets/templates instead of bespoke code on every project.
* Work with the CTO and Product to feed recurring client needs and integration patterns into the roadmap and reference architecture.
* Contribute to internal playbooks, reference diagrams, and best practices for integrations, security reviews, and enterprise onboarding.

  

**What success looks like**

* Enterprise university implementations go live with stable, observable integrations and minimal postgolive firefighting.
* Deals are scoped realistically, with fewer we sold something we cannot or should not build situations.
* Over time, more of what you design becomes standardized features and implementation patterns, reducing custom effort per customer.

**Required experience**

* 10+ years in a technical role such as Solutions Architect, Integration Architect, Senior Engineer, or Solutions/PreSales Engineer in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.
* Strong experience designing and implementing integrations between SaaS platforms and enterprise systems (CRM/SIS/ERP, telephony/contactcenter, identity providers, data platforms).
* Solid understanding of modern integration patterns: REST APIs, webhooks, eventdriven architecture, iPaaS/MCPstyle connectors, and data synchronization strategies.
* Handson familiarity with at least some of: Salesforce or other CRM, student information systems, contactcenter platforms (e.g., Genesys), and cloud platforms.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform. GCP is preferred; AWS or Azure is also acceptable.
* Working knowledge of serverless architectures and managed database services (e.g., Cloud SQL, Firestore, BigQuery, RDS, DynamoDB, Cosmos DB).
* Proven track record working directly with enterprise customers, leading technical workshops, and navigating between business and technical stakeholders.
* Ability to create clear solution artifacts: architecture diagrams, integration specs, sequencing diagrams, and SOW inputs understandable by both engineers and nontechnical leaders

In this role, you will lead the end-to-end and timely execution of adopting Google Cloud Platform solutions to the customer.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

* Serve as the trusted technical advisor to C-suite executives at Google’s most strategic global accounts, shaping their overarching AI strategy and accelerating the adoption of Gemini Enterprise.
* Influence the core product roadmap by translating complex architectural challenges into actionable requirements for Google's engineering teams.
* Deliver leading practice recommendations and high-stakes technical presentations to executive boards and key business stakeholders to secure massive-scale technical wins.
* Act as a thought leader and mentor across the Google Cloud organization, elevating the technical acumen of engineers and shaping best practices for agentic AI architectures.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. 25e3ff27.title: HR Solution Architect
25e3ff27.description:
**Hiring: HR Solution Architect**

**Location:**
Gurugram, India

**Work Model:**
Hybrid

**Employment Type:**
Permanent

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced
**HR Solution Architect**
to bridge HR strategy, business processes, employee experience and enterprise technology architecture.

The ideal candidate will translate complex HR business requirements into scalable, secure and effective technology solutions. This role requires a problem-first approach, evaluating multiple solution options across HR platforms, process redesign, enterprise integrations, automation and AI-enabled solutions.

You will work closely with HR leadership, enterprise architects, technology teams, data, security and business stakeholders to define solution strategies, architecture roadmaps and technology recommendations that deliver measurable business value.

The role requires a combination of strong HR technology knowledge, enterprise solutioning capabilities, integration architecture understanding and awareness of emerging AI capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. HR Solution Architecture & Process Design**

* Lead business discovery, requirement assessment, process mapping and solution design engagements.
* Evaluate existing HR processes and identify opportunities for simplification, digitisation and automation.
* Design end-to-end HR workflows covering recruitment, onboarding, core HR, employee services, performance, learning, compensation and workforce management.
* Evaluate technology options based on business value, scalability, complexity, security, cost and long-term sustainability.
* Develop solution blueprints, architecture recommendations, business cases and design documentation.

**2. HR Technology & AI Solutioning**

* Evaluate opportunities to leverage AI, Generative AI, intelligent automation and AI agents across HR processes.
* Assess whether business requirements are best addressed through existing HCM platforms, enterprise AI solutions, third-party tools, custom applications or hybrid approaches.
* Contribute to the design of AI-enabled HR assistants, conversational solutions, intelligent workflows and agent-based applications.
* Define proof-of-concept approaches, success measures, validation criteria and deployment considerations.
* Ensure appropriate human oversight, escalation mechanisms and accountability in AI-enabled HR workflows.

**3. Enterprise Integration & Architecture**

* Define integration approaches across HR applications, enterprise platforms, APIs, data services and automation solutions.
* Provide architectural guidance on REST APIs, event-driven integrations, middleware, data pipelines and system interoperability.
* Promote reusable integration patterns and scalable architecture while reducing fragmented systems and point-to-point dependencies.
* Partner with enterprise, cloud, security, data and infrastructure architects to ensure alignment with technology standards.
* Contribute to architecture reviews, solution governance and technical decision-making.

**4. HR Data Governance & Responsible AI**

* Ensure employee and candidate data is handled securely and in accordance with privacy, compliance and regulatory requirements.
* Incorporate data protection, access controls, data minimisation, retention, auditability and transparency into solution designs.
* Evaluate AI-related risks such as bias, inaccurate outputs, confidentiality, explainability and inappropriate automation.
* Ensure human review and appropriate controls for sensitive HR decisions involving recruitment, compensation, performance and employee matters.
* Collaborate with HR, IT, Cyber Security, Legal, Risk and Data Governance teams.

**5. Stakeholder Management & Technology Roadmaps**

* Work closely with HR leaders, business stakeholders, product managers, technology teams and external vendors.
* Translate business challenges and technical architecture decisions into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders.
* Lead solution workshops, design discussions and cross-functional alignment sessions.
* Develop current-state and future-state architecture roadmaps aligned with HR and enterprise technology strategy.
* Identify opportunities to simplify the HR technology landscape, improve employee experience and increase operational efficiency.

**Required Skills & Experience**

**Experience & Education**

* 15+ years of experience in HR technology, enterprise technology, solution architecture, product management, technical consulting or a related field.
* At least 7 years of experience in solution architecture, technical roadmaps, enterprise solution design or cross-platform technology strategy.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline. Relevant equivalent experience may also be considered.

**HR Technology & Functional Expertise**

* Strong understanding of end-to-end HR processes, including Talent Acquisition, Onboarding, Core HCM, Workforce Management, Performance Management, Learning, Compensation and Employee Services.
* Experience with HR technology transformation, HRIS implementations, process redesign and enterprise HR platforms.
* Ability to identify business and process challenges before recommending technology solutions.

**Solution & Integration Architecture**

* Strong understanding of enterprise solution architecture, cloud platforms, APIs, integration patterns and data architecture fundamentals.
* Exposure to REST APIs, event-driven architecture, middleware, data pipelines, identity management and security principles.
* Ability to develop conceptual and logical solution architectures and assess technical trade-offs.
* Understanding of Agile, DevOps, prototyping and software development lifecycle practices.

**AI, Automation & Responsible AI**

* Practical understanding of Generative AI, LLM-based applications, AI agents, intelligent automation and enterprise AI platforms.
* Familiarity with AI orchestration, conversational solution design, prompt engineering or agent interoperability.
* Understanding of Responsible AI principles, including fairness, bias mitigation, reliability, transparency, explainability, privacy and human oversight.
* Ability to assess AI use cases and identify appropriate governance, controls and monitoring requirements.

**Stakeholder & Consulting Skills**

* Excellent communication, presentation, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to engage confidently with senior HR and IT leaders and communicate complex technical concepts in business language.
* Strong consulting, facilitation, negotiation and influencing skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with HR platforms such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, ServiceNow HRSD, UKG, Phenom or similar enterprise solutions.
* Exposure to enterprise architecture and application portfolio management tools such as LeanIX.
* TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification.
* Experience with AI agent orchestration frameworks, conversational AI or enterprise AI solution design.
* Familiarity with enterprise data platforms and HR data governance.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Business problems are clearly understood and process improvements are considered before technology selection.
* HR technology recommendations are scalable, secure, cost-effective and aligned with enterprise architecture.
* AI-enabled HR solutions are designed with appropriate governance, transparency and human oversight.
* HR applications, integrations, data services and AI capabilities work together as a connected ecosystem.
* Architecture recommendations enable informed decisions and measurable improvements in employee experience and HR operations.

**Additional Information**

* Primary work location: Gurugram, India.
* Work model: Hybrid.
* Working hours: Regular business hours, with flexibility to collaborate with global stakeholders across time zones.
* Travel: Occasional travel may be required.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics – Senior Manager - Databricks Architect**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Senior Data & AI Architect with 13+ years of experience in data engineering and data architecture, strong hands-on expertise in Databricks, Hadoop, Spark/PySpark, and cloud data platforms.
  
  
This role combines deep technical ownership of enterprise Lakehouse and data platform architecture with hands-on experience building Agentic AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions on Databricks. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing large-scale, production-grade data pipelines, architecting modern AI-driven solutions, and engaging directly with clients on strategic proposals and solution design.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Architect, design, and deliver scalable Data & AI solutions on the Databricks Lakehouse platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, governance, and consumption layers.
* Design and optimize large-scale distributed data processing pipelines using Hadoop, Apache Spark, and PySpark.
* Build reusable, production-grade Python frameworks and pipelines for batch and streaming data engineering workloads.
* Define and implement cloud data architecture on AWS and/or Azure, covering storage, IAM, networking, security, and monitoring, with native Databricks integration.
* Own end-to-end ETL/ELT design, data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and data quality frameworks across the platform.
* Design dimensional data models (star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension tables, SCD) to support analytical and reporting use cases.
* Design and build Agentic AI solutions on Databricks, including LLM integration, tool/function calling, agent workflows, guardrails, and enterprise data integration.
* Architect and implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions using Databricks — document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, grounding, and evaluation.
* Establish and enforce engineering best practices for Git-based version control, code reviews, and CI/CD across development, test, and production environments.
* Lead performance optimization and production deployment of Databricks jobs, workflows, and pipelines at scale.
* Participate in strategic RFP/RFI responses, technical proposals, solution shaping, effort estimation, and architecture presentations.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor in customer workshops, translating business requirements into robust technical architectures.
* Mentor engineering teams on Databricks, Spark, cloud architecture, and modern AI/RAG engineering practices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
13+ years of experience in Data Engineering / Data Architecture, with strong hands-on experience across Databricks, Hadoop, Spark/PySpark, and cloud data platforms.
  
  

* Databricks

+ Strong expertise in Databricks Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, and Unity Catalog.
+ Hands-on experience with Jobs/Workflows, performance optimization, and production deployments.

* Hadoop & Spark

+ Strong knowledge of the Hadoop ecosystem, HDFS, and Hive.
+ Strong hands-on experience with Apache Spark and PySpark for large-scale distributed data processi

* Python

+ Strong proficiency in Python for building scalable, reusable, production-grade data pipelines and frameworks.
+ Cloud
+ Strong experience with AWS and/or Azure, including cloud storage, IAM, networking, security, and monitoring.
+ Experience integrating Databricks with cloud-native services.

* Data Engineering

+ Expertise in ETL/ELT, batch and streaming processing, data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and data quality.
+ Proven ability to design scalable, production-ready pipeline architectures.

* SQL & Data Modelling

+ Strong SQL skills, with experience in dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension models, SCD, and analytical data models.

* Agentic AI

+ Hands-on experience designing and building Agentic AI solutions with Databricks, including LLMs, tool/function calling, agent workflows, guardrails, and enterprise data integration.

* RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

+ Strong experience building RAG solutions using Databricks, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, grounding, and evaluation.

* Git & CI/CD

+ Strong knowledge of Git, branching strategies, pull requests, and code reviews.
+ Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment across multiple environments.
+ Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles and/or Terraform is a plus.

* Strategic RFPs & Solutioning

+ Ability to participate in strategic RFP/RFI responses, solution shaping, technical proposals, and effort estimations.
+ Experience delivering architecture presentations and leading customer workshops.

* Client Communication
* Strong client-facing and communication skills, with the ability to understand business requirements, translate them into scalable technical solutions, and clearly communicate architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Prior experience in a consulting, systems integrator, or client-facing delivery role.
* Relevant cloud or Databricks certifications (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer / Solutions Architect, AWS/Azure certifications).

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

d45061a7.title: Customer Engagement Manager
d45061a7.description:
**About Ema**
Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.
  
  
We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.
  
  
**The Role**
The Customer Engagement Manager owns a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts end-to-end: every engagement, every outcome, every relationship, every expansion opportunity. Think of this as the McKinsey Associate Partner model applied to enterprise AI delivery.
  
  
You are the single point of accountability for your accounts. The customer calls you — not your manager — when they have a problem. You staff delivery teams, oversee solution quality, run executive readouts, measure ROI, drive adoption, rebuild trust when things break, and grow the book through proven production value.
  
  
**This is not a project management role.**
This is an account ownership role that combines delivery orchestration, outcome ownership, customer leadership, and commercial growth.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* Account Ownership
* Own your accounts end-to-end: every engagement, every outcome, every relationship. Everything good or bad stops with you.
* Be the single point of contact the customer calls for any problem — delivery, quality, adoption, escalation, or expansion.
* Maintain a holistic view of each account: engagement status, risk exposure, opportunity pipeline, and the customer’s strategic priorities for the quarter.
* Run account planning: engagement roadmaps, resource forecasting, risk assessment, and growth strategy.
* Delivery Orchestration
* Staff and direct delivery teams (Engineering Leads, Product Managers) across your accounts.
* Oversee delivery quality across all engagements: review solution architectures, attend go-live rehearsals, ensure evaluation rigor.
* Manage cross-engagement dependencies within an account (e.g., shared integration infrastructure between parallel deployments).
* Serve as the delivery escalation point: join war rooms, coordinate fixes across Engineering and Product, and communicate resolution to the customer.
* You don’t write code — but you review architectures, challenge unrealistic scope, and ensure go-live readiness. Your leverage is orchestration and judgment.
* Outcome Ownership & Continuous Improvement
* Own post-go-live outcomes: adoption, ROI, accuracy, and user trust. This role absorbs the Outcomes Manager function for your accounts.
* Run regular usage readouts: AI deflection rates, false positive/negative trends, HITL escalation patterns, user bypass rates, and trust signals.
* Separate product gaps from process, training, or expectation gaps. Not everything that looks broken is an engineering problem.
* Drive continuous improvement cycles: readout → diagnose → prioritize → fix → re-measure.
* Communicate outcomes in business language: efficiency gains, cost savings, error reduction — not just dashboards, but diagnosis and action plans.
* Executive Stakeholder Leadership
* Run QBRs with VP/C-level stakeholders: present outcomes, risks, improvement plans, and the strategic roadmap.
* Navigate internal customer politics: when the VP of IT and VP of Business disagree on priorities, facilitate alignment around shared success metrics.
* Communicate bad news credibly: present the data, the diagnosis, and the recovery plan — without losing trust.
* Handle C-level escalations. When the CTO threatens to terminate or the CFO questions ROI, you are the person in the room.
* Commercial Growth
* Grow your book through outcome-driven expansion: deliver the first SOW excellently, measure ROI rigorously, present evidence to the C-suite, then propose the next SOW grounded in proven value.
* Identify new use cases by deeply understanding customer business processes and pain points — not by pushing a product catalog.
* Know when to push for expansion vs. when to stabilize. Premature expansion erodes trust. You earn the right to grow by delivering first.
* Co-sell with Sales: provide the delivery credibility and outcome evidence that makes expansion proposals close.
* Product & Platform Partnership
* Act as the voice of your customers to Product and Core Engineering. Translate field patterns into structured, actionable feedback — not one-off requests.
* Identify cross-customer patterns that signal platform gaps or opportunities.
* Partner with Product on customer-facing roadmap discussions: what’s coming, what’s not, and how to manage expectations.
* Team Development
* Coach Engineering Leads and Implementation Managers on architecture quality, customer communication, delivery discipline, and outcome thinking.
* Promote shared standards and best practices across engagements.
* Build reusable account-level assets: engagement playbooks, QBR templates, outcome tracking frameworks, and expansion qualification criteria.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* 15+ years in enterprise technology delivery, consulting, account management, or customer leadership.

928669c5.title: Builder - Program Manager
928669c5.description:
**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a Program Manager to lead the rollout and ongoing improvement of calling and contact-center technology across business units. The role sits at the intersection of business operations, product, engineering, and external technology partners.

The person will translate business workflows into scalable dialer and lead-management solutions, coordinate integrations and launches, monitor service health, and resolve operational issues. Hands-on contact center and dialer experience is a must.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

•
**Lead program discovery and delivery:**
Work with business units to understand customer journeys, calling workflows, agent needs, and operational requirements. Convert these into clear BRDs and PRDs, scoped plans, milestones, owners, and launch criteria.

•
**Implement dialer programs across business units:**
Coordinate end-to-end setup of campaigns, queues, agent centers, routing and assignment logic, call dispositions, retries, callbacks, recordings, and virtual numbers.

•
**Bridge business, product, and technology:**
Translate operational needs into clear requirements for product, engineering, CRM, and vendor teams. Coordinate API, webhook, CRM, and other system integrations, and track delivery through testing and launch.

•
**Manage lead orchestration**
: Define how leads are created, deduplicated, assigned, routed, attempted, followed up, and closed. Ensure call outcomes and lead status sync correctly with source systems.

•
**Own testing, go-live, and stabilization:**
Coordinate UAT, agent readiness, launch communications, issue triage, and post-launch monitoring for new campaigns and workflows.

•
**Manage platform and infrastructure readiness:**
Coordinate agent IDs, tenant and user setup, channel and license allocation, number provisioning, and capacity planning across campaigns.

•
**Monitor operational health and governance:**
Track lead volumes, lead-to-attempt conversion, call connectivity, call drops, campaign activity, and critical bot or missed-call flows. Identify anomalies and coordinate timely resolution.

•
**Lead incident triage and root-cause analysis:**
Be a first point of coordination when dialer, telephony, CRM, or lead-flow issues occur. Determine whether the issue relates to configuration, data, platform, network, or a vendor, and drive it to resolution.

•
**Manage external partners:**
Coordinate requirements, integrations, escalations, service issues, and operational changes with dialer and telecom vendors.

•
**Support compliance and number governance:**
Coordinate NDNC/DNC complaint investigation and suppression workflows, and maintain oversight of number allocation, whitelisting, and number lifecycle.

•
**Enable reporting and conversation intelligence:**
Coordinate business-unit onboarding to call analytics tools, including access, call-data pipelines, reporting, dashboards, and use-case configuration.

•
**Track program outcomes:**
Maintain clear status reporting, risks, dependencies, decisions, and measurable outcomes for stakeholders across business, product, technology, finance, and operations.

**PREREQUISITES**

• Prior contact center (CC) experience is mandatory. Candidates must understand contact-center operations, agent workflows, campaign execution, and the practical challenges of running high-volume calling.

• Hands-on experience with dialers or contact-center platforms is mandatory, including autodialers such as predictive, preview, or progressive dialing. Experience with platforms such as Ameyo, Ozonetel, Exotel, Servetel, or similar is relevant.

• Strong program management skills: able to structure work across multiple teams, manage dependencies and risks, and drive delivery through launch and stabilization.

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, including comfort with operational dashboards, funnel metrics, and incident investigation.

**Share your resume at mitansha.aggarwal@cars24.com**

b23fba56.title: Pre-Sales & Tender Bidding Specialist
b23fba56.description:
We are looking for an experienced Pre-Sales & Tender Bidding Specialist / Manager with strong expertise in government and enterprise tendering, RFP/RFQ responses, proposal management and business development support.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in identifying relevant tender opportunities, understanding client requirements, preparing technical and commercial proposals, coordinating with internal technology and digital marketing teams, and ensuring timely and compliant submission of bids.
  
  
This role will focus on opportunities across digital marketing, website and software development, IT services, digital transformation and AI-led solutions.
  
  
The candidate should be able to independently manage the complete tender lifecycle, from opportunity identification and bid qualification to proposal submission and post-bid coordination.
  
  
**Experience:**
3 - 6 Years
  
  
**Location:**
Kolkata (Onsite)
  
  
**‍Key Responsibilities**
‍
  
  
**Tender & Bid Management**

* Identify and track relevant government, PSU, enterprise and private-sector tenders, RFPs, RFQs and EOI opportunities.
* Monitor tender portals, procurement platforms and other relevant sources for digital marketing and software project opportunities.
* Review tender documents, eligibility criteria, scope of work, technical specifications, evaluation criteria and submission requirements.
* Conduct bid qualification and feasibility analysis based on project scope, capabilities, eligibility, timelines and commercial viability.
* Prepare tender calendars, bid trackers, submission schedules and compliance checklists.
* Ensure all tender submissions are accurate, complete, compliant and submitted within the defined deadlines.
* Coordinate pre-bid queries, clarifications, corrigenda, extensions and other tender-related communications.

‍
  
  
**Pre-Sales & Proposal Development**

* Understand client requirements and translate them into structured technical and business proposals.
* Prepare RFP/RFQ responses, technical proposals, solution write-ups, capability documents, company profiles and presentations.
* Develop project understanding, proposed approach, implementation methodology, deliverables, timelines and resource plans.
* Coordinate with Technology, Project Management, Digital Marketing, Creative and other internal teams to gather inputs.
* Support the preparation of Statements of Work (SOW), scope documents, assumptions, exclusions and project plans.
* Ensure proposals clearly communicate Web Spiders' capabilities, relevant experience, value proposition and proposed solution.

‍
  
  
**Digital Marketing & Software Project Expertise**
**Support Proposals And Tenders Related To**

* Digital marketing and performance marketing.
* SEO, SEM, social media marketing and content marketing.
* Website design, development and maintenance.
* Web portals, CMS and e-commerce solutions.
* Mobile application development.
* Custom software development and enterprise applications.
* AI-powered solutions, chatbots and conversational AI.
* Cloud, DevOps, application support and digital transformation.
* Creative design, branding and multimedia solutions.
* Work with internal experts to understand technical requirements and prepare relevant, client-focused proposals.

‍
  
  
**Technical & Commercial Coordination**

* Coordinate with technical leads, project managers, solution architects and business stakeholders for proposal inputs.
* Support effort estimation, resource planning, costing and commercial proposal preparation.
* Work with Finance / Accounts and Business Development teams to finalize pricing and commercial terms.
* Review proposal assumptions, dependencies, payment terms, SLAs and contractual requirements.
* Maintain consistency between technical scope, resource estimates, pricing and delivery commitments.
* Escalate risks, deviations, missing information and commercial concerns before submission.

‍
  
  
**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Participate in pre-bid meetings, client discussions, clarification calls and presentations.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely completion of bid deliverables.
* Support client presentations, solution walkthroughs and tender-related meetings.
* Maintain professional communication with prospective clients, partners and consortium members where applicable.
* Track bid outcomes, feedback, negotiation status and next steps.

‍
  
  
**Proposal Documentation & Knowledge Management**

* Maintain a centralized repository of proposals, tender documents, case studies, credentials and reusable bid content.
* Develop and maintain proposal templates, capability decks, company profiles and solution libraries.
* Track submitted bids, win/loss outcomes, reasons for rejection and improvement opportunities.
* Ensure all bid documentation follows company standards and approval requirements.
* Maintain confidentiality of client information, pricing, business proposals and internal documents.

‍
  
  
**‍Required Skills & Experience**

* 3–6 years of relevant experience in Pre-Sales, Tender Management, Bid Management, Proposal Management or IT Business Development.
* Should have experienced with any one of the tender platforms (GeBiz/Tender24x7,Gems, any other Gov portals) for the Digital Marketing & Software Projects.
* Proven experience in handling government / PSU / enterprise tenders, RFPs, RFQs and EOIs.
* Strong knowledge of the complete tender bidding lifecycle.
* Experience in preparing technical and commercial proposals for software, IT services or digital marketing projects.
* Good understanding of website development, software engineering, digital marketing and digital transformation solutions.
* Strong technical writing, documentation and presentation skills.
* Ability to read and interpret tender documents, eligibility criteria and technical requirements.
* Experience coordinating with technical, project delivery, finance and business development teams.
* Strong attention to detail, deadline management and compliance tracking.
* Proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace, Excel / Google Sheets and PowerPoint / Google Slides.

‍
  
  
**Interview Process**

* Application review
* 5–10 minute initial screening call with the TA team
* Technical interviews {Domain specific}
* ‍Practical test conducted in the presence of a panel member
* ‍Role match & offer

according to the local market

c1ef7830.title: Lead Software Architect
c1ef7830.description:
**Job Description**
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.
  
  
**Overview**
Boeing is the world's largest aerospace company and leading manufacturer of commercial airplanes and defense, space and security systems. We are engineers and technicians. Skilled scientists and thinkers. Bold innovators and dreamers. Join us, and you can build something better for yourself, for our customers and for the world.
  
  
As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U.S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Boeing’s team is committed to innovating for the future, leading with sustainability, and cultivating a culture based on the company’s core values of safety, quality and integrity.

The Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC) is a 5500+ engineering workforce that contributes to global aerospace growth. Our engineers deliver cutting-edge R&D, innovation, and high-quality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IIoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace.
  
  
**People-driven culture**
At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts – enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected. No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people’s careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing.
  
  
With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace.
  
  
**Position Overview:**
**Boeing Digital Services org**
is currently looking for
**Lead Software Architect**
to join their team in Bengaluru, KA. As a Software Architect, you will be part of the Boeing Global Services, which develops software applications and products for that create direct value to its customers. We provide re-vamped work environments focused on delivering data-driven solutions at a rapidly increased pace over traditional development. Be a part of our
  
  
passionate and motivated team who are excited to use the latest in software technologies for modern web and mobile application development. Through our products we deliver innovative solutions to our global customer base at an accelerated pace.
  
  
**Position Responsibilities:**

* Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to clearly communicate with other team members

* Candidate must be a self-starter with a positive attitude, high ethics, and strong analytical and creative problem-Solving skills and a track record of working successfully under pressure in a time-constrained environment
* Able to communicate with others on the team virtually
* Experience in understanding and interacting with multiple data formats
* Ability to rapidly learn and understand software from source code
* Knowledge and/or experience of SAFe projects and processes desirable
* Organization skills to manage a workload of various tasks, which may be interrupted by high priority system issues or requests.

* Delivers working software in accordance with expected quality standards
* Designs for testability: Design and evolve the system to support testability and test automation
* Works on prototyping and evaluating technical feasibility
* Own and drive the end-to-end solution and technical architecture for complex, mission-critical aviation systems, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards and business goals.
* Define and govern architectural guidelines, design patterns, coding standards, and best practices across multiple development teams.
* Lead design reviews and architecture governance, making and clearly documenting key technical decisions and trade-offs (performance, cost, scalability, security).

* Define the full-stack and API architecture (REST and GraphQL) and the integration patterns across distributed, multi-cloud enterprise environments.
* Evaluate AI/ML feature quality, reliability, and operational readiness, and define the testability, observability, and metrics needed to support them in production.

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* Bachelor’s degree is required as basic qualification.
* Full stack developer who has excellent programming skills in the latest tools & technology frameworks like Java 8+ (Core and Advanced), Spring Boot 3.x, Angular 12, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React JS
* Must have hands-on experience with message brokers; knowledge of either Kafka or RabbitMQ is a mandatory requirement for designing reliable asynchronous workflows, event-driven integrations, and ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

* Good experience on Database technologies like SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL
* Hands-on experience with Build and Deployment tools and languages. Experience in best practices and Tools around CI/CD.
* Knowledge of integrating with Maven, Gradle and Shell scripting.
* Experience with Azure Cloud is highly preferrable
* Proven experience as a Software Architect or Technical Lead defining end-to-end solution architecture for large-scale, enterprise Java applications.
* Deep expertise in architecting microservices and distributed systems using Java 8+, Spring Boot 3.x, Spring Cloud, and RESTful/GraphQL API design.
* Strong command of software architecture patterns and principles - Domain-Driven Design (DDD), event-driven architecture, CQRS, SOLID, and the 12-factor app methodology.
* Hands-on experience designing cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure (AKS, App Services, Functions, API Management, Event Hubs) including containerization with Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes.
* Expertise in defining non-functional requirements - scalability, performance, high availability, resiliency, and observability - and designing systems to meet them.
* Strong background in application and data security - OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, secure coding practices, secrets management, and compliance with enterprise security standards.
* Experience establishing CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/ARM/Bicep), and DevOps practices using Azure DevOps or equivalent.
* Ability to perform architectural trade-off analysis, create and maintain architecture decision records (ADRs), and produce clear technical design documentation and diagrams (C4/UML).
* Proven experience architecting AI/ML/LLM-powered product features for production - including agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), model APIs, prompt orchestration, and intelligent automation.
* Proficiency with modern AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot) and the ability to guide teams in adopting them responsibly and effectively across development workflows.
* Strong command of GraphQL and REST API design and of the integration patterns that connect full-stack systems across complex, distributed enterprise environments.
* Experience defining modernization strategy for legacy / brownfield systems using patterns such as strangler fig, lift-and-refactor, and incremental modernization.
* Ability to evaluate AI feature quality, reliability, and operational readiness, and to establish responsible-AI and governance practices for production systems.

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):**

* Experience with DevOps Practices such as Continuous integration and continuous deployment (using Microsoft DevOps), configuration management, metrics and monitoring schemes, virtualization and cloud computing using Microsoft Azure
* Proficiency in Angular or React Native for cross-platform mobile development
* Solid understanding of mobile UI/UX best practices and platform-specific design guidelines
* Knowledge and/or experience of the Aviation Industry desirable
* Familiarity with Java software development in order to effectively perform analysis of issues and identify potential code defects
* Scripting experience with JavaScript, Python.

:

c33c1441.title: AI Data Science Solutions Lead, Aladdin, Vice President
c33c1441.description:
**About This Role**
**Your Team**
The Data Science & Artificial Intelligence (AI) team helps transform how technology, data, and AI drive better outcomes for clients and the business. The team partners closely with client-facing teams, product strategists, engineers, and business leaders to develop and scale AI-powered solutions that enhance productivity, improve decision-making, strengthen client engagement, and unlock commercial value. This is a highly impactful team focused on translating innovation into real-world business outcomes and advancing the future of AI-powered client engagement across the firm.
  
  
**Your Role and Impact**
We are seeking a highly motivated AI Solutions Lead to join the Data Science & AI team. This role combines technical expertise in machine learning, generative AI, and data engineering with the ability to translate business challenges into scalable AI solutions. You will partner with stakeholders across Sales, Product Strategy, Chief Operating Officer (COO) functions, and Technology to identify opportunities, develop AI-driven products, and deploy solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. Success in this role requires intellectual curiosity, analytical thinking, hands-on technical skills, and the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and embrace the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies while challenging outcomes. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Develop artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and advanced analytics solutions that drive commercial growth, improve client experiences, and enhance operational efficiency.
* Design, develop, evaluate, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions in partnership with engineering teams.
* Build intelligent AI-powered assistants, agentic workflows, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications that deliver measurable business value.
* Establish experimentation, evaluation, monitoring, and performance measurement frameworks to assess business impact and solution effectiveness.
* Leverage modern cloud, data, and directed acyclic graph-based workflow orchestration frameworks for data and batch processing to build scalable AI solutions.
* Champion responsible AI practices, model governance, security, scalability, and reliability standards.
* Partner across product, engineering, business, and AI teams to advance enterprise AI capabilities and communicate insights effectively.

Your Experience
  
  

* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or another quantitative discipline; advanced degrees are a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to build and deploy AI and machine learning solutions in production environments.
* Strong technical proficiency in Python, Structured Query Language (SQL), data engineering, and analytical platforms.
* Demonstrated expertise in machine learning, statistics, experimentation, and predictive modeling.
* Experience developing generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, natural language processing (NLP), and related techniques.
* Experience in asset management, financial services, fintech, or modern cloud-based AI ecosystems is preferred.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and responsible AI practices.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

* **Architecture & System Integrations:**

* **Testing & Vendor Coordination:**
  Own test planning (access, data setup, scenario coverage) across CRP/UAT cycles and coordinate with vendor teams to ensure timely delivery readiness.
* **Support & Governance:**
  Serve as the L3 escalation point for production issues across order capture, pricing, catalog, checkout, and integrations. Present updates, capability gaps, and solution risks in PMO calls, governance forums, and SteerCo discussions.

**Must-Have Skill Sets**

* **ERP & B2B E-Commerce Expertise:**
  8+ years of experience in ERP-enabled e-commerce solutions, including at least 4+ years of hands-on leadership in Sana Commerce Cloud (or equivalent B2B e-commerce platforms).
* **D365 F&O & Third-Party Integrations:**
  Proven experience integrating e-commerce platforms with Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O, Experlogix (CPQ/configurator), Flintfox (pricing engine), and middleware via APIs and OData.
* **B2B Commerce Workflows:**
  Deep domain expertise in distributor portals, PunchOut flows, customer-specific pricing/catalog segmentation, "on-behalf-of" ordering, role-based access, and order orchestration.
* **End-to-End Delivery & Support:**
  Demonstrated track record leading functional designs, CRP/UAT cycles, and L3 production troubleshooting.

**Preferred Qualifications & Certifications**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field (Master’s degree is a plus).
* **Certifications:**
  Sana Commerce Cloud certifications/training; Microsoft Dynamics 365 certifications (MB-300, MB-500, or MB-700) or Azure cloud integration certifications.
* **Additional Technical Exposure:**
  Familiarity with D365 security models, Microsoft Power Platform (workflow extensions and user provisioning), and complex CPQ systems.

**Key Deliverables & Expected Outcomes**

* **Deliverables:**
* End-to-end commerce solution architecture covering B2B portals, distributor ordering flows, pricing, catalog segmentation, PunchOut, and Available-to-Promise (ATP).
* Technical integration architecture documentation for D365 F&O, Flintfox, Experlogix, and middleware.
* Solution blueprints for "on-behalf-of" ordering and customer-specific catalog/pricing enablement.
* **Outcomes:**
* A scalable, future-ready enterprise commerce platform that eliminates fragmented ordering experiences across channels and establishes clear alignment between IT, Sales Ops, Pricing, Finance, and global digital teams.

3c011fa8.title: Program Manager II, Global Catalog Operations
3c011fa8.description:
**Description**
Amazon.com operates in a global eCommerce environment without boundaries, and operates a diverse set of businesses worldwide, including Retail, third party marketplaces, eCommerce platforms, web services for developers.
  
  
The Amazon product catalog is a set of records; each record being a set of facts describing a physical or digital product. These records are often organized by defined relationships (e.g. variations such as different sizes of the same shoe). Our ability to provide a good product discovery experience and empower our customers to make well informed purchase decisions is dependent on the quality of our product catalog. In a high quality catalog, every product is described with a complete, structured, accurate and correctly normalized set of facts. Every product is represented by a unique record appropriately related to one another.
  
  
The Global catalog operations (GCO) team is part of Amazon Selection & Catalog services (ASCS) teams in India focus on leveraging human intelligence, external or internal, to measure and improve the quality of the catalog: Global catalog operations (GCO) charter is to make Catalog engineering programs more effective by providing expert human judgment. Catalog Operations from its inception has been partnering with engineering teams to run programs focused on improving the data quality of catalog in all market places.
  
  
We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Program Manager to join our rapidly growing team. The role is centered on developing insights and eliminating defects in quality that affects business metrics. As part of this role, you will work on 1) Creating mechanisms to identify, investigate, and solve quality issues impacting the business metrics, 2) Working collaboratively across our partner teams (ex: Science, PMs, Engineering, Business, etc.) to combine efforts to solve problems, 3) Developing data-driven approaches alongside our SWOT/BA teams to rapidly identify opportunity areas, and trends at scale, 4) You will take complex opportunities and break them down into manageable pieces, then ensure timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**As a Program Manager II You Will**

* Drive appropriate data-oriented analysis, adoption of technology solutions and process improvement projects to achieve operational and business goal
* Communicate and take the lead role in identifying Gaps in process areas and work with all stakeholders to resolve the gaps
* Be a SME for the process and a referral point for in-house and customer team
* Has the ability to drive business/operational metrics through quantitative decision making, and adoption of different tools and resources
* Ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced work environment driven by complex software systems and processes
* Ability to perform deep dive in the process and come up with process improvement solutions
* Shall collaborate effectively with customers (Science, Engineering, Product, etc.) to bring in improvements to the business metrics
* Provide regular updates on project progress and performance, ensuring transparency and alignment with key business goals.
* Exercise discretion in prioritizing process improvements, aligning them with broader business objectives.
* Ensure effective risk controls are developed and maintained. Implement corrective actions and maintain commitment to goals, ensuring on-time project completion and minimized losses.
* Develop and influence new ideas, establishing procedures and practices to promote long-term solutions in dynamic environments.
* Drive continuous improvement and decision-making strategies.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Bachelor's degree

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

8598e629.description:
**Client - Fast growing AI Solutions setup focused on SAP; helping CFO save millions**

**The role**

You run the funnel from first meeting to signed contract: you lead customer calls alongside our sellers, shape the solution with our technical pre-sales lead, and build the deck, proposal or RFP (Request for Proposal) response that wins the deal. You also own how the market sees us, through our capability story, case studies, events and social media. You will work directly with our Chief Business Officer and founders as we scale from our first customers in India, the US and Europe, and you will build the pre-sales and growth function as it grows. The pace is fast, and the ownership is real.

**What you will do**

* **Own the funnel:**
  track every opportunity from first meeting to signed contract, keep the CRM (customer relationship management system) and forecast honest, and find and fix where deals stall.
* **Run customer calls:**
  lead discovery and follow-up calls with CIOs (Chief Information Officers) and SAP leaders alongside our sellers, and drive the next steps to closure.
* **Win RFPs:**
  own our responses end to end, from the bid or no-bid call, plan and compliance matrix to the commercial sections and final submission, with our technical pre-sales lead on the technical answers.
* **Shape every proposal:**
  tailored customer decks within 24 hours of a call; proposals, statements of work and pricing within 48 hours.
* **Own our story:**
  the capability deck, case studies and follow-up packs, kept sharp and backed by evidence.
* **Run events:**
  plan and deliver presence at SAP user-group meetings, webinars, CIO roundtables and partner events, from invitations and content to the follow-up that turns attendees into meetings.
* **Build the engine:**
  reusable content, templates and AI-assisted workflows that make every next deal faster; bring what you learn from customers back into product and pricing.

**What you bring**

* 4–7 years in pre-sales, bid and proposal work, or consulting, at an IT (Information Technology) services firm, SAP partner, consulting firm or software company.
* Confidence leading client calls with senior IT leaders, and a track record of moving deals forward, not just documenting them.
* Strong business writing and storytelling: answer first, then evidence. You build clean, well-structured and impactful slides quickly.
* Working knowledge of SAP: what ECC and S/4HANA are, why custom code and testing matter in a migration, and how SAP programmes are bought.
* Comfort with Excel for pricing and effort tables.
* Daily use of AI writing tools (such as Claude or Microsoft Copilot) to work faster, while checking every fact.
* The ability to juggle several deadlines at once and still deliver on time.

**Nice to have:**
proposals for US or European clients; an SAP functional background (Finance, Sales and Distribution, or Materials Management); an MBA (Master of Business Administration); experience of new-age design tools.

**Why join**

* Shape how a new kind of SAP company tells its story to CIOs (Chief Information Officers) in India, the US and Europe.
* Work directly with the founders, and room to build and lead the pre-sales function.

**How we hire**

A portfolio conversation about decks or proposals you have built, a 24-hour customer-deck exercise, a short live working session, and an SAP conversation with our technical pre-sales lead. We aim to decide within a week and prefer candidates who can join within 30–60 days.

We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end architectural design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise ServiceNow solutions. You will act as a trusted technical advisor, bridging the gap between business requirements and scalable platform architecture, with a primary focus on Customer Service Management (CSM) and Financial Services Operations (FSO). Key Responsibilities

* End-to-End Architecture: Design scalable, secure, and maintainable ServiceNow solutions aligned with platform best practices and enterprise architecture standards.

* Domain Leadership: Lead the technical design for Customer Service Management (CSM) and Financial Services Operations (FSO) workflows, data models, and industry-specific integrations.

* Stakeholder Alignment: Conduct discovery workshops with business leaders, product owners, and technical teams to translate complex business requirements into clear technical specifications and user stories.

* Technical Governance: Establish and enforce ServiceNow development standards, code review processes, upgradeability guidelines, and instance health checks.

* Integration Strategy: Architect robust integrations between ServiceNow and external enterprise systems (core banking platforms, CRMs, ERPs, and legacy databases) using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, and MID Servers.

* Mentorship & Delivery: Guide technical leads and developers throughout the Agile/Scrum lifecycle to ensure high-quality, on-time delivery.

* Consulting & Communication: Strong executive presence with the ability to communicate complex architectural trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Remote Self-Management: Proven ability to operate independently in a remote, contract-based engagement model with high accountability. Mandatory & Preferred Certifications

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)

* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)

* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management (CIS-CSM)
