b7d79be3.title: Global AI Solution Engineer
b7d79be3.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Senior Operation Manager for D&A  

**Mission of the Role**

Are you passionate about turning business needs into practical, AI-enabled solutions and excited to be part of a global company transforming industry with cutting-edge technology? ABB is looking for an **AI Solution Engineer** to join our **Automation IS** team.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between business needs and practical AI-enabled solutions. You will assess whether AI is the right approach and recommend an implementation approach based on the standards, reference architectures and technology guidance defined by the Advanced Analytics Architect and relevant platform architects. You will stay hands-on throughout delivery, working with Data Analysts, Snowflake Developers, Power BI/Fabric Developers, Data Engineers and other specialists to build, validate and hand over working solutions. You will also contribute to project set-up, incremental delivery, solution quality, production readiness and reuse across Automation.

  

**Work model:** #LI Hybrid **Area:** This role contributes to AU IS in AU.

  

**Responsibilities**

**Business understanding and solution fit**

* Work with Data Analysts and business stakeholders to clarify:business needs and expected outcomessuccess measuresAI-specific data and context requirementsrisks and ownership
* Assess whether AI, analytics, automation or a conventional solution best addresses the identified business need.
* Recommend solutions based on approved patterns and guidance from the Advanced Analytics Architect and the Snowflake, Azure and Fabric platform architects.

  

**Build and development**

* Develop and validate AI components, proofs of concept, prototypes and minimum viable solutions using Python, SQL and approved technologies.
* Build Azure- or Snowflake-based AI applications and services, including orchestration, retrieval, RAG, agent logic, APIs, evaluation and integration components.
* Create implementation assets, including prompts, agent instructions, evaluation datasets, notebooks, application logic, automated workflows, tests and deployment assets.
* Use enterprise data from SAP and Salesforce to develop AI/ML solutions that address business needs and deliver measurable business value. These include predictive models, GenAI applications and AI agents.
* Apply Snowflake AI/ML capabilities to build and validate machine learning and generative AI solutions using enterprise data. These include Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search and AI Functions.

  

**Quality, compliance and operations**

* Evaluate and test solutions for grounding, answer quality, model or agent behaviour, business value, safety, cost and operational reliability.
* Apply the defined Responsible AI, information security, privacy, access-control and IT compliance requirements within the assigned solution scope. Work with architecture, platform, security and operations specialists where required.
* Contribute to CI/CD, production readiness, handover and monitoring design.
* Support incident and problem analysis related to AI solutions within the assigned scope.
* Document AI solutions, including their logic, assumptions, limitations, test results and operational requirements.

  

**Collaboration**

* Work as part of a multidisciplinary delivery team with Data Analysts, Snowflake Developers, Data Engineers, Power BI/Fabric Developers and platform specialists.

  

**Requirements (Mandatory)**

**Experience and education**

* At least 2 years of relevant experience delivering AI, ML or advanced analytics solutions, including at least one solution taken from requirements through implementation.
* 4–6 years of professional experience in Data Science, AI/ML Engineering, BI analytics or a similar data-focused role.
* Master's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.
* Fluent spoken and written English (minimum C1 level).

  

**Technical skills**

* Hands-on proficiency in Python and SQL for data preparation, API integration, testing and solution development.
* Strong practical understanding of generative AI application patterns, including RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering and evaluation.
* Practical experience with at least one enterprise AI development platform, preferably Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Snowflake Cortex or Snowflake Intelligence. Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Power BI AI capabilities is an advantage.
* General understanding of classical machine learning concepts. Hands-on experience is an advantage where relevant to the use case.
* Working experience with version control and testing, preferably using GitHub or Azure DevOps. Exposure to CI/CD and deployment processes is an advantage.
* Experience documenting AI solutions and understanding data quality concepts, with attention to data accuracy and consistency.

  

**Ways of working**

* Experience working in an Agile or similar delivery setup.
* Ability to take part in stakeholder discussions and clarify technical, data and AI-specific aspects of documented business requirements.
* Ability to explain technical options, limitations and trade-offs, and to work effectively in a multidisciplinary delivery team.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with analysts and customers and convert documented requirements into practical AI solution components.

  

**Nice to Have / Differentiators**

* Relevant professional certifications, particularly:Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100)Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103)SnowPro Core or GenAI certificationsFabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700)
* Practical experience with Snowflake AI/ML capabilities such as Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst or AI Functions.
* Experience with Azure DevOps for work planning, execution and reporting.
* Experience using SAP and Salesforce enterprise data as inputs to AI/ML solutions.

  

**More About Us**

ABB provides a comprehensive range of integrated automation, electrical and digital systems and services for customers in the process, hybrid and maritime industries. These offerings, coupled with deep domain knowledge in each end market, help to optimize productivity, energy efficiency, sustainability and safety of industrial processes and operations.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

045668e2.title: Solution Architect for Global Partner Card
045668e2.description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title: Solution Architect for Global Partner Card, VP**

**Location: Pune - Magarpatta, India**

**Corporate Title: Vice President**

**Role Description**

* IT (Information Technology) Architects are responsible for a significant segment of the bank's architecture and ensuring it supports overall bank strategy; designing and overseeing the construction of complex IT systems and infrastructure, aligning technology solutions with business goals and requirements.
* Work includes analyzing an organization's needs, evaluating existing systems, and designing comprehensive solutions that meet functional and technical specifications using a deep understanding of one or more various technology domains, such as infrastructure architecture, application development, data platforms, cloud computing, security with the appropriate business domain knowledge.
* They collaborate with stakeholders, including business leaders, project managers, and developers, to gather requirements and translate them into architectural designs; considering factors like scalability, performance, reliability, security, and cost-effectiveness when creating blueprints for IT systems.
* They define architecture principles to guide solution design, develop the target technology estate to support the organization’s business strategies, develop roadmaps to enable transition to the target estate, govern the transition and provide guidance and support throughout the implementation process, ensuring that solutions are built according to architecture principles and align to the roadmaps and organization’s target architecture.
They often act as a bridge between technical teams and business stakeholders, helping to communicate technical concepts in a clear and understandable manner.  

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy

* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end solution architecture for Global Partner Card applications, aligning business requirements and technology decisions with enterprise architecture principles, business priorities and platform modernization goals.
* Define target-state architectures and transition roadmaps for Java and Spring Boot microservices; assess the existing application landscape, identify dependencies and technical debt, and guide phased delivery toward the target estate.
* Translate business and functional requirements into solution designs covering application components, service boundaries, REST API contracts and end-to-end data flows; define integration patterns, versioning and backward compatibility.
* Define Oracle-backed data and persistence architecture, including data models, ownership, transaction boundaries, consistency, access patterns and schema evolution; guide the appropriate use of Spring Data JPA/Hibernate and JDBC.
* Design reliable integrations across card applications, partner systems and shared services; evaluate synchronous REST and asynchronous messaging approaches, including timeouts, retries, circuit breakers and idempotency.
* Embed security and privacy requirements into solution architecture, including Spring Security, authentication, authorization, secrets management, sensitive-data protection and auditability; collaborate with security and control stakeholders to address applicable requirements.
* Lead architecture reviews and maintain solution documentation, architectural decisions, standards and reusable patterns; evaluate technology options and trade-offs, secure required approvals and manage architecture risks and exceptions.
* Define measurable non-functional requirements for scalability, performance, availability, resilience and recoverability; partner with engineering and QA teams to validate architectural assumptions through prototypes and appropriate testing.
* Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams to define deployment and operational architecture, including CI/CD, environment configuration and container or cloud approaches where applicable; balance maintainability, cost and delivery constraints.
* Define observability and operational requirements, including Spring Boot Actuator health checks, metrics, logging, tracing and alerting; ensure application and database designs support agreed service objectives and production diagnostics.
* Provide architectural guidance throughout implementation and review delivered solutions for alignment with approved designs and roadmaps; support production readiness and resolve design-level issues identified through incidents and root-cause analysis.
Partner with business stakeholders, enterprise and domain architects, engineers, QA, operations and vendors to align cross-domain dependencies and communicate architectural decisions; mentor teams and guide resolution of design and delivery trade-offs.  

**Your skills and experience**

* At least 10 years of experience in Java solution design and software development, with demonstrated experience owning end-to-end solution architecture and guiding enterprise application delivery.
* Strong experience translating business requirements into architectural designs, defining target states and transition roadmaps, and evaluating technology trade-offs across scalability, reliability, security, maintainability and cost.
* Deep knowledge of Java, Spring Boot and Spring Framework, supported by practical development experience; ability to assess design patterns, configuration, dependency management and transaction handling, and guide implementation teams.
* Proven experience designing microservices and REST APIs, including service boundaries, API contracts, versioning, backward compatibility and end-to-end integration; ability to evaluate synchronous and asynchronous communication patterns.
* Strong experience with Oracle-backed data architecture, including relational data modeling, data ownership, access patterns, transaction boundaries, consistency and schema evolution; sound knowledge of SQL performance, Spring Data JPA/Hibernate and JDBC.
* Experience incorporating security, privacy and auditability into solution designs, including authentication, authorization, Spring Security, secrets management and sensitive-data protection; ability to work with security and control stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of distributed-system design and measurable non-functional requirements, including performance, availability, resilience and recoverability; experience evaluating failure scenarios, idempotency, retries and circuit breakers.
* Experience leading architecture reviews, documenting architectural decisions and managing design risks, dependencies and exceptions; ability to validate designs through prototypes and testing, and assess alignment with architecture principles and roadmaps.
* Sound knowledge of deployment and operational architecture, including CI/CD, environment configuration, observability and production readiness; familiarity with Spring Boot Actuator, metrics, logging and tracing, and experience resolving design-level production issues.
* Proven ability to influence business and technical stakeholders, collaborate with enterprise and domain architects and vendors, and mentor engineering teams; strong communication skills to explain complex designs, negotiate trade-offs and guide delivery in an Agile environment.
Desirable: experience with cards or payments applications and transaction processing, together with practical exposure to asynchronous messaging, container-based deployment and cloud architecture.  

  

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

**How we’ll support you**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career
* Coaching and support from experts in your team
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs  

  

**About us and our teams**

Please visit our company website for further information:

https://www.db.com/company/company.html

  

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

32ea82ad.title: Senior Professional Services Cloud Architect, Professional Services, ProServe India
32ea82ad.description:
**Description**
Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services (ProServe) is looking for an experienced Senior Professional Services Cloud Architect to join our India team. As a key member of the strategic account team, you will lead technical sales engagements, shape solution architecture, and influence revenue throughout the sales cycle for some of the largest enterprises in Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail.
  
  
You will act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers accelerate their cloud adoption — from migration and modernization to cloud-native applications and emerging technologies such as generative AI and agentic AI. You will create and lead the solution design that delivers each customer's business outcomes. Working as the link between ProServe Account Executives (PAEs) and our Delivery teams, you will make sure proposed solutions are realistic, achievable, and make the best use of ProServe and our partners. We are expanding our teams targeting Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail industry segments in India, and this is a compelling time to join and help shape how these customers build on AWS.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead cloud solution design during pre-sales engagements: run demonstrations, conduct initial scoping, and architect scalable, secure AWS solutions across Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail enterprises.
* Design complex AWS solutions, estimates, and proposals that deliver customer business outcomes, defining project scope and technical approaches for Statements of Work using ProServe offerings and delivery kits.
* Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, and proof-of-concept implementations while advising C-suite and senior technical stakeholders on cloud modernization, generative AI, and agentic AI strategies.
* Ensure smooth hand-offs to Delivery teams so that scope, architecture, and expected outcomes are fully understood at launch, and lead delivery of complex engagements as needed, including migrations, data and analytics, and application development.
* Share knowledge across the organization through mentoring, reusable artifacts, and contributions to ProServe best practices, and represent AWS ProServe at customer events and industry conferences across India.

A day in the life
  
  
You might start your morning reviewing architecture designs for a customer's cloud migration, then join a working session with their engineering team to refine a data warehousing solution. After lunch, you could lead a stakeholder review presenting progress and recommendations to senior executives. Later, you collaborate with partners and internal teams to scope a new engagement, before wrapping up by documenting reusable patterns from a recently completed project to share across the organization.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our ProServe team in {ADDRESS} works with some of the country's largest Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail enterprises to help them realize their cloud ambitions on AWS. You will partner closely with PAEs who own the customer relationship, Delivery teams including Engagement Managers and Delivery Consultants, AWS account teams and Solutions Architects, AWS Specialists including the Generative AI Innovation Center, and AWS Partner Network (APN) partners. Together, this ecosystem turns architectures into measurable customer outcomes.
  
  
As an industry subject matter expert, you will help define cloud operating models, drive strategic enterprise transformation, and set up Cloud Centers of Excellence. We are building an inclusive team culture where knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning are part of everyday work. If you want to help shape how India's largest enterprises innovate with the cloud, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**About AWS**
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience
* 3+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
* Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences in pre-sales environments
* Experience in database (eg. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis)
* Experience communicating technical concepts to diverse audiences in pre-sales environments

**Preferred Qualifications**

* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Associate's degree or above
* Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
* Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders
* Experience with broad enterprise systems work including SAP, Oracle, and custom applications
* Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks (like TOGAF, Zachman) and identifying the relationships between business services, information, applications and global infrastructure assets
* Knowledge of compliance and security standards across the enterprise IT landscape
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Product Management, Customer Service, Operations, Legal, Finance, and Senior Leadership
* Familiarity with the Indian market, digital transformation initiatives (for example Digital India and government cloud policies) and regional compliance requirements (for example RBI, SEBI and IRDAI guidelines, and the DPDP Act)
* Experience designing generative AI, machine learning and data analytics solutions
* Experience with large-scale migration programs (1,000+ servers) using AWS migration tools and methods
* Software development experience in an object-oriented language

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Role Summary**

Lead strategic managed services engagements for enterprise and high-impact Sprinklr CCaaS customers, driving architecture, transformation, and long-term value realization. Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders and shape scalable, future-ready customer service solutions across digital and voice ecosystems.

**Who You Are**

Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.

* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

**We invest in our people**: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. 06764258.title: Cloud Identity Engineer (Microsoft Entra ID)
06764258.description:
About GCA

GCA Technology Services is a managed services provider (MSP) and consultancy that specializes exclusively in Identity and Access Management (IAM). For more than 20 years, we have helped organizations design, run, and improve the systems that control who has access to what. We hire selectively for integrity, passion, and expertise, and we work as a team of experts, not as individuals filling seats. Our work is client-driven: this position is opening to support a new GCA client, and over your tenure you can expect to work with multiple clients.

About the Role

You will own the Microsoft Entra ID platform for GCA's new client, which has a large hybrid Active Directory and Entra environment. As client needs change, you will move between clients. You will work alongside other GCA IAM engineers, and you are expected to lead most technical meetings with client stakeholders while only rarely needing a GCA escalation. You will make informed technical decisions on your own, escalating only when a decision carries material risk or falls outside your authority.

Responsibilities

* Design, configure, and operate Conditional Access, multifactor authentication and authentication methods, Privileged Identity Management, and Identity Protection.

* Onboard and troubleshoot application and single sign-on integrations, app registrations, and enterprise application consent.

* Run access reviews and manage entitlements as part of identity governance.

* Act as the primary technical contact for Entra: gather requirements, recommend designs, and lead working sessions with client stakeholders.

* Follow each client's change management process, and document decisions and configurations.

* Take on tickets, engineering, and project work as directed, across the full range of IAM needs.

* Assist with Active Directory and hybrid identity work when it overlaps with Entra.

Required Qualifications

* 5+ years of hands-on identity engineering experience.

* Hands-on production experience administering Entra ID at enterprise scale (thousands of users), including Conditional Access, MFA, PIM, and Identity Protection.

* SSO integration experience (SAML, OIDC/OAuth), app registrations, and enterprise applications.

* Access reviews, entitlement management, and identity governance fundamentals.

* Able to run requirements and design meetings independently, with clear spoken and written English.

* Sound judgment: makes informed technical decisions independently and escalates only when risk or scope warrants.

* Comfortable working inside a client's change management process and writing clear documentation.

* Hands-on experience rolling out passkeys, FIDO2, and Temporary Access Pass.

* Microsoft SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator) certification or equivalent.

Preferred Qualifications

* HR-driven lifecycle provisioning and joiner, mover, and leaver workflows.

* External and guest identities (B2B and cross-tenant access).

* Device-aware access: hybrid join and Intune compliance signals used in Conditional Access.

* Sign-in and audit log integration with a SIEM, and response to Identity Protection risk events.

* Automation with Microsoft Graph and PowerShell.

* Working knowledge of hybrid identity (Entra Cloud Sync or Entra Connect with Active Directory).

Bonus (Nice to Have)

* Workload identity hygiene (service principals, app secrets and certificates).

* Experience guiding or mentoring other engineers.

Working Arrangement

* Employment: full-time employee (consultant), 40 hours per week.

* Pay: ₹22,00,000 to ₹33,00,000 per year

* Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time. In India this is an evening and overnight shift, about 9:30 PM to 6:30 AM IST (8:30 PM to 5:30 AM during US daylight saving time). Candidates must be able to work this schedule reliably.

* Occasional work outside core hours may be needed for pre-scheduled change windows, arranged in advance.

* Location: remote, based in India.

* Language: fluent spoken and written English. This role works directly with client staff.

* Day-to-day work is directed by GCA and its clients through each client's ticketing system and team meetings.

* Assignment: the current need is driven by a new GCA client. As an MSP and consultancy, GCA expects you to work with multiple clients over your tenure.

Pay: ₹2,200,000.00 - ₹3,300,000.00 per year

Benefits:

Work Location: Remote

0b421d3b.title: Program Manager - POD, Pay on Delivery
0b421d3b.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are the cash people!  
  
Cash / Pay on delivery is the largest instrument of choice by customers on Amazon.in (and in other similar emerging markets where we are expanding) – this despite the rapid advances in digital payments technology space. Customers continue to prefer Pay on Delivery (POD), not only because they want to pay by cash (indeed half of our COD customers pay digitally at doorstep!) – but because it solves many other needs for them – Building trust in the Amazon marketplace, peace of mind to only pay when the item is delivered, and not block money until then, ordering for friends and family who are not digitally savvy etc.  
  
On the other hand, POD also has its down-sides: it leads to low-intent purchases, casual rejects and abuse from some customers, which impacts the sustainability of the instrument. Hence there is a need to continuously shape the POD offering, to make it available for the good customers, while reducing its access to the not-so-good customers, and make it an overall more sustainable business lever for Amazon.  
  
Our mission is to make POD a sustainable and profitable payment instrument for Amazon's flywheel, enabling more and better POD access to all Amazon customers providing a first-class payment experience better or at least at par with prepaid instruments.  
Our vision is to build POD into an APP that enables customers to pay using cash/ digitally at doorstep seamlessly, for physical goods as well as digital services on Amazon as well as external merchants, helping businesses to scale faster and sustainably.  
We work on improving Customer experience and sustainability for POD – across onsite availability and experience, post-order payment experience, doorstep experience, refund experience and managing overall instrument P&L.  
  
This role will work on data mining and analysis for the overall POD area, make business decisions using these insights and enable business to make product/program/business decisions. The individual will also be working on running campaigns to drive POD adoption as well as convert POD customers to Prepaid/Pay customers. The individual will have to interact extensively with other members within the team, across business lines work in partnership with Pay Data Analytics, Machine Learning and Central Customer Analytics teams. The individual will need to get a strong grasp of the business, establish the input/output metrics that will reflect the state of business, develop insights and dashboards to track the same and run programs that drive positive uplift in metrics. The individual will also establish, track and improve POD PnL.  
  
Role Expectations  

* Ability to do exploratory analysis: Fetch data from systems and analyze trends
* Identify consumer segments that need to be actioned to drive adoption of Amazon Pay
* Developing India specific customer segmentation models to improve the efficiency of marketing and financing product roadmap inputs .
* Establishing mechanisms for cross functional teams to consume customer insights to improve engagement along the customer life cycle
* Run campaigns to migrate customers from POD to Prepaid/Pay
* POD PnL: Establish POD PnL and Identify opportunities to increase the bottom-line, increasing revenue and cutting down costs
* Work with cross functional teams

  
About the team  
We will be honest – POD is a challenging area to work on. It has high level of ambiguity, the problem and solution space are both complex, and require patience, resilience and innovative ideas to iterate and figure out what works. It is like choosing to live in the mountains. To meditate. Or run a marathon. Risky, yet rewarding. And something that you need to choose as your “hard”, willingly, and play the long game.  
  
You will be joining a team of such passionate believers – who have chosen to work in this area with a mission to improve the experience for the India that wants to shop on e-commerce using cash, and for those who are yet to trust us to move to a prepaid mode of payment.  
  
You will be required to ideate, research on customer needs/pain points, thoroughly analyze data, generate insights, develop proof of concepts, write compelling business cases and gain agreement from Leaders across levels & functions, to implement the solutions.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience in analyzing data to drive decisions
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3+ years of defining and executing against program timeline & requirements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in complex problem solving, and working in a tight schedule environment
* 3+ years of developing program strategies and plans, diving execution, and influencing senior stakeholders experience
* Experience with scripting (e.g. Python, PowerShell)

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

f365904d.title: Senior Engagement Manager
f365904d.description:
**A career that’s the whole package!**
At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.
  
  
**Conga**
lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.
  
  
Job Title: Sr. Technical Engagement Manager
  
  
Location: Bangalore/Ahmedabad
  
  
Reports to: Manager, Platform Migrations Program
  
  
**A quick snapshot…**
Conga is seeking a Sr. Technical Engagement Manager with 8+ years of experience leading technical SaaS implementations to own the technical delivery of multiple customer implementations of Conga’s Industry leading SAAS products, including Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), Configure, Price and Quote (CPQ), Order Management, & Billing and additional solutions. This is a highly visible role within Conga and to our clients. As the technical lead on each engagement, you will engage directly with customer business and IT stakeholders while collaborating with cross-functional teams, including Product Delivery, Engineering, Product Marketing, Professional Services, Customer Success, Technical Support, and more. At Conga, we thrive on solving complex problems at scale within ambitious timeframes to ensure customer success.
  
  
**Why it’s a big deal…**
This role is mission-critical to Conga, dedicated to ensuring the success of strategic and enterprise customers adopting Conga’s platform. Your work will shape the technical program for migrating these customers to our next-generation platform—including solution design, integrations, data migration, and environment strategy— establishing best practices that all customers will follow. With high visibility to Conga leadership, you will be at the forefront of delivering and supporting enterprise-wide implementations. Your ability to own the full technical delivery lifecycle—from solution design and estimation through build, testing, and go-live—will help build long-lasting relationships with customers and accelerate time-to-value for their solutions. By ensuring successful implementation of the Conga Revenue Lifecycle Platform, you will empower customers to boost productivity, accuracy, consistency, and operational efficiencies—critical elements for their business success.
  
  
**Are you the person we’re looking for?**
**Responsibilities**
**Technical Delivery Expertise-**
You will be responsible for planning, executing, and overseeing the technical delivery of multiple customer projects simultaneously, including solution design reviews, integration architecture, data migration, and release planning. You will ensure that each project is delivered on time, within scope and budget, while creating a scalable and reproducible rollout framework for strategic and enterprise implementations. With 8+ years of experience in technical project or delivery management, you are well-versed in SaaS (Software-as-a-Service) implementations and the nuances of configuring, customizing, and integrating the product to work for customers. You possess extensive knowledge of tools like Jira, Confluence, and MS Office, along with the following technical experience:
  
  

* Hands on involvement with CPQ/CLM/CRM solutions is mandatory (any one), along with involvement in product implementations.
* Experience in preparing and reviewing the estimations for the implementations involving configuration and customization for customer-specific use cases.
* Working knowledge of the Salesforce platform (data model, flows, Apex, security model) and how Conga solutions extend it.
* Experience with integrations between CRM and ERP/billing systems using REST/SOAP APIs and middleware (e.g., MuleSoft, Boomi).
* Understanding of data migration, environment/sandbox strategy, and release and deployment practices (CI/CD).
* Ability to lead technical discussions with customer architects and translate business requirements into solution designs and user stories.

**Champion the Customer**
. You recognize that customers are one of the company’s most valuable assets. With more than 11,000 customers worldwide, Conga is committed to their success—and so are you. We want to know how your dedication and expertise will enhance the experience of our strategic and enterprise customers as they adopt our platform.
  
  
**Key Skills And Experience Needed**

* Strong end-to-end project ownership and proven track record of successfully delivering results
* On-time and effective stakeholder management
* Flexibility to work with global teams across IN, EMEA and US

**Strong communication and interpersonal skills.**
You’re not just comfortable engaging in collaborative discussions, but initiating them, too. You are skilled at reading and adapting to different communication styles. When you speak you are clear and concise. Your strong listening skills foster connection with our clients and allows you to accurately collect the right information so you can resolve issues in the most expedient way. You will be the primary point of contact for early adopters, translating complex technical topics for both business and technical audiences and providing them with information, updates, and support throughout the program. Clear and effective communication is crucial to ensure participants understand their role, responsibilities, and the program's benefits.
  
  
**Time.**
Willingness to understand you will be working with a global team/customer base. This means you know you may not necessarily be working “9 to 5” but are willing take a call either early in the morning or late in the evening to accommodate your global team members.
  
  
**Here’s What Will Give You An Edge…**
Technical Problem Solving. You should be able to have some level of technical knowledge to better understand the issues alongside the Project Team, Engineering and Support, think on your feet, and pivot easily when things need to change or move in a different direction in order to make our early adopters successful. You should be able to be innovative with finding new and creative solutions for problems we haven’t run into before.
  
  
**Relationship Building**
. As the technical engagement lead, you will foster strong relationships with early adopters, acting as a liaison between them and the internal teams. Building rapport, addressing concerns, and ensuring a positive experience for participants will help drive engagement and retention.
  
  
**Experience And Certifications**

* Previous experience with Configure Price Quote (CPQ) and Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) technologies is essential, especially with exposure to Conga products.
* Industry certifications like Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Salesforce (Administrator, Platform App Builder), Conga product certifications, or similar credentials will set you apart.

**Did we pique your interest?**
If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. We'd love to hear from you!
  
  
**Preferred Resume Format**
We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly.
  
  
**Don’t meet every requirement for the role?**


Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We understand interviewing can be stressful for those with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to allow you to show us your best self, please let your recruiter know as soon as possible. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Conga is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complimentary.
  
  
**Conga's Applicant Privacy Statement**
The information you provide during the application process will be used in accordance with Conga’s Applicant Privacy Statement (https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement). By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined in this privacy statement.

d2a45bdc.title: Sr Technical Program Manager, Amazon Business, Private Brand, Recommerce
d2a45bdc.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon is reinventing how organizations of every size buy, sell, and recover value — and Amazon India is on a fast-growing trajectory across three businesses: Amazon Business, Private Brands, and ReCommerce. That growth depends on one thing: India rapidly adopting the tools, platforms, and AI capabilities being built across the company, rather than rebuilding them. We are hiring a Seattle-based Senior Technical Program Manager to own that mission end to end.  
  
In this high-visibility role, you will be the single owner of capability alignment between India and the global teams that build Amazon's products, spanning Amazon Business, Private Brands, and ReCommerce. Sitting at the interface between India's businesses and the teams that build the roadmaps, you will ensure India is represented when new capabilities are designed, maintain a single view of capability adoption across all three lines of business, sequence the cross-organizational dependencies , and advocate for India's priorities in global planning.  
  
This is a rare front-row seat; You will work hand-in-hand with the teams building Amazon's newest business models and agentic AI products — from enterprise procurement and conversational commerce to intelligent, automated operations — gaining exposure to latest technology and go-to-market approaches before they scale, and shaping how they reach one of Amazon's most important growth markets.  
  
If you excel at influence without authority, thrive across organizational and geographic boundaries, and want a strategic mandate with executive visibility at the leading edge of Amazon's fastest-growing businesses, this role is for you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Own the capability-inclusion mechanism: Represent India in global product planning, requirements, and design reviews from the outset — converting today's informal, ad-hoc process into a governed, repeatable intake across all three businesses.  
  
Run a single view of capability adoption: Maintain source of truth for the full portfolio of tracked capabilities across the three businesses, with dependency maps and effort sizing, and represent it in global planning and review forums.  
  
Sequence cross-team dependencies: Untangle the multi-team dependency chains that cause launches to slip, coordinating across engineering, product, finance/compliance, and operations teams.  
  
Negotiate funding and execution ownership for India-specific customization work, including the last-mile localization required to bring global capabilities to market in India.  
  
Advocate for India's priorities in global planning, escalating structural blockers to the right leaders with clear, data-backed cases — particularly where India is deprioritized despite its strategic value.  
  
Establish the baseline and reporting that measure adoption progress and inform how the function scales over time.  
  
Partner deeply with the teams building Amazon's newest products and business models, ensuring India's needs are reflected early and that new capabilities reach the market efficiently.  
  
A day in the life  
You start your morning with AI as your co-pilot — using Amazon's internal generative-AI tools to scan overnight changes across the global product roadmaps for all three businesses, summarize what moved, and surface the handful of new capabilities where India isn't yet in the design conversation. What used to take an analyst days, you triage before your first meeting.  
  
Mid-morning, you join a working session with a product team building one of Amazon's newest AI-powered capabilities, aligning India into their next release so the market isn't left to catch up later. You then prepare for the executive review you own — a recurring leadership forum where you present the single view of capability adoption across the three businesses, call out risks and dependencies, and drive decisions with senior leaders on what India needs and when.  
  
In the afternoon, you unblock a stalled dependency: a global capability that needs a market-specific compliance change before India can adopt it. You get the owning teams and India's tech lead aligned on sequencing and funding, turning a multi-quarter stall into a committed plan. Alongside the day-to-day, you're steering the India launch of a multi-million-dollar product — coordinating engineering, finance, and operations across two continents to bring a capability to one of Amazon's most important growth markets.  
  
You close the day the way you opened it — with AI doing the heavy lifting: drafting an escalation, modeling a dependency sequence, and building the data-backed case for why a high-value capability should reach India sooner. You are not just adopting Amazon's AI tools; you are living at the frontier of how they change the way work gets done.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The ideal candidate will combine strong program leadership, deep understanding of business processes (particularly in the diagnostics industry), and broad technical expertise across modern data platforms, data engineering, analytics and emerging AI technologies. Key

Responsibilities Program & Delivery Leadership

* Lead multiple strategic data and digital transformation programs end to end, ensuring alignment with business objectives, delivery commitments and measurable outcomes.
* Lead and develop large, multidisciplinary teams comprising data engineers, data architects, BI developers, data scientists and data governance specialists.
